3031.gl: [stout]; one of the 3 sons of abi-etam, a descendant of judah

3032.gl: (v) (qal) to throw lots, cast lots; (n) love, loving-one, friend
3032.gi: propriamente, maneggiare, cioè lanciare, ad esempio, sorti

3033.g: properly, affection; concretely, a darling object
3033.gl: one dearly loved, beloved one, object of love
3033.gi: propriamente, affetto; concretamente, un oggetto caro

3034.g: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
3034.gl: to throw, shoot, cast; (qal) to shoot (arrows); (piel) to cast, cast down, throw down; (hiphil); to give thanks,, laud, praise; to confess, confess (the name of god); (hithpael); to confess (sin); to give thanks
3034.gi: fisicamente, lanciare (una pietra, una freccia) contro o via; specialmente riverire o adorare (con le mani tese); intensivamente, lamentarsi (torcendo le mani)

3035.gl: [timely, lovely]; son of zechariah, ruler of the tribe of manasseh east of the jordan in the time of david; a man who took a foreign wife in the time of ezra

3036.gl: [thankful]; a meronothite and one of the builders of the walls of jerusalem

3037.g: jaddua, the name of two israelites
3037.gl: [knowing]; one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant with nehemiah; son and successor in the high priesthood of jonathan, jeshua, or johanan; the last of the high priests mentioned in the old testament, probably living in the time of alexander the great
3037.gi: Jaddua, il nome di due israeliti

3038.gl: [praising]; a levite of the family of merari and the chief of one of the 3 choirs of the temple whose descendants also formed one of the perpetual temple choirs; he is named at the beginning of 3 psalms (39, 62, 77) either as the composer or the recipient of those psalms but most likely as the leader of the choir by which those psalms were to be sung

3040.gl: [beloved]; the wife of king amon and mother of king josiah

3041.gl: [beloved of jehovah]; the name given to solomon through nathan the prophet

3042.g: jedajah, the name of two israelites
3042.gl: [praised of jehovah]; a simeonite, forefather of ziza; son of harumaph and one who took part in rebuilding the walls of jerusalem
3042.gi: jedajah, il nome di due israeliti

3043.g: jediael, the name of three israelites
3043.gl: [god makes known]; a chief patriarch of the tribe of benjamin; maybe the same as 'ashbel'; the 2nd son of meshelemiah and a korahite gatekeeper; son of shimri and one of david's mighty warriors; one of the chiefs of the thousands of manasseh who joined david on his march to ziklag; maybe the same man as 3 above
3043.gi: jediael, il nome di tre israeliti

3045.g: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
3045.gl: to know; (qal); to know; to know, learn to know; to perceive; to perceive and see, find out and discern; to discriminate, distinguish; to know by experience; to recognize, admit, acknowledge, confess; to consider; to know, be acquainted with; to know (a person carnally); to know how, be skilful in; to have knowledge, be wise; (niphal); to be made known, be or become known, be revealed; to make oneself known; to be perceived; to be instructed; (piel) to cause to know; (poal) to cause to know; (pual); to be known; known, one known, acquaintance (participle); (hiphil) to make known, declare; (hophal) to be made known; (hithpael) to make oneself known, reveal oneself
3045.gi: sapere (propriamente, accertare vedendo); usato in una grande varietà di sensi, figurato, letteralmente, eufemisticamente e per inferenza (incluso osservazione, cura, riconoscimento; e causalmente, istruzione, designazione, punizione, ecc.)

3046.gl: to know; (p'al) to know; (aphel) to let someone know, communicate, inform, cause to know

3047.gl: [he knows]; a judahite, son of onam and brother of shammai, in the genealogy of the sons of jerahmeel by his wife atarah

3048.g: jedajah, the name of two israelites
3048.gl: [jehovah has known]; a priest in jerusalem; a man who returned with zerubbabel; a ruler of the priests in the days of jeshua; a post exilic priest; one honored by jehovah, perhaps one of the above
3048.gi: jedajah, il nome di due israeliti

3049.g: properly, a knowing one; specifically, a conjurer; (by impl) a ghost
3049.gl: a knower, one who has a familiar spirit; a familiar spirit, soothsayer, necromancer (metonymy)
3049.gi: propriamente, uno che sa; specificamente, un incantatore; (per impl) un fantasma

3050.gl: jah (the shortened form of "jehovah"); the proper name of the one true god; used in many compounds; names beginning with the letters 'je'; names ending with 'iah' or 'jah'

3051.g: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come
3051.gl: to give, provide, ascribe, come; (qal); to give; to set, place; to provide (with reflexive); to ascribe (glory); to grant, permit, come now
3051.gi: dare (sia letterale che figurato); generalmente, porre; imperativamente (riflessivo) vieni

3052.g: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come
3052.gl: to give, provide; (p'al); to give; to place, lay (foundations); (hithp'al); to be given; to be paid
3052.gi: dare (sia letterale che figurato); generalmente, porre; imperativamente (riflessivo) vieni

3053.g: properly, what is given (by providence), i.e., a lot
3053.gi: propriamente, ciò che è dato (da provvidenza), cioè, un sorteggio

3054.gl: (hithpael) to become a jew (in fact or in fraud), become judaised

3055.gl: [beauty]; a town in dan, located between baalath and bene-berak and 8 miles east of joppa

3056.gl: one of the family of caleb

3057.gl: [jewess]; (adj f) the jewess; (n pr f) the wife of ezra the calebite

3058.g: jehu, the name of five israelites
3058.gl: [jehovah is he]; the king of the northern kingdom israel who overthrew the dynasty of omri; son of hanani and an israelite prophet in the time of baasha and jehoshaphat; the antothite, a benjamite, one of david's mighty warriors; a descendant of judah of the house of hezron; son of josibiah and a chief of the tribe of simeon
3058.gi: jehu, il nome di cinque israeliti

3059.g: jehoachaz, the name of three israelites
3059.gl: [jehovah has seized]; a king of judah and son of josiah; a king of the northern kingdom of israel and son of jehu; a king of judah and son of jehoram (ahaziah)
3059.gi: jehoachaz, il nome di tre israeliti

3060.g: jehoash, the name of two israelite kings
3060.gl: [given by the lord]; son of king ahaziah and the 8th king of judah; son of king jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of israel
3060.gi: jehoash, il nome di due re israeliti

3061.gl: judahthe territory of the tribe of judah

3063.g: jehudah (or judah), the name of five israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
3063.gl: [praised]; the son of jacob by leah; the tribe descended from judah the son of jacob; the territory occupied by the tribe of judah; the kingdom comprised of the tribes of judah and benjamin which occupied the southern part of canaan after the nation split upon the death of solomon; a levite in ezra's time; an overseer of jerusalem in the time of nehemiah; a levite musician in the time of nehemiah; a priest in the time of nehemiah
3063.gi: Giuda (o Jehuda), nome di cinque israeliti; anche della tribù discesa dal primo, e del suo territorio

3064.g: a jehudite (i.e., judaite or jew), or descendant of jehudah (i.e., judah)
3064.gi: un giudeo (cioè giudaico o ebreo), o discendente di Giuda (cioè Jehuda)

3065.gl: [jew]; son of nethaniah and servant of king jehoiakim

3066.gl: in the jewish language, in hebrew

3067.gl: [jewess, praised]; the daughter of beeri the hittite and wife of esau

3068.g: (the) self-existent or eternal; jeho-vah, jewish national name of god
3068.gl: [the existing one]; the proper name of the one true god; unpronounced except with the vowel pointings of h0136
3068.gi: (il) sé-esistente o eterno; JHVH, nome nazionale ebraico di Dio

3069.gl: jehovahused primarily in the combination 'lord jehovah'; equal to h3068 but pointed with the vowels of h0430

3070.g: jehovah-jireh, a symbolical name for mount moriah
3070.gl: [jehovah sees]; symbolic name given by abraham to mount moriah in commemoration of the interposition of the angel of jehovah who prevented the sacrifice of isaac and provided a substitute
3070.gi: Jehovah-jireh, nome simbolico per il monte Moria

3071.g: jehovah-nissi, a symbolical name of an altar in the desert
3071.gl: [jehovah is my banner]; the name given by moses to the altar which he built in commemoration of the discomfiture of the amalekites
3071.gi: Jehovah-nissi, nome simbolico di un altare nel deserto

3072.g: jehovah-tsidkenu, a symbolical epithet of the messiah and of jerusalem
3072.gl: [jehovah is our righteousness]; a sacred name symbolically applied to jerusalem and the messiah
3072.gi: Jehovah-tsidkenu, epiteto simbolico del Messia e di Gerusalemme

3073.g: jehovah-shalom, a symbolical name of an altar in palestine
3073.gl: [jehovah is peace]; the name of a sacred altar built by gideon in ophrah
3073.gi: Jehovah-shalom, nome simbolico di un altare in Palestina

3074.g: jehovah-shammah, a symbolic title of jerusalem
3074.gl: [jehovah is there]; a symbolic name for jerusalem

3075.g: jehozabad, the name of three israelites
3075.gl: [jehovah has endowed]; son of shomer, a moabitish woman, who murdered joash, king of judah; a benjamite, captain of 180,000 armed men, in the days of jehoshaphat; a korhite levite, 2nd son of obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of david

3076.g: jehochanan, the name of eight israelites
3076.gl: [jehovah has graced]; a priest during the high priesthood of joiakim who returned with zerubbabel; a high priest in the time of ezra; a levite priest who took part in the dedication of the wall in the time of nehemiah; son of tobiah; a korhite levite and one of the doorkeepers to the tabernacle in the time of david; a captain of judah under king jehoshaphat; an ephraimite; an israelite with a foreign wife in the time of ezra; a jewish captain after the fall of jerusalem; the eldest son of king josiah; a post-exilic prince of the line of david; father of azariah, priest in solomon's time; a benjamite, one of david's mighty warriors; a gadite, one of david's mighty warriors; a returning exile

3077.g: jehojada, the name of three israelites
3077.gl: [jehovah knows]; father of benaiah, david's mighty warrior; leader of the priests who joined david at hebron; high priest at the time of athaliah's usurpation of the throne of judah; hid joash, the king's son, for six years and eventually replaced him on the throne of judah; second priest, or sagan, to seraiah the high priest

3078.gl: [jehovah establishes]; king of judah, son of jehoiakim, and the next to last king of judah before the babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to nebuchadnezzar who took him to babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released

3079.gl: [jehovah raises up]; son of josiah and the third from the last king of judah; subject vassel of nebuchadnezzar who reigned for 11 years before he died a violent death either in combat or by the hands of his own subjects

3080.g: jehojarib, the name of two israelites
3080.gl: [jehovah contends]; a priest in jerusalem; the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in david's time

3081.gl: [jehovah is able]; a son of shelemiah and a servant of king zedekiah whom he sent to jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice

3082.g: jehonadab, the name of an israelite and of an arab
3082.gl: [jehovah is willing]; a son of rechab, chief of the rechabites, in the time of jehu and ahab; a nephew of david
3082.gi: Jehonadab, nome di un israelita e di un arabo

3083.g: jehonathan, the name of four israelites
3083.gl: [jehovah has given]; a son of king saul and a friend of david; a son of the high priest abiathar and the last descendant of eli of whom we hear; a nephew of david who like david slew a giant of gath; an uncle of david; one of david's mighty warriors; one of david's treasurers; a scribe in the time of jeremiah; a levite and father of zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall; a son or descendant of gershom, the son of moses, and a priest to the tribe of dan; a son of kareah and a brother of johanan; a judaite captain after the fall of jerusalem; another judaite father of peleth; father of ebed in the time of ezra; son of asahel in the time of ezra; a priest of the family of melicu in the time of nehemiah; son of joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of nehemiah

3084.g: jehoseph (i.e., joseph), a son of jacob
3084.gl: [jehovah has added]; the eldest son of jacob by rachel

3085.gl: [jehovah has adorned]; a descendant of saul through jonathan

3086.gl: [jehovah delights]; wife of king joash and mother of king amaziah of judah

3087.gl: [jehovah is righteous]; grandson of the high priest hilkiah; son of the high priest seraiah; and father of the high priest joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to babylon by nebuchadnezzar

3088.g: jehoram, the name of a syrian and of three israelites
3088.gl: [jehovah is exalted]; son of king jehoshaphat of judah and himself king of judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of judah to the worship of baal; son of king ahab of the northern kingdom of israel and king of israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of elijah to the very letter; a priest in the reign of jehoshaphat
3088.gi: Jehoram, nome di un siriano e di tre israeliti

3089.gl: [jehovah has sworn]; daughter of king joram of judah and wife of the high priest jehoiada; alternate spelling 'jehoshabeath'

3090.gl: [jehovah is an oath]; daughter of king joram of judah and wife of the high priest jehoiada; alternate spelling 'jehosheba

3091.gl: [jehovah is salvation]; (n pr m) son of nun of the tribe of ephraim and successor to moses as the leader of the children of israel; led the conquest of canaan; a resident of beth-shemesh on whose land the ark of the covenant came to a stop after the philistines returned it; son of jehozadak and high priest after the restoration; governor of jerusalem under king josiah who gave his name to a gate of the city of jerusalem

3092.g: jehoshaphat, the name of six israelites; also of a valley near jerusalem
3092.gl: [jehovah has judged]; (n pr m) son of king asa and himself king of judah for 25 years; one of the best, most pious, and prosperous kings of judah; son of nimshi and father of king jehu of the northern kingdom of israel; son of ahilud and chronicler under david and solomon; son of paruah and one of the 12 commissary officers under solomon; a priest and trumpeter in the time of david; (n pr loc) symbolical name of a valley near jerusalem which is the place of ultimate judgment; maybe the deep ravine which separates jerusalem from the mount of olives through which the kidron flowed
3092.gi: Jehoshaphat, nome di sei israeliti; anche di una valle vicino a Gerusalemme

3094.g: jehallelel, the name of two israelites
3094.gl: [god is praised]; a calebite descendant of judah; father of azariah and a merarite levite in the time of hezekiah

3095.gl: a precious stone (known for its hardness); perhaps the jasper, onyx, or diamond

3096.g: jahats or jahtsah, a place east of the jordan
3096.gl: [trodden down]; a place in reuben east of the dead sea where israel defeated sihon king of the amorites; site uncertain
3096.gi: Jahats o Jahtsah, un luogo ad est del Giordano

3097.g: joab, the name of three israelites
3097.gl: [jehovah is father]; son of david's sister zeruiah and general of david's army; a judaite descendant of kenaz; a post exilic family

3098.g: joach, the name of four israelites
3098.gl: [jehovah is brother]; son of asaph and chronicler to hezekiah; a gershonite son or grandson of zimmah; a korhite, 3rd son of obed-edom and doorkeeper in the time of david; son of joahaz and chronicler to king josiah

3099.g: joachaz, the name of two israelites
3099.gl: [jehovah has grasped]; the father of joah, josiah's chronicler

3100.g: joel, the name of twelve israelites
3100.gl: [jehovah is god]; son of pethuel and the 2nd of the 12 minor prophets with a book by his name; probably prophesied in the time of king uzziah of judah; eldest son of samuel the prophet and father of heman the singer; a simeonite chief; a reubenite; a chief of gad; son of izrahiah and a chief of issachar; brother of nathan of zobah and one of david's mighty warriors; son of pedaiah and a chief of the half tribe of manasseh west of the jordan in the time of david; a son of nebo who returned with ezra and had a foreign wife; a benjamite, son of zichri; a levite; a kohathite levite in the reign of hezekiah; a gershonite levite chief in the time of david; a gershonite levite, son of jehiel and a descendant of laadan; maybe same as 13

3101.g: joash, the name of six israelites
3101.gl: [given by the lord]; son of king ahaziah and the 8th king of judah; son of king jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of israel; father of gideon; a son of king ahab; a descendant of shelah the son of judah; either the son of shelah or the son of jokim; son of shemaah of gibeah who resorted to david at ziklag

3102.gl: [persecuted]; the 3rd son of issachar also called 'jashub'

3103.g: jobab, the name of two israelites and of three foreigners
3103.gl: [a desert]; the last in order of the sons of joktan, a descendant of shem; one of the kings of edom; the king of madon, located in northern canaan, and one of the kings who opposed joshua during the conquest and who were routed at meron; head of a benjamite house; another benjamite
3103.gi: Jobab, il nome di due israeliti e di tre stranieri

3104.g: the blast of a horn (from its continuous sound); specifically, the signal of the silver trumpets; hence, the instrument itself and the festival thus introduced
3104.gl: ram, ram's horn, trumpet, cornet; ram (only in combination); ram's horn, trumpet; jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (metonymy)
3104.gi: il suono di un corno (dal suo suono continuo); specificamente, il segnale delle trombe d'argento; di conseguenza, lo strumento stesso e il festival così introdotto

3106.gl: [stream]; the son of lamech by adah and the inventor of musical instruments

3107.g: jozabad, the name of ten israelites
3107.gl: [jehovah has endowed]; a korhite levite, 2nd son of obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of david; one of david's mighty warriors; another of david's mighty warriors; four other priests or levites
3107.gi: Jozabad, il nome di dieci israeliti

3108.gl: [jehovah remembers]; a servant of king joash of judah and one of his murderers; also called 'zabad'

3109.g: jocha, the name of two israelites
3109.gl: [jehovah gives life]; one of the sons of beriah the benjamite; the tizite, one of david's mighty warriors
3109.gi: Jocha, il nome di due israeliti

3110.g: jochanan, the name of nine israelites
3110.gl: [jehovah has graced]; a priest during the high priesthood of joiakim who returned with zerubbabel; a jewish captain after the fall of jerusalem; the eldest son of king josiah; a post-exilic prince of the line of david; father of azariah, priest in solomon's time; a benjamite, one of david's mighty warriors; a gadite, one of david's mighty warriors; a returning exile
3110.gi: Jochanan, il nome di nove israeliti

3111.g: jojada, the name of two israelites
3111.gl: [jehovah knows]; son of paseah, who assisted to repair the old gate of jerusalem; son of the high priest eliashib in the time of nehemiah
3111.gi: Jojada, il nome di due israeliti

3112.gl: [jehovah establishes]; king of judah, son of jehoiakim, and the next to last king of judah before the babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to nebuchadnezzar who took him to babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released

3113.gl: [jehovah raises up]; a priest and son of jeshua the high priest

3114.g: jojarib, the name of four israelites
3114.gl: [jehovah contends]; the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in david's time; a teacher in the time of ezra; a judaite in the time of nehemiah
3114.gi: Joarib, il nome di quattro israeliti

3115.gl: [jehovah is glory]; the daughter of levi, wife and at the same time aunt of amram, and the mother of moses, aaron, and miriam

3116.gl: [jehovah is able]; a son of shelemiah and a servant of king zedekiah whom he sent to jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice

3117.g: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
3117.gl: day, time, year; day (as opposed to night); day (24 hour period); as defined by evening and morning in genesis 1; as a division of time; a working day, a day's journey; days, lifetime (pl.); time, period (generally); year; temporal references; today; yesterday; tomorrow
3117.gi: un giorno (come le ore calde), sia letterale (dall'alba al tramonto, o da un tramonto al successivo), o figurato (uno spazio di tempo definito da un termine associato), (spesso usato avverbialmente)

3118.gl: time; day (always refers to a twenty-four hour period when the word is modified by a definite or cardinal number)

3119.gl: (adv) by day, in the daytime; (subst) daytime

3120.g: javan, the name of a son of joktan, and of the race (ionians, i.e., greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in arabia
3120.gl: [ionia, greece]; (n pr m) a son of japheth and grandson of noah; (n pr loc) greece, ionia, ionians; location of descendants of javan
3120.gi: Javan, il nome di un figlio di Joktan, e della razza (ioni, cioè greci) discendente da lui, con il loro territorio; anche di un luogo in Arabia

3121.gi: propriamente, i fondimenti (come effervescente); di conseguenza, fango

3122.g: jonadab, the name of an israelite and of a rechabite
3122.gl: [jehovah is willing]; a son of rechab, chief of the rechabites, in the time of jehu and ahab; a nephew of david
3122.gi: jonadab, nome di un israelita e di un recabita

3123.g: a dove (apparently from the warmth of their mating)
3123.gi: una colomba (apparentemente dal calore del loro accoppiamento)

3124.gl: [dove]; son of amittai and a native of gath-hepher; 5th of the minor prophets who prophesied during the reign of jeroboam ii and whom god sent also to prophecy to nineveh

3125.g: a jevanite, or descendant of javan
3125.gi: un gianita, o discendente di gavàn

3126.g: a sucker; hence, a twig (of a tree felled and sprouting)
3126.gi: un pollone; quindi, un rametto (di un albero abbattuto che germoglia)

3128.g: dove of (the) silence (i.e., dumb israel) of (i.e., among) distances (i.e., strangers); the title of a ditty (used for a name of its melody)
3128.gl: [the silent dove of far-off places]; meaning uncertain; probably name of melody; only used in title of psalm 56
3128.gi: colomba del (del) silenzio (cioè israele muto) di (cioè tra) distanze (cioè tra stranieri); il titolo di una canzoncina (usata come nome della sua melodia)

3129.g: jonathan, the name of ten israelites
3129.gl: [jehovah has given]; a son of king saul and a friend of david; a son of the high priest abiathar and the last descendant of eli of whom we hear; one of david's mighty warriors; a levite and father of zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall; a son of kareah and a brother of johanan; a judaite captain after the fall of jerusalem; another judaite; father of ebed in the time of ezra; son of asahel in the time of ezra; a priest of the family of melicu in the time of nehemiah; son of joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of nehemiah

3130.g: joseph, the name of seven israelites
3130.gl: [jehovah has added]; the eldest son of jacob by rachel; father of igal, who represented the tribe of issachar among the spies; a son of asaph; a man who took a foreign wife in the time of ezra; a priest of the family of shebaniah in the time of nehemiah

3131.gl: [jehovah adds]; father or ancestor of shelomith who returned with ezra

3132.gl: [may he avail]; son of jeroham of gedor and one of david's mighty warriors

3133.gl: [jehovah is witness]; a benjamite, son of pedaiah

3134.gl: [jehovah is help]; a korhite, one of david's mighty warriors who joined him at ziklag

3135.g: joash, the name of two israelites
3135.gl: [jehovah hastens]; a benjamite, son of becher; one of the officers in david's court

3136.gl: [jehovah is righteous]; grandson of the high priest hilkiah; son of the high priest seraiah; and father of the high priest joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to babylon by nebuchadnezzar

3137.gl: [jehovah raises up]; a descendant of judah

3138.g: sprinkling; hence, a sprinkling (or autumnal showers)
3138.gl: early rain, autumn shower; rain which falls in palestine from late october until early december

3139.gl: [he instructs]; the head or ancestor of a family who returned from babylon with ezra

3140.gl: [jehovah has taught me]; one of the gadites dwelling at gilead in bashan in the reign of king jotham of judah

3141.g: joram, the name of three israelites and one syrian
3141.gl: [jehovah is exalted]; son of king jehoshaphat of judah and himself king of judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of judah to the worship of baal; son of king ahab of the northern kingdom of israel and king of israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of elijah to the very letter; a levite in the time of david and an ancestor of shelomith; son of toi, king of hamath
3141.gi: ioràm, nome di tre israeliti e di un siriano

3142.gl: [whose love is returned]; son of zerubbabel

3143.gl: [jehovah causes to dwell]; a simeonite, father of jehu

3144.gl: [jehovah makes equal]; a prince of the house of simeon

3145.gl: [jehovah makes equal]; son of elnaam and one of david's mighty warriors

3146.gl: [jehovah judges]; (n pr m) one of david's mighty warriors; a priest and trumpeter in the time of david

3147.g: jotham, the name of three israelites
3147.gl: [jehovah is perfect]; son of king uzziah of judah by jerushah; king of judah for 16 years and contemporary with isaiah and king pekah of israel; son of jahdai and a descendant of caleb and judah; youngest son of gideon who escaped from the massacre of his brothers
3147.gi: jotham, il nome di tre israeliti

3148.g: properly, redundant; hence, over and above, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjunction
3148.gl: (n m) superiority, advantage, excess; (adv) excess, better; (conj) besides, moreover, more

3150.gl: [jehovah sprinkles]; a descendant of parosh who took a foreign wife in the time of ezra

3151.gl: [he makes prominent]; a hagarite, officer of david in charge of the flocks

3152.gl: [whom god will preserve]; a benjamite of the sons of elpaal

3153.gl: [jehovah has listened]; son of hoshaiah the maachathite and one of the captains who escaped from jerusalem during the last siege of the babylonians; one of the first to return to gedaliah at mizpah where he took a prominent part after the assassination of gedaliah

3154.g: sweat, i.e., (by implication) a sweating dress
3154.gi: sudore, cioè (per implicazione) un vestito da sudore

3155.g: a jizrach (i.e., ezrachite or zarchite) or descendant of zerach
3155.gl: [descendant of zerah]; a descendant of zerah of judah
3155.gi: un jizrach (cioè, ezrita o zarchita) o discendente di zerach

3156.g: jizrachjah, the name of two israelites
3156.gl: [jehovah will shine]; a chieftain of issachar; a levite and leader of the chorus at the dedication of the wall of jerusalem under nehemiah
3156.gi: jizrachjah, il nome di due israeliti

3157.g: jizreel, the name of two places in palestine and of two israelites
3157.gl: [god sows]; (n pr m) a descendant of the father or founder of etam of judah; first son of hosea the prophet; (n pr loc) a city in the nekeb of judah; a city in issachar on the northwest spur of mount gilboa

3158.g: a jizreelite or native of jizreel
3158.gl: [sown of god]; an inhabitant of jezreel
3158.gi: un jizreelita o nativo di jizreel

3159.gl: [sown of god]; a female inhabitant of jezreel; used only of ahinoam, a wife of david

3160.gl: [hidden]; a man of asher, son of shomer or shamer of the house of beriah

3162.gl: (n m) union, unitedness; (adv) together, altogether, all together, alike

3163.gl: [his unity]; a gileadite, son of buz and father of jeshishai

3164.gl: [my unity is god]; a chief of manasseh on the east of the jordan

3165.g: jechdijah, the name of two israelites
3165.gl: [jehovah is unity]; a levite in the time of david; a meronothite, officer of david in charge of the she-asses
3165.gi: jechdijah, il nome di due israeliti

3166.g: jachaziel, the name of five israelites
3166.gl: [beheld of god]; a benjamite warrior who joined david at ziklag; a priest in the reign of david who helped move the ark; a kohathite levite, 3rd son of hebron; a levite, son of zechariah, of the sons of asaph, in the reign of jehoshaphat; an ancestor of one of the families who returned from exile with ezra

3167.gl: [jehovah views]; son of tikvah, apparently a priest and leader during the time of ezra

3169.gi: jechizkijah, il nome di cinque israeliti

3170.gl: [whom god leads back]; a priest of the house of immer

3171.g: jechiel (or jechavel), the name of eight israelites
3171.gl: [god lives]; a levite and one of the chief musicians in the time of david; a gershonite levite who had charge of the treasures in the time of david; son of hachmoni and an officer of david and tutor of david's sons; a son of king jehoshaphat of judah put to death by his brother jehoram; hemanite who took part in the restoration of king hezekiah; a levite and overseer in the time of hezekiah; a ruler of the temple during the reforms of josiah; father of obadiah of the sons of joab in the time of ezra; father of shechaniah of the sons of elam in the time of ezra; a son of elam who put away his foreign wife in the time of ezra; a priest of the sons of harim who also had to put away his foreign wife in the time of ezra

3172.g: a jechielite or descendant of jechiel
3172.gl: [god shall save alive, swept away of god]; a gershonite levite of the family of laadan
3172.gi: un jechielita o discendente di jechiel

3173.g: properly, united, i.e., sole; by implication, beloved; also lonely; (feminine) the life (as not to be replaced)

3173.gi: propriamente, unito, cioè unico; per implicazione, amato; anche solitario; (femminile) la vita (come non sostituibile)

3174.gl: [jehovah lives]; doorkeeper of the ark at the time of its establishment in jerusalem

3176.g: to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope

3178.g: a jachleelite or descendant of jachleel

3179.g: probably to be hot; figuratively, to conceive

3181.gl: [whom jehovah guards]; a man of issachar and one of the heads of the family of tola

3183.gl: [god divides]; the 1st of the 4 sons of naphtali and founder of the family of jahzeelites

3184.g: a jachtseelite (collectively) or descendants of jachtseel

3184.gi: un jachseelita (collettivamente) o discendenti di jachseel

3189.g: jachath, the name of four israelites
3189.gl: [he will snatch up]; son of reaiah and grandson of shobal of the tribe of judah; a son of libni and grandson of gershom and great grandson of levi; a gershonite levite; the eldest son of shimei and the grandson of laadan; founder of the house of jahath; a levite and son of shelomoth; a merarite levite in the reign of josiah

3190.g: to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right)
3190.gl: to be good, be pleasing, be well, be glad; (qal); to be glad, be joyful; to be well placed; to be well for, be well with, go well with; to be pleasing, be pleasing to; (hiphil); to make glad, rejoice; to do good to, deal well with; to do well, do thoroughly; to make a thing good or right or beautiful; to do well, do right

3191.g: to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right)
3191.gl: (p'al) to be good, do good, be pleasing
3191.gi: rendere (causativo) bene, letteralmente (sano, bello) o figurato (felice, prospero, giusto)

3192.gl: [pleasing]; a city in judah, hometown of meshullemeth, wife of king manasseh; site unknown

3193.g: jotbathah, a place in the desert
3193.gl: [pleasantness]; a stopping place in the wilderness; site unknown

3194.g: juttah (or jutah), a place in palestine
3194.gl: [stretched out]; a town in the mountains of judah, in the neighbourhood of maon and carmel; modern 'yutta'
3194.gi: jutta (o jutta), un luogo in Palestina

3195.gl: [enclosed]; a son of ishmael whose descendants warred with israel east of the jordan; also called 'ituraea'

3198.g: to be right (i.e., correct); reciprocal, to argue; causatively, to decide, justify or convict
3198.gl: to prove, decide, judge, rebuke, reprove, correct, be right; (hiphil); to decide, judge; to adjudge, appoint; to show to be right, prove; to convince, convict; to reprove, chide; to correct, rebuke; (hophal) to be chastened; (niphal) to reason, reason together; (hithp) to argue
3198.gi: essere giusto (cioè, corretto); reciprocamente, discutere; causalmente, decidere, giustificare o condannare

3199.g: jakin, the name of three israelites and of a temple pillar
3199.gl: [he will establish]; (n pr m) the 4th son of simeon and founder of the family of jachinites; a priest and the head of the 21st course in the time of david; a post-exilic priest in the time of nehemiah; (n pr) name of the right-hand pillar before the temple
3199.gi: jakin, il nome di tre israeliti e di una colonna del tempio

3200.g: a jakinite (collectively) or descendants of jakin
3200.gl: [he will establish]; the descendants of jachin
3200.gi: un jakinita (collettivamente) o discendenti di jakin

3201.g: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
3201.gl: to prevail, overcome, endure, have power, be able; (qal); to be able, be able to gain or accomplish, be able to endure, be able to reach; to prevail, prevail over or against, overcome, be victor; to have ability, have strength

3202.g: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)

3202.gi: potere, letteralmente (può, poteva) o moralmente (può, potrebbe)

3203.gl: [jehovah is able]; wife of king amaziah of judah and mother of king uzziah (azariah)

3204.gl: [jehovah will establish]; son of king jehoiakim of judah and king of judah for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to nebuchadnezzar and was taken captive to babylon where he was imprisoned for the next 36 years; released at the death of nebuchadnezzar and lived in babylon until his death; primary spelling 'jehoiachin'

3205.g: to bear young; causatively, to beget; medically, to act as midwife; specifically, to show lineage
3205.gl: to bear, bring forth, beget, gender, travail; (qal); to bear, bring forth; of child birth; of distress (simile); of wicked (behavior); to beget; (niphal) to be born; (piel); to cause or help to bring forth; to assist or tend as a midwife; midwife (participle); (pual) to be born; (hiphil); to beget (a child); to bear (figurative for wicked bringing forth iniquity); (hophal) day of birth, birthday (infinitive); (hithpael) to declare one's birth (pedigree)

3206.g: something born, i.e., a lad or offspring
3206.gl: child, son, boy, offspring, youth; child, son, boy; child, children; descendants; youth; apostate israelites (figuratively)
3206.gi: qualcosa di nato, cioè un ragazzo o una prole

3210.gl: [jehovah lodges]; a son of ezra and a descendant of caleb

3212.g: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)

3212.gi: camminare (letteralmente o figurato); causalmente, portare (in vari sensi)

3213.g: to howl (with a wailing tone) or yell (with a boisterous one)
3213.gl: (hiphil) to howl, wail, make a howling
3213.gi: ululare (con un tono luttuoso) o gridare (con un tono rumoroso)

3216.gl: (qal) to speak rashly, talk wildly; to devour

3217.gl: scab, skin sore, scales, scurf, an eruptive disease

3218.g: a devourer; specifically, the young locust
3218.gl: young locust (early stage of development); caterpillar (as devouring)
3218.gi: un divoratore; specificamente, il giovane locusta

3219.g: a travelling pouch (as if for gleanings)
3219.gi: un sacco da viaggio (come se per spigolature)

3220.g: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the mediterranean sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south

3222.gl: meaning uncertain, meaning perhaps mules or hot springs

3223.gl: [day of god]; the eldest son of simeon

3224.gl: [day by day]; one of the daughters of job born after the restoration
3224.gi: Jemimah, una delle figlie di Giob

3225.g: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
3225.gl: right, right hand, right side; right hand; right (of direction); south (the direction of the right hand when facing east)
3225.gi: la mano destra o lato (gamba, occhio) di una persona o altro oggetto (come il più forte e più destro); localmente, il sud

3226.g: jamin, the name of three israelites
3226.gl: [right hand]; the 2nd son of simeon; founder of the family of jaminites; a judaite, the 2nd son of ram the jerahmeelite; a levite who helped ezra interpret the law
3226.gi: Jamin, il nome di tre israeliti

3227.gl: right, on the right, right hand

3228.g: a jeminite (collectively) or descendants of jamin
3228.gl: [the right hand]; the descendants of jamin
3228.gi: un jeminita (collettivamente) o discendenti di Jamin

3229.gl: [whom god will fill up]; father of michaiah the prophet

3230.gl: [he will reign]; a chief of the tribe of simeon

3231.g: to be right-handed or take the right-hand side

3231.gi: essere manuso o prendere il lato destro

3232.g: jimnah, the name of two israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them
3232.gl: [right hand]; (n pr m) the 1st born son of asher; a levite, descendant of imnah, who assisted in the reforms of hezekiah; (n patr) descendants of imnah, son of asher
3232.gi: Jimnah, il nome di due israeliti; anche (con l'articolo) la posterità di uno di essi

3234.gl: [he will restrain]; son of helem, descendant of asher, and leader of the tribe of asher

3235.g: to exchange; by implication, to change places
3235.gl: to exchange; (hiphil) to exchange; (hithpael) to enter into, be changed into

3236.gl: [bitterness]; a descendant of asher of the family of zophah and a chief of the tribe

3238.g: to rage or be violent; by implication, to suppress, to maltreat
3238.gl: to oppress, suppress, treat violently, maltreat, vex, do wrong; (qal) to oppress, suppress; (hiphil) to treat violently, maltreat
3238.gi: ruggire o essere violento; per implicazione, sopprimere, maltrattare

3239.gl: [he rests]; a place apparently in the north of galilee in naphtali, taken by tiglath-pileser in his first incursion into palestine

3240.g: to deposit; by implication, to allow to stay
3240.gl: to rest; (qal); to rest, settle down and remain; to repose, have rest, be quiet; (hiphil); to cause to rest, give rest to, make quiet; to cause to rest, cause to alight, set down; to lay or set down, deposit, let lie, place; to let remain, leave; to leave, depart from; to abandon; to permit; (hophal); to obtain rest, be granted rest; to be left, be placed; open space (subst)
3240.gi: depositare; per implicazione, permettere di rimanere

3241.gl: [asleep]; a town in the mountains of judah apparently not far from hebron

3243.g: to suck; causatively, to give milk
3243.gl: to suckle, nurse, suck; (qal); to suck; suckling, babe (subst); (hiphil); to give suck to, nurse; nursing, nursing woman, nurse (participle)

3244.g: an unclean (acquatic) bird; probably the heron (perhaps from its blowing cry, or because the nightheron is meant)
3244.gl: great owl, eared owl; an unclean animal
3244.gi: uccello impuro (acquatico); probabilmente l'airone (forse per il suo richiamo soffiato, o perché si intenda l'airone notturno)

3245.g: to set (literally or figuratively); intensively, to found; reflexively, to sit down together, i.e., settle, consult
3245.gl: to found, fix, establish, lay foundation; (qal) to found, establish, begin; (niphal); to fix or seat themselves close together, sit in conclave; to be founded; (piel); to found; to establish, appoint, ordain; (pual) to be founded, be laid; (hophal) to be founded
3245.gi: stabilire (letteralmente o figurato); intensivamente, fondare; riflessivamente, sedersi insieme, cioè, stabilirsi, consultarsi

3252.gl: [one who looks forth]; daughter of haran, niece of abraham, sister of lot and milcah

3253.gl: [jehovah sustains]; a levite and overseer of the offerings during the revival in the time of king hezekiah

3258.g: jabets, the name of an israelite, and also of a place in palestine

3261.gl: (qal) to sweep, sweep away, sweep together

3262.g: jeuel, the name of four israelites
3262.gl: [god sweeps away]; son of zerah and a chief man of judah

3263.gl: [counsellor]; head of a house of benjamin

3265.gl: [forested]; father of elhanan the giant slayer, one of david's mighty warriors; also called 'jaare-oregim'

3266.g: jeush, the name of an edomite and of four israelites
3266.gl: [he hurries to aid]; son of eshek, a remote descendant of king saul; a gershonite levite of the house of shimei; son of king rehoboam of judah
3266.gi: jeush, il nome di un edomita e di quattro israeliti

3267.gl: to be strong, be fierce (meaning dubious); (niphal) barbarous (participle)

3268.gl: [made bold by god]; one of the levites appointed by david to perform the musical service before the ark

3269.gl: [made bold by jehovah]; a levite, apparently the 3rd son or a descendant of merari

3272.gl: (ithpael) to advise, counsel, take counsel; (p'al) counsellor (participle)

3273.g: jeiel, the name of six israelites

3274.g: jeish, the name of an edomite and of a an israelite
3274.gl: [assembler]; son of esau by aholibamah the daughter of anah, son of zibeon the hivite; a benjamite, son of bilhan

3275.gl: [troublesome]; one of seven chief men of the tribe of gad

5759.gl: young male or man or boy, boy

5762.g: avvith (or avvoth), a place in palestine
5762.gl: [ruins]; the city of hadad ben-bedad, one of the kings of edom
5762.gi: avvith (o avvoth), un luogo in Palestina

5763.gl: to give suck, suckle, nurse; (qal) giving suck (participle)

5767.gl: unjust one, perverse one, unrighteous one

5770.gl: to eye, look at; (qal) to eye, look at

5775.g: a bird (as covered with feathers, or rather as covering with wings), often collectively

5775.gi: un uccello (coperto di piume, o piuttosto che copre con le ali), spesso collettivamente

5776.g: a bird (as covered with feathers, or rather as covering with wings), often collectively
5776.gi: un uccello (coperto di piume, o piuttosto che copre con le ali), spesso collettivamente

5780.g: uts, a son of aram, also a seirite, and the regions settled by them
5780.gl: [wooded]; (n pr m) son of aram and grandson of seth; son of nahor by milcah; an edomite, son of dishan and grandson of seir; (n pr loc) the country of job; probably east and southeast of palestine somewhere in the arabian desert

5781.gl: (hiphil) to totter, cause to totter, crush; meaning dubious

5782.gl: to rouse oneself, awake, awaken, incite; (qal) to rouse oneself, awake; (niphal) to be roused; (polel) to stir up, rouse, incite; (hithpolel) to be excited, be triumphant; (hiphil); to rouse, stir up; to act in an aroused manner, awake

5783.gl: (niphal) to be exposed, be bared, be laid bare

5785.g: skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather
5785.gl: skin, hide; skin (of men); hide (of animals)
5785.gi: pelle (come nudo); per implicazione, pelle, cuoio

5786.gl: (piel) to blind, make blind, put out the eyes of

5789.gl: (qal) to lend aid, come to help, hasten

5790.gl: (qal) to hasten to, help, succour; meaning dubious

5791.gl: to be bent, be crooked, bend, make crooked, pervert; (piel); to make crooked, falsify, pervert, subvert; to bend, make crooked; (pual) thing bent (participle); (hithpael) to bend oneself

5793.g: uthai, the name of two israelites

5795.g: a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goat's hair)

5796.g: a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goat's hair)
5796.gi: capra (come forte), maschile al plurale (che è usato anche ellitticamente per il pelo di capra)

5797.g: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)

5797.gi: forza in varie applicazioni (forza, sicurezza, maestà, lode)

5798.g: uzza or uzzah, the name of five israelites
5798.gl: [strength]; (n pr m) a man slain by jehovah for touching the sacred ark; a benjamite of the sons of ehud; ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile with zerubbabel; a merarite levite; (n pr loc) the garden where kings manasseh and amon of judah were buried
5798.gi: Uzza o Uzza, il nome di cinque israeliti

5799.gl: entire removal, scapegoat; refers to the goat used for sacrifice for the sins of the people; meaning dubious
5799.gi: capra della partenza; il capro espiatorio

5800.g: to loosen, i.e., relinquish, permit, etc

5801.g: trade, i.e., the place (mart) or the payment (revenue)
5801.gi: commercio, cioè, il luogo (mercato) o il pagamento (ricavo)

5802.gl: [strong devastation]; father of nehemiah, leader of half the district of beth zur, and a repairer of the walls of jerusalem under another nehemiah

5803.gl: [gad is mighty]; ancestor of a family of laymen who returned from exile with zerubbabel; a man who sealed the covenant with nehemiah

5804.gl: [the strong]; another name for 'gaza', a city of the philistines located in the extreme southwest of palestine close to the mediterranean

5806.g: azubah, the name of two israelitesses
5806.gl: [forsaken]; wife of caleb, the son of hezron; daughter of shilhi, wife of king asa, and mother of king jehoshaphat of judah
5806.gi: azzubah, il nome di due israelite

5808.g: forcible; collectively and concretely, an army
5808.gi: forzato; collettivamente e concretamente, un esercito

5809.g: azzur, the name of three israelites
5809.gl: [he that assists]; a benjamite of gibeon, father of the false prophet hananiah; father of jaazaniah, one of the princes against whom ezekiel was commanded to prophecy
5809.gi: azzur, il nome di tre israeliti

5810.gl: to be strong; (qal) to be strong, prevail; (hiphil) to make firm, strengthen

5812.g: azazjah, the name of three israelites
5812.gl: [jehovah is mighty]; a levite musician in the reign of david who played the harp in the procession which brought the ark from obed-edom to jerusalem; a levite in the reign of king hezekiah of judah in charge of the tithes; father of hoshea, prince of the tribe of ephraim when david took the census
5812.gi: azazia, il nome di tre israeliti

5813.g: uzzi, the name of six israelites
5813.gl: [strong]; a levite, son of bukki and father of zerahiah in the line of the high priest although apparently never high priest himself; son of tola and grandson of issachar; a benjamite, son of bela and head of a family of benjamin; son of michri and father of elah and an ancestor of a family of returned exiles settling in jerusalem. maybe same as 3; a levite, son of bani, and an overseer of the levites in jerusalem in the time of nehemiah; a priest, chief of the father's house of jedaiah, in the time of joiakim the high priest; one of the priests who helped ezra in the dedication of the wall of jerusalem. maybe same as 6
5813.gi: uzzi, il nome di sei israeliti

5814.gl: [strength of jehovah]; one of david's mighty warriors

5816.g: uzziel, the name of six israelites
5816.gl: [my strength is god]; the 4th son of kohath and grandson of levi, uncle of moses and aaron; a simeonite captain, son of ishi, in the days of king hezekiah of judah; descendant of bela, head of a family in the tribe of benjamin; a musician of the sons of heman in the time of david; a levite of the sons of jeduthun in the days of king hezekiah of judah; son of harhaiah, probably a priest and a goldsmith, who took part in repairing the wall under nehemiah
5816.gi: uzziele, il nome di sei israeliti

5817.g: an uzzielite (collectively) or descendants of uzziel
5817.gl: [my strength is god]; descendants of uzziel
5817.gi: un uzzielita (collettivamente) o discendenti di uzziele

5818.g: uzzijah, the name of five israelites
5818.gl: [my strength is jehovah]; son of king amaziah of judah and king of judah himself for 52 years; also 'azariah'; a kohathite levite and ancestor of samuel; a priest of the sons of harim who took a foreign wife in the time of ezra; a judaite, father of athaiah or uthai; father of jehonathan, one of david's overseers
5818.gi: uzzia, il nome di cinque israeliti

5819.gl: [strong]; a layman of the family of zattu who took a foreign wife in the time of ezra

5820.g: azmaveth, the name of three israelites and of a place in palestine
5820.gl: [strong unto death]; (n pr m) one of david's mighty warriors; a descendant of mephibosheth, the son of jonathan and grandson of king saul; a benjamite, father of jeziel and pelet who were two of david's men who joined him at ziklag; overseer of the royal treasures in the reign of david; (n pr loc) a place in benjamin; also 'beth-azmeveth'
5820.gi: azmavet, il nome di tre israeliti e di un luogo in Palestina

5821.gl: [very strong]; father of paltiel prince of the tribe of issachar who represented his tribe in the division of the promised land

5822.gl: an unclean bird of prey; osprey, black eagle, buzzard; perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown
5822.gi: probabilmente l'aquila di mare (per la sua forza)

5825.gl: [dug over]; a town in the lowlands of judah

5826.g: to surround, i.e., protect or aid
5826.gl: to help, succour, support; (qal) to help; (niphal) to be helped; (hiphil) to help

5827.g: ezer, the name of two israelites
5827.gl: [treasure]; son of ephraim who was slain by inhabitants of gath; a priest who helped at the dedication of the walls of jerusalem under nehemiah
5827.gi: Ezer, il nome di due israeliti

5828.gl: help, succour; help, succour; one who helps

5829.g: ezer, the name of four israelites
5829.gl: [treasure]; father of hushah of the sons of hur; a gadite chief who fought with david; a levite who aided in repairing the wall of jerusalem in the time of nehemiah
5829.gi: Ezer, il nome di quattro israeliti

5830.gl: [help]; the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in jerusalem; co-worker with nehemiah; a priest with zerubbabel; another post-exilic jew

5831.gl: [help]; the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in jerusalem; co-worker with nehemiah

5832.g: azarel, the name of five israelites
5832.gl: [god has helped]; a korhite warrior of david who joined him at ziklag; a levite musician of the family of heman in the time of david; a danite, son of jeroham and a prince of the tribe at the census of david; one of the sons of bani who took a foreign wife in the time of ezra; a priest, ancestor of maasiai or amashai, a priest in jerusalem after the return from exile; a priest and musician in the time of nehemiah
5832.gi: Azarel, il nome di cinque israeliti

5833.gl: help, succour, assistance; help, succour; one who helps

5834.gl: [help]; a judaite, father of jether, mered, epher, and jalon

5835.gl: enclosure; ledge (surrounding ezekiel's altar); court (outer one of temple)

5836.gl: [help of jehovah]; son of chelub and superintendent of king david's farm laborers

5837.g: azriel, the name of three israelites
5837.gl: [my help is god]; a head of a house of the half-tribe of manasseh beyond the jordan; a naphtalite, ancestor of jerimoth, the head of the tribe at the time of the census of david; father of seraiah, an officer of king jehoiakim of judah
5837.gi: Azriel, il nome di tre israeliti

5838.g: azarjah, the name of nineteen israelites
5838.gl: [jehovah has helped]; son of king amaziah of judah and king of judah himself for 52 years; also 'uzziah'; the godly friend of daniel who nebuchadnezzar renamed abednego; one of the three friends who with daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which god had given the jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the lord; also, 'abednego' (h5664 or h5665); son of nathan and an officer of solomon; perhaps david's grandson and solomon's nephew; a prophet in the days of king asa of judah; son of king jehoshaphat of judah and brother to 5; another son of king jehoshaphat of judah and brother to 4; a priest, son of ahimaaz, grandson of zadok and high priest in the reign of king solomon; the high priest in the reign of king uzziah of judah; a priest who sealed the covenant with nehemiah; probably same as 18; a kohathite levite, father of joel in the reign of king hezekiah of judah; a merarite levite, son of jehalelel in the reign of king hezekiah of judah; a kohathite levite, son of zephaniah and ancestor of samuel the prophet; a levite who helped ezra in instructing the people in the law; son of jeroham and one of the temple captains of judah in the time of queen athaliah; probably the same as 21; son of maaseiah who repaired part of the wall of jerusalem in the time of nehemiah; one of the leaders who returned from babylon with zerubbabel; a man who assisted in the dedication of the wall of jerusalem in the time of nehemiah; probably the same as 10; son of johanan, one of the captains of ephraim in the reign of king ahaz of judah; a judaite, son of ethan of the sons of zerah; a judaite, son of jehu of the family of the jerahmeelites and descended from jarha the egyptian slave of sheshan; probably one of the captains of the time of queen athaliah and the same as 15; a priest, son of hilkiah; a priest, son of johanan; son of king jehoram of judah; probably clerical error for 'ahaziah'; son of meraioth; son of hoshaiah and one of the proud men who confronted jeremiah
5838.gi: Azaria, il nome di diciannove israeliti

5839.gl: [jehovah has helped]; the godly friend of daniel who nebuchadnezzar renamed abednego; one of the three friends who with daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which god had given the jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the lord; also, 'abednego' (h5664 or h5665)
5839.gi: Azaria, uno dei compagni di Daniele

5840.g: azrikam, the name of four israelites
5840.gl: [help against the enemy]; son of neariah and descendant of zerubbabel of the royal line of judah; a benjamite, eldest son of azel and descendant of saul; a levite, ancestor of shemaiah in the time of nehemiah; governor of the palace of king ahaz of judah and victim of murder by zichri
5840.gi: Azricam, il nome di quattro israeliti

5841.g: an azzathite or inhabitant of azzah

5841.gi: un abitante di Azzah o Azzatita

5842.gl: stylus; iron stylus with diamond tip used to write on stone or metal; reed pen used on a roll
5842.gi: uno stilo o bastone per segnare

5844.g: to wrap, i.e., cover, veil, clothe, or roll

5845.g: a receptacle (for milk, i.e., pail; figuratively, breast)
5845.gi: un contenitore (per il latte, cioè secchio; figurato, seno)

5848.g: to shroud, i.e., clothe (whether transitive or reflexive); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish

5849.g: to encircle (for attack or protection); especially to crown (literally or figuratively)
5849.gl: to surround; (qal) to surround; to crown, give a crown; (piel) to crown; (hiphil) crown-bestower (participle)
5849.gi: circondare (per attacco o protezione); specialmente incoronare (letteralmente o figurato)

5851.gl: [a crown]; wife of jerahmeel and mother of onam

5852.g: ataroth, the name (thus simply) of two places in palestine

5853.gl: [crowns of glory]; a gadite town on the west border of benjamin

5854.gl: [the crowns of]; the house of joab, a place in judah

5855.gl: [crowns of their rapine]; a town in the territory of gad

5857.g: ai, aja or ajath, a place in palestine
5857.gl: [heap of ruins]; a city lying east of bethel and beside bethaven near jericho and the 2nd city taken on the invasion of canaan; a city of the ammonites on the east of the jordan and apparently attached to heshbon
5857.gi: Ai, Aja o Ajath, un luogo in Palestina

5858.gl: [stone, bare mountain]; (n pr m) a son of shobal; (n pr loc) mountain of cursing, north of shechem and opposite mount gerizim

5859.gl: [a ruin]; a place in the north of palestine belonging to the tribe of naphtali

5860.g: to swoop down upon (literally or figuratively)
5860.gl: to scream, shriek; (qal) to scream; to dart greedily, swoop upon, rush upon; (qal) to dart greedily

5861.g: a hawk or other bird of prey
5861.gi: un falco o altro uccello predatore

5862.gl: [lair of wild beasts]; a village of the tribe of simeon; a town in judah fortified and garrisoned by king rehoboam of judah and located between bethlehem and tekoa; a cliff; site uncertain

5863.gl: [ruins of abarim]; a station of israel in the wilderness on the southeast side of moab; a town in judah
5863.gi: Ije-ha-Abarim, un luogo vicino alla Palestina

5864.g: ijim, a place in the desert
5864.gl: [ruins]; a station of israel in the wilderness on the southeast side of moab; a town in judah

5865.g: concealed, i.e., the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e., (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
5865.gl: for ever, ever, everlasting, evermore, perpetual, old, ancient, world
5865.gi: nascosto, cioè il punto di scomparsa; generalmente, tempo immemorabile (passato o futuro), cioè (praticamente) eternità; frequentemente, avverbiale (specialmente con prefissione preposizionale) sempre

5866.gl: [exalted]; an ahohite, one of david's mighty warriors

5867.g: elam, a son of shem and his descendants, with their country; also of six israelites

5869.g: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
5869.gl: eye; eye; of physical eye; as showing mental qualities; of mental and spiritual faculties (figuratively); spring, fountain
5869.gi: un occhio (letteralmente o figurato); per analogia, una sorgente (come l'occhio del paesaggio)

5871.g: ajin, the name (thus simply) of two places in palestine
5871.gl: [spring]; one of the landmarks on the eastern boundary of palestine; one of the southernmost cities of judah in the nekeb and allotted to the tribe of simeon and given to the priests
5871.gi: Ajin, il nome (così semplicemente) di due luoghi in Palestina

5872.gl: [fount of the kid]; a town in the wilderness of judah on the western shore of the dead sea

5873.gl: [fountain of the garden]; a city in the low country of judah; a city on the border of issachar and allotted to the gershonite levites

5874.gl: [fountain of dor]; a place in the territory of issachar yet possessed by manasseh; located 4 miles (6.5 km) north of tabor; place of residence of the spiritist consulted by king saul

5875.gl: [spring of one calling]; the spring which the lord brought forth in response to samson's complaint of being thirsty after he had just killed 1000 men with the jawbone of an ass
5875.gi: En-ha-Kore, un luogo vicino alla Palestina

5876.gl: [swift fountain]; one of the cities on the border of issachar

5877.gl: [fount of hazor]; one of the fenced cities in the territory of naphtali

5878.gl: [spring of herod]; a camping place of gideon and israel near the hill of moreh

5879.g: enajim or enam, a place in palestine
5879.gl: [double spring]; a city in the lowlands of judah
5879.gi: Enajim o Enam, un luogo in Palestina

5880.gl: [spring of judgment]; a place near southern palestine coincident or the same place as kadesh
5880.gi: En-Mishpat, un luogo vicino alla Palestina

5881.gl: [having eyes]; a prince of the tribe of naphtali at the census at mount sinai

5882.gl: [fountain of the two calves]; a place on the dead sea; site uncertain

5883.gl: [fount of the fuller]; a place near jerusalem on the border between judah and benjamin and from which the permanent source of the pool of siloam comes
5883.gi: en-rogel, un luogo vicino a Gerusalemme

5884.gl: [fount of the pomegranate]; one of the places that the returning exiles reinhabited in judah

5885.gl: [fountain of the sun]; a spring on the boundary of judah on the south and benjamin on the north

5886.gl: [fountain of the jackal]; a spring near jerusalem

5887.gl: [fountain of the apple-city]; a place on the border between ephraim and manasseh

5888.gl: to be faint, be weary; (qal) to be faint, be weary

5891.g: ephah, the name of a son of midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an israelite and of an israelitess
5891.gl: [gloomy]; (n pr m) a son of midian; a judaite, son of jahdai; (n pr f) a concubine of caleb in the line of judah
5891.gi: Efa, il nome di un figlio di Madian, e della regione da lui abitata; anche di un israelita e di un'israelita

5892.g: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
5892.gl: excitement, anguish; of terror; city, town (a place of waking, guarded); city, town
5892.gi: una città (un luogo sorvegliato da veglie o da sentinelle) nel senso più ampio (anche di un semplice accampamento o avamposto)

5893.gl: [belonging to a city]; son of bela and father of huppim and shuppim

5894.g: a watcher, i.e., an angel (as guardian)
5894.gl: waking, watchful, wakeful one, watcher, angel
