1075.gi: calcolare per generazioni, cioè tracciare nella genealogia

1076.gl: a genealogy, a record of descent or lineage

1077.gl: a birthday celebration, a birthday feast; the earlier greeks used this word of funeral commemorations, a festival commemorative of a deceased friend

1078.gl: source, origin; a book of one's lineage, i.e., in which his ancestry or progeny are enumerated; used of birth, nativity; of that which follows origin (namely, existence, life); the wheel (or machinery) of life (james 3:6), the wheel of human origin which as soon as men are born begins to run (i.e., its course of life)

1080.g: to procreate (properly, of the father, but by extension of the mother); figuratively, to regenerate
1080.gl: of men who fathered children; to be born; to be begotten; of women giving birth to children; metaphorically; to engender, cause to arise, excite; in a jewish sense, of one who brings others over to his way of life, to convert someone; of god making christ his son; of god making men his sons through faith in christ's work

1081.g: offspring; by analogy, produce (literally or figuratively)
1081.gl: that which has been born or begotten; the offspring or progeny of men or animals; the fruits of the earth, the produce of agriculture
1081.gi: prole; per analogia, prodotto (letteralmente o figurato)

1082.g: gennesaret (i.e., kinnereth), a lake and plain in palestine
1082.gl: [a harp]; a lake also called the sea of galilee or the sea of tiberias; a very lovely and fertile region on the sea of galilee
1082.gi: Gennesaret (cioè Chinneret), un lago e una pianura in Palestina

1085.g: "kin" (abstract or concrete, literal or figurative, individual or collective)
1085.gl: race; offspring; family; stock, race, nation; i.e., nationality or descent from a particular people; the aggregate of many individuals of the same nature, kind, sort
1085.gi: "parentela" (astratto o concreto, letterale o figurato, individuale o collettivo)

1086.g: a gergesene (i.e., girgashite) or one of the people from palestine
1086.gl: [a stranger drawing near(?)]; also called gadarenes, is assumed to have been located on the eastern shore of lake gennesaret
1086.gi: un gergeseno (cioè, girgasita) o uno dei popoli della Palestina

1087.g: the eldership, i.e., (collectively) the jewish sanhedrin
1087.gl: a senate, council of elders; to denote the chief council of nations or cities; the sanhedrin

1089.g: to taste; by implication, to eat; figuratively, to experience (good or ill)
1089.gl: to taste, to try the flavor of; to taste; i.e., perceive the flavor of, partake of, enjoy; to feel, make trial of, experience; to take food, eat, to take nourishment, eat
1089.gi: assaggiare; per implicazione, mangiare; figurativamente, esperire (buono o male)

1090.gl: to practise agriculture, to till the ground

1092.gl: a husbandman, tiller of the soil, a vine dresser
1092.gi: un lavoratore della terra, cioè, agricoltore

1093.g: soil; by extension a region, or the solid part or the whole of the terrene globe (including the occupants in each application)
1093.gl: arable land; the ground, the earth as a standing place; the main land as opposed to the sea or water; the earth as a whole; the earth as opposed to the heavens; the inhabited earth, the abode of men and animals; a country, land enclosed within fixed boundaries, a tract of land, territory, region
1093.gi: terreno; per estensione una regione, o la parte solida o l'intero globo terrestre (inclusi gli occupanti in ogni applicazione)

1095.gl: to grow old; of things and institutions: to fail from age, be obsolescent

1096.g: to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e., (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.)
1096.gl: to become, i.e., to come into existence, begin to be, receive being; to become, i.e., to come to pass, happen; of events; to arise, appear in history, come upon the stage; of men appearing in public; to be made, finished; of miracles, to be performed, wrought; to become, be made
1096.gi: far essere ("gen"-erare), cioè (riflessivamente) diventare (venire all'esistenza), usato con grande ampiezza (letterale, figurato, intensivo, ecc.)

1097.g: to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed)
1097.gl: to learn to know, come to know, get a knowledge of perceive, feel; to become known; to know, understand, perceive, have knowledge of; to understand; to know; jewish idiom for sexual intercourse between a man and a woman; to become acquainted with, to know
1097.gi: conoscere (assolutamente) in una grande varietà di applicazioni e con molte implicazioni (come segue, con altre non così chiaramente espresse)

1098.g: sweet wine, i.e., (properly) must (fresh juice), but used of the more saccharine (and therefore highly inebriating) fermented wine
1098.gl: the sweet juice pressed the grape, sweet wine
1098.gi: vino dolce, cioè (propriamente) mosto (succo fresco), ma usato per il vino fermentato più zuccherino (e quindi altamente inebriante)

1100.g: the tongue; by implication, a language (specially, one naturally unacquired)
1100.gl: the tongue, a member of the body, an organ of speech; the language or dialect used by a particular people distinct from that of other nations
1100.gi: la lingua; per implicazione, una lingua (specialmente, una non naturalmente acquisita)

1101.g: properly, a case (to keep mouthpieces of wind-instruments in) i.e., (by extension) a casket or (specially) purse
1101.gl: a case in which to keep mouth-pieces of wind instruments; a small box for other uses; especially a casket, a purse to keep money in
1101.gi: propriamente, una custodia (per conservare le bocche degli strumenti a fiato) cioè (per estensione) una cassetta o (specialmente) un borsello

1103.gl: legitimately born, not spurious; true, genuine, sincere

1106.g: cognition, i.e., (subjectively) opinion, or (objectively) resolve (counsel, consent, etc.)
1106.gl: the faculty of knowledge, mind, reason; that which is thought or known, one's mind; view, judgment, opinion; mind concerning what ought to be done; by one's self: resolve purpose, intention; by others: judgment, advice; decree
1106.gi: cognizione, cioè (soggettivamente) opinione, o (oggettivamente) risoluzione (consiglio, consenso, ecc.)

1107.g: to make known; subjectively, to know
1107.gl: to make known; to become known, be recognized; to know, to gain knowledge of, have thorough knowledge of; in earlier greek it means "to gain a knowledge of" or "have thorough knowledge of"

1108.gl: knowledge signifies in general intelligence, understanding; the general knowledge of christian religion; the deeper more perfect and enlarged knowledge of this religion, such as belongs to the more advanced; especially of things lawful and unlawful for christians; moral wisdom, such as is seen in right living

1111.gl: to murmur, mutter, grumble, say anything against in a low tone; of the cooing of doves; of those who confer secretly together; of those who discontentedly complain

1112.gl: a murmur, murmuring, muttering; a secret debate; a secret displeasure not openly avowed

1113.gl: a murmurer, one who discontentedly complains (against god)

1114.g: properly, a wizard (as muttering spells), i.e., (by implication) an imposter
1114.gl: a wailer, a howler; a juggler, enchanter (because incantations used to be uttered in a kind of howl); a deceiver, imposter
1114.gi: propriamente, un mago (come mormorando incantesimi), cioè (per implicazione) un impostore

1115.g: the skull; golgotha, a knoll near jerusalem
1115.gl: [skull]; the name of a place outside jerusalem where jesus was crucified; so called, apparently because its form resembled a skull
1115.gi: il cranio; golgota, un colle vicino a Gerusalemme

1116.g: gomorrha (i.e., amorah), a place near the dead sea
1116.gl: [submersion]; a city in eastern part of judah that was destroyed when the lord rained fire and brimstone on it; now covered by the dead sea
1116.gi: gomorra (cioè amorah), un luogo vicino al mar Morto

1117.g: a load (as filling), i.e., (specially) a cargo, or (by extension) wares
1117.gl: a lading or freight of a ship, cargo, merchandise conveyed in a ship; any merchandise
1117.gi: un carico (come riempimento), cioè (specialmente) un carico, o (per estensione) merci

1120.gl: to fall on the knees, the act of imploring aid, and of expressing reverence and honor

1121.g: a writing, i.e., a letter, note, epistle, book, etc.; plural learning
1121.gl: a letter; any writing, a document or record; a note of hand, bill, bond, account, written acknowledgement of a debt; a letter, an epistle; the sacred writings (of the old testament); letters, i.e., learning; of sacred learning
1121.gi: un scritto, cioè una lettera, nota, epistola, libro, ecc.; al plurale apprendimento

1122.gl: a clerk, scribe, especially a public servant, secretary, recorder, whose office and influence differed in different states; a man learned in the mosaic law and in the sacred writings, an interpreter, teacher; a religious teacher: so instructed that from his learning and ability to teach advantage may redound to the kingdom of heaven

1124.g: a document, i.e., holy writ (or its contents or a statement in it)
1124.gl: a writing, thing written; the scripture, used to denote either the book itself, or its contents; a certain portion or section of the holy scripture
1124.gi: un documento, cioè sacra scrittura (o i suoi contenuti o una dichiarazione in essa)

1125.g: to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe
1125.gl: to write, with reference to the form of the letters; to delineate (or form) letters on a tablet, parchment, paper, or other material; to write, with reference to the contents of the writing; to express in written characters; to commit to writing (things not to be forgotten), write down, record; used of those things which stand written in the sacred books (of the old testament); to write to one, i.e., by writing (in a written epistle) to give information, directions; to fill with writing; to draw up in writing, compose

1126.gl: old womanish, old wives, an old woman

1127.g: to keep awake, i.e., watch (literally or figuratively)
1127.gl: to watch; metaphorically give strict attention to, be cautious, active; to take heed lest through remission and indolence some destructive calamity suddenly overtake one
1127.gi: restare sveglio, cioè vegliare (letteralmente o figuratamente)

1128.g: to practise naked (in the games), i.e., train (figuratively)
1128.gl: to exercise naked (in a palaestra or school of athletics); to exercise vigorously, in any way, either the body or the mind

1129.gl: the exercise of the body in a palaestra or school of athletics; any exercise whatever; the exercise of conscientiousness relative to the body such as is characteristic of ascetics and consists in abstinence from matrimony and certain kinds of food

1130.g: to strip, i.e., (reflexively) go poorly clad
1130.gl: to be lightly or poorly clad; to be a light armed soldier

1131.g: nude (absolute or relative, literal or figurative)
1131.gl: properly; unclad, without clothing, the naked body; ill clad; clad in undergarments only (the outer garments or cloak being laid aside); of the soul, whose garment is the body, stripped of the body, without a body; metaphorically; naked, i.e., open, lay bare; only, mere, bare, i.e., mere grain not the plant itself
1131.gi: nudo (assoluto o relativo, letterale o figurato)

1134.gl: of or belonging to a woman, feminine, female

1135.gl: a woman of any age, whether a virgin, or married, or a widow; a wife; of a betrothed woman

1136.g: gog, a symbolic name for some future antichrist
1136.gl: [mountain]; the king of the land of magog who will come from the north and attack the land of israel
1136.gi: gog, un nome simbolico per un futuro anticristo

1137.gl: corner; an external angle, a corner; internal corner, i.e., a secret place

1138.gl: [beloved]; second king of israel, and ancestor of jesus christ

1139.g: to be exercised by a daemon
1139.gl: to be under the power of a demon

1140.g: a daemonic being; by extension a deity
1140.gl: the divine power, deity, divinity; a spirit, a being inferior to god, superior to men; evil spirits or the messengers and ministers of the devil
1140.gi: un essere daemonico; per estensione, una divinità

1141.gl: resembling or proceeding from an evil spirit, demon-like

1142.g: a daemon or supernatural spirit (of a bad nature)
1142.gl: a god, a goddess; an inferior deity, whether good or bad; in the new testament, an evil spirit
1142.gi: un demone o spirito soprannaturale (di natura cattiva)

1143.gl: to bite with the teeth; metaphorically, to wound the soul, cut lacerate, rend with reproaches

1148.gl: [slow firebrand]; is a town on the west side of the sea of galilee, near magdala

1149.gl: [a priestly robe]; a part of illyricum on the adriatic sea; on the east adjoining pannonia and upper moesia, on the north separated from liburia by the river titus, and extending southwards as far as the river drinus and the city lissus

1151.gl: a young cow, heifer; of the red heifer with whose ashes, by the mosaic law, those were to be sprinkled who had become defiled

1152.g: perhaps gentle; damaris, an athenian woman
1152.gl: [a heifer]; an athenian woman converted to christianity by paul's preaching
1152.gi: forse gentile; Damaride, una donna ateniese

1153.g: a damascene or inhabitant of damascus
1153.gi: un damasceno o abitante di Damasco

1154.gl: [silent is the sackcloth weaver]; one of the most ancient and most important cities of syria lying in almost lovely and fertile plain at the eastern base of the antilibanus

1155.g: to loan on interest; reflexively, to borrow
1155.gl: to lend money; to have money lent to one's self; to take a loan, borrow
1155.gi: prestare a interesse; riflessivamente, prendere in prestito

1156.g: probably akin to the base of g1325; a loan
1156.gi: probabilmente affine alla base di g1325; un prestito

1158.gl: [judgment of god]; the name of a jewish prophet, noted for his wisdom and prophecies

1159.g: to expend, i.e., (in a good sense) to incur cost, or (in a bad one) to waste
1159.gl: to incur expense, expend, spend; in a bad sense: to waste, squander, consume
1159.gi: spendere, cioè (in senso buono) sostenere una spesa, o (in senso cattivo) sprecare

1162.gl: need, indigence, want, privation, penury; a seeking, asking, entreating, entreaty to god or to man

1163.g: also deon deh-on'; neuter active participle of the same; both used impersonally; it is (was, etc.) necessary (as binding)
1163.gl: it is necessary, there is need of, it behooves, is right and proper; necessity lying in the nature of the case; necessity brought on by circumstances or by the conduct of others toward us; necessity in reference to what is required to attain some end; a necessity of law and command, of duty, equity; necessity established by the counsel and decree of god (especially by that purpose of his which relates to the salvation of men by the intervention of christ and which is disclosed in the old testament prophecies); concerning what christ was destined finally to undergo, his sufferings, death, resurrection, ascension
1163.gi: anche deon deh-on'; participio attivo neutro dello stesso; entrambi usati impersonalmente; è (era, ecc.) necessario (come vincolo)

1164.gl: a thing shown; a specimen of any thing, example, pattern

1165.gl: to make an example of, to show as an example

1166.gl: to show, expose to the eyes; metaphorically; to give evidence or proof of a thing; to show by words or teach

1170.g: so and so (when the person is not specified)
1170.gl: such a one, a certain one, i.e., one whose name i cannot call on the instant, or whose name it is of no importance to mention
1170.gi: tal e tal (quando la persona non è specificata)

1172.g: to dine, i.e., take the principle (or evening) meal
1172.gi: cenare, cioè prendere il pasto principale (o serale)

1173.g: dinner, i.e., the chief meal (usually in the evening)
1173.gl: supper, especially a formal meal usually held at the evening,; used of the messiah's feast, symbolising salvation in the kingdom; food taken at evening
1173.gi: cena, cioè il pasto principale (di solito la sera)

1174.gl: in a good sense; reverencing god or the gods, pious, religious; in a bad sense; superstitious

1175.gl: in a good sense; reverencing god or the gods, pious, religious; in a bad sense; superstitious; religious

1179.g: the ten-city region; the decapolis, a district in syria
1179.gl: [ten cities]; a track of land so called from the ten cities that were in it; according to pliny, these cities were: damascus, opoton, philadelphia, raphana, scythopolis, gadara, hippondion, pella, galasa, and canatha (gill)
1179.gi: la regione delle dieci città; la decapoli, un distretto in Siria

1181.g: a tenth, i.e., as a percentage or (technically) tithe
1181.gl: a tenth part of anything, a tithe; the tenth party of booty taken from an enemy; the tithes of fruits of the earth and of flocks, which by the law of moses were presented to the levites in the congregation of israel
1181.gi: un decimo, cioè come percentuale o (tecnicamente) decima

1183.g: to tithe, i.e., to give or take a tenth
1183.gl: to exact or receive the tenth part; to pay tithes
1183.gi: dare la decima, cioè dare o prendere un decimo

1185.gl: to bait, catch by a bait; metaphorically to beguile by banishments, allure, entice, deceive

1187.g: a guardsman (as if taking the right) or light-armed soldier
1187.gl: throwing with the right hand, a slinger, an archer, javelinmen
1187.gi: un guardiano (come se prendesse il diritto) o soldato di fanteria leggera

1188.g: the right side or (feminine) hand (as that which usually takes)
1188.gl: the right, the right hand; metaphorically; a place of honor or authority
1188.gi: il lato destro o (femminile) mano (come quella che di solito prende)

1189.g: to beg (as binding oneself), i.e., petition
1189.gl: to want, lack; to desire, long for; to ask, beg; the thing asked for; to pray, make supplications

1190.g: a derbaean or inhabitant of derbe
1190.gi: un derbeo o abitante di derbe

1191.g: derbe, a place in asia minor
1191.gl: [tanner, tanner of skin, coverer with skin]; a city of lycaonia, on the confines of isauria
1191.gi: Derbe, un luogo in Asia Minore

1194.g: properly, to flay, i.e., (by implication) to scourge, or (by analogy) to thrash
1194.gl: to flay, skin; to beat, thrash, smite
1194.gi: propriamente, scuoiare, cioè (per implicazione) flagellare, o (per analogia) battere

1195.g: to be a binder (captor), i.e., to enchain (a prisoner), to tie on (a load)
1195.gl: to put in chains; to bind up, bind together
1195.gi: essere un legatore (catturatore), cioè incatenare (un prigioniero), legare (un carico)

1198.gl: bound, in bonds, a captive, a prisoner

1199.g: a band, i.e., ligament (of the body) or shackle (of a prisoner); figuratively, an impediment or disability
1199.gi: una fascia, cioè legamento (del corpo) o catena (di un prigioniero); figurativamente, un impedimento o disabilità

1200.gl: a keeper of a prison, a jailor

1201.g: a place of bondage, i.e., a dungeon
1201.gi: un luogo di schiavitù, cioè una prigione sotterranea

1204.g: here; used also imperative hither!; and of time, hitherto
1204.gl: of place,; hither to this place; in urging and calling, here! come!; of time, hither to, now
1204.gi: qui; usato anche come imperativo vieni qui!; e di tempo, fino a qui

1205.gl: come hither, come here, come; interjection, come!, come now!

1206.g: secondary, i.e., (specially) on the second day
1206.gl: of or belonging to the second; of one who comes or does a thing, on the second day

1207.g: second-first, i.e., (specially) a designation of the sabbath immediately after the paschal week (being the second after passover day, and the first of the seven sabbaths intervening before pentecost)
1207.gl: second-first; the second of the first sabbaths after the feast of the passover
1207.gi: secondo-primo, cioè (specialmente) una designazione del sabato immediatamente dopo la settimana pasquale (essendo il secondo dopo il giorno di Pasqua, e il primo dei sette sabati intermedi prima della Pentecoste)

1208.g: (ordinal) second (in time, place, or rank; also adverb)
1208.gl: the second, the other of two
1208.gi: (ordinale) secondo (nel tempo, nel luogo o nel rango; anche avverbio)

1209.g: to receive (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
1209.gl: to take with the hand; to take hold of, take up; to take up, receive; used of a place receiving one; to receive or grant access to, a visitor, not to refuse intercourse or friendship; to receive hospitality; to receive into one's family to bring up or educate; of the thing offered in speaking, teaching, instructing; to receive favorably, give ear to, embrace, make one's own, approve, not to reject; to receive, i.e., to take upon one's self, sustain, bear, endure; to receive, get; to learn
1209.gi: ricevere (in varie applicazioni, letteralmente o figuratamente)

1210.g: to bind (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
1210.gl: to bind tie, fasten; to bind, fasten with chains, to throw into chains; metaphorically; satan is said to bind a woman bent together by means of a demon, as his messenger, taking possession of the woman and preventing her from standing upright; to bind, put under obligation, of the law, duty etc.; to be bound to one, a wife, a husband; to forbid, prohibit, declare to be illicit
1210.gi: legare (in varie applicazioni, letteralmente o figurativamente)

1211.g: a particle of emphasis or explicitness; now, then, etc
1211.gl: now, then, verily, in truth, really, surely, certainly; forthwith, at once
1211.gi: una particella di enfasi o di esplicitazione; ora, allora, ecc

1213.gl: to make manifest; to make known by relating, to declare; to give one to understand, to indicate, signify

1214.gl: [governor of the people]; a companion of paul, who deserted the apostle when he was a prisoner at rome and returned to thessalonica

1215.g: to be a people-gatherer, i.e., to address a public assembly
1215.gl: to address a public assembly, make a speech to the people
1215.gi: essere un radunatore di popolo, cioè, rivolgere un'assemblea pubblica

1216.g: demetrius, the name of an ephesian and of a christian
1216.gl: [belonging to ceres]; a heathen silversmith at ephesus; a certain christian, 3jo 12
1216.gi: Demetrio, nome di un efesino e di un cristiano

1217.g: a worker for the people, i.e., mechanic (spoken of the creator)
1217.gl: a workman for the public; the author of any work, an artisan, framer, builder
1217.gi: un operaio per il popolo, cioè, artigiano (parlando del creatore)

1218.gl: the people, the mass of people assembled in a public place

1219.g: public; (feminine singular dative case as adverb) in public
1219.gl: belonging to the people or state, public; publicly, in public places, in full view of all
1219.gi: pubblico; (caso dativo singolare femminile come avverbio) in pubblico

1220.gl: [containing ten]; a roman silver coin in new testament time

1221.g: a particle of generalization; indeed, at any time
1221.gl: now at length; at any time; at last; just exactly
1221.gi: una particella di generalizzazione; infatti, in qualsiasi momento

1222.g: a particle of asseveration; indeed doubtless
1222.gl: it is used when something is affirmed in a slightly ironical manner, as if with an pretence of uncertainty; perhaps; doubtless; verily; truly
1222.gi: una particella di affermazione; infatti, senza dubbio

1223.g: through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional)
1223.gl: through; of place; with; in; of time; throughout; during; of means; by; by the means of; through; the ground or reason by which something is or is not done; by reason of; on account of; because of for this reason; therefore; on this account
1223.gi: attraverso (in applicazioni molto ampie, locali, causali o occasionali)

1225.gl: to throw over or across, to send over; to traduce, calumniate, slander, accuse, defame

1226.g: to confirm thoroughly (by words), i.e., asseverate
1226.gi: confermare a fondo (a parole), cioè, affermare

1227.g: to look through, i.e., recover full vision
1227.gl: to look through, penetrate by vision; to look fixedly, stare straight before one; to see clearly
1227.gi: guardare attraverso, cioè, recuperare la piena vista

1228.gl: prone to slander, slanderous, accusing falsely; a calumniator, false accuser, slanderer,; metaphorically applied to a man who, by opposing the cause of god, may be said to act the part of the devil or to side with him satan the prince of the demons, the author of evil, persecuting good men, estranging mankind from god and enticing them to sin, afflicting them with diseases by means of demons who take possession of their bodies at his bidding

1229.gl: to carry a message through, announce everywhere, through places, through assemblies of men etc.; to publish abroad, declare

1230.gl: to be through, continue; to be between, intervene, used of time, to have intervened, elapsed, passed meanwhile

1231.g: to know thoroughly, i.e., ascertain exactly
1231.gl: to distinguish, i.e., to know accurately, ascertain exactly; in a legal sense, to examine, determine, decide
1231.gi: conoscere a fondo, cioè, accertare esattamente

1232.gl: to publish abroad, make known thoroughly; to discriminate

1233.gl: to distinguish; in a legal sense, examination, opinion, decision

1234.gl: to murmur; either of a whole crowd, or among one another; always used of many indignantly complaining
1234.gi: lamentarsi in mezzo a una folla

1235.gl: to watch through; to remain awake; to be fully awake

1236.gl: to lead through, lead across, send across; to pass, to live

1237.g: to receive in turn, i.e., (figuratively) succeed to
1237.gl: to receive through another, anything left or bequeathed by him, to receive in succession, receive in turn, succeed to
1237.gi: ricevere a turno, cioè, (figurato) succedere a

1238.gl: a diadem; a blue band marked with white which persian kings used to bind on the turban or tiara; the kingly ornament for the head, the crown

1239.g: to give throughout a crowd, i.e., deal out; also to deliver over (as to a successor)
1239.gl: to distribute, divide among several; to give over, deliver
1239.gi: dare in mezzo a una folla, cioè, distribuire; anche consegnare (a un successore)

1241.gl: to bind or gird all around; to gird one's self with a thing, gird a thing around one's self

1242.g: properly, a disposition, i.e., (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will)
1242.gl: a disposition, arrangement, of any sort, which one wishes to be valid, the last disposition which one makes of his earthly possessions after his death, a testament or will; a compact, a covenant, a testament; god's covenant with noah, etc.
1242.gi: propriamente, una disposizione, cioè, (specialmente) un contratto (specialmente un testamento divisorio)

1243.gl: division, distribution; distinction, difference; in particular, a distinction arising from a different distribution to different persons

1244.gl: to divide into parts, to part, to tear, cleave or cut asunder; to distribute

1246.gl: to confute with rivalry and effort or in a contest

1247.g: to be an attendant, i.e., wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a christian deacon
1247.gl: to be a servant, attendant, domestic, to serve, wait upon; to minister to one, render ministering offices to; to be served, ministered unto; to wait at a table and offer food and drink to the guests,; of women preparing food; to minister i.e., supply food and necessities of life; to relieve one's necessities (e.g., by collecting alms), to provide take care of, distribute, the things necessary to sustain life; to take care of the poor and the sick, who administer the office of a deacon; in christian churches to serve as deacons; to minister; to attend to anything, that may serve another's interests; to minister a thing to one, to serve one or by supplying any thing
1247.gi: essere un attendente, cioè, servire (umilmente o come ospite, amico, o (figurato) maestro); tecnicamente, agire come diacono cristiano

1248.g: attendance (as a servant, etc.); figuratively (eleemosynary) aid, (official) service (especially of the christian teacher, or technically of the diaconate)
1248.gl: service, ministering, especially of those who execute the commands of others; of those who by the command of god proclaim and promote religion among men; of the office of moses; of the office of the apostles and its administration; of the office of prophets, evangelists, elders etc.; the ministration of those who render to others the offices of christian affection especially those who help meet need by either collecting or distributing of charities; the office of the deacon in the church; the service of those who prepare and present food
1248.gi: servizio (come servo, ecc.); figurato (elemosina) aiuto, servizio (ufficiale) (specialmente del maestro cristiano, o tecnicamente del diaconato)

1249.g: an attendant, i.e., (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon)
1249.gl: one who executes the commands of another, especially of a master, a servant, attendant, minister; the servant of a king; a deacon, one who, by virtue of the office assigned to him by the church, cares for the affairs of the church; a waiter, one who serves food and drink
1249.gi: un attendente, cioè, (caso genitivo) un servitore (a tavola o in altri doveri umili); specialmente, un maestro e pastore cristiano (tecnicamente, un diacono)

1251.g: to hear throughout, i.e., patiently listen (to a prisoner's plea)
1251.gl: to hear one through, hear to the end, hear with care, hear fully
1251.gi: ascoltare a fondo, cioè, ascoltare pazientemente (l'appello di un prigioniero)

1252.g: to separate thoroughly, i.e., (literally and reflexively) to withdraw from, or (by implication) oppose; figuratively, to discriminate (by implication, decide), or (reflexively) hesitate
1252.gl: to separate, make a distinction, discriminate, to prefer; to learn by discrimination, to try, decide; to determine, give judgment, decide a dispute; to withdraw from one, desert; to separate one's self in a hostile spirit, to oppose, strive with dispute, contend; to be at variance with one's self, hesitate, doubt
1252.gi: separare a fondo, cioè, (letteralmente e riflessivamente) ritirarsi da, o (per implicazione) opporsi; figurato, discriminare (per implicazione, decidere), o (riflessivamente) esitare

1254.g: to hinder altogether, i.e., utterly prohibit
1254.gi: ostacolare del tutto, cioè proibire completamente

1255.g: to talk throughout a company, i.e., converse or (genitive case) publish
1255.gl: to converse together, to talk with
1255.gi: parlare in mezzo a una compagnia, cioè conversare o (caso genitivo) pubblicare

1256.g: to say thoroughly, i.e., discuss (in argument or exhortation)
1256.gl: to think different things with one's self, mingle thought with thought; to ponder, revolve in mind; to converse, discourse with one, argue, discuss
1256.gi: dire completamente, cioè discutere (in argomento o esortazione)

1257.g: to leave off in the middle, i.e., intermit
1257.gl: to interpose a delay, to intermit, leave off for a time something already begun

1258.gl: conversation, speech, discourse, language; the tongue or language peculiar to any people

1259.g: to change thoroughly, i.e., (mentally) to conciliate
1259.gl: to change; to change the mind of anyone, to reconcile; to be reconciled, to renew friendship with one

1260.g: to reckon thoroughly, i.e., (genitive case) to deliberate (by reflection or discussion)
1260.gl: to bring together different reasons, to reckon up the reasons, to reason, revolve in one's mind, deliberate
1260.gi: calcolare completamente, cioè (caso genitivo) deliberare (per riflessione o discussione)

1261.g: discussion, i.e., (internal) consideration (by implication, purpose), or (external) debate
1261.gl: the thinking of a man deliberating with himself; a thought, inward reasoning; purpose, design; a deliberating, questioning about what is true; hesitation, doubting; disputing, arguing
1261.gi: discussione, cioè (interna) considerazione (per implicazione, proposito), o (esterna) dibattito

1263.g: to attest or protest earnestly, or (by implication) hortatively
1263.gl: to testify; earnestly, religiously to charge; to attest, testify to, solemnly affirm; to give solemn testimony to one; to confirm a thing by testimony, to testify, cause it to be believed
1263.gi: attestare o protestare con fervore, o (per implicazione) esortare

1265.g: to stay constantly (in being or relation)
1265.gl: to stay permanently, remain permanently, continue

1266.g: to partition thoroughly (literally in distribution, figuratively in dissension)
1266.gl: to cleave asunder, cut in pieces; to be divided into opposing parts, to be at variance, in dissension; to distribute
1266.gi: partire completamente (letteralmente in distribuzione, figurato in dissensione)

1268.g: to distribute, i.e., (of information) to disseminate

1269.g: to nod (or express by signs) across an intervening space
1269.gl: to express one's meaning by a sign, nod to, beckon to, wink at
1269.gi: annuire (o esprimere con segni) attraverso uno spazio intermedio

1270.g: something thought through, i.e., a sentiment
1270.gi: qualcosa pensato a fondo, cioè un sentimento

1271.g: deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise
1271.gl: the mind as a faculty of understanding, feeling, desiring; understanding; mind, i.e., spirit, way of thinking and feeling; thoughts, either good or bad
1271.gi: pensiero profondo, propriamente la facoltà (mente o sua disposizione), per implicazione il suo esercizio

1272.g: to open thoroughly, literally (as a first-born) or figuratively (to expound)
1272.gl: to open by dividing or drawing asunder, to open thoroughly (what had been closed); a male opening the womb (the closed matrix), i.e., the first-born; of the eyes and the ears; to open the mind of one, i.e., to cause to understand a thing; to open one's soul, i.e., to rouse in one the faculty of understanding or the desire of learning
1272.gi: aprire completamente, letteralmente (come primogenito) o figurato (esporre)

1273.g: to sit up the whole night
1273.gl: to spend the night, to pass the whole night

1274.gl: to accomplish fully, bring quite to an end, finish

1275.gi: per tutto il tempo, cioè (avverbialmente) costantemente

1276.gl: to pass over, cross over, i.e., a river, a lake

1278.g: to toil through, i.e., (passively) be worried
1278.gl: to work out laboriously, make complete by labor; to exert one's self, strive; to manage with pains, accomplish with great labor; to be troubled, displeased, offended, pained, to be worked up

1279.gl: to cause to pass through a place; to carry across; to journey through a place, go through; to travel through

1280.gl: to be entirely at loss, to be in perplexity

1281.g: to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e., (transitively and by implication) to earn in business
1281.gl: thoroughly, earnestly to undertake a business; to undertake a business for sake of gain
1281.gi: occuparsi completamente, cioè (transitivamente e per implicazione) guadagnare in affari

1282.g: to saw asunder, i.e., (figuratively) to exasperate
1282.gl: to saw asunder or in two, to divide by a saw; to be sawn through mentally, i.e., to be rent with vexation

1284.gl: to break asunder, burst through, rend asunder; to rend, which was done by the jews to their clothes in cases of extreme indignation or in deep grief

1285.gl: to make clear or plain, to explain, unfold, declare; of things done, to declare i.e., to tell, announce, narrate

1286.g: to shake thoroughly, i.e., (figuratively) to intimidate
1286.gl: to shake thoroughly; to make to tremble; to terrify; to agitate; to extort from one by intimidation money or other property

1287.g: to dissipate, i.e., (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander
1287.gl: to scatter abroad, disperse, to winnow; to throw the grain a considerable distance, or up into the air, that it may be separated from the chaff; to gather the wheat, freed from the chaff into the granary; to winnow grain
1287.gi: dissipare, cioè (caso genitivo) sbaragliare o separare; specialmente vagliare; figurato sperperare

1288.g: to draw apart, i.e., sever or dismember
1288.gl: to rend asunder, break asunder; of a man, to tear in pieces
1288.gi: tirare a parte, cioè recidere o smembrare

1289.g: to sow throughout, i.e., (figuratively) distribute in foreign lands
1289.gi: seminare ovunque, cioè (figurato) distribuire in terre straniere

1290.g: dispersion, i.e., (specially and concretely) the (converted) israelite resident in gentile countries
1290.gl: a scattering, dispersion; of israelites dispersed among foreign nations; of the christians scattered abroad among the gentiles
1290.gi: dispersione, cioè (specialmente e concretamente) l'israelita (convertito) residente nei paesi gentili

1291.g: to set (oneself) apart (figuratively, distinguish), i.e., (by implication) to enjoin
1291.gl: to draw asunder, divide, distinguish, dispose, order; to open one's self i.e., one's mind, to set forth distinctly; to admonish, order, charge
1291.gi: mettere (se stesso) da parte (figurato, distinguere), cioè (per implicazione) ingiungere

1292.gl: an interval, distance, space of time

1293.gl: a distinction, difference; of the different sounds musical instruments make

1294.g: to distort, i.e., (figuratively) misinterpret, or (morally) corrupt
1294.gl: to distort, turn aside; to oppose, plot against the saving purposes and plans of god; to turn aside from the right path, to pervert, corrupt
1294.gi: distorcere, cioè (in senso figurato) interpretare male, o (moralmente) corrompere

1295.g: to save thoroughly, i.e., (by implication or analogy) to cure, preserve, rescue, etc
1295.gl: to preserve through danger, to bring safely through; to save, i.e., cure one who is sick, bring him through; to save, keep from perishing; to save out of danger, rescue
1295.gi: salvare completamente, cioè (per implicazione o analogia) guarire, preservare, soccorrere, ecc.

1298.g: to disturb wholly, i.e., agitate (with alarm)

1299.g: to arrange thoroughly, i.e., (specially) institute, prescribe, etc
1299.gl: to arrange, appoint, ordain, prescribe, give order
1299.gi: disporre completamente, cioè (specialmente) istituire, prescrivere, ecc.

1300.g: to accomplish thoroughly, i.e., (subjectively) to persist
1300.gl: to bring thoroughly to an end, accomplish

1301.g: to watch thoroughly, i.e., (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly
1301.gi: vegliare completamente, cioè (positivamente e transitivamente) osservare strettamente, o (negativamente e riflessivamente) evitare completamente

1302.gl: through, by, with, because of, for the sake of

1303.g: to put apart, i.e., (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest)
1303.gl: to arrange, dispose of, one's own affairs; of something that belongs to one; to dispose of by will, make a testament; to make a covenant, enter into a covenant, with one
1303.gi: mettere da parte, cioè (in senso figurato) disporre (per assegnazione, patto o lascito)

1304.gl: to rub between, rub hard; to wear away, consume; to spend, pass time

1306.g: to glimmer through, i.e., break (as day)
1306.gl: to shine through, to dawn; of daylight breaking through the darkness of night
1306.gi: brillare attraverso, cioè sorgere (come il giorno)

1308.g: to bear through, i.e., (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e., (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass
1308.gl: to bear or carry through any place; to carry different ways; to carry in different directions, to different places; of people who are carried hither and thither in a ship, driven to and fro; to differ, to test, prove, the good things that differ,; to distinguish between good and evil, lawful and unlawful, to approve of things that excel, to differ from one; to excel, surpass one; impersonally, it makes a difference, it matters, is of importance
1308.gi: portare attraverso, cioè (letteralmente) trasportare; solitamente portare da parte, cioè (oggettivamente) gettare qua e là (in senso figurato, riferire); soggettivamente, differire, o (per implicazione) superare

1309.gl: to flee through danger, to escape

1310.gl: to spread abroad, blaze abroad; to spread abroad his fame or renown

1311.g: to rot thoroughly, i.e., (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert)
1311.gl: to change for the worse, to corrupt; of minds, morals; to destroy, ruin; to consume; of bodily vigour and strength; of the worm or moth that eats provisions, clothing, etc.; to destroy, to kill
1311.gi: marcir completamente, cioè (per implicazione) rovinare (passivamente, decadere completamente, in senso figurato, pervertire)

1312.gl: corruption, destruction; in the new testament that destruction which is effected by the decay of the body after death

1313.gl: different, varying in kind; excellent, surpassing

1314.gl: to guard carefully; the lxx used this especially of god's providential care

1315.g: to handle thoroughly, i.e., lay violent hands upon
1315.gl: to move by the use of the hands, take in hand, manage, administer, govern; to lay hands on, slay, kill [with one's own hand]
1315.gi: maneggiare completamente, cioè porre violente mani su

1316.gl: to separate thoroughly or wholly; to separate one's self, depart

1318.gl: that can be taught; taught, instructed by one; teachings, precepts

1319.gl: teaching, instruction; teaching; that which is taught, doctrine; teachings, precepts

1320.gl: a teacher; one who is fitted to teach, or thinks himself so; the teachers of the jewish religion; of those who by their great power as teachers draw crowds around them i.e., john the baptist, jesus; by preeminence used of jesus by himself, as one who showed men the way of salvation; of the apostles, and of paul; of those who in the religious assemblies of the christians, undertook the work of teaching, with the special assistance of the holy spirit; of false teachers among christians; in the new testament one who teaches concerning the things of god, and the duties of man

1321.g: to teach (in the same broad application)
1321.gl: to teach; to hold discourse with others in order to instruct them, deliver didactic discourses; to be a teacher; to discharge the office of a teacher, conduct one's self as a teacher; to teach one; to impart instruction; instill doctrine into one; the thing taught or enjoined; to explain or expound a thing; to teach one something

1322.gl: teaching; that which is taught; doctrine, teaching, concerning something; the act of teaching, instruction; in religious assemblies of the christians, to speak in the way of teaching, in distinction from other modes of speaking in public

1323.gl: a didrachmon or double drachma, a silver coin equal to two attic drachmas or one alexandrian, or one half a shekel

1324.g: double, i.e., twin; didymus, a christian
1324.gl: [two fold, twain]; a surname for the apostle thomas
1324.gi: doppio, cioè gemello; Didimo, un cristiano

1325.g: to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection)
1325.gl: to give; to give something to someone; of one's own accord to give one something, to his advantage; to bestow a gift; to grant, give to one asking, let have; to supply, furnish, necessary things; to give over, deliver; to reach out, extend, present; of a writing; to give over to one's care, entrust, commit; something to be administered; to give or commit to some one something to be religiously observed; to give what is due or obligatory, to pay: wages or reward; to furnish, endue; to give; to cause, profuse, give forth from one's self; to give, hand out lots; to appoint to an office; to give one to someone as his own; as an object of his saving care; to give one to someone, to follow him as a leader and master; to give one to someone to care for his interests; to give one to someone to whom he already belonged, to return; to grant or permit one; to commission
1325.gi: dare (usato in un'applicazione molto ampia, propriamente, o per implicazione, letteralmente o figuratamente; grandemente modificato dal contesto)

1326.g: to wake fully; i.e., arouse (literally or figuratively)
1326.gl: to wake up, awaken, arouse (from sleep); of the sea, which begins to be agitated, to rise; metaphorically; to arouse the mind; stir up, render active
1326.gi: svegliare completamente; cioè destare (letteralmente o figuratamente)

1327.g: an outlet through, i.e., probably an open square (from which roads diverge)
1327.gl: a way out through, outlet, exit; literally the ways through which ways go out; the places before the city where the roads from the country terminate, therefore outlets of the country highways, also entrances into the city; of boundaries of countries
1327.gi: un'uscita attraverso, cioè probabilmente una piazza aperta (da cui si diramano le strade)

1329.g: to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate
1329.gl: to unfold the meaning of what is said, explain, expound; to translate into one's native language

1330.gl: to go through, pass through; to go, walk, journey, pass through a place; to travel the road which leads through a place, go, pass, travel through a region; to go different places; of people, to go abroad; of a report, to spread, go abroad

1331.g: to question throughout, i.e., ascertain by interrogation
1331.gl: to ask through; ask many, one after another; to find out by asking, enquire out
1331.gi: interrogare completamente, cioè accertare tramite interrogatorio

1332.gl: of two years, two years old

1334.gl: to lead or carry a narration through to the end; set forth, recount, relate in full, describe

1336.g: carried through, i.e., (adverbially with g1519 and g3588 prefixed) perpetually
1336.gi: portato attraverso, cioè (avverbialmente con εις e τος prefissi) perpetuamente

1337.g: having two seas, i.e., a sound with a double outlet
1337.gl: resembling or forming two seas: thus of the euxine sea; lying between two seas, i.e., washed on both sides by the sea; an isthmus or tongue of land, the extremity of which is covered by the waves; a projecting reef or bar against which the waves dash on both sides
1337.gi: che ha due mari, cioè uno stretto con un doppio sbocco

1339.g: to stand apart, i.e., (reflexively) to remove, intervene
1339.gl: to place separately, put asunder, disjoin; to stand apart, to part, depart
1339.gi: stare a parte, cioè (riflessivamente) rimuovere, intervenire

1340.g: to stout it through, i.e., asservate
1340.gl: to lean upon; to affirm stoutly, assert confidently

1342.g: equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively)
1342.gl: righteous, observing divine laws; in a wide sense, upright, righteous, virtuous, keeping the commands of god; of those who seem to themselves to be righteous, who pride themselves to be righteous, who pride themselves in their virtues, whether real or imagined; innocent, faultless, guiltless; used of him whose way of thinking, feeling, and acting is wholly conformed to the will of god, and who therefore needs no rectification in the heart or life; only christ truly; approved of or acceptable of god; in a narrower sense, rendering to each his due and that in a judicial sense, passing just judgment on others, whether expressed in words or shown by the manner of dealing with them
1342.gi: equo (di carattere o atto); per implicazione, innocente, santo (assolutamente o relativamente)

1343.g: equity (of character or act); specially (christian) justification
1343.gl: in a broad sense: state of him who is as he ought to be, righteousness, the condition acceptable to god; the doctrine concerning the way in which man may attain a state approved of god; integrity, virtue, purity of life, rightness, correctness of thinking feeling, and acting; in a narrower sense, justice or the virtue which gives each his due
1343.gi: equità (di carattere o atto); specialmente (cristiana) giustificazione

1344.g: to render (i.e., show or regard as) just or innocent
1344.gl: to render righteous or such he ought to be; to show, exhibit, evince, one to be righteous, such as he is and wishes himself to be considered; to declare, pronounce, one to be just, righteous, or such as he ought to be
1344.gi: rendere (cioè mostrare o considerare come) giusto o innocente

1345.g: an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision
1345.gl: that which has been deemed right so as to have force of law; what has been established, and ordained by law, an ordinance; a judicial decision, sentence; of god; either the favorable judgment by which he acquits man and declares them acceptable to him; unfavorable: sentence of condemnation; a righteous act or deed
1345.gi: un atto equo; per implicazione, uno statuto o una decisione

1346.gl: just, agreeably to right; properly, as is right; uprightly, agreeable to the law of rectitude

1347.gl: the act of god declaring men free from guilt and acceptable to him; abjuring to be righteous, justification

1349.g: right (as self-evident), i.e., justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution)
1349.gl: custom, usage; right, just; a suit at law; a judicial hearing, judicial decision, especially sentence of condemnation; execution of a sentence, punishment; to suffer punishment; the goddess justice, avenging justice
1349.gi: giusto (come autoevidente), cioè giustizia (il principio, una decisione o la sua esecuzione)

1351.g: equivocal, i.e., telling a different story
1351.gl: saying the same thing twice, repeating; double tongued, double in speech, saying one thing with one person another with another (with the intent to deceive)
1351.gi: equivoco, cioè dire una storia diversa

1352.gi: attraverso la quale cosa, cioè di conseguenza

1353.gl: to pass or travel through; to travel here and there, go about

1354.gl: [devoted to bacchus]; an athenian, a member of the areopagus, converted to christianity by paul

1356.gl: fallen from zeus, i.e., from heaven; an image of the ephesian artemis which was supposed to have fallen from heaven

1357.gl: in a physical sense, a making straight, restoring to its natural and normal condition something which in some way protrudes or has got out of line, as broken or misshapen limbs; of acts and institutions, reformation

1359.g: sons of jupiter, i.e., the twins dioscuri
1359.gl: castor and pollux, were the twin sons on jupiter and leda, and were regarded as the tutelary divinities of sailors
1359.gi: figli di Giove, cioè i gemelli Dioscuri

1360.g: on the very account that, or inasmuch as
1360.gl: on this account that, because; for
1360.gi: per il motivo stesso che, o poiché

1361.g: jove-nourished; diotrephes, an opponent of christianity
1361.gl: [nourished by jove]; a proud arrogant christian mentioned in 3 john 9
1361.gi: nutrito da Giove; Diotrefe, un oppositore del cristianesimo

1365.g: properly, to duplicate, i.e., (mentally) to waver (in opinion)

1366.gl: having a double mouth as a river; used of the edge of the sword and of other weapons, so has the meaning of two-edged

1368.gl: to filter through, strain through, pour through a filter, strain out

1369.g: to make apart, i.e., sunder (figuratively, alienate)
1369.gl: to cut into two parts, cleave asunder, sever
1369.gi: fare a parte, cioè separare (figurato, alienare)

1371.g: to bisect, i.e., (by extension) to flog severely
1371.gl: to cut into two parts; of the cruel method of punishment used by the hebrews and others of cutting one in two; cut up by scourging, scourge severely
1371.gi: tagliare a metà, cioè (per estensione) fustigare severamente

1372.gl: to suffer thirst, suffer from thirst; figuratively, those who are said to thirst who painfully feel their want of, and eagerly long for, those things by which the soul is refreshed, supported, strengthened

1374.g: two-spirited, i.e., vacillating (in opinion or purpose)
1374.gl: double minded; wavering, uncertain, doubting; divided in interest
1374.gi: duplice-spirito, cioè vacillante (nell'opinione o nello scopo)

1377.g: compare the base of g1169 and g1249); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute
1377.gl: to make to run or flee, put to flight, drive away; to run swiftly in order to catch a person or thing, to run after; to press on: figuratively of one who in a race runs swiftly to reach the goal; to pursue (in a hostile manner); in any way whatever to harass, trouble, molest one; to persecute; to be mistreated, suffer persecution on account of something; without the idea of hostility, to run after, follow after: someone; metaphorically, to pursue; to seek after eagerly, earnestly endeavor to acquire
1377.gi: Cfr. la base di g1169 e g1249); inseguire (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, perseguitare

1378.gl: doctrine, decree, ordinance; of public decrees; of the roman senate; of rulers; the rules and requirements of the law of moses; carrying a suggestion of severity and of threatened judgment; of certain decrees of the apostles relative to right living

1379.g: to prescribe by statute, i.e., (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule
1379.gl: to decree, command, enjoin, lay down an ordinance
1379.gi: prescrivere per statuto, cioè (riflessivamente) sottomettersi, governare cerimonialmente

1380.g: compare the base of g1166) of the same meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or uncertainly)
1380.gl: to be of opinion, think, suppose; to seem, to be accounted, reputed; it seems to me; i think, judge: thus in question; it seems good to, pleased me, i determined
1380.gi: Cfr. la base di g1166) dello stesso significato; pensare; per implicazione, sembrare (veramente o incertamente)

1381.g: to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve
1381.gl: to test, examine, prove, scrutinise (to see whether a thing is genuine or not), as metals; to recognize as genuine after examination, to approve, deem worthy

2097.gl: to bring good news, to announce glad tidings; used in the old testament of any kind of good news; of the joyful tidings of god's kindness, in particular, of the messianic blessings; in the new testament used especially of the glad tidings of the coming kingdom of god, and of the salvation to be obtained in it through christ, and of what relates to this salvation; glad tidings are brought to one, one has glad tidings proclaimed to him; to proclaim glad tidings; instruct (men) concerning the things that pertain to christian salvation
2097.gi: annunciare buone notizie ("evangelizzare") specialmente il vangelo

2098.g: a good message, i.e., the gospel
2098.gl: a reward for good tidings; good tidings; the glad tidings of the kingdom of god soon to be set up, and subsequently also of jesus the messiah, the founder of this kingdom; the glad tidings of salvation through christ; the proclamation of the grace of god manifest and pledged in christ; the gospel; the narrative of jesus' life and teachings (i.e., the books of matthew, mark, luke, and john)
2098.gi: un buon messaggio, cioè, il vangelo

2099.gl: a bringer of good tidings, an evangelist; the name given to the new testament heralds of salvation through christ who are not apostles

2100.gl: to be well pleasing; to be well pleased with a thing

2102.gl: in a manner well pleasing to one, acceptable

2104.g: well born, i.e., (literally) high in rank, or (figuratively) generous
2104.gl: well born, of noble race; noble minded
2104.gi: nobile, cioè (letteralmente) di alto rango, o (figurato) generoso

2105.g: a clear sky, i.e., fine weather
2105.gi: un cielo sereno, cioè, bel tempo

2106.g: to think well of, i.e., approve (an act); specially, to approbate (a person or thing)
2106.gl: it seems good to one, is one's good pleasure; think it good, choose, determine, decide; to do willingly; to be ready to, to prefer, choose rather; to be well pleased with, take pleasure in, to be favorably inclined towards one
2106.gi: pensare bene di, cioè, approvare (un atto); specialmente, approvare (una persona o cosa)

2107.g: satisfaction, i.e., (subjectively) delight, or (objectively) kindness, wish, purpose
2107.gl: will, choice; good will, kindly intent, benevolence; delight, pleasure, satisfaction; desire; for delight in any absent thing easily produces longing for it
2107.gi: soddisfazione, cioè (soggettivamente) delizia, o (oggettivamente) gentilezza, desiderio, scopo

2110.g: a worker of good, i.e., (specially) a philanthropist
2110.gl: benefactor; a title of honor, conferred on such as had done their country service, and upon princes, equivalent to soter, pater patriae
2110.gi: un operatore di bene, cioè, (specialmente) un filantropo

2112.g: directly, i.e., at once or soon

2113.g: to lay a straight course, i.e., sail direct
2113.gl: to make a straight course, run a straight course
2113.gi: tracciare una rotta retta, cioè navigare direttamente

2114.g: to cheer up, i.e., (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully
2114.gl: to put in good spirits, gladden, make cheerful; to be of good spirits, to be cheerful; to be joyful, be of good cheer, of good courage
2114.gi: rallegrarsi, cioè, (intransitivamente) essere allegro; comparativo neutro (avverbialmente) più allegro

2115.gl: well disposed, kind; of good cheer, of good courage

2116.gl: to make straight, level, plain; to lead or guide straight, to keep straight or direct; of the steersman or helmsman of a ship; of a charioteer

2117.g: straight, i.e., (literally) level, or (figuratively) true; adverbially (of time) at once
2117.gl: straight, level; straight forward, upright, true, sincere; straightway, immediately, forthwith
2117.gi: retto, cioè (letteralmente) livellato, o (figurato) vero; avverbiamente (di tempo) subito

2119.g: to have good time, i.e., opportunity or leisure
2119.gl: to have opportunity; to have leisure; to do something; to give one's time to a thing
2119.gi: avere tempo, cioè opportunità o tempo libero

2122.gl: seasonably, opportunely; when the opportunity occurs

2123.g: better for toil, i.e., more facile
2123.gi: meglio per fatica, cioè più facile

2124.g: properly, caution, i.e., (religiously) reverence (piety); by implication, dread (concretely)
2124.gl: caution, circumspection, discretion; avoidance; a reasonable shunning; reverence, veneration; reverence toward god, godly fear, piety; fear anxiety, dread
2124.gi: correttamente, cautela, cioè (religiosamente) riverenza (pietà); per implicazione, timore (concretamente)

2125.g: to be circumspect, i.e., (by implication) to be apprehensive; religiously, to reverence
2125.gl: to act cautiously, circumspectly; to beware, fear; to reverence, stand in awe of
2125.gi: essere circospetto, cioè (per implicazione) essere apprensivo; religiosamente, riverire

2126.gl: taking hold well; carefully and surely; cautiously; reverencing god, pious, religious
2126.gi: prendere bene (con cura), cioè circospetto (religiosamente, pio)

2127.g: to speak well of, i.e., (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper)
2127.gl: to praise, celebrate with praises; to invoke blessings; to consecrate a thing with solemn prayers; to ask god's blessing on a thing; pray god to bless it to one's use; pronounce a consecratory blessing on; of god; to cause to prosper, to make happy, to bestow blessings on; favored of god, blessed
2127.gi: parlare bene di, cioè (religiosamente) benedire (ringraziare o invocare una benedizione su, prosperare)

2129.g: fine speaking, i.e., elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), i.e., (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or largess
2129.gl: praise, laudation, panegyric: of christ or god; fine discourse, polished language; in a bad sense, language artfully adapted to captivate the hearer: fair speaking, fine speeches; an invocation of blessing, benediction; consecration; a (concrete) blessing, benefit
2129.gi: parlare fine, cioè eleganza di linguaggio; encomio ("elogio"), cioè (riverentemente) adorazione; religiosamente, benedizione; per implicazione, consacrazione; per estensione, beneficio o liberalità

2130.gl: ready or free to impart; liberal

2132.g: to be well- minded, i.e., reconcile
2132.gl: to wish (one) well; to be well disposed, of a peaceable spirit

2134.gl: to castrate, to neuter a man; metaphorically to make one's self a eunuch i.e., by abstaining (like a eunuch from marriage)

2135.g: a castrated person (such being employed in middle eastern bed-chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by implication, a chamberlain (state-officer)
2135.gl: a bed keeper, bed guard, superintendent of the bedchamber, chamberlain; in the palace of middle eastern monarchs who support numerous wives the superintendent of the women's apartment or harem, an office held by eunuchs; an emasculated man, a eunuch; eunuchs in middle eastern courts held by other offices of greater, held by the ethiopian eunuch mentioned (see acts 8:2739); one naturally incapacitated; for marriage; begetting children; one who voluntarily abstains from marriage
2135.gi: una persona castrata (tali venivano impiegati nelle camere da letto del Medio Oriente); per estensione un uomo impotente o celibe; per implicazione, un ciambellano (funzionario statale)

2136.g: fine travelling; euodia, a christian woman
2136.gi: viaggio fine; Euodia, una donna cristiana

2137.g: to help on the road, i.e., (passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively, to succeed in business affairs
2137.gl: to grant a prosperous and expeditious journey, to lead by a direct and easy way; to grant a successful issue, to cause to prosper; to prosper, be successful
2137.gi: aiutare lungo il cammino, cioè (passivamente) avere successo nel raggiungere; figuratamente, avere successo negli affari

2138.gi: buono per la persuasione, cioè, (intransitivo) lamentela

2139.g: well standing around, i.e., (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case)
2139.gi: stare bene attorno, cioè (un concorrente) ostacolare (un corridore) in ogni direzione (figurativamente, del peccato nel caso genitivo)

2141.g: (intransitively) to be good for passing through, i.e., (figuratively) have pecuniary means
2141.gl: to be well off, have means
2141.gi: (intransitivo) essere buono per passare attraverso, cioè, (figurato) avere mezzi pecuniari

2145.g: sitting well towards, i.e., (figuratively) assiduous (neuter, diligent service)
2145.gi: sedersi bene verso, cioè (figurativamente) assiduo (neutro, servizio diligente)

2146.g: to be of good countenance, i.e., (figuratively) to make a display
2146.gl: to make a fair show; to please
2146.gi: avere un buon aspetto, cioè, (figurato) fare una mostra

2147.gl: to come upon, hit upon, to meet with; after searching, to find a thing sought; without previous search, to find (by chance), to fall in with; those who come or return to a place; to find by enquiry, thought, examination, scrutiny, observation, to find out by practice and experience; to see, learn, discover, understand; to be found i.e., to be seen, be present; to be discovered, recognized, detected, to show one's self out, of one's character or state as found out by others (men, god, or both); to get knowledge of, come to know, god; to find out for one's self, to acquire, get, obtain, procure

2148.g: a storm from the east (or southeast), i.e., (in modern phrase) a levanter
2148.gl: [a violent agitation]; south east wind raising mighty waves; a wind causing broad waves
2148.gi: una tempesta da est (o sud-est), cioè, (in frase moderna) un levanter

2150.gl: reverence, respect; piety towards god, godliness
2150.gi: pietà; specialmente, il piano del vangelo

2151.g: to be pious, i.e., (towards god) to worship, or (towards parents) to respect (support)
2151.gl: to act piously or reverently; towards god, one's country, magistrates, relations, and all to whom dutiful regard or reverence is due
2151.gi: essere pio, cioè (verso Dio) adorare, o (verso i genitori) rispettare (sostenere)

2154.gl: well marked, clear and definite, distinct

2155.gl: having strong bowels; compassionate, tender hearted

2157.gl: charm or elegance of figure, external beauty, decorum, modesty, seemliness; of external charm, comeliness

2158.gl: of elegant figure; shapely, graceful, comely, bearing one's self becomingly in speech or behavior; of good standing; honorable, influential, wealthy, respectable
2158.gi: ben formato, cioè, (figurato) decoroso, nobile (in rango)

2159.g: in a well-strung manner, i.e., (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely)
2159.gi: in modo ben teso, cioè (figurativamente) intensamente (in senso buono, cogentemente; in senso cattivo, fieramente)

2160.g: witticism, i.e., (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry
2160.gl: pleasantry, humour, facetiousness; in a bad sense; scurrility, ribaldry, low jesting
2160.gi: battuta spiritosa, cioè, (in senso volgare) volgarità

2161.g: well- fated, i.e., fortunate; eutychus, a young man
2161.gl: [fortunate]; a youth restored to life by paul
2161.gi: ben destinato, cioè, fortunato; Eutico, un giovane uomo

2162.gl: the utterance of good or auspicious words; good report, praise

2163.gl: sounding well; uttering words of good omen, speaking auspiciously

2164.g: to bear well, i.e., be fertile
2164.gl: to be fertile, bring forth plentifully

2165.g: to put (middle voice or passively, be) in a good frame of mind, i.e., rejoice
2165.gl: to gladden, make joyful; to be glad, to be merry, to rejoice; to rejoice in, be delighted with a thing
2165.gi: mettere (voce media o passivamente, essere) in buon umore, cioè rallegrarsi

2166.gl: [the good and abounding river]; a large, famous river which rises in the mountains of armenia major, flows through assyria, syria, mesopotamia and the city of babylon, and empties into the gulf of persia

2168.g: to be grateful, i.e., (actively) to express gratitude (towards); specially, to say grace at a meal
2168.gl: to be grateful, feel thankful; give thanks
2168.gi: essere grato, cioè, (attivamente) esprimere gratitudine (verso); specialmente, dire la grazia a un pasto

2169.g: gratitude; actively, grateful language (to god, as an act of worship)
2169.gi: gratitudine; attivamente, linguaggio grato (a Dio, come atto di culto)

2170.gl: mindful of favors, grateful, thankful; pleasing, agreeable; acceptable to others, winning, liberal, beneficent

2171.g: properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to god, or in votive obligation
2171.gl: a prayer to god; a vow
2171.gi: propriamente, un desiderio, espresso come petizione a Dio, o in obbligo votivo

2172.g: to wish; by implication, to pray to god
2172.gl: to pray to god; to wish, to pray, to pray for

2173.gl: easy to make use of, useful

2174.g: to be in good spirits, i.e., feel encouraged
2174.gl: to be of good courage, to be of a cheerful spirit
2174.gi: essere di buon umore, cioè sentirsi incoraggiato

2175.gl: a sweet smell, fragrance; a fragrant or sweet smelling thing, incense, on odor or something sweet smelling; an odor of acquiescence, satisfaction; a sweet odor, spoken of the smell of sacrifices and obligations, agreeably to the ancient notion that god smells and is pleased with the odor of sacrifices; metaphorically a thing well pleasing to god

2176.g: properly, well-named (good-omened), i.e., the left (which was the lucky side among the pagan greeks); neuter as adverbial, at the left hand
2176.gl: of good name and of good omen; in the latter sense used in taking auguries; but those omens were euphemistically called "euonumos" which in fact were regarded as unlucky, i.e., which came from the left, sinister omens, (for which a good name was desired); left, on the left hand
2176.gi: propriamente, ben nominato (di buon auspicio), cioè, il sinistro (che era il lato fortunato tra i greci pagani); neutro come avverbio, alla mano sinistra

2178.gl: once, at once; all at once; once for all

2179.gl: a native or inhabitant of ephesus

2180.g: an ephesian or inhabitant of ephesus
2180.gl: a native or inhabitant of ephesus
2180.gi: un efesino o abitante di Efeso

2181.g: ephesus, a city of asia minor
2181.gl: [permitted]; a maritime city of asia minor, capital of ionia and under the romans, of proconsular asia, situated on the icarian sea between smyrna and miletus

2183.g: diurnality, i.e., (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the jewish priests' service at the temple, as distributed by families
2183.gl: a service limited to a stated series of days; the class or course itself of priests who for a week at a time performed the duties of the priestly office
2183.gi: diurnalità, cioè, (specialmente) la rotazione quotidiana o classe del servizio dei sacerdoti ebrei al tempio, come distribuito per famiglie

2185.g: to arrive upon, i.e., extend to

2186.g: to stand upon, i.e., be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal)
2186.gl: to place at, place upon, place over; to stand by, be present; to stand over one, place one's self above; used especially of persons coming upon one suddenly; an angel, of the advent of angels; of dreams; of evils coming upon one; to be at hand; be ready,; of time; to come upon; of rain
2186.gi: stare su, cioè, essere presente (in varie applicazioni, amichevoli o meno, di solito letterale)

2187.gl: [double fruitfulness]; a city about a short day's journey from jerusalem

2188.gl: be thou opened; receive the power of hearing, the ears of the deaf and the eyes of the blind being considered as closed

2189.g: hostility; by implication, a reason for opposition
2189.gi: ostilità; per implicazione, un motivo per l'opposizione

2190.g: hateful (passively, odious, or actively, hostile); usually as a noun, an adversary (especially satan)
2190.gl: hated, odious, hateful; hostile, hating, and opposing another; used of men as at enmity with god by their sin; opposing (god) in the mind; a man that is hostile; a certain enemy; the hostile one; the devil who is the most bitter enemy of the divine government
2190.gi: odioso (passivamente, odioso, o attivamente, ostile); di solito come sostantivo, un avversario (specialmente satana)

2191.g: an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively)
2191.gl: a viper, offspring of vipers; addressed to cunning, malignant, wicked men
2191.gi: una vipera o un altro serpente velenoso (letteralmente o figurativamente)

2192.g: to hold (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession; ability, contiuity, relation, or condition)
2192.gl: to have, i.e., to hold; to have (hold) in the hand, in the sense of wearing, to have (hold) possession of the mind (refers to alarm, agitating emotions, etc.), to hold fast keep, to have or comprise or involve, to regard or consider or hold as; to have i.e., own, possess; external things such as pertain to property or riches or furniture or utensils or goods or food etc.; used of those joined to any one by the bonds of natural blood or marriage or friendship or duty or law etc, of attendance or companionship; to hold one's self or find one's self so and so, to be in such or such a condition; to hold one's self to a thing, to lay hold of a thing, to adhere or cling to; to be closely joined to a person or a thing
2192.gi: tenere (usato in varie applicazioni, letteralmente o figurativamente, diretto o remoto; come possesso; capacità, continuità, relazione o condizione)

2193.g: a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place)
2193.gi: una congiunzione, preposizione e avverbio di continuazione, fino a (di tempo e luogo)

2194.g: zabulon (i.e., zebulon), a region of palestine
2194.gl: [a habitation]; the tenth of the sons of jacob; the tribe of zebulun
2194.gi: Zabulon (cioè, Zebulon), una regione della Palestina

2196.gl: [a rising (as the sun)]; the son of judah, ancestor of christ

2197.g: zacharias (i.e., zechariah), the name of two israelites
2197.gl: [remembered of jehovah]; the father of john the baptist; son of barachias, who was slain by the jews between the altar and the temple
2197.gi: Zaccaria (cioè, Zaccaria), il nome di due israeliti

2198.gl: to live, breathe, be among the living (not lifeless, not dead); to enjoy real life; to have true life and worthy of the name; active, blessed, endless in the kingdom of god; to live i.e., pass life, in the manner of the living and acting; of mortals or character; living water, having vital power in itself and exerting the same upon the soul; metaphorically to be in full vigor; to be fresh, strong, efficient,; (adjective) active, powerful, efficacious

2199.gl: [my gift]; a fisherman of galilee, the father of the apostles james the great and john, and the husband of salome

2200.gl: boiling hot, hot; metaphorically of fervour of mind an zeal

2201.g: a couple, i.e., a team (of oxen yoked together) or brace (of birds tied together)
2201.gl: two draught cattle (horses or mules or oxen) yoked together, a pair or yoke of beasts; a pair
2201.gi: una coppia, cioè una coppia (buoi giunti insieme) o una coppia (uccini legati insieme)

2203.g: in the oblique cases there is used instead of it a (probably cognate) name ??? <pronunciation strongs="deece"/>, which is otherwise obsolete; zeus or dis (among the latins, jupiter or jove), the supreme deity of the greeks
2203.gl: [a father of helps]; the national god of the greeks and corresponds to the roman jupiter
2203.gi: nei casi obliqui viene usato invece un nome (probabilmente affine) ??? <pronunciation strongs="deece"/>, che è altrimenti obsoleto; zeus o dis (tra i latini, giove o giupitero), la divinità suprema dei greci

2204.g: to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e., (figuratively) be fervid (earnest)
2204.gl: to boil with heat, be hot; used of water; metaphorically; used of boiling anger, love, zeal, for what is good or bad etc.; fervent in spirit, said of zeal for what is good
2204.gi: essere caldo (bollire, di liquidi; o brillare, di solidi), cioè (figurato) essere fervido (ardente)

2205.g: properly, heat, i.e., (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of god), or an enemy, malice)
2205.gl: excitement of mind, ardour, fervour of spirit; zeal, ardour in embracing, pursuing, defending anything; zeal in behalf of, for a person or thing; the fierceness of indignation, punitive zeal; an envious and contentious rivalry, jealousy
2205.gi: propriamente, calore, cioè (figurato) "zelo" (in senso favorevole, ardore; in senso sfavorevole, gelosia, come di un marito (figurato, di Dio), o di un nemico, malizia)

2206.g: to have warmth of feeling for or against
2206.gl: to burn with zeal; to be heated or to boil with envy, hatred, anger; in a good sense, to be zealous in the pursuit of good; to desire earnestly, pursue; to desire one earnestly, to strive after, busy one's self about him; to exert one's self for one (that he may not be torn from me); to be the object of the zeal of others, to be zealously sought after; to envy
2206.gi: avere calore di sentimento per o contro

2207.gl: one burning with zeal, a zealot; used of god as jealous of any rival and sternly vindicating his control; most eagerly desirous of, zealous for, a thing; to acquire a thing, (zealous of); to defend and uphold a thing, vehemently contending for a thing

2208.g: a zealot, i.e., (specially) partisan for jewish political independence
2208.gl: one burning with zeal, a zealot; used of god as jealous of any rival and sternly vindicating his control; most eagerly desirous of, zealous for, a thing; to acquire a thing, (zealous of); to defend and uphold a thing, vehemently contending for a thing
2208.gi: un zelota, cioè, (specialmente) partigiano per l'indipendenza politica ebraica

2210.g: to injure, i.e., (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment
2210.gl: to affect with damage, do damage to; to sustain damage, to receive injury, suffer loss
2210.gi: danneggiare, cioè (riflessivamente o passivamente) subire danno

2211.gl: [jupiter]; a teacher of the jewish law and afterwards a christian
2211.gi: donato da Giove; Zena, un cristiano

2212.g: to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by hebraism) to worship (god), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life)
2212.gl: to seek in order to find; to seek a thing; to seek [in order to find out] by thinking, meditating, reasoning, to enquire into; to seek after, seek for, aim at, strive after; to seek i.e., require, demand; to crave, demand something from someone
2212.gi: cercare (letteralmente o figurato); specialmente, (per ebraismo) adorare (Dio), o (in senso negativo) complottare (contro la vita)

2213.g: a search (properly concretely), i.e., (in words) a debate
2213.gl: a question, debate; about the law
2213.gi: una ricerca (propriamente concreta), cioè (in parole) un dibattito

2214.g: a searching (properly, the act), i.e., a dispute or its theme
2214.gl: a seeking; enquiry; a questioning, debate; a subject of questioning or debate, matter of controversy
2214.gi: una ricerca (propriamente, l'atto), cioè una disputa o il suo tema

2215.gl: a kind of darnel, resembling wheat except the grains are black

2216.gl: [born at babel, i.e., babylon]; the head of the tribe of judah at the time of the return from babylonish captivity in the first year of cyrus

2217.gl: darkness, blackness; used of the darkness of the nether world

2218.g: a coupling, i.e., (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales)
2218.gl: a yoke; a yoke that is put on draught cattle; metaphorically, used of any burden or bondage; as that of slavery; of troublesome laws imposed on one, especially of the mosaic law, hence the name is so transferred to the commands of christ as to contrast them with the commands of the pharisees which were a veritable 'yoke'; yet even christ's commands must be submitted to, though easier to be kept; a balance, pair of scales
2218.gi: un accoppiamento, cioè (figurato) servitù (una legge o obbligazione); anche (letteralmente) la bilancia (come connessione delle scale)

2219.gl: leaven; metaphorically of inveterate mental and moral corruption, viewed in its tendency to infect others leaven is applied to that which, though small in quantity, yet by its influence thoroughly pervades a thing; either in a good sense as in the parable matthew 13:33; or in a bad sense, of a pernicious influence, "a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump"

2220.gl: to leaven; to mix leaven with dough so as to make it ferment

2221.g: to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e., (figuratively) to capture or ensnare
2221.gl: to take alive; to take, catch, capture
2221.gi: prendere vivo (fare prigioniero di guerra), cioè (figurato) catturare o intrappolare
