2222.gl: life; the state of one who is possessed of vitality or is animate; every living soul; life; of the absolute fullness of life, both essential and ethical, which belongs to god, and through him both to the hypostatic "logos" and to christ in whom the "logos" put on human nature; life real and genuine, a life active and vigorous, devoted to god, blessed, in the portion even in this world of those who put their trust in christ, but after the resurrection to be consummated by new accessions (among them a more perfect body), and to last for ever

2223.g: a belt; by implication, a pocket
2223.gl: a girdle, belt, serving not only to gird on flowing garments but also, since it was hollow, to carry money in
2223.gi: una cintura; per implicazione, una tasca

2224.g: to bind about (especially with a belt)
2224.gl: to gird; to gird one's self

2225.g: to engender alive, i.e., (by analogy) to rescue (passively, be saved) from death
2225.gl: to bring forth alive; to give life; to preserve alive
2225.gi: generare vivo, cioè (per analogia) salvare (passivamente, essere salvato) dalla morte

2226.g: a live thing, i.e., an animal
2226.gl: a living being; an animal, brute, beast

2227.gl: to produce alive, begat or bear living young; to cause to live, make alive, give life; by spiritual power to arouse and invigorate; to restore to life; to give increase of life: thus of physical life; of the spirit, quickening as respects the spirit, endued with new and greater powers of life; metaphorically, of seeds quickened into life, i.e., germinating, springing up, growing

2230.gl: to be leader, to lead the way; to rule, command; of a province, to be governor of a province; said of a proconsul, of a procurator

2231.gl: chief command, rule, sovereignty; of the reign of a roman emperor

2232.g: a leader, i.e., chief person (or figuratively, place) of a province
2232.gl: a leader of any kind, a guide, ruler, prefect, president, chief, general, commander, sovereign; a "legatus caesaris" (an officer administering a province in the name and with the authority of the roman emperor); the governor of a province; a procurator, an officer who was attached to a proconsul or a proprietor and had charge of the imperial revenues; in causes relating to these revenues he administered justice; of a principal town as the capital of the region
2232.gi: un capo, cioè persona principale (o figurato, luogo) di una provincia

2233.g: to lead, i.e., command (with official authority); figuratively, to deem, i.e., consider
2233.gl: to lead; to go before; to be a leader; to rule, command; to have authority over; a prince, of regal power, governor, viceroy, chief, leading as respects influence, controlling in counsel, overseers or leaders of the churches; used of any kind of leader, chief, commander; the leader in speech, chief, spokesman; to consider, deem, account, think
2233.gi: condurre, cioè comandare (con autorità ufficiale); figurato, ritenere, cioè considerare

2238.gl: sweet smelling, garden mint; a kind of small odoriferous herb, with which the jews used to scatter on the floors of their houses and synagogues

2239.gl: a customary abode, dwelling place, haunt, customary state; custom, usage, morals, character

2240.g: to arrive, i.e., be present (literally or figuratively)
2240.gl: to have come, have arrived, be present; metaphorically; to come to one, i.e., to seek an intimacy with one, become his follower: to come upon one (unexpectedly); to come upon one, of things endured
2240.gi: arrivare, cioè essere presente (letteralmente o figurato)

2242.gl: [ascending]; the father of joseph, the husband of mary

2243.gl: [my god is jehovah]; the old testament prophet elijah

2244.gl: age, time of life; age, term or length of life; adult age, maturity; suitable age for anything; metaphorically of an attained state fit for a thing; stature, i.e., in height and comeliness of stature

2245.g: as big as, i.e., (interjectively) how much
2245.gl: as old as, as tall as; how great; how small

2246.gl: the sun; the rays of the sun; the light of day

2250.g: day, i.e., (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context)
2250.gl: the day, used of the natural day, or the interval between sunrise and sunset, as distinguished from and contrasted with the night; in the daytime; metaphorically, "the day" is regarded as the time for abstaining from indulgence, vice, crime, because acts of the sort are perpetrated at night and in darkness; of the civil day, or the space of twenty four hours (thus including the night); of the last day of this present age, the day christ will return from heaven, raise the dead, hold the final judgment, and perfect his kingdom; used of time in general, i.e., the days of his life.
2250.gi: giorno, cioè (letteralmente) lo spazio di tempo tra l'alba e il buio, o le 24 ore complete (ma diversi giorni erano di solito conteggiati dagli ebrei come inclusi delle parti di entrambi gli estremi); figurato, un periodo (sempre definito più o meno chiaramente dal contesto)

2259.gl: at which time, when; whenever, at length when

2260.g: than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed)

2261.g: properly, affable, i.e., mild or kind
2261.gi: propriamente, affabile, cioè mite o gentile

2262.gl: [watchful]; the son of jose and the father of elmodam

2264.g: heroic; herod, the name of four jewish kings
2264.gl: [heroic]; the name of a royal family that flourished among the jews in the times of christ and the apostles; herod the great (the ruler of judaea when jesus christ was born; herod surnamed "antipas," the son of herod the great, (the ruler during the latter part of jesus' earthly life; herod agrippa i, the son of aristobulus and berenice and grandson of herod the great, (he ordered james to be executed and imprisoned peter); herod agrippa ii (referred to in the new testament simply as agrippa), son of herod agrippa i (he was almost persuaded to become a christian by paul's arguments)
2264.gi: eroico; Erode, nome di quattro re ebrei

2265.gl: herodians, i.e., herod's partisans, herod's supporters

2266.g: herodias, a woman of the heodian family
2266.gl: [heroic]; daughter of aristobulus and granddaughter of herod the great

2268.gl: [jehovah's help]; a famous hebrew prophet who prophesied in the reigns of uzziah, jotham, ahaz, and hezekiah

2269.gl: [hairy]; was the eldest son of isaac and twin brother of jacob

2270.g: to keep still (intransitively), i.e., refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech
2270.gl: to keep quiet; to rest, cease from labor; to lead a quiet life, said of those who are not running hither and thither, but stay at home and mind their business; to be silent, i.e., to say nothing, hold one's peace
2270.gi: stare fermo (intransitivo), cioè astenersi dal lavoro, dalla curiosità o dal parlare

2271.g: (as noun) stillness, i.e., desistance from bustle or language
2271.gl: quietness; description of the life of one who stays at home doing his own work, and does not officiously meddle with the affairs of others; silence
2271.gi: (come sostantivo) quiete, cioè, cessazione di attività o di linguaggio

2272.g: properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e., (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing)
2272.gi: propriamente, rimanere seduto (sedentario), cioè, (per implicazione) immobile (non disturbato, non disturbante)

2274.g: to make worse, i.e., vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower
2274.gl: to make less, inferior, to overcome; to be made inferior; to overcome, worsted, to be conquered by one, forced to yield to one; to hold a thing inferior, set below
2274.gi: peggiorare, cioè sconfiggere (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, valutare meno

2275.g: a deterioration, i.e., (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss
2275.gl: a diminution, decrease: i.e., defeat; loss, as respects to salvation
2275.gi: un deterioramento, cioè, (oggettivamente) fallimento o (soggettivamente) perdita

2276.g: worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb)
2276.gi: peggiore (come sostantivo); per implicazione, meno (come avverbio)

2278.g: to make a loud noise, i.e., reverberate
2278.gl: to sound; used of the roaring of the sea
2278.gi: fare un forte rumore, cioè, rimbombare

2279.g: a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e., roar; figuratively, a rumor
2279.gl: a sound, noise; spoken of the roar of the sea waves; rumour, report
2279.gi: un rumore forte o confuso ("eco"), cioè ruggito; figurato, una voce

2280.gl: [large hearted, courageous]; one of the twelve apostles, also apparently known as lebbaeus, judas, and jude

2281.gl: the sea; used of the sea in general; used specifically of the mediterranean sea or the red sea

2282.gl: to warm, keep warm; to cherish with tender love, to foster with tender care

2283.gl: [palm tree]; thamar (or tamar), the wife of the two sons of judah, er and onan

2284.gl: to be astonished; to astonish, terrify; to be amazed; to be frightened

2288.g: (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively)
2288.gl: the death of the body; that separation (whether natural or violent) of the soul and the body by which the life on earth is ended; with the implied idea of future misery in hell; the power of death; since the nether world, the abode of the dead, was conceived as being very dark, it is equivalent to the region of thickest darkness i.e., figuratively, a region enveloped in the darkness of ignorance and sin; metaphorically, the loss of that life which alone is worthy of the name,; the misery of the soul arising from sin, which begins on earth but lasts and increases after the death of the body in hell; the miserable state of the wicked dead in hell; in the widest sense, death comprising all the miseries arising from sin, as well physical death as the loss of a life consecrated to god and blessed in him on earth, to be followed by wretchedness in hell
2288.gi: (propriamente, un aggettivo usato come sostantivo) morte (letteralmente o figurato)

2289.gl: to put to death; metaphorically; to make to die i.e., destroy, render extinct; by death to be liberated from the bond of anything, literally to be made dead in relation to (something)

2290.g: to celebrate funeral rites, i.e., inter

2291.g: thara (i.e., terach), the father of abraham

2292.gl: to be of good courage, be of good cheer; to be bold

2293.gl: to be of good courage, be of good cheer

2295.g: wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract)
2295.gl: a wonderful thing, a marvel; wonder; to wonder [with great wonder i.e.,] exceedingly
2295.gi: meraviglia (propriamente concreto; ma per implicazione, astratto)

2296.g: to wonder; by implication, to admire
2296.gl: to wonder, wonder at, marvel; to be wondered at, to be had in admiration

2297.g: wondrous, i.e., (neuter as noun) a miracle
2297.gi: meraviglioso, cioè, (neutro come sostantivo) un miracolo

2298.gl: wonderful, marvellous; worthy of pious admiration, admirable, excellent; passing human comprehension; causing amazement joined with terror; marvellous; extraordinary, striking, surprising

2300.g: to look closely at, i.e., (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit
2300.gl: to behold, look upon, view attentively, contemplate (often used of public shows); of important persons that are looked on with admiration; to view, take a view of; in the sense of visiting, meeting with a person; to learn by looking, to see with the eyes, to perceive
2300.gi: guardare attentamente, cioè (per implicazione) percepire (letteralmente o figurato); per estensione visitare

2301.gl: to bring upon the stage; to set forth as a spectacle, expose to contempt

2302.g: a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e., general audience-room; by implication, a show itself (figuratively)
2302.gl: a theatre, a place in which games and dramatic spectacles are exhibited, and public assemblies held (for the greeks used the theatre also as a forum); a public show; metaphorically, a man who is exhibited to be gazed at and made sport of
2302.gi: un luogo per spettacoli pubblici ("teatro"), cioè sala per il pubblico; per implicazione, uno spettacolo stesso (figurato)

2303.gl: brimstone; divine incense, because burning brimstone was regarded as having power to purify, and to ward off disease

2304.gl: a general name of deities or divinities as used by the greeks; spoken of the only and true god, trinity; of christ; holy spirit; the father

2307.g: a determination (properly, the thing), i.e., (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination
2307.gl: what one wishes or has determined shall be done; of the purpose of god to bless mankind through christ; of what god wishes to be done by us; commands, precepts; will, choice, inclination, desire, pleasure
2307.gi: una determinazione (propriamente, la cosa), cioè, (attivamente) scelta (specialmente, scopo, decreto; astrattamente, volontà) o (passivamente) inclinazione

2309.g: to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas g1014 properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e., choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e., be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by hebraism, to delight in
2309.gl: to will, have in mind, intend; to be resolved or determined, to purpose; to desire, to wish; to love; to like to do a thing, be fond of doing; to take delight in, have pleasure
2309.gi: determinare (come opzione attiva da impulso soggettivo; mentre g1014 propriamente denota piuttosto un'acquisizione passiva in considerazioni oggettive), cioè scegliere o preferire (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, volere, cioè essere incline (a volte avverbialmente, volentieri); impersonalmente per il futuro, per essere sul punto di; per ebraismo, dilettarsi

2310.g: something put down, i.e., a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively)
2310.gl: laid down as a foundation, the foundation (of a building, wall, city); metaphorically the foundations, beginnings, first principals; of institution or system of truth
2310.gi: qualcosa posto giù, cioè una base (di un edificio, ecc.), (letteralmente o figurato)

2311.g: to lay a basis for, i.e., (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate
2311.gl: to lay the foundation, to found; to make stable, establish
2311.gi: porre una base, cioè (letteralmente) erigere, o (figurato) consolidare

2315.gl: inspired by god; the contents of the scriptures

2316.g: a deity, especially (with g3588) the supreme divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; exceedingly (by hebraism)
2316.gl: a god or goddess, a general name of deities or divinities; the godhead, trinity; god the father, the first person in the trinity; christ, the second person of the trinity; holy spirit, the third person in the trinity; spoken of the only and true god; refers to the things of god; his counsels, interests, things due to him; whatever can in any respect be likened unto god, or resemble him in any way; god's representative or viceregent; of magistrates and judges
2316.gi: una divinità, specialmente (con g3588) la suprema divinità; figurato, un magistrato; eccedentemente (per ebraismo)

2319.gl: hateful to god, exceptionally impious and wicked

2320.gl: deity; the state of being god, godhead

2321.g: friend of god; theophilus, a christian
2321.gl: [friend of god]; the person to whom luke addressed his gospel and the book of acts
2321.gi: amico di Dio; Teofilo, un cristiano

2322.g: attendance (specially, medical, i.e., cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics
2322.gl: service rendered by one to another; specifically medical service: curing, healing; household service; body of attendants, servants, domestics
2322.gi: assistenza (specialmente, medica, cioè, cura); figurato e collettivamente, domestici

2323.g: to wait upon menially, i.e., (figuratively) to adore (god), or (specially) to relieve (of disease)
2323.gl: to serve, do service; to heal, cure, restore to health
2323.gi: servire umilmente, cioè (figurato) adorare (Dio), o (specialmente) guarire (dalla malattia)

2324.gl: an attendant, servant: of god; spoken of moses discharging the duties committed to him by god

2325.gl: to reap, harvest; proverbial expression for sowing and reaping; cut off, destroy; as crops are cut down with a sickle

2326.gl: harvest, the act of reaping; figurative for the gathering of men into the kingdom of god; referring to time of reaping, the final judgment, when the righteous are gathered into the kingdom of god and the wicked are cast into hell for ever

2328.gl: to make warm, to heat; to warm one's self

2331.g: a thessalonican, i.e., inhabitant of thessalonice
2331.gi: un tessalonicese, cioè abitante di Tessalonica

2332.g: thessalonice, a place in asia minor
2332.gl: [victory of falsity]; a famous and populous city, situated on the thermaic gulf, the capital of the second division of macedonia and the residence of a roman governor and quaestor
2332.gi: Tessalonica, un luogo in Asia Minore

2333.gl: [god-given]; the name of an insurgent mentioned in gamaliel's speech before the jewish council at the time of the arraignment of the apostles

2334.g: to be a spectator of, i.e., discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge))
2334.gl: to be a spectator, look at, behold; to view attentively, take a view of, survey; to view mentally, consider; to see; to perceive with the eyes, to enjoy the presence of one; to discern, descry; to ascertain, find out by seeing
2334.gi: essere spettatore di, cioè, discernere, (letteralmente, figurato (esperienza) o intensivamente (riconoscere))

2335.gl: a viewing, beholding; that which is viewed, a spectacle, sight

2336.gl: that which a thing is put or laid away, a receptacle, repository, chest, box; used of the sheath of a sword

2337.gl: to give the breast, give suck, to suckle; to suck

2338.gl: of the female sex; a woman, a female

2339.gl: a hunting of wild beasts to destroy them; metaphorically of preparing destruction for men

2340.g: to hunt (an animal), i.e., (figuratively) to carp at
2340.gl: to go a hunting, to hunt, to catch in hunting; metaphorically to lay wait for, strive to ensnare, catch artfully

2341.g: to be a beast-fighter (in the gladiatorial show), i.e., (figuratively) to encounter (furious men)
2341.gi: essere un combattitore di bestie (nel combattimento gladiatorio), cioè (figurato) affrontare (uomini furiosi)

2342.gl: an animal; a wild animal, wild beast, beast; metaphorically a brutal, bestial man, savage, ferocious

2343.g: to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively)
2343.gl: to gather and lay up, to heap up, store up; to accumulate riches; to keep in store, store up, reserve; metaphorically so to live from day to day as to increase either the bitterness or the happiness of one's consequent lot

2344.g: a deposit, i.e., wealth (literally or figuratively)
2344.gl: the place in which good and precious things are collected and laid up; a casket, coffer, or other receptacle, in which valuables are kept; a treasury; storehouse, repository, magazine; the things laid up in a treasury, collected treasures
2344.gi: un deposito, cioè ricchezza (letteralmente o figurato)

2345.g: to manipulate, i.e., have to do with; by implication, to injure
2345.gl: to touch, handle; to do violence to, injury
2345.gi: manipolare, cioè avere a che fare; per implicazione, ferire

2346.gl: to press (as grapes), press hard upon; a compressed way; narrow straitened, contracted; metaphorically to trouble, afflict, distress

2347.gl: a pressing, pressing together, pressure; metaphorically oppression, affliction, tribulation, distress, straits

2348.gl: to die, to be dead; metaphorically to be spiritually dead

2350.g: to be in tumult, i.e., disturb, clamor
2350.gl: to make a noise or uproar, be turbulent; to disturb, throw into confusion; to be troubled in mind; to wail tumultuously
2350.gi: essere in tumulto, cioè disturbare, clamore

2351.gl: a noise, tumult, uproar; of persons wailing; of a clamorous and excited multitude; of riotous persons; a tumult, as a breach of public order

2352.gl: to break, break in pieces, shatter, smite through

2353.gl: whatever is fed or nursed; a ward, nursling, child; a flock, cattle, especially sheep and goats

2354.gl: to mourn, to lament; of singers of dirges, [to wail]; to bewail, deplore

2356.gl: religious worship; especially external, that which consists of ceremonies; religious discipline, religion

2357.g: ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e., pious
2357.gl: fearing or worshipping god; to tremble; trembling, fearful
2357.gi: cerimonioso nel culto (come dimostrativo), cioè pio

2358.g: and a derivative of g0680 (meaning a noisy iambus, a hymn sung in festal processions in honor of the god bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e., (figuratively) to conquer or (by hebraism) to give victory
2358.gl: to triumph, to celebrate a triumph; cause one to triumph
2358.gi: e derivato da g0680 (significando un iambus rumoroso, un inno cantato in processioni festive in onore del dio Bacco); fare una processione acclamatoria, cioè (figurato) conquistare o (per ebraismo) dare la vittoria

2359.gl: the hair of the head; the hair of animals

2360.g: to clamor, i.e., (by implication) to frighten
2360.gl: to cry aloud, make a noise by outcry; in the new testament, to trouble, frighten; to be troubled in mind, to be frightened, alarmed

2361.gl: a large thick drop, especially of clotted blood

2362.g: a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate
2362.gl: a throne seat; a chair of state having a footstool; assigned in the new testament to kings, hence, kingly power or royalty; metaphorically to god, the governor of the world; to the messiah, christ, the partner and assistant in the divine administration; hence divine power belonging to christ; to judges i.e., tribunal or bench; to elders
2362.gi: un solido trono; per implicazione, potere o (concretamente) un potente

2363.g: thyatira, a place in asia minor
2363.gl: [odor of affliction]; a colony of macedonia greeks, situated between sardis and pergamos on the river lycus; its inhabitants gained their living by traffic and the art of dyeing in purple
2363.gi: Tiatira, un luogo in Asia Minore

2364.g: a female child, or (by hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant)
2364.gl: a daughter; a daughter of god; acceptable to god, rejoicing in god's peculiar care and protection; with the name of a place, city, or region; denotes collectively all its inhabitants and citizens; a female descendant
2364.gi: una figlia femmina, o (per ebraismo) discendente (o abitante)

2367.gl: the citrus, an odoriferous north african tree used as incense, prized by the ancient greeks and romans on account of the beauty of its wood for various ornamental purposes

2368.g: an aroma, i.e., fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself
2368.gi: un aroma, cioè polvere profumata bruciata nel culto religioso; per implicazione, il bruciamento stesso

2369.g: a place of fumigation, i.e., the alter of incense (in the temple)
2369.gl: a utensil for fumigating or burning incense; an altar of incense
2369.gi: un luogo di incenso, cioè l'altare dell'incenso (nel tempio)

2370.g: to fumigate, i.e., offer aromatic fumes

2371.g: to be in a furious fight, i.e., (figuratively) to be exasperated
2371.gl: to carry on war with great animosity; to be very angry, be exasperated
2371.gi: essere in una furiosa lotta, cioè (figurato) essere esasperato

2372.gl: passion, angry, heat, anger forthwith boiling up and soon subsiding again; glow, ardour, the wine of passion, inflaming wine (which either drives the drinker mad or kills him with its strength)

2373.g: to put in a passion, i.e., enrage
2373.gl: to cause one to become incensed, to provoke to anger; to be wroth

2374.g: a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively)
2374.gl: a door; the vestibule; used of any opening like a door, an entrance, way or passage into; in a parable or metaphor; the door through which sheep go in and out, the name of him who brings salvation to those who follow his guidance; "an open door" is used of the opportunity of doing something; the door of the kingdom of heaven (likened to a palace) denotes the conditions which must be complied with in order to be received into the kingdom of god
2374.gi: un portale o un ingresso (l'apertura o la chiusura, letteralmente o figuratamente)

2375.gl: a shield, a large oblong, four cornered shield
2375.gi: un grande scudo (a forma di porta)

2377.gl: a doorkeeper, porter; a male or female janitor

2378.g: sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively)
2378.gi: sacrificio (l'atto o la vittima, letteralmente o figurato)

2379.g: a place of sacrifice, i.e., an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative)
2379.gl: the altar for slaying and burning of victims used of; the altar of whole burnt offerings which stood in the court of the priests in the temple at jerusalem; the altar of incense which stood in the sanctuary or the holy place; any other altar; metaphorically, the cross on which christ suffered an expiatory death: to eat of this altar i.e., to appropriate to one's self the fruits of christ's expiatory death
2379.gi: un luogo di sacrificio, cioè un altare (caso speciale o genitivo, letterale o figurato)

2380.g: properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e., (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose)
2380.gl: to sacrifice, immolate; to slay, kill; of the paschal lamb; slaughter
2380.gi: propriamente, affrettarsi (respiro pesante, soffiare, fumare), cioè (per implicazione) sacrificare (propriamente, per fuoco, ma caso genitivo); per estensione immolare (sacrificare per qualsiasi scopo)

2382.g: the chest ("thorax"), i.e., (by implication) a corslet
2382.gl: the breast, the part of the body from the neck to the navel, where the ribs end; a breastplate or corset consisting of two parts and protecting the body on both sides from the neck to the middle
2382.gi: il petto (torace), cioè (per implicazione) una corazza

2383.gl: [whom god enlightens]; a ruler of a synagogue, probably near the western shore of the sea of galilee

2384.g: jacob (i.e., ja`akob), the progenitor of the israelites
2384.gl: [heel-catcher, supplanter]; was the second son of isaac; the father of joseph, the husband of mary

2385.g: jacobus, the name of three israelites
2385.gl: [supplanter]; son of zebedee, an apostle and brother of the apostle john, commonly called james the greater or elder, slain by herod, acts 12; an apostle, son of alphaeus, called the less; james the half-brother of christ; an unknown james, father of the apostle judas(?)
2385.gi: Giacomo, il nome di tre israeliti

2386.gl: a means of healing, remedy, medicine; a healing

2387.gl: [foamy healer]; jambres, one of pharaoh's magicians who attempted to replicate moses' miracles in the old testament

2388.gl: [flourishing]; son of joseph and the father of melchi, in the genealogy of christ

2389.gl: [he vexed]; jannes, one of pharaoh's magicians who attempted to replicate moses' miracles in the old testament

2390.gl: to cure, heal; to make whole; to free from errors and sins, to bring about (one's) salvation

2391.gl: [descent]; one of the antediluvian patriarchs, the father of enoch

2393.gl: jasper, a precious stone of various colors (for some are purple, others blue, others green, and others the color of brass)

2394.g: about to cure; jason, a christian
2394.gl: [one who will heal]; a thessalonians who entertained paul and silas, and maybe a cousin of paul (romans 16:21)

2396.g: used as an interjection to denote surprise; lo!
2396.gi: usato come interiezione per esprimere sorpresa; ecco!

2398.g: pertaining to self, i.e., one's own; by implication, private or separate
2398.gl: pertaining to one's self, one's own, belonging to one's self
2398.gi: relativo a sé, cioè, proprio; per implicazione, privato o separato

2399.g: a private person, i.e., (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot")
2399.gl: a private person as opposed to a magistrate, ruler, king; a common soldier, as opposed to a military officer; a writer of prose as opposed to a poet; in the new testament, an unlearned, illiterate, man as opposed to the learned and educated: one who is unskilled in any art
2399.gi: una persona privata, cioè (per implicazione) un ignorante (confronta "idiota")

2401.g: idumaea (i.e., edom), a region east (and south) of palestine
2401.gl: idumaea, the name of a region between southern palestine and the arabian petraea inhabited by edom or esau and his posterity
2401.gi: idumea (cioè, edom), una regione est (e sud) della palestina

2403.g: jezabel (i.e., jezebel), a tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher)
2403.gl: [chaste]; wife of ahab, an impious and cruel queen who protected idolatry and persecuted the prophets; the symbolic name of a woman who pretended to be a prophetess, and who, addicted to antinomianism, claimed christian liberty of eating things sacrificed to idols
2403.gi: Jezabel (cioà Jezebel), una donna tiria (usata come sinonimo di donna litigiosa o falso maestro)

2404.g: holy city; hierapolis, a place in asia minor
2404.gl: [holy city]; a city of phrygia, situated above the junction of the rivers lycus and maeander, near colosse and laodicea
2404.gi: città santa; Ierapoli, un luogo in Asia Minore

2405.gl: the priesthood, the office of a priest

2406.g: the priestly fraternity, i.e., sacerdotal order (figuratively)
2406.gl: the office of a priest; the order or body of priests
2406.gi: la confraternita sacerdotale, cioè ordine sacerdotale (figurato)

2407.g: to be a priest, i.e., perform his functions
2407.gl: to be a priest, discharge the office of a priest, to be busied in sacred duties
2407.gi: essere un sacerdote, cioà eseguire le sue funzioni

2408.gl: [whom jehovah has appointed]; the old testament prophet jeremiah

2409.gl: a priest, one who offers sacrifices and in general in busied with sacred rites; referring to priests of gentiles or the jews,; metaphorically of christians, because, purified by the blood of christ and brought into close intercourse with god, they devote their life to him alone and to christ

2410.gl: [place of fragrance]; jericho, a noted city

2411.g: a sacred place, i.e., the entire precincts (whereas g3485 denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the temple (at jerusalem or elsewhere)
2411.gl: a sacred place, temple; used of the temple of artemis at ephesus; used of the temple at jerusalem
2411.gi: un luogo sacro, cioè l'intero recinto (mentre g3485 indica il santuario centrale stesso) del tempio (a Gerusalemme o altrove)

2412.gl: befitting men, places, actions or sacred things to god; reverent

2413.gl: sacred, consecrated to the deity, pertaining to god; sacred scriptures, because inspired by god, treating of divine things and therefore to be devoutly revered

2414.g: hierosolyma (i.e., jerushalaim), the capitol of palestine
2414.gl: [set ye double peace]; denotes either the city itself or the inhabitants; "the jerusalem that now is", with its present religious institutions, i.e., the mosaic system, so designated from its primary external location; "jerusalem that is above", that is existing in heaven, according to the pattern of which the earthly jerusalem was supposed to be built; metaphorically "the city of god founded by christ", now wearing the form of the church, but after christ's return to put on the form of the perfected messianic kingdom; "the heavenly jerusalem", that is the heavenly abode of god, christ, the angels, saints of the old and new testament periods and those christians that are alive at christ's return; "the new jerusalem", a splendid visible city to be let down from heaven after the renovation of the world, the future abode of the blessed
2414.gi: gerusalemme (cioè, jerushalaim), la capitale della palestina

2415.g: a hierosolymite, i.e., inhabitant of hierosolyma
2415.gl: a citizen or inhabitant of jerusalem
2415.gi: un gerusalemita, cioè abitante di Gerusalemme

2416.gl: to commit sacrilege, to rob a temple; in romans 2:22, where the meaning is, "thou who abhorrest idols and their contamination, doest yet not hesitate to plunder their shrines"
2416.gi: essere un ladro di tempio (in senso figurato)

2418.g: to be a temple-worker, i.e., officiate as a priest (figuratively)
2418.gl: to minister in the manner of a priest, minister in priestly service; of those who defend the sanctity of the law by undergoing a violent death; of the preaching of the gospel
2418.gi: essere un lavoratore del tempio, cioè officiare come sacerdote (in senso figurato)

2419.g: hierusalem (i.e., jerushalem), the capitol of palestine
2419.gl: [set ye double peace]; denotes either the city itself or the inhabitants; "the jerusalem that now is", with its present religious institutions, i.e., the mosaic system, so designated from its primary external location; "jerusalem that is above", that is existing in heaven, according to the pattern of which the earthly jerusalem was supposed to be built; metaphorically "the city of god founded by christ", now wearing the form of the church, but after christ's return to put on the form of the perfected messianic kingdom; "the heavenly jerusalem", that is the heavenly abode of god, christ, the angels, saints of the old and new testament periods and those christians that are alive at christ's return; "the new jerusalem", a splendid visible city to be let down from heaven after the renovation of the world, the future abode of the blessed
2419.gi: gerusalemme (cioè, jerushalem), la capitale della palestina

2420.g: sacredness, i.e., (by implication) the priestly office

2421.gl: [wealthy]; the father of david the king

2422.gl: [whom god sets free]; son of gilead, and a judge in israel

2423.gl: [whom jehovah establishes]; was the son of jehoiakim, and for three months and ten days king of judah until nebuchadnezzar carried him into captivity (597 bc)

2424.g: jesus (i.e., jehoshua), the name of our lord and two (three) other israelites
2424.gl: [jehovah is salvation]; joshua was the famous captain of the israelites, moses' successor; jesus, son of eliezer, one of the ancestors of christ; jesus, the son of god, the saviour of mankind, god incarnate; jesus barabbas was the captive robber whom the jews begged pilate to release instead of christ; jesus, surnamed justus, a jewish christian, an associate with paul in the preaching of the gospel
2424.gi: Gesù (cioè Giosuè), il nome del nostro Signore e di altri due (tre) israeliti

2425.g: competent (as if coming in season), i.e., ample (in amount) or fit (in character)
2425.gl: sufficient; many enough, enough; sufficient in ability, i.e., meet, fit
2425.gi: competente (come se venisse in stagione), cioè, abbondante (in quantità) o adatto (nel carattere)

2426.gl: sufficient, ability or competency to do a thing

2427.gl: to make sufficient, render fit; to equip one with adequate power to perform duties of one

2428.gl: an olive branch; for suppliants approached the one whose aid they would implore holding an olive branch entwined with white wool and fillets, to signify that they came as suppliants; supplication

2430.g: image-like; iconium, a place in asia minor
2430.gl: [little image]; a famous city of asia minor, which was the capital of lycaonia
2430.gi: simile a un'immagine; iconio, un luogo in asia minore

2431.g: propitious or merry ("hilarious"), i.e., prompt or willing
2431.gl: cheerful, joyous, prompt to do anything
2431.gi: propizio o allegro (allegra), cioè, pronto o disposto

2433.g: to conciliate, i.e., (transitively) to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious
2433.gl: to render one's self, to appease, conciliate to one's self; to become propitious, be placated or appeased; to be propitious, be gracious, be merciful; to expiate, make propitiation for
2433.gi: riconciliare, cioè, (transitivamente) espiare (peccato), o (intransitivamente) essere propizio

2434.gl: an appeasing, propitiating; the means of appeasing, a propitiation

2435.g: an expiatory (place or thing), i.e., (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the ark (in the temple)
2435.gl: relating to an appeasing or expiating, having placating or expiating force, expiatory; a means of appeasing or expiating, a propitiation; used of the cover of the ark of the covenant in the holy of holies, which was sprinkled with the blood of the expiatory victim on the annual day of atonement (this rite signifying that the life of the people, the loss of which they had merited by their sins, was offered to god in the blood as the life of the victim, and that god by this ceremony was appeased and their sins expiated); hence the lid of expiation, the propitiatory; an expiatory sacrifice; a expiatory victim
2435.gi: un'espiazione (luogo o cosa), cioè (concretamente) una vittima espatoria, o (specialmente) il coperchio dell'arca (nel tempio)

2436.g: cheerful (as attractive), i.e., propitious; adverbially (by hebraism) god be gracious!, i.e., (in averting some calamity) far be it
2436.gi: allegra (come attraente), cioè, propizio; avverbiatemente (per ebraismo) Dio sia clemente!, cioè, (per scongiurare qualche calamità) lontano sia!

2437.g: (the) illyrican (shore), i.e., (as a name itself) illyricum, a region of europe
2437.gl: [the lyric band]; a region lying between italy, germany, macedonia and thrice, having on one side the adriatic sea, and on the other the danube
2437.gi: (la) illirica (riva), cioè (come nome stesso) Illirico, una regione d'Europa

2438.g: a strap, i.e., (specially) the tie (of a sandal) or the lash (of a scourge)
2438.gl: a thong of leather, a strap; in the new testament of the thongs with which captives or criminals were either bound or beaten; of the thongs or ties by which sandals were fastened to the feet
2438.gi: una striscia, cioè, (specialmente) il laccio (della sandalia) o la frusta (del flagello)

2440.gl: a garment (of any sort); garments, i.e., the cloak or mantle and the tunic; the upper garment, the cloak or mantle

2442.g: of uncertain affinity); to long for
2442.gl: to desire, long for, especially the longing of love

2443.g: in order that (denoting the purpose or the result)
2443.gl: that, in order that, so that
2443.gi: affinché (indicando lo scopo o il risultato)

2445.g: joppe (i.e., japho), a place in palestine
2445.gl: [beautiful]; joppa, a city of palestine on the mediterranean, lying on the border of the tribes of dan and ephraim
2445.gi: Joppe (cioè Jaffa), un luogo in Palestina

2446.g: the jordanes (i.e., jarden), a river of palestine
2446.gl: [the descender]; the one river of palestine, has its course of little more than 200 miles (300 km), from the roots of anti-lebanon to the head of the dead sea
2446.gi: il giordano (cioè, jarden), un fiume della palestina

2447.g: rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents)
2447.gl: poison (of animals); poison of asps is under their lips,; spoken of men given to reviling and calumniating and thereby injuring others; rust
2447.gi: ruggine (come se emessa dai metalli); anche veleno (come emesso dai serpenti)

2448.g: judah (i.e., jehudah or juttah), a part of (or place in) palestine
2448.gl: [he shall be praised]; the fourth son of the patriarch jacob; the tribe that were the offspring of judah; the region occupied by the tribe; a city of the tribe of judah, conjectured to be hebron, which was a city assigned to the priests and located in the hill country, and the native place of john the baptist according to jewish tradition
2448.gi: Giuda (cioè Jehudah o Jutta), una parte di (o un luogo in) Palestina

2449.g: the judaean land (i.e., judaea), a region of palestine
2449.gl: [he shall be praised]; in a narrower sense, to the southern portion of palestine lying on this side of the jordan and the dead sea, to distinguish it from samaria, galilee, peraea, and idumaea; in a broader sense, referring to all palestine
2449.gi: la terra giudaica (cioè Giudea), una regione di Palestina

2450.gl: to adopt jewish customs and rites, imitate the jews, judaise; one who observes the ritual law of the jews

2451.gi: giudeo, cioè, simile a un giudeo

2452.g: judacally or in a manner resembling a judaean
2452.gl: jewishly, after the manner of the jews
2452.gi: giudeamente o in modo simile a un giudeo

2453.gl: jewish, belonging to the jewish race; jewish as respects to birth, race, religion

2454.g: "judaism", i.e., the jewish faith and usages
2454.gl: the jewish faith and worship, religion of the jews, judaism
2454.gi: "giudaismo", cioè, la fede e le usanze ebraiche

2455.g: judas (i.e., jehudah), the name of ten israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region
2455.gl: [he shall be praised]; the fourth son of jacob; an unknown ancestor of christ; a man surnamed the galilean, who at the time of the census of quirinus, excited the revolt in galilee (see acts 5:37); a certain jew of damascus (see acts 9:11); a prophet surnamed barsabas, of the church at jerusalem (see acts 15:22, 27, 32); the apostle who was surnamed lebbaeus or thaddaeus (see john 14:22), and believed to have written the epistle of jude; the half-brother of jesus (see matthew 13:55); judas iscariot, the apostle who betrayed jesus
2455.gi: Giuda (cioè Jehudah), il nome di dieci israeliti; anche della discendenza di uno di loro e della sua regione

2457.gl: [soft-haired]; the centurion of "augustus band", to whose charge paul was delivered when he was sent prisoner from caesarea to rome

2458.gl: [youthful]; a christian woman at rome, mentioned by paul as one of his kinsfolk and fellow prisoners

2459.g: justus, the name of three christian
2459.gl: [just]; a surname of joseph, called barsabas (see acts 1:23); of titus, a christian at corinth, with whom paul lodged (see acts 18:7); a surname of jesus, a friend of paul (see colossians 4:11)
2459.gi: giusto, il nome di tre cristiani

2460.g: an equestrian, i.e., member of a cavalry corps
2460.gi: un cavaliere, cioè, membro di un corpo di cavalleria

2464.g: isaac (i.e., jitschak), the son of abraham
2464.gl: [to laugh]; the son of abraham and sarah
2464.gi: Isacco (cioè Jischak), il figlio di Abramo

2465.gi: simile a un angelo, cioè, angelico

2466.g: isachar (i.e., jissaskar), a son of jacob (figuratively, his descendant)
2466.gl: [reward]; the ninth son of jacob and the fifth of leah
2466.gi: issachar (cioè, jissaskar), un figlio di giacobbe (figurato, il suo discendente)

2469.g: inhabitant of kerioth; iscariotes (i.e., keriothite), an epithet of judas the traitor
2469.gl: [men of kerioth]; the apostle who betrayed jesus
2469.gi: abitante di kerioth; iscariota (cioè, keriotita), un epiteto di giuda il traditore

2471.g: likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication, equity
2471.gl: equality; equity, fairness, what is equitable
2471.gi: similitudine (in condizione o proporzione); per implicazione, equità

2472.gl: equally precious; equally honored, to be esteemed equal to

2474.g: israel (i.e., jisrael), the adopted name of jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively)
2474.gl: [he shall be a prince of god]; the name given to the patriarch jacob (and borne by him in addition to his former name); the family or descendants of israel, the race of israel; christians, the israel of god (galatians 6:16), for not all those who draw their bodily descent from israel are true israelites, i.e., are those whom god pronounces to be israelites and has chosen to salvation
2474.gi: israel (cioè, jisrael), il nome adottato di giacobbe, inclusi i suoi discendenti (letteralmente o figurato)

2475.g: an "israelite", i.e., descendant of israel (literally or figuratively)
2475.gl: an israelite, one of the race of israel, a name to be held in honor
2475.gi: un "israelita", cioè, discendente di israel (letteralmente o figurato)

2476.g: to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively)
2476.gl: to cause or make to stand, to place, put, set; to bid to stand by, [set up]; in the presence of others, in the midst, before judges, before members of the sanhedrin;; to place; to make firm, fix establish; to cause a person or a thing to keep his or its place; to stand, be kept intact (of family, a kingdom), to escape in safety; to establish a thing, cause it to stand; to uphold or sustain the authority or force of anything; to set or place in a balance; to weigh: money to one (because in very early times before the introduction of coinage, the metals used to be weighed); to stand; to stand by or near; to stop, stand still, to stand immovable, stand firm; of the foundation of a building; to stand; continue safe and sound, stand unharmed, to stand ready or prepared; to be of a steadfast mind; of quality, one who does not hesitate, does not waiver
2476.gi: stare (transitivo o intransitivo), usato in varie applicazioni (letteralmente o figuratamente)

2477.g: to be knowing (learned), i.e., (by implication) to visit for information (interview)
2477.gl: to enquire into, examine, investigate; to find out, learn, by enquiry; to gain knowledge of by visiting; of some distinguished person, to become personally acquainted with, know face to face
2477.gi: essere sapiente (istruito), cioè (per implicazione) visitare per informazioni (intervista)

2478.gl: strong, mighty; of living beings; strong either in body or in mind; of one who has strength of soul to sustain the attacks of satan, strong and therefore exhibiting many excellences; on inanimate things; strong, violent, forcibly uttered, firm, sure

2479.g: compare ?????, a form of g2192); forcefulness (literally or figuratively)
2479.gi: cfr. ?????, una forma di g2192); forza (letteralmente o figurato)

2480.g: to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively)
2480.gl: to be strong; to be strong in body, to be robust, to be in sound health; to have power; to have power as shown by extraordinary deeds; to exert, wield power, to have strength to overcome; to be a force, avail; to be serviceable; to be able, can

2481.gl: equally, in like manner; agreeably to expectation, i.e., it may be, probably

2482.gl: [calf like]; the whole peninsula between the alps and the straits of messina

2484.g: ituraea (i.e., jetur), a region of palestine
2484.gl: [past the limits, he will arrange]; a mountainous region, lying northeast of palestine and west of damascus
2484.gi: Iturea (cioè Jetur), una regione di Palestina

2487.gl: a footprint, track, footstep; in the new testament, metaphorically of imitating the example of any one

2488.gl: [jehovah is upright]; the son of king uzziah or azariah and jerusha

2489.gl: [jehovah is a gracious giver]; the wife of chuza, herod's steward, and a follower of jesus

2490.gl: [grace, gift of god]; one of the ancestors of christ

2491.g: joannes (i.e., jochanan), the name of four israelites
2491.gl: [jehovah is a gracious giver]; john the baptist, the son of zacharias and elisabeth, the forerunner of christ; john the apostle, the writer of the 4th gospel, son of zebedee and salome, brother of james the elder, the writer of the three epistles of john and the book of revelation, perhaps referred to as the one "whom jesus loved" in the gospel of john; john, surnamed mark, the companion of barnabas and paul (see acts 12:12); john, a certain man, a member of the sanhedrin (see acts 5:6)
2491.gi: giovanni (cioè, jochanan), il nome di quattro israeliti

2492.gl: [the cry of woe, i will exclaim]; job, a man known for his piety and, consistency and fortitude in the endurance of trials

2493.gl: [to whom jehovah is god]; the second of the twelve minor prophets, the son of pethuel, probably prophesied in judah in the reign of uzziah

2494.gl: [jehovah is a gracious giver]; one of the ancestors of christ

2495.g: jonas (i.e., jonah), the name of two israelites
2495.gl: [dove]; the fifth minor prophet, the son of amittai, and a native of gath-hepher and lived during the reign of jeroboam ii, king of israel; jonas, the father of peter
2495.gi: giona (cioè, jonah), il nome di due israeliti

2496.gl: [whom jehovah has exalted]; the son of jehoshaphat, king of judah, succeeded his father on the throne of judah

2497.gl: [whom jehovah has exalted]; the son of matthat, in the genealogy of christ

2498.gl: [whom jehovah judges]; the king of judah, son of asa

2499.gl: [he will be sustained of jehovah]; the son of eliezer, in the genealogy of jesus christ

2500.g: joses, the name of two israelites
2500.gl: [exalted]; one of the ancestors of christ, luke 3:29; joses, the brother of jesus, mark 6:3; joses, the son of mary, the sister of the mother of jesus, matthew 27:56; joses, a levite, acts 4:36
2500.gi: giuseppe, il nome di due israeliti

2501.g: joseph, the name of seven israelites
2501.gl: [let him (god) add, increaser]; the patriarch, the eleventh son of jacob; the son of jonan or jonam, one of the ancestors of christ (see luke 3:30); the son of judah (also spelled judas or joda) another ancestor of jesus (see luke 3:26); the son of mattathias, another ancestor of christ (see luke 3:24); the husband of mary, the mother of jesus; a half-brother of jesus (see matthew 13:55); joseph of arimathaea, a member of the sanhedrin, who believed in jesus (see matthew 27:57, 59; mark 15:43, 45); joseph surnamed barnabas (see acts 4:36); joseph call barsabas and surnamed justus (see acts 1:23)
2501.gi: giuseppe, il nome di sette israeliti

2502.gl: [whom jehovah heals]; king of judah, who restored among the jews the worship of the true god, and after a reign of thirty one years was slain in battle about 611 bc

2503.g: "iota", the name of the eighth letter of the greek alphabet, put (figuratively) for a very small part of anything
2503.gl: the hebrew letter yod (?), the smallest of them all; hence equivalent to the minutest part
2503.gi: "iota", il nome dell'ottava lettera dell'alfabeto greco, usata (figurato) per indicare una parte molto piccola di qualsiasi cosa

2504.g: so also the dative case ????? <pronunciation strongs="kam-oy'"/>, and accusative case ???? <pronunciation strongs="kam-eh'"/> and (or also, even, etc.) i, (to) me
2504.gl: and i; i also, i as well, i likewise, in like manner i; even i, this selfsame i
2504.gi: così anche il caso dativo ????? <pronunciation strongs="kam-oy'"/>, e caso accusativo ???? <pronunciation strongs="kam-eh'"/> e (o anche, anche, ecc.) io, (a) me

2505.g: according to which things, i.e., just as
2505.gi: secondo le quali cose, cioè, proprio come

2507.g: to lower (or with violence) demolish (literally or figuratively)
2507.gl: to take down; without the notion of violence: to detach from the cross, one crucified; with the use of force: to throw down, cast down; to pull down, demolish; the subtle reasonings (of opponents) likened to a fortress, i.e., to refute, to destroy
2507.gi: abbassare (o con violenza) demolire (letteralmente o figurato)

2508.g: to cleanse, i.e., (specially) to prune; figuratively, to expiate
2508.gl: to cleanse, of filth impurity, etc; to prune trees and vines from useless shoots; metaphorically from guilt, to expiate

2509.gl: according as, just as, even as

2510.gl: to fit or fasten to, bind on; to lay hold of, fasten on (hostilely)

2511.gl: to make clean, cleanse; from physical stains and dirt; utensils, food; a leper, to cleanse by curing; to remove by cleansing; in a moral sense; to free from defilement of sin and from faults; to purify from wickedness; to free from guilt of sin, to purify; to consecrate by cleansing or purifying; to consecrate, dedicate; to pronounce clean in a levitical sense

2512.g: a washing off, i.e., (ceremonially) ablution, (morally) expiation
2512.gl: a cleansing, purification, a ritual purgation or washing; of the washing of the jews before and after their meals; of levitical purification of women after childbirth; a cleansing from the guilt of sins wrought by the expiatory sacrifice of christ

2513.gl: clean, pure; physically; purified by fire; in a similitude, like a vine cleansed by pruning and so fitted to bear fruit; in a levitical sense; clean, the use of which is not forbidden, imparts no uncleanness; ethically; free from corrupt desire, from sin and guilt; free from every admixture of what is false, sincere genuine; blameless, innocent; unstained with the guilt of anything

2514.gl: cleanness, purity; in a levitical sense

2515.gl: a chair, a seat; used of the exalted seat occupied by men of eminent rank or influence, as teachers and judges

2516.gl: to sit down, seat one's self, sit

2517.g: thereafter, i.e., consecutively; as a noun (by ellipsis of noun) a subsequent person or time
2517.gl: one after another, successively, in order
2517.gi: dopo di ciò, cioè, consecutivamente; come sostantivo (per ellissi del sostantivo) una persona o tempo successivo

2518.g: to lie down to rest, i.e., (by implication) to fall asleep (literally or figuratively)
2518.gl: to fall asleep, drop off to sleep; to sleep; to sleep normally; euphemistically, to be dead; metaphorically; to yield to sloth and sin; to be indifferent to one's salvation
2518.gi: sdraiarsi a riposare, cioè, (per implicazione) addormentarsi (letteralmente o figurato)

2520.g: to reach to, i.e., (neuter of present active participle, figuratively as adjective) becoming
2520.gl: to come down; to come to, reach to; it is becoming; it is fit
2520.gi: raggiungere, cioè, (neutro del participio presente attivo, figurato come aggettivo) diventando

2521.g: and ???? (to sit; akin to the base of g1476); to sit down; figuratively, to remain, reside
2521.gl: to sit down, seat one's self; to sit, be seated, of a place occupied; to have a fixed abode, to dwell
2521.gi: e ???? (sedersi; affine alla base di g1476); sedersi; figurato, rimanere, risiedere

2523.g: to seat down, i.e., set (figuratively, appoint); intransitively, to sit (down); figuratively, to settle (hover, dwell)
2523.gl: to make to sit down; to set, appoint, to confer a kingdom on one; intransitively; to sit down; to sit; to have fixed one's abode; to sojourn, to settle, settle down
2523.gi: accomodarsi, cioè, stabilire (figuratamente, nominare); intransitivamente, sedersi; figuratamente, stabilirsi (sovrastare, dimorare)

2524.gl: to send down, to let down

2525.g: to place down (permanently), i.e., (figuratively) to designate, constitute, convoy
2525.gl: to set, place, put; to set one over a thing (in charge of it); to appoint one to administer an office; to set down as, constitute, to declare, show to be; to constitute, to render, make, cause to be; to conduct or bring to a certain place; to show or exhibit one's self; come forward as

2529.g: to behold fully, i.e., (figuratively) distinctly apprehend
2529.gl: to look down, see from above, view from on high; to see thoroughly, perceive clearly, understand

2531.gl: according as; just as, even as; in proportion as, in the degree that; since, seeing that, agreeably to the fact that; when, after that

2532.g: and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words

2533.g: the dell; caiaphas (i.e., cajepha), an israelite

2533.gi: la valle; caifa (cioè, cajepha), un israelita

2535.g: cain, (i.e., cajin), the son of adam
2535.gl: [maker, fabricator (literally smith)]; the first born of adam, and slew his brother, abel
2535.gi: cain, (cioè, cajin), il figlio di adam

2536.g: cainan (i.e., kenan), the name of two patriarchs
2536.gl: [their smith]; the son of enos, genesis 5:9; son of arphaxad and ancestor of christ, luke 3:36
2536.gi: cainan (cioè, kenan), il nome di due patriarchi

2537.g: new (especially in freshness; while g3501 is properly so with respect to age
2537.gl: new; as respects form; recently made, fresh, recent, unused, unworn; as respects substance; of a new kind, unprecedented, novel, uncommon, unheard of
2537.gi: nuovo (specialmente per freschezza; mentre g3501 è propriamente così in relazione all'età)

2538.gl: newness; in the new state of life in which the holy spirit places us so as to produce a new state which is eternal life

2539.g: and indeed, i.e., nevertheless or notwithstanding

2540.gi: un'occasione, cioè, tempo stabilito o opportuno

2541.g: caesar, a title of the roman emperor
2541.gl: [severed]; the surname of julius caesar, which adopted by octavius augustus and his successors afterwards became a title, and was appropriated by the roman emperors as part of their title

2542.g: caesaria, the name of two places in palestine
2542.gl: [severed]; the city of caesarea of philippi, situated at the foot of lebanon near the sources of the jordan in gaulanitis; the city caesarea of palestine was built near the mediterranean by herod the great on the site of strabo's tower, between joppa and dora
2542.gi: cesarea, il nome di due luoghi in palestina

2544.g: and yet indeed, i.e., although really

2545.g: to set on fire, i.e., kindle or (by implication) consume
2545.gl: to set on fire, light, burning; to burn, consume with fire
2545.gi: dare fuoco, cioè, accendere o (per implicazione) consumare

2546.gi: allo stesso modo in quel luogo

2547.gl: of place; and from thence, and thence; of time; and thereafter, and afterward

2549.g: badness, i.e., (subjectively) depravity, or (actively) malignity, or (passively) trouble
2549.gl: malignity, malice, ill-will, desire to injure; wickedness, depravity; wickedness that is not ashamed to break laws; evil, trouble
2549.gi: malvagità, cioè (soggettivamente) depravazione, o (attivamente) malizia, o (passivamente) tribolazione

2550.gl: bad character, depravity of heart and life; malignant subtlety, malicious craftiness

2551.gl: to speak evil of, revile, abuse, one; to curse

2552.gl: the suffering of evil, i.e., trouble, distress, afflicted

2553.gl: to suffer (endure) evils (hardships, troubles); to be afflicted

2554.g: to be a bad-doer, i.e., (objectively) to injure, or (genitive) to sin
2554.gl: to do harm; to do evil, do wrong
2554.gi: essere un cattivo operatore, cioè (oggettivamente) ferire, o (genitivo) peccare

2556.g: worthless (intrinsically, such; whereas g4190 properly refers to effects), i.e., (subjectively) depraved, or (objectively) injurious
2556.gl: of a bad nature; not such as it ought to be; of a mode of thinking, feeling, acting; base, wrong, wicked; troublesome, injurious, pernicious, destructive, baneful
2556.gi: inutile (intrinsecamente, tale; mentre g4190 si riferisce propriamente agli effetti), cioè (soggettivamente) depravato, o (oggettivamente) dannoso

2559.gl: to oppress, afflict, harm, maltreat; to embitter, render evil affected

2560.gl: miserable, to be ill; improperly, wrongly; to speak ill of, revile, one

2562.g: a stalk of grain, i.e., (collectively) stubble
2562.gl: a stalk of grain or a reed, stubble,; the stalk left after the ears are cut off
2562.gi: uno stelo di grano, cioè (collettivamente) paglia

2563.g: a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a similar plant); by implication, a pen
2563.gl: a reed; a staff made of a reed, a reed staff; a measuring reed or rod; a writer's reed, a pen
2563.gi: una canna (la pianta o il suo fusto, o quella di una pianta simile); per implicazione, una penna

2564.g: to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise)
2564.gl: to call; to call aloud, utter in a loud voice; to invite; to call i.e., to name, by name; to give a name to; to receive the name of, receive as a name; to give some name to one, call his name; to be called i.e., to bear a name or title (among men); to salute one by name
2564.gi: "chiamare" (propriamente, ad alta voce, ma usato in una varietà di applicazioni, direttamente o altrimenti)

2565.g: a cultivated olive tree, i.e., a domesticated or improved one
2565.gl: the garden olive as opposed to the wild olive
2565.gi: un albero d'olivo coltivato, cioè, uno addomesticato o migliorato

2567.gl: teaching that which is good, a teacher of goodness

2568.g: good harbors, i.e., fairhaven, a bay of crete
2568.gl: [goodly ports]; a bay of crete, near the city lasaea, so called because it had a good harbor
2568.gi: buoni porti, cioè Fairhaven, una baia di Creta

2569.g: to do well, i.e., live virtuously

2570.g: properly, beautiful, but chiefly (figuratively) good (literally or morally), i.e., valuable or virtuous (for appearance or use, and thus distinguished from g0018, which is properly intrinsic)
2570.gl: beautiful, handsome, excellent, eminent, choice, surpassing, precious, useful, suitable, commendable, admirable; beautiful to look at, shapely, magnificent; good, excellent in its nature and characteristics, and therefore well adapted to its ends; genuine, approved; precious; joined to names of men designated by their office, competent, able, such as one ought to be; praiseworthy, noble; beautiful by reason of purity of heart and life, and hence praiseworthy; morally good, noble; honorable, conferring honor; affecting the mind agreeably, comforting and confirming
2570.gi: propriamente, bello, ma soprattutto (figuratamente) buono (letteralmente o moralmente), cioè, prezioso o virtuoso (per aspetto o uso, e quindi distinto da g0018, che è propriamente intrinseco)

2572.gl: to hide, veil; to hinder the knowledge of a thing

2573.gl: beautifully, finely, excellently, well; rightly, so that there shall be no room for blame, well, truly; excellently, nobly, commendably; honorably, in honor; in a good place, comfortable; to speak well of one, to do good; to be well (of those recovering health)

2575.gl: a furnace; for smelting; for burning earthen ware; for baking bread

2576.g: to shut down, i.e., close the eyes
2576.gl: to shut the eyes, close the eyes

2577.g: properly, to toil, i.e., (by implication) to tire (figuratively, faint, sicken)
2577.gl: to grow weary, be weary; to be sick
2577.gi: propriamente, faticare, cioè (per implicazione) affaticarsi (figuratamente, svenire, ammalarsi)

2578.gl: to bend, bow, the knee (the knees); to one; in honor of one; in religious veneration; used of worshippers; to bow one's self

2579.gl: and if; also or even if; of only, at least; even if

2580.gl: [place of reeds]; a village in galilee about 5 miles (8 km) north-west from nazareth

2581.gl: [zealous]; the surname of apostle simon, otherwise known as "simon zelotes"

2582.gl: [prince of servants]; a queen of ethiopia (ad 38)

2583.g: a rule ("canon"), i.e., (figuratively) a standard (of faith and practice); by implication, a boundary, i.e., (figuratively) a sphere (of activity)
2583.gl: a rod or straight piece of rounded wood to which any thing is fastened to keep it straight; used for various purposes; a measuring rod, rule; a carpenter's line or measuring tape; the measure of a leap, as in the olympic games; a definitely bounded or fixed space within the limits of which one's power of influence is confined; the province assigned one; one's sphere of activity; metaphorically any rule or standard, a principle or law of investigating, judging, living, acting
2583.gi: una regola ("canone"), cioè (figuratamente) uno standard (di fede e pratica); per implicazione, un confine, cioè (figuratamente) una sfera (di attività)

2584.g: capernaum (i.e., caphanachum), a place in palestine
2584.gl: [village of comfort]; a flourishing city of galilee situated on the western shore of the sea of galilee or lake of gennesaret, near the place where the jordan flows into the lake
2584.gi: capernaum (cioè, caphanachum), un luogo in palestina

2585.g: to retail, i.e., (by implication) to adulterate (figuratively)
2585.gl: to be a retailer, to peddle; to make money by selling anything; to get sordid gain by dealing in anything, to do a thing for base gain; to trade in the word of god; to try to get base gain by teaching divine truth; to corrupt, to adulterate; peddlers were in the habit of adulterating their commodities for the sake of gain
2585.gi: vendere al dettaglio, cioè (per implicazione) adulterare (figuratamente)

2587.g: cappadocia, a region of asia minor
2587.gl: [province of good horses]; a region in asia minor, bounded under the roman empire on the north by pontus, on the east by armenia minor, on the south by cilicia and commagene, on the west by lycaonia and galatia

2588.g: the heart, i.e., (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle
2588.gl: the heart; that organ in the animal body which is the center of the circulation of the blood, and hence was regarded as the seat of physical life; denotes the center of all physical and spiritual life; the vigour and sense of physical life; the center and seat of spiritual life; the soul or mind, as it is the fountain and seat of the thoughts, passions, desires, appetites, affections, purposes, endeavors; of the understanding, the faculty and seat of the intelligence; of the will and character; of the soul so far as it is affected and stirred in a bad way or good, or of the soul as the seat of the sensibilities, affections, emotions, desires, appetites, passions; of the middle or central or inmost part of anything, even though inanimate
2588.gi: il cuore, cioè (figurativamente) i pensieri o i sentimenti (mente); anche (per analogia) il mezzo

2590.gl: fruit; the fruit of the trees, vines, of the fields; the fruit of one's loins, i.e., his progeny, his posterity; that which originates or comes from something, an effect, result; work, act, deed; advantage, profit, utility; praises, which are presented to god as a thank offering; to gather fruit (i.e., a reaped harvest) into life eternal (as into a granary), is used in figuratively discourse of those who by their labors have fitted souls to obtain eternal life

2592.gl: to bear fruit; to bear, bring forth, deeds; to bear fruit of one's self

2595.gl: a dry stalk or twig, a straw; chaff

2596.g: (prepositionally) down (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case (genitive, dative or accusative) with which it is joined)
2596.gl: down from, through out; according to, toward, along
2596.gi: (preposizionalmente) giù (nel luogo o nel tempo), in relazioni variate (secondo il caso (genitivo, dativo o accusativo) con cui è unito)

2598.gl: to cast down; to throw to the ground, prostate; to put in a lower place; to lay (down) a foundation

2599.gl: to press down by an imposing weight; to weigh down; metaphorically to burden

2600.gl: descent; the act of descending; the place of descent; that part of the mountain where the descent is made

2601.g: to cause to go down, i.e., precipitate
2601.gl: to cause to go down; to bring down; to cast down, thrust down

2602.g: a deposition, i.e., founding; figuratively, conception
