2602.gi: una deposizione, cioè fondazione; figuratamente, concezione

2603.g: to award the price against, i.e., (figuratively) to defraud (of salvation)
2603.gl: to decide as umpire against someone; to defraud or beguile of the prize of victory; metaphorically to deprive of salvation
2603.gi: assegnare il prezzo contro, cioè (figurativamente) defraudare (della salvezza)

2605.gl: to announce, declare, promulgate, make known; to proclaim publicly, publish; to denounce, report, betray

2607.g: to note against, i.e., find fault with
2607.gl: to find fault with, blame; to accuse, condemn
2607.gi: annotare contro, cioè trovare difetto con

2608.g: to rend in pieces, i.e., crack apart

2609.g: to lead down; specially, to moor a vessel
2609.gl: to lead down, bring down; to bring the vessel from deep water to the land; to be brought (down) in a ship, to land, touch at
2609.gi: condurre giù; specialmente, ormeggiare una nave

2610.g: to struggle against, i.e., (by implication) to overcome

2611.g: to tie down, i.e., bandage (a wound)

2613.g: to adjudge against, i.e., pronounce guilty
2613.gl: to give judgment against (one), to pronounce guilty; to condemn

2614.g: to hunt down, i.e., search for

2615.gl: to bring into bondage, enslave; to enslave to one's self, bring into bondage to one's self

2616.g: to exercise dominion against, i.e., oppress
2616.gl: to exercise harsh control over one, to use one's power against one; to oppress one

2617.g: to shame down, i.e., disgrace or (by implication) put to the blush
2617.gl: to dishonor, disgrace; to put to shame, make ashamed; to be ashamed, blush with shame; one is said to be put to shame who suffers a repulse, or whom some hope has deceived
2617.gi: umiliare, cioè disonorare o (per implicazione) mettere in imbarazzo

2618.g: to burn down (to the ground), i.e., consume wholly
2618.gl: to burn up, consume by fire

2619.gl: to cover up; to veil or cover one's self

2620.gl: to glory against, to exult over, to boast one's self to the injury (of a person or thing)

2621.g: to lie down, i.e., (by implication) be sick; specially, to recline at a meal
2621.gl: to have lain down, i.e., to lie prostrate; of the sick; of those at meals, to recline
2621.gi: sdraiarsi, cioè (per implicazione) ammalarsi; specialmente, sdraiarsi a un pasto

2623.g: to shut down (in a dungeon), i.e., incarcerate

2624.g: to be a giver of lots to each, i.e., (by implication) to apportion an estate
2624.gl: to distribute by lot; to distribute as an inheritance
2624.gi: essere un distributore di sorti a ciascuno, cioè (per implicazione) ripartire un'eredità

2625.g: to recline down, i.e., (specially) to take a place at table
2625.gl: in the new testament in reference to eating, to make to recline; to recline (at a table)
2625.gi: sdraiarsi, cioè (specialmente) prendere posto a tavola

2626.g: to dash (wash) down, i.e., (by implication) to deluge
2626.gl: to overwhelm with water, to submerge, deluge

2629.gl: to cut up in pieces; to slay; to beat, bruise; to cut, gash, mangle

2630.gl: to cast down a precipice; to through down headlong

2632.gl: to give judgment against, to judge worthy of punishment; to condemn; by one's good example to render another's wickedness the more evident and censurable

2634.g: to lord against, i.e., control, subjugate
2634.gl: to bring under one's power, to subject one's self, to subdue, master; to hold in subjection, to be master of, exercise lordship over

2635.g: to be a traducer, i.e., to slander
2635.gl: to speak against one, to criminate, traduce

2638.g: to take eagerly, i.e., seize, possess, etc. (literally or figuratively)
2638.gl: to lay hold of; to lay hold of so as to make one's own, to obtain, attain to, to make one's own, to take into one's self, appropriate; to seize upon, take possession of; of evils overtaking one, of the last day overtaking the wicked with destruction, of a demon about to torment one; in a good sense, of christ by his holy power and influence laying hold of the human mind and will, in order to prompt and govern it; to detect, catch; to lay hold of with the mind; to understand, perceive, learn, comprehend
2638.gi: prendere avidamente, cioè afferrare, possedere, ecc. (letteralmente o figuratamente)

2639.g: to lay down, i.e., (figuratively) to enrol
2639.gl: to lay down, to lie down; to narrate at length, recount, set forth; to set down in a list or register, to enrol; of soldiers; of those widows who held a prominent place in the church and exercised a certain superintendence over the rest of the women, and had charge of the widows and orphans supported at the public expense

2640.g: a remainder, i.e., (by implication) a few

2641.g: to leave down, i.e., behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining
2641.gl: to leave behind; to depart from, leave; to be left; to bid (one) to remain; to forsake, leave to one's self a person or thing by ceasing to care for it, to abandon, leave in the lurch; to be abandoned, forsaken; to cause to be left over, to reserve, to leave remaining; like our "leave behind", it is used of one who on being called away cannot take another with him; especially of the dying (to leave behind); like our "leave", leave alone, disregard; of those who sail past a place without stopping
2641.gi: lasciare giù, cioè indietro; per implicazione, abbandonare, avere rimanente

2642.g: to stone down, i.e., to death
2642.gl: to overwhelm with stones, to stone

2643.g: exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e., restoration to (the divine) favor
2643.gl: exchange; of the business of money changers, exchanging equivalent values; adjustment of a difference, reconciliation, restoration to favor; in the new testament of the restoration of the favor of god to sinners that repent and put their trust in the expiatory death of christ

2644.g: to change mutually, i.e., (figuratively) to compound a difference
2644.gl: to change, exchange, as coins for others of equivalent value; to reconcile (those who are at variance); return to favor with, be reconciled to one; to receive one into favor
2644.gi: cambiare reciprocamente, cioè (figurato) comporre una differenza

2645.g: left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the rest)
2645.gi: lasciato giù (indietro), cioè rimanente (plurale il resto)

2646.g: properly, a dissolution (breaking up of a journey), i.e., (by implication) a lodging-place
2646.gl: an inn, lodging place; an eating room, dining room
2646.gi: propriamente, una dissoluzione (interruzione di un viaggio), cioè (per implicazione) una dimora

2647.g: to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e., (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially (compare g2646) to halt for the night
2647.gl: to dissolve, disunite; (what has been joined together), to destroy, demolish; metaphorically to overthrow i.e., render vain, deprive of success, bring to naught; to subvert, overthrow; of institutions, forms of government, laws, etc., to deprive of force, annul, abrogate, discard; of travellers, to halt on a journey, to put up, lodge (the figurative expression originating in the circumstance that, to put up for the night, the straps and packs of the beasts of burden are unbound and taken off; or, more correctly from the fact that the traveller's garments, tied up when he is on the journey, are unloosed at it end)
2647.gi: allentare giù (disintegrarsi), cioè (per implicazione) demolire (letteralmente o figuratamente); specialmente (cfr. g2646) sostare per la notte

2648.g: to learn thoroughly, i.e., (by implication) to note carefully
2648.gl: to learn thoroughly, examine carefully; to consider well
2648.gi: imparare completamente, cioè (per implicazione) notare attentamente

2649.gl: to bear witness against, to testify against one

2651.g: according to sole places, i.e., (adverbially) separately

2655.g: to grow utterly torpid, i.e., (by implication) slothful (figuratively, expensive)
2655.gl: to cause to grow numb or torpid; to be torpid, inactive, to be to the detriment of one; to weigh heavily upon, be burdensome to
2655.gi: diventare completamente torpido, cioè (per implicazione) pigro (figurato, costoso)

2656.g: to nod down (towards), i.e., (by analogy) to make signs to
2656.gl: to nod to, make a sign; to indicate to another by a nod or sign what one wishes him to do
2656.gi: annuire verso, cioè (per analogia) fare segni a

2657.gl: to perceive, remark, observe, understand; to consider attentively, fix one's eyes or mind upon

2658.g: to meet against, i.e., arrive at (literally or figuratively)
2658.gl: to come to, arrive; to come to a place over against, opposite another; metaphorically to attain to a thing
2658.gi: incontrare contro, cioè arrivare (letteralmente o figuratamente)

2659.g: a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), i.e., (by implication, (perhaps by some confusion with g3506 or even with g3571)) stupor (lethargy)
2659.gl: a pricking, piercing; severe sorrow, extreme grief; insensibility or torpor of mind, such as extreme grief easily produces; hence a "spirit of stupor", which renders their souls torpid so insensible that they are not affected at all by the offer made them of salvation through the messiah
2659.gi: un formicolio (sensazione, come delle dormienti), cioè (per implicazione, (forse per qualche confusione con g3506 o addirittura con g3571)) torpore (letargia)

2660.g: to pierce thoroughly, i.e., (figuratively) to agitate violently ("sting to the quick")
2660.gl: to prick, pierce; metaphorically to pain the mind sharply, agitate it vehemently; especially of the emotion of sorrow
2660.gi: trafiggere completamente, cioè (figurato) agitare violentemente ("pungere al vivo")

2662.g: to trample down; figuratively, to reject with disdain
2662.gl: to tread down, trample under foot, to trample on; metaphorically to treat with rudeness and insult; to spurn, treat with insulting neglect

2663.gl: a putting to rest; calming of the winds; a resting place; metaphorically the heavenly blessedness in which god dwells, and of which he has promised to make persevering believers in christ partakers after the toils and trials of life on earth are ended

2664.g: to settle down, i.e., (literally) to colonize, or (figuratively) to (cause to) desist
2664.gl: to make quiet, to cause to be at rest, to grant rest; to lead to a quiet abode; to still, restrain, to cause (one striving to do something) to desist; to rest, take rest

2665.g: something spread thoroughly, i.e., (specially) the door screen (to the most holy place) in the jewish temple
2665.gl: a veil spread out, a curtain; the name given to the two curtains in the temple at jerusalem, one of them at the entrance to the temple separated the holy place from the outer court, the other veiled the holy of holies from the holy place
2665.gi: qualcosa di esteso completamente, cioè (specialmente) il velo (del luogo santissimo) nel tempio ebraico

2666.g: to drink down, i.e., gulp entire (literally or figuratively)
2666.gl: to drink down, swallow down; to devour; to swallow up, destroy
2666.gi: bere completamente, cioè, inghiottire interamente (letteralmente o figurato)

2668.g: to sail down upon a place, i.e., to land at
2668.gl: to sail down from the deep sea to the land; to put in
2668.gi: navigare verso un luogo, cioè approdare a

2669.g: to labor down, i.e., wear with toil (figuratively, harass)
2669.gl: to tire down with toil, exhaust with labor; to afflict or oppress with evils; to make trouble for; to treat roughly
2669.gi: faticare, cioè consumare con fatica (figurato, molestare)

2670.gl: to plunge or sink into the sea; to sink, to go down; a grievous offender for the purpose of killing him, to drown

2672.g: to execrate; by analogy, to doom
2672.gl: to curse, doom, imprecate evil upon

2673.g: to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally or figuratively
2673.gl: to render idle, unemployed, inactivate, inoperative; to cause a person or thing to have no further efficiency; to deprive of force, influence, power; to cause to cease, put an end to, do away with, annul, abolish; to cease, to pass away, be done away; to be severed from, separated from, discharged from, loosed from any one; to terminate all intercourse with one
2673.gi: essere (rendere) completamente inattivo (inutile), letteralmente o figuratamente

2675.g: to complete thoroughly, i.e., repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust
2675.gl: to render, i.e., to fit, sound, complete; to mend (what has been broken or rent), to repair; to complete; to fit out, equip, put in order, arrange, adjust; to fit or frame for one's self, prepare; ethically: to strengthen, perfect, complete, make one what he ought to be
2675.gi: completare completamente, cioè, riparare (letteralmente o figurato) o regolare

2676.gl: a strengthening, perfecting of the soul; a training, disciplining, instructing

2678.g: to sway downward, i.e., make a signal
2678.gl: to shake down, throw down; to shake; to make a sign, to signal with the hand to one
2678.gi: oscillare verso il basso, cioè fare un segnale

2679.gl: to dig under, dig down, demolish, destroy

2680.g: to prepare thoroughly (properly, by external equipment; whereas g2090 refers rather to internal fitness); by implication, to construct, create
2680.gl: to furnish, equip, prepare, make ready; of one who makes anything ready for a person or thing; of builders, to construct, erect, with the included idea of adorning and equipping with all things necessary
2680.gi: preparare completamente (propriamente, con equipaggiamento esterno; mentre g2090 si riferisce piuttosto a idoneità interna); per implicazione, costruire, creare

2681.g: to camp down, i.e., haunt; figuratively, to remain
2681.gl: to pitch one's tent, to fix one's abode, to dwell

2682.gl: the pitching of tents, encamping; place of tarrying, encampment, abode; of the nest of birds

2684.g: to be a sentinel, i.e., to inspect insidiously
2684.gl: to inspect, view closely, in order to spy out and plot against
2684.gi: essere una sentinella, cioè ispezionare insidiosamente

2686.g: to be crafty against, i.e., circumvent
2686.gl: to circumvent by artifice or fraud, conquer by subtle devices; to outwit; overreach; to deal craftily with

2687.gl: to send or put down, to lower; to put or keep down one who is roused or incensed, to repress, restrain, appease, quiet

2688.g: properly, a position or condition, i.e., (subjectively) demeanor
2688.gi: propriamente, una posizione o condizione, cioè (soggettivamente) comportamento

2689.gl: a lowering, letting down; a garment let down, dress, attire

2690.g: to turn upside down, i.e., upset
2690.gl: to turn over, turn under; the soil with a plough; to overturn, overthrow, throw down

2691.gl: to feel the impulses of sexual desire

2692.g: an overturn ("catastrophe"), i.e., demolition; figuratively, apostasy
2692.gl: overthrow, destruction; of cities; metaphorically of the extinction of a spirit of consecration
2692.gi: un rovesciamento ("catastrofe"), cioè demolizione; figurato, apostasia

2693.g: to strew down, i.e., (by implication) to prostrate (slay)
2693.gl: to strew over (the ground); to prostrate (compare "to lay low"), slay

2694.g: to drag down, i.e., arrest judicially
2694.gl: to draw down, pull down; to draw along, drag forcibly

2696.gl: to cover with a seal, to close up, close with a seal

2697.gl: a holding back, hindering; a holding fast, possession

2698.g: to place down, i.e., deposit (literally or figuratively)
2698.gl: to lay down, deposit, lay up; to lay by or up for one's self, for future use; to lay up favor for one's self with any one, to gain favor with (to do something for one which may win favor)
2698.gi: posare giù, cioè, depositare (letteralmente o figurato)

2700.g: to shoot down with an arrow or other missile
2700.gl: to shoot down or thrust through with an arrow
2700.gi: abbattere con una freccia o altro proiettile

2701.g: to run down, i.e., hasten from a tower
2701.gi: correre giù, cioè, affrettarsi da una torre

2702.g: to bear down, i.e., (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a vote
2702.gl: to bear down, bring down, cast down; to cast a pebble or calculus into the urn; to give one's vote, to approve; to be born down, to sink, (from the window to the pavement); metaphorically; to be weighted down by, overcome, carried away; to sink into sleep, drop asleep
2702.gi: premere giù, cioè (figurato) sopraffare (con sonnolenza); specialmente, esprimere un voto

2703.gl: to flee away, flee for refuge

2704.g: to spoil entirely, i.e., (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave
2704.gl: to corrupt, deprave; corrupted in mind; to destroy; to be destroyed, to perish
2704.gi: rovinare completamente, cioè, (letteralmente) distruggere; o (figurato) corrompere

2705.gl: to kiss much, kiss again and again, kiss tenderly

2706.gl: to contemn, despise, disdain, think little or nothing of

2708.gl: to pour down upon; pour over, pour upon

2709.g: subterranean, i.e., infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits)
2709.gl: subterranean; refers to those who dwell in the world below, departed souls
2709.gi: sotterraneo, cioè, infernale (appartenente al mondo degli spiriti defunti)

2710.gl: to use much or excessively or ill; to use up, consume by use; to use fully

2713.gl: over against, opposite before; metaphorically before one i.e., he being judge

2714.gl: over against, before the face of, before the presence of, in the sight of, before; referring to places; metaphorically; having one as it were before the eyes, before one as witness; before god as judge

2716.g: to work fully, i.e., accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion
2716.gl: to perform, accomplish, achieve; to work out i.e., to do that from which something results; of things: bring about, result in; to fashion i.e., render one fit for a thing
2716.gi: lavorare completamente, cioè compiere; per implicazione, finire, modellare

2718.g: to come (or go) down (literally or figuratively)
2718.gl: to come down, go down; of one who goes from a higher to a lower locality; of those who come to a place by a ship

2719.g: to eat up, i.e., devour (literally or figuratively)
2719.gl: to consume by eating, to eat up, devour; of birds; of a dragon; of a man eating up the little book; to ruin (by the infliction of injuries); metaphorically; to devour i.e., squander, waste: substance; to devour i.e., forcibly appropriate: widows' property; to strip one of his goods; by fire, to devour i.e., to utterly consume, destroy; of the consumption of the strength of body and mind by strong emotions
2719.gi: mangiare completamente, cioè, divorare (letteralmente o figurato)

2720.gl: to make straight, guide, direct; of the removal of the hindrances to coming to one

2721.g: to stand over against, i.e., rush upon (assault)

2722.g: to hold down (fast), in various applications (literally or figuratively)
2722.gl: to hold back, detain, retain; from going away; to restrain, hinder (the course or progress of); that which hinders, antichrist from making his appearance; to check a ship's headway i.e., to hold or head the ship; to hold fast, keep secure, keep firm possession of; to get possession of, take; to possess
2722.gi: tenere giù (fermamente), in varie applicazioni (letteralmente o figurato)

2723.g: to be a plaintiff, i.e., to charge with some offence
2723.gl: to accuse; before a judge: to make an accusation; of an extra-judicial accusation
2723.gi: essere un querelante, cioè, accusare di qualche reato

2725.g: against one in the assembly, i.e., a complainant at law; specially, satan
2725.gl: an accuser; a name given to the devil by the rabbis
2725.gi: contro qualcuno nell'assemblea, cioè, un querelante legalmente; specialmente, satana

2726.gl: a downcast look expressive of sorrow; shame, dejection, gloom

2727.g: to sound down into the ears, i.e., (by implication) to indoctrinate ("catechize") or (genitive case) to apprise of
2727.gl: to sound towards, sound down upon, resound; to charm with resounding sound, to fascinate; to teach orally, to instruct; to inform by word of mouth; to be orally informed
2727.gi: risuonare nelle orecchie, cioè, (per implicazione) istruire ("catechizzare") o (caso genitivo) informare di

2728.gl: to rust over, cover with rust

2729.gl: to be strong to another's detriment, to prevail against; to be superior in strength; to overcome; to prevail

2730.g: to house permanently, i.e., reside (literally or figuratively)
2730.gl: to dwell, settle; metaphorically divine powers, influences, etc., are said to dwell in his soul, to pervade, prompt, govern it; to dwell in, inhabit; god is said to dwell in the temple, i.e., to be always present for worshippers
2730.gi: alloggiare permanentemente, cioè, risiedere (letteralmente o figurato)

2731.g: residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion)
2731.gi: residenza (propriamente, l'atto; ma per implicazione, concretamente, la dimora)

2733.g: residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself)
2733.gl: dwelling, habitation; to cause to dwell, to send or bring into an abode; to give a dwelling to
2733.gi: residenza (propriamente, la condizione; ma per implicazione, l'abitazione stessa)

2734.g: to mirror oneself, i.e., to see reflected (figuratively)
2734.gl: to show in a mirror, to make to reflect, to mirror; to look at one's self in a mirror; to behold one's self in a mirror

2735.g: something made fully upright, i.e., (figuratively) rectification (specially, good public administration)
2735.gl: a right action, a successful achievement; of wholesome public measures or institutions
2735.gi: qualcosa reso perfettamente eretto, cioè (in senso figurato) rettifica (specialmente, buona amministrazione pubblica)

2736.gl: down, downwards; below, beneath; of place, below; of temporal succession

2738.g: properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow
2738.gl: heat; of painful and burning heat
2738.gi: propriamente, una bruciatura (concretamente), ma usato (in astratto) di un bagliore

2739.gl: to burn with heat, to scorch; to be tortured with intense heat

2741.gl: to burn up, set fire to; to suffer with feverish burning, be parched with fever

2742.gl: burning heat; of the sun; eurus, a very dry hot, east wind, scorching and drying up everything

2743.g: to brand ("cauterize"), i.e., (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively)
2743.gl: to mark by branding, to brand, branded with their own consciences; whose souls are branded with the marks of sin; who carry about with them the perpetual consciousness of sin; seared; in a medical sense, to cauterise, remover by cautery
2743.gi: marchiare a fuoco ("cauterizzare"), cioè (per implicazione) rendere insensibile (in senso figurato)

2744.g: to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense)
2744.gl: to glory (whether with reason or without); to glory on account of a thing; to glory in a thing

2745.g: a boast (properly, the object; by implication, the act) in a good or a bad sense
2745.gl: that of which one glories or can glory, matter or ground of glorying; a glorying or boasting
2745.gi: un vanto (propriamente, l'oggetto; per implicazione, l'atto) in senso buono o cattivo

2746.g: boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense
2746.gi: vantarsi (propriamente, l'atto; per implicazione, l'oggetto), in senso buono o cattivo

2747.gl: [millet]; the eastern harbor of corinth (i.e., its harbor on the saronic gulf) and the emporium of its trade with the asiatic shores of the mediterranean, as lechaeum on the corinthian gulf connected it with italy and the west

2748.g: cedron (i.e., kidron), a brook near jerusalem
2748.gl: [turbid]; the name of a winter torrent, rising near jerusalem and flowing down through a valley of kidron, having the mount of olives on the east, into the dead sea
2748.gi: cedron (cioè Kidron), un torrente vicino a Gerusalemme

2749.gl: to lie; of an infant; of one buried; of things that quietly cover some spot; of a city situated on a hill; of things put or set in any place, in ref. to which english often uses "to stand"; of vessels, of a throne, of the site of a city, of grain and other things laid up together, of a foundation; metaphorically; to be (by god's intent) set, i.e., destined, appointed; of laws, to be made, laid down; lies in the power of the evil one, i.e., is held in subjection by the devil
2749.gi: giacere disteso (letteralmente o in senso figurato)

2750.gl: a band, either for bed-girth, or for tying up a corpse after it has been swathed in linen

2751.gl: to sheer: a sheep; to get or let be shorn; of shearing or cutting short the hair of the head

2752.gl: an order, command, spec. a stimulating cry, either that by which animals are roused and urged on by man, as horses by charioteers, hounds by hunters, etc., or that by which a signal is given to men, e.g., to rowers by the master of a ship, to soldiers by a commander (with a loud summons, a trumpet call)

2753.g: "hail"; to incite by word, i.e., order

2754.gl: vain glory, groundless, self esteem, empty pride; a vain opinion, error

2755.gl: glorying without reason, conceited, vain glorious, eager for empty glory

2756.gl: empty, vain, devoid of truth; of places, vessels, etc. which contain nothing; of men; empty handed; without a gift; metaphorically destitute of spiritual wealth, of one who boasts of his faith as a transcendent possession, yet is without the fruits of faith; metaphorically of endeavors, labors, acts, which result in nothing, vain, fruitless, without effect; vain of no purpose

2757.gl: empty discussion, discussion of vain and useless matters

2758.g: to make empty, i.e., (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify
2758.gl: to empty, make empty; of christ, he laid aside equality with or the form of god; to make void; deprive of force, render vain, useless, of no effect; to make void; cause a thing to be seen to be empty, hollow, false
2758.gi: rendere vuoto, cioè (in senso figurato) abbassare, neutralizzare, falsificare

2759.g: a point ("center"), i.e., a sting (figuratively, poison) or goad (figuratively, divine impulse)
2759.gl: a sting, as that of bees, scorpions, locusts; an iron goad, for urging on oxen, horses and other beasts of burden; hence the proverb, "to kick against the goad", i.e., to offer vain and perilous or ruinous resistance
2759.gi: un punto ("centro"), cioè una puntura (in senso figurato, veleno) o uno stimolo (in senso figurato, impulso divino)

2760.g: a centurion, i.e., captain of one hundred soldiers
2760.gl: centurion, an officer in the roman army
2760.gi: un centurione, cioè capitano di cento soldati

2762.g: something horn-like, i.e., (specially) the apex of a hebrew letter (figuratively, the least particle)
2762.gl: a little horn; extremity, apex, point; used by grammarians of the accents and diacritical points, i.e., the smallest distinguishing stroke of a hebrew letter
2762.gi: qualcosa simile a un corno, cioè (specialmente) l'apice di una lettera ebraica (in senso figurato, la minima particella)

2764.gl: of or belonging to a potter; made of clay, earthen
2764.gi: fatto di argilla, cioè di terra

2765.gl: an earthen vessel, a pot, jar; a jug or pitcher; a water pitcher
2765.gi: un vaso di terracotta, cioè una giara

2766.g: earthenware, i.e., a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning)
2766.gl: clay, potter's earth; anything made of clay, earthen ware; a roofing tile; the roof itself; the phrase "through the roof", means through the door in the roof to which a ladder or stairway led up from the street (according to the rabbis distinguish two ways of entering a house, "the way through the door" and "the way through the roof"
2766.gi: terracotta, cioè una tegola (per analogia, un sottile tetto o tenda)

2767.g: to mingle, i.e., (by implication) to pour out (for drinking)
2767.gl: to mix, mingle; to mix wine, water; to pour out for drinking

2768.gl: a horn; of animals; since animals (especially bulls) defend themselves with their horns, the horn with the hebrews (and other nations) is a symbol of strength and courage, and used as such in a variety of phrases; a mighty and valiant helper, the author of deliverance, of the messiah; a projecting extremity in a shape like a horn, a point, apex: as of an altar
2768.gi: un corno (letteralmente o in senso figurato)

2769.g: something horned, i.e., (specially) the pod of the carob-tree
2769.gl: a little horn; the husk of a fruit, perhaps the name of the fruit
2769.gi: qualcosa cornuto, cioè (specialmente) il baccello del carrubo

2770.gl: to gain, acquire, to get gain; metaphorically; of gain arising from shunning or escaping from evil (where we say "to spare one's self", "be spared"); to gain any one i.e., to win him over to the kingdom of god, to gain one to faith in christ; to gain christ's favor and fellowship

2772.gl: small pieces of money, small coin, change, money

2773.g: a handler of coins, i.e., money-broker
2773.gi: un trattatore di monete, cioè un sensale di denaro

2774.g: a principal thing, i.e., main point; specially, an amount (of money)
2774.gl: the chief or main point, the principal thing; the pecuniary sum total of a reckoning, amount; the principal, capital, as distinguished from the interest; a sum of money, sum
2774.gi: una cosa principale, cioè punto principale; specialmente, una somma (di denaro)

2775.gl: to bring under headings, to sum up, to summarise; to smite or wound in the head, to smite on the cheek

2776.g: the head (as the part most readily taken hold of), literally or figuratively
2776.gl: the head, both of men and often of animals; metaphorically anything supreme, chief, prominent; of persons, master lord: of a husband in relation to his wife; of christ: the lord of the husband and of the church; of things: the corner stone
2776.gi: il capo (come parte più facilmente afferrata), letteralmente o figurato

2777.g: properly, a knob, i.e., (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled)
2777.gl: a little head; the highest part, extremity of anything; as the capital of a column; the tips or knobs of the wooden rod around which parchments were rolled were called by this word, because they resembled little heads; the alexandrian writers transferred the name to the roll or volume itself; in the roll of the book
2777.gi: propriamente, un pomo, cioè (per implicazione) un rotolo (per estensione dall'estremità di un bastone su cui era arrotolato il manoscritto)

2778.g: properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e., (by implication) a tax
2778.gl: census (among the romans, denoting a register and valuation of property in accordance with which taxes were paid), in the new testament the tax or tribute levied on individuals and to be paid yearly; the coin with which the tax is paid, tribute money
2778.gi: propriamente, un censimento (o 'census'), cioè (per implicazione) una tassa

2780.gl: a keeper of a garden, a gardener
2780.gi: un custode di giardino, cioè giardiniere

2781.g: a cell for honey, i.e., (collectively) the comb
2781.gi: una cella per il miele, cioè (collettivamente) il favo

2782.g: a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself)
2782.gl: that which is proclaimed by a herald or public crier, a proclamation by herald; in the new testament the message or proclamation of the heralds of god or christ
2782.gi: una proclamazione (specialmente del vangelo; per implicazione, il vangelo stesso)

2783.g: a herald, i.e., of divine truth (especially of the gospel)
2783.gl: a herald or messenger vested with public authority, who conveyed the official messages of kings, magistrates, princes, military commanders, or who gave a public summons or demand, and performed various other duties, god's ambassador, the herald or proclaimer of the divine word
2783.gi: un araldo, cioè di verità divina (specialmente del vangelo)

2784.g: to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel)
2784.gl: to be a herald, to officiate as a herald; to proclaim after the manner of a herald; always with the suggestion of formality, gravity and an authority which must be listened to and obeyed; to publish, proclaim openly: something which has been done; used of the public proclamation of the gospel and matters pertaining to it, made by john the baptist, by jesus, by the apostles and other christian teachers
2784.gi: araldare (come banditore pubblico), specialmente la verità divina (il vangelo)

2785.g: a huge fish (as gaping for prey)
2785.gl: a sea monster, whale, huge fish
2785.gi: un pesce enorme (come spalancato per la preda)

2786.g: the rock; cephas (i.e., kepha), a surname of peter
2786.gl: [stone]; another name for the apostle peter
2786.gi: la roccia; Cephas (cioè Kepha), un soprannome di Pietro

2787.g: a box, i.e., the sacred ark and that of noah
2787.gl: a wooden chest or box; in the new testament the ark of the covenant, in the temple at jerusalem; of noah's vessel built in the form of an ark
2787.gi: una cassa, cioè l'arca sacra e quella di Noè

2788.gl: a harp to which praises of god are sung in heaven

2790.gl: a harper, one who plays the harp and accompanies it with his voice
2790.gi: un cantante (suonatore) di lira, cioè arpista

2791.g: cilicia, a region of asia minor
2791.gl: [the land of celix]; a maritime province in the southeast of asia minor, boarding on pamphylia in the west, lycaonia and cappadocia in the north and syria in the east
2791.gi: la Cilicia, una regione dell'Asia Minore

2792.gl: cinnamon was a well known aromatic substance, the rind of "laurus cinnamonum" called "korunda-gauhah" in ceylon

2793.gl: to be in jeopardy, to be in danger, to put in peril

2795.gl: to cause to go, i.e., to move, set in motion; to be moved, move: of that motion which is evident in life; to move from a place, to remove; metaphorically; to move excite; a riot, disturbance; to throw into commotion

2797.gl: [a snare]; the father of saul, the first king of israel

2798.g: a twig or bough (as if broken off)
2798.gl: a young tender shoot, broken off for grafting; a branch; as the jewish patriarchs are likened to a root, so their posterity are likened to branches
2798.gi: un ramoscello o un ramo (come se spezzato)

2799.g: to sob, i.e., wail aloud (whereas 1145 is rather to cry silently)
2799.gl: to mourn, weep, lament; weeping as the sign of pain and grief for the thing signified (i.e., for the pain and grief); of those who mourn for the dead; to weep for, mourn for, bewail, one
2799.gi: singhiozzare, cioè piangere ad alta voce (mentre 1145 è piuttosto piangere silenziosamente)

2801.gl: a fragment, broken piece; remnants of food

2802.gl: [lame]; a small island nearly due west of cape malta on the south coast of crete, and nearly due south of phoenice

2804.g: claudius, the name of two romans
2804.gl: [lame]; c. caesar the name of the fourth roman emperor, who came to power in 41 ad and was poisoned by his wife agrippina, in 54 ad; c. lysias a tribune of the roman cohort who rescued paul from the hands of the mob at jerusalem
2804.gi: Claudio, il nome di due romani

2806.gl: to break; used in the new testament of the breaking of bread or communion

2807.g: a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively
2807.gl: a key; since the keeper of the keys has the power to open and to shut; metaphorically in the new testament to denote power and authority of various kinds
2807.gi: una chiave (come chiudere una serratura), letteralmente o figurato

2808.gl: to shut, shut up; metaphorically; to cause the heavens to withhold rain; to shut up compassion so that it is like a thing inaccessible to one, to be devoid of pity towards one; to obstruct the entrance into the kingdom of heaven

2809.g: stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act)
2809.gl: thing stolen; the act of theft
2809.gi: furto (propriamente, la cosa rubata, ma usato per l'atto)

2810.gl: [of a renowned father]; one of the two disciples who were going to emmaus on the day of the resurrection

2812.gl: an embezzler, pilferer; the name is transferred to false teachers, who do not care to instruct men, but abuse their confidence for their own gain

2813.gl: to steal; to commit a theft; take away by theft i.e., take away by stealth

2814.g: a limb or shoot (as if broken off)
2814.gl: a tender and flexible branch; specifically the shoot or branch of a vine, a vine sprout
2814.gi: un arto o un germoglio (come se spezzato)

2815.gl: [mild, merciful]; a companion of paul and apparently a member of the church of philippi

2816.g: to be an heir to (literally or figuratively)
2816.gl: to receive a lot, receive by lot; especially to receive a part of an inheritance, receive as an inheritance, obtain by right of inheritance; to be an heir, to inherit; to receive the portion assigned to one, receive an allotted portion, receive as one's own or as a possession; to become partaker of, to obtain

2817.g: heirship, i.e., (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession
2817.gl: an inheritance, property received (or to be received) by inheritance; what is given to one as a possession; the eternal blessedness of the consummated kingdom of god which is to be expected after the visible return of christ; the share which an individual will have in that eternal blessedness
2817.gi: eredità, cioè, (concretamente) un patrimonio o (caso genitivo) una proprietà

2818.g: a sharer by lot, i.e., inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor
2818.gl: one who receives by lot, an heir; an heir; in messianic usage, one who receives his allotted possession by right of sonship; one who has acquired or obtained the portion allotted to him
2818.gi: un partecipante per sorteggio, cioè, erede (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, un possessore

2819.g: a die (for drawing chances); by implication, a portion (as if so secured); by extension, an acquisition (especially a patrimony, figuratively)

2819.gi: un dado (per estrarre le chance); per implicazione, una porzione (come se così garantita); per estensione, un'acquisizione (specialmente un patrimonio, figurato)

2820.g: to allot, i.e., (figuratively) to assign (a privilege)
2820.gl: to cast lots, determine by lot; to choose by lot; to allot, assign by lot; on to another as a possession; in new testament: to make a lot, i.e., a heritage, private possession

2821.gl: a calling, calling to; a call, invitation; to a feast; of the divine invitation to embrace salvation of god

2822.g: invited, i.e., appointed, or (specially), a saint
2822.gl: called, invited (to a banquet); invited (by god in the proclamation of the gospel) to obtain eternal salvation in the kingdom through christ; called to (the discharge of) some office; divinely selected and appointed
2822.gi: invitato, cioè designato, o (specialmente), un santo

2823.g: an earthen pot used for baking in
2823.gl: a clibanus, a earthen vessel for baking bread; a furnace, oven

2824.g: a slope, i.e., (specially) a "clime" or tract of country
2824.gl: an inclination, slope, declivity; the [supposed] sloping of the earth from the equator towards the poles, a zone; a tract of land, a region
2824.gi: una pendenza, cioè, (specialmente) un "clima" o tratto di paese

2825.g: a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating)
2825.gl: a small bed, a couch; a couch to recline on at meals; a couch on which a sick man is carried
2825.gi: un lettino (per dormire, malattia, sedersi o mangiare)

2827.g: to slant or slope, i.e., incline or recline (literally or figuratively)
2827.gl: transitively; to incline, bow; to cause to fall back; to recline; in a place for repose; intransitively; to incline one's self; of the declining of the day
2827.gi: inclinare o riposare, cioè, slittare o pendere (letteralmente o figurato)

2828.g: properly, reclination, i.e., (concretely and specially), a party at a meal
2828.gl: a hut erected to pass the night in; a tent; anything to recline on; a chair in which to lean back the head; a reclining chair; a company reclining; a row or party of persons reclining at meal
2828.gi: propriamente, reclinazione, cioè (concretamente e specialmente), un banchetto

2830.g: a surge of the sea (literally or figuratively)
2830.gl: a dashing or surging wave, a surge, a violent agitation of the sea

2831.gl: to be tossed by the waves; metaphorically to be agitated (like the waves) mentally

2832.gl: [my exchanges]; the father of james the less, the husband of mary the sister of the mother of jesus

2833.g: to scratch, i.e., (by implication) to tickle
2833.gl: to scratch, tickle, make to itch; to itch; desirous of hearing something pleasant

2834.g: cnidus, a place in asia minor
2834.gl: [nettled]; a peninsula [now cape crio] and a city by the same name, situated at the extreme south west of the peninsula of asia minor, on a promontory now called cape crio, which projects between the islands of cos and rhodes
2834.gi: Cnido, un luogo in Asia Minore

2835.g: a quadrans, i.e., the fourth part of an as
2835.gl: a quadrans (about the fourth part of an "as"); in the new testament a coin equal to one half the attic chalcus worth about 3/8 of a cent

2836.g: a cavity, i.e., (especially) the abdomen; by implication, the matrix; figuratively, the heart

2836.gi: una cavità, cioè, (specialmente) l'addome; per implicazione, la matrice; figurato, il cuore

2837.g: to put to sleep, i.e., (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease
2837.gl: to cause to sleep, put to sleep; metaphorically; to still, calm, quiet; to fall asleep, to sleep; to die

2838.gl: a reposing, taking rest; a lying, reclining

2839.g: common, i.e., (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane

2839.gi: comune, cioè, (letteralmente) condiviso da tutti o da alcuni, o (ceremonialmente) profano

2841.g: to share with others (objectively or subjectively)

2841.gi: condividere con gli altri (oggettivamente o soggettivamente)

2842.g: partnership, i.e., (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction
2842.gl: fellowship, association, community, communion, joint participation, intercourse; the share which one has in anything, participation; intercourse, fellowship, intimacy; the right hand as a sign and pledge of fellowship (in fulfilling the apostolic office); a gift jointly contributed, a collection, a contribution, as exhibiting an embodiment and proof of fellowship
2842.gi: partnership, cioè (letteralmente) partecipazione, o (sociale) convivenza, o (pecuniario) beneficenza

2843.gl: social, sociable, ready and apt to form and maintain communion and fellowship; inclined to make others sharers in one's possessions, inclined to impart, free in giving, liberal

2844.gl: a partner, associate, comrade, companion; a partner, sharer, in anything; of the altar in jerusalem on which the sacrifices are offered; sharing in the worship of the jews; partakers of (or with) demons; brought into fellowship with them, because they are the authors of heathen worship

2845.g: a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm
2845.gl: a place for laying down, resting, sleeping in; a bed, couch; the marriage bed; of adultery; cohabitation, whether lawful or unlawful; sexual intercourse
2845.gi: un lettino; per estensione, convivenza; per implicazione, lo sperma maschile

2846.gl: a sleeping room, bed chamber; the officer who is over the bed chamber, the chamberlain

2847.gl: crimson, scarlet colored. a kernel, the grain or berry of the "ilex coccifera"; these berries are the clusters of the eggs of a female insect, the "kermes" (resembling the cochineal), and when collected and pulverised produces a red which was used in dyeing (pliny); scarlet cloth or clothing

2849.g: properly, to curtail, i.e., (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction)
2849.gl: to lop or prune, as trees and wings; to curb, check, restrain; to chastise, correct, punishment; to cause to be punished
2849.gi: propriamente, accorciare, cioè, (figurato) castigare (o riservare per l'infrazione)

2852.gl: to strike with the fist, give one a blow with the fist; to maltreat, treat with violence and contumely

2853.g: to glue, i.e., (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively)
2853.gl: to glue, to glue together, cement, fasten together; to join or fasten firmly together; to join one's self to, cleave to

2854.g: properly, a poultice (as made of or in the form of crackers), i.e., (by analogy) a plaster
2854.gl: a preparation composed of various materials and used as a remedy for tender eyelids
2854.gi: propriamente, una cataplasma (come fatto di o nella forma di cracker), cioè, (per analogia) una cerotto

2856.gl: to mutilate; in new testament: to shorten, abridge, curtail

2857.g: colossae, a place in asia minor
2857.gl: [monstrosities]; anciently a large and flourishing city, but in strabo's time a small town of phrygia major situated on the lycus not far from its junction with the maeander and in the neighbourhood of laodicea and hierapolis
2857.gi: Colosse, un luogo in Asia Minore

2859.g: the bosom; by analogy, a bay
2859.gl: the front of the body between the arms; the bosom of a garment, i.e., the hollow formed by the upper forepart of a rather loose garment bound by a girdle or sash, used for keeping and carrying things (the fold or pocket); a bay of the sea
2859.gi: il seno; per analogia, una baia

2861.g: a diving-place, i.e., pond for bathing (or swimming)
2861.gl: a place for diving, a swimming hole, a reservoir or pool for bathing
2861.gi: un luogo per tuffarsi, cioè stagno per fare il bagno (o nuotare)

2863.gl: to let the hair grow, have long hair

2864.g: the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from g2359; which properly denotes merely the scalp)
2864.gi: i capelli del capo (ciocche, come ornamento, e quindi diverso da 2359; che propriamente indica solo il cuoio capelluto)

2865.g: properly, to provide for, i.e., (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain)

2865.gi: propriamente, provvedere, cioè (per implicazione) portare via (come da un pericolo; caso genitivo ottenere)

2869.gl: to grow weary or tired; to cease from violence, cease raging

2870.gl: lamentation with beating of the breast as a sign of grief

2871.gl: the act of cutting, a cut; a cutting in pieces, slaughter

2872.g: to feel fatigue; by implication, to work hard
2872.gl: to grow weary, tired, exhausted (with toil or burdens or grief); to labor with wearisome effort, to toil; of bodily labor
2872.gi: sentire fatica; per implicazione, lavorare duramente

2873.g: a cut, i.e., (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains
2873.gl: a beating; a beating of the breast with grief, sorrow; labor; trouble; to cause one trouble, make work for him; intense labor united with trouble and toil
2873.gi: un taglio, cioè (per analogia) fatica (come se riducesse le forze), letteralmente o in senso figurato; per implicazione, dolori

2875.g: to "chop"; specially, to beat the breast in grief
2875.gl: to cut, strike, smite; to cut from, cut off; to beat one's breast for grief
2875.gi: tagliare; specialmente, battere il petto nel dolore

2878.g: a votive offering and the offering; a consecrated present (to the temple fund); by extension (the latter term) the treasury itself, i.e., the room where the contribution boxes stood
2878.gl: a gift offered (or to be offered) to god; the sacred treasury
2878.gi: un'offerta votiva e l'offerta; un dono consacrato (al fondo del tempio); per estensione (quest'ultimo termine) il tesoro stesso, cioè la stanza dove stavano le cassette delle offerte

2879.gl: [baldness]; a man who, with others, rebelled against moses

2880.g: to cram, i.e., glut or sate

2881.g: a corinthian, i.e., inhabitant of corinth
2881.gl: a corinthian, and inhabitant of corinth
2881.gi: un corinzio, cioè abitante di Corinto

2882.gl: [satiated]; an ancient and famous city of greece, on the isthmus of corinth, and about 40 miles (65 km) west of athens

2884.g: a cor, i.e., a specific measure
2884.gl: a corus or cor, the largest hebrew dry measure (i.e., for wheat, meal etc.) about 10 to 11 bushels (350 to 400 liters)
2884.gi: un cor, cioè una misura specifica

2885.g: to put in proper order, i.e., decorate (literally or figuratively); specially, to snuff (a wick)
2885.gl: to put in order, arrange, make ready, prepare; to ornament, adore; metaphorically to embellish with honor, gain honor
2885.gi: mettere in ordine, cioè decorare (letteralmente o in senso figurato); specialmente, stoppinare (un lucignolo)

2886.gl: of or belonging to the world; relating to the universe; earthly; worldly, i.e., having the character of this present corrupt age
2886.gi: terreno ("cosmico"), letteralmente (mondano) o in senso figurato (corrotto)

2888.g: a world-ruler, an epithet of satan
2888.gl: lord of the world, prince of this age; the devil and his demons
2888.gi: un dominatore del mondo, un epiteto di Satana

2889.g: orderly arrangement, i.e., decoration; by implication, the world (including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally))

2892.gl: a guard, used of roman soldiers guarding the sepulcher of christ

2893.gl: to be light; to lighten; a ship by throwing the cargo overboard

2895.gl: a pallet, camp bed (a rather simple bed holding only one person)

2899.g: a margin, i.e., (specially), a fringe or tassel
2899.gl: the extremity or prominent part of a thing, edge, skirt, margin; the fringe of a garment; in the new testament a little appendage hanging down from the edge of the mantle or cloak, made of twisted wool; a tassel, tuft: the jews had such appendages attached to their mantles to remind them of the law

2901.gl: to strengthen, make strong; to be made strong, to increase in strength, to grow strong

2902.g: to use strength, i.e., seize or retain (literally or figuratively)

2903.gi: il più forte, cioè, (in dignità) molto onorevole

2906.g: an outcry (in notification, tumult or grief)
2906.gi: un grido (in notifica, tumulto o dolore)

2909.gl: more useful, more serviceable, more advantageous; more excellent
2909.gi: più forte, cioè (figurato) migliore, cioè nobile

2910.gl: to hang up, suspend; to be suspended, to hang; used of one hanging on a cross; used of the law and the prophets, they is summed up or hanging on two precepts

2912.g: a cretan, i.e., inhabitant of crete
2912.gl: a cretan, an inhabitant of the island of crete
2912.gi: un cretese, cioè abitante di Creta

2914.g: crete, an island in the mediterranean

2917.g: a decision (the function or the effect, for or against ("crime"))
2917.gl: a decree, judgments; judgment; condemnation of wrong, the decision (whether severe or mild) which one passes on the faults of others; in a forensic sense; the sentence of a judge; the punishment with which one is sentenced; condemnatory sentence, penal judgment, sentence; a matter to be judicially decided, a lawsuit, a case in court
2917.gi: una decisione (la funzione o l'effetto, per o contro ("crimine"))

2919.g: by implication, to try, condemn, punish
2919.gl: to separate, put asunder, to pick out, select, choose; to approve, esteem, to prefer; to be of opinion, deem, think, to be of opinion; to determine, resolve, decree; to judge; to pronounce an opinion concerning right and wrong; to be judged, i.e., summoned to trial that one's case may be examined and judgment passed upon it; to pronounce judgment, to subject to censure; of those who act the part of judges or arbiters in matters of common life, or pass judgment on the deeds and words of others; to rule, govern; to preside over with the power of giving judicial decisions, because it was the prerogative of kings and rulers to pass judgment; to contend together, of warriors and combatants; to dispute; in a forensic sense; to go to law, have suit at law

2928.gl: to hide, conceal, to be hid; escape notice; metaphorically to conceal (that it may not become known)

2929.gl: to be of crystalline brightness and transparency; to shine like crystal

2930.gl: crystal, a kind of precious stone

2932.g: to get, i.e., acquire (by any means; own)

2932.gi: ottenere, cioè, acquisire (con qualsiasi mezzo; possedere)

2936.gl: to make habitable, to people, a place, region, island; to found a city, colony, state; to create; of god creating the worlds; to form, shape, i.e., to completely change or transform

2939.gi: un fondatore, cioè, Dio (come autore di tutte le cose)

2940.gi: gioco d'azzardo, cioè (figurato) artifizio o frode

2943.g: from the circle, i.e., all around
2943.gl: round about, from all sides, all around

2953.gl: a cyprian or cypriote, i.e., a native of cyprus
2953.gi: un cipriota (cipro), cioè abitante di cipro

2956.gi: cioè cirenaico, cioè abitante di Cirene

2960.g: belonging to the lord (jehovah or jesus)
2960.gl: belonging to the lord; related to the lord

3384.g: a "mother" (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote)

3386.gi: allora per niente, cioè non dire (anzi ancora)

3389.gi: una trebbiatrice di madri, cioè matricida

3392.g: to sully or taint, i.e., contaminate (ceremonially or morally)
3392.gl: to dye with another color, to stain; to defile, pollute, sully, contaminate, soil; to defile with sins
3392.gi: sporcare o contaminare, cioè contaminare (cerimonialmente o moralmente)

3393.gl: that which defiles, defilement; metaphorically, vices the foulness of which contaminates one in his intercourse with the ungodly mass of mankind

3394.gl: the act of defiling, defilement, pollution

3395.gl: that which has been produced by a mixing, a mixture

3397.g: a small space of time or degree
3397.gl: small, little; of size: of stature, of length; of space; of age: less by birth, younger; of time: short, brief, a little while, how little!; of quantity: i.e., number, amount; of rank or influence

3398.g: small (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity)
3398.gl: small, little; of size: hence of stature, of length; of space; of age: less by birth, younger; of time: short, brief, a little while, how little!; of quantity: i.e., number, amount; of rank or influence
3398.gi: piccolo (in dimensione, quantità, numero o (figurato) dignità)

3399.g: miletus, a city of asia minor
3399.gl: [pure white fine wool]; a maritime city, now nearly 10 miles (16 km), from the coast of caria or ionia, near the mouth of the maeander and 35 miles (55 km) from ephesus

3400.gl: a mile, among the romans the distance of a thousand paces or eight stadia, about 1.5 km (about 0.93 miles)

3403.g: to remind, i.e., (middle voice) to recall to mind
3403.gl: to remind; to be recalled or to return to one's mind, to remind one's self of, to remember; to be recalled to mind, to be remembered, had in remembrance; to remember a thing; be mindful of
3403.gi: ricordare, cioè (voce media) richiamare alla mente

3404.g: to detest (especially to persecute); by extension, to love less
3404.gl: to hate, pursue with hatred, detest; to be hated, detested
3404.gi: detestare (specialmente perseguitare); per estensione, amare meno

3406.gl: one who pays wages, a rewarder

3408.g: pay for service (literally or figuratively), good or bad
3408.gl: dues paid for work; wages, hire; reward: used of the fruit naturally resulting from toils and endeavors; in both senses, rewards and punishments; of the rewards which god bestows, or will bestow, upon good deeds and endeavors; of punishments
3408.gi: pagare per il servizio (letteralmente o figurato), buono o cattivo

3409.g: to let out for wages, i.e., (middle voice) to hire
3409.gl: to let out for hire; to hire
3409.gi: dare in affitto per salario, cioè (voce media) assumere

3410.gl: the price for which anything is either let or hired; of a harlots hire; that which is either let or hired for a price, as of a house, dwelling, lodging

3412.gl: [mutilated]; the chief maritime town of the island of lesbos in the aegean
3412.gi: Mitilene (o Mytilene), una città sull'isola di Lesbo

3413.gl: [who is like god]; the first of the chief princes or archangels who is supposed to be the guardian angel of the israelites

3414.g: a mna (i.e., mina), a certain weight

3415.g: to bear in mind, i.e., recollect; by implication, to reward or punish
3415.gl: to remind; to be recalled or to return to one's mind, to remind one's self of, to remember; to be recalled to mind, to be remembered, had in remembrance; to remember a thing; be mindful of
3415.gi: tenere a mente, cioè ricordare; per implicazione, ricompensare o punire

3416.gl: [remembering]; a christian from cyprus, a common greek name

3418.gl: a monument or memorial to perpetuate the memory of any person or thing; a sepulchral monument; a sepulcher or tomb
3418.gi: un memoriale, cioè monumento sepolcrale (luogo di sepoltura)

3419.g: a remembrance, i.e., cenotaph (place of interment)
3419.gl: any visible object for preserving or recalling the memory of any person or thing; a memorial, monument, specifically, a sepulchral monument; a sepulcher, a tomb
3419.gi: una rimembranza, cioè cenotafio (luogo di sepoltura)

3420.gl: memory, remembrance; mention: to remember a thing, call to remembrance

3421.g: to exercise memory, i.e., recollect; by implication, to punish; also to rehearse
3421.gl: to be mindful of, to remember, to call to mind; to think of and feel for a person or thing; to hold in memory, keep in mind; to make mention of
3421.gi: esercitare la memoria, cioè ricordare; per implicazione, punire; anche ripetere

3422.gl: a memorial (that by which the memory of any person or thing is preserved), a remembrance

3423.g: to give a souvenir (betrothal present), i.e., betroth
3423.gl: to be promised in marriage, be betrothed
3423.gi: dare un pegno (dono di fidanzamento), cioè fidanzare

3424.gi: parlare a stento, cioè muto (senza parole)

3426.g: a modius, i.e., certain measure for things dry (the quantity or the utensil)
3426.gl: a dry measure holding 16 sextarii (or 1/6 of the attic medimnus), about a peck (9 liters)
3426.gi: un modio, cioè certa misura per cose secche (la quantità o l'utensile)

3428.gl: an adulteress; as the intimate alliance of god with the people of israel was likened to a marriage, those who relapse into idolatry are said to commit adultery or play the harlot; figuratively equivalent to faithless to god, unclean, apostate

3429.gl: to have unlawful intercourse with another's wife, to commit adultery with

3431.gl: to commit adultery; to be an adulterer; to commit adultery with, have unlawful intercourse with another's wife; of the wife: to suffer adultery, be debauched; a hebrew idiom, the word is used of those who at a woman's solicitation are drawn away to idolatry, i.e., to the eating of things sacrificed to idols

3432.gl: an adulterer; metaphorically one who is faithless toward god, ungodly

3433.gl: with difficulty, hardly; not easily, i.e., scarcely, very rarely

3434.gl: [king]; the name of the idol god of the ammonites

3435.gl: to pollute, stain, contaminate, defile; used in new testament of those who have not kept themselves pure from the defilements of sin, who have soiled themselves by fornication and adultery

3436.gl: defilement, an action by which anything is defiled

3437.gl: blame; to have a complaint against any one

3438.g: a staying, i.e., residence (the act or the place)

3438.gi: un soggiorno, cioè residenza (l'atto o il luogo)

3439.gl: single of its kind, only; used of only sons or daughters (viewed in relation to their parents); used of christ, denotes the only begotten son of god

3441.g: remaining, i.e., sole or single; by implication, mere
3441.gl: alone (without a companion), forsaken, destitute of help, alone, only, merely
3441.gi: rimanente, cioè unico o singolo; per implicazione, semplice

3442.gl: deprived of one eye, having one eye

3443.gl: to make single or solitary; leave alone, forsake

3444.gl: the form by which a person or thing strikes the vision; external appearance

3446.g: formation, i.e., (by implication), appearance (semblance or (concretely) formula)
3446.gl: a forming, shaping; form; the mere form, semblance; the form befitting a thing or truly expressing the fact, the very form
3446.gi: formazione, cioè (per implicazione), aspetto (apparenza o (concretamente) formula)

3447.g: to fabricate the image of a bullock
3447.gl: to make (an image of) a calf

3448.gl: a tender juicy shoot; a sprout, of a plant or tree; offspring; of men: a boy or a girl, especially if fresh and delicate; of animals: a young one; a calf, a bullock, a heifer

3449.gl: a hard and difficult labor, toil, travail, hardship, distress

3451.gl: devoted to and skilled in the arts sacred to the muses; accomplished in the liberal arts; specifically, skilled in music; playing on musical instruments

3453.g: to initiate, i.e., (by implication) to teach
3453.gl: to initiate into the mysteries; to teach fully, instruct; to accustom one to a thing; to give one an intimate acquaintance with a thing

3454.gl: a speech, word, saying; a narrative, story; a true narrative; a fiction, a fable; an invention, a falsehood

3455.gl: to low, bellow, properly of horned cattle; to roar, of a lion

3456.g: to make mouths at, i.e., ridicule
3456.gl: to turn up the nose or sneer at; to mock, deride
3456.gi: fare la bocca a, cioè deridere

3457.gl: belonging to a mill; made of millstone

3458.gl: a mill stone; a large mill consisted of two stones, an upper and an under one; the "nether" stone was stationary, but the upper one was turned by an ass; a mill, the noise made by a mill

3459.gl: place where a mill runs; mill house

3460.g: myra, a place in asia minor

3460.gi: Mira, un luogo in Asia Minore

3461.g: a ten-thousand; by extension, a "myriad" or indefinite number
3461.gl: ten thousand; an innumerable multitude, an unlimited number; innumerable hosts
3461.gi: diecimila; per estensione, una "miriade" o numero indefinito

3463.g: ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many

3467.g: to shut the eyes, i.e., blink (see indistinctly)
3467.gl: to see dimly, see only what is near
3467.gi: chiudere gli occhi, cioè, sbattere le palpebre (vedere confusamente)

3468.g: probably akin to the base of g3433) and probably ?? (the face; from g3700); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark
3468.gl: a bruise, wale, wound that trickles with blood
3468.gi: probabilmente affine alla radice di g3433) e probabilmente ?? (il volto; da g3700); un neo ("occhio nero") o segna d'urto

3469.gl: to blame, find fault with, mock at

3470.g: a flaw or blot, i.e., (figuratively) disgraceful person
3470.gl: blemish, blot, disgrace; censure; insult; of men who are a disgrace to society
3470.gi: un difetto o macchia, cioè, (figurato) persona disonorevole

3471.gi: diventare insipido; figurativamente, rendere (passivamente, agire) come un sempliciotto

3474.g: dull or stupid (as if shut up), i.e., heedless, (morally) blockhead, (apparently) absurd

3475.gl: [drawing out]; moses, the lawgiver of the jewish people, editor of the book of genesis and writer of most of the following four books
3475.gi: Mosè, Mosè o Mosè (cioè Mosèh), il legislatore ebreo

3478.g: nazareth or nazaret, a place in palestine
3478.gl: [the guarded one]; the ordinary residence and home town of christ
3478.gi: Nazareth o Nazaret, un luogo in Palestina

3479.g: a nazarene, i.e., inhabitant of nazareth
3479.gi: un nazareno, cioè, abitante di Nazaret

3480.g: a nazoraean, i.e., inhabitant of nazareth; by extension, a christian
3480.gl: [one separated]; an inhabitant of nazareth; a title given to jesus in the new testament; a name given to christians by the jews, acts 24:5
3480.gi: un nazareno, cioè abitante di Nazareth; per estensione, un cristiano

3481.gl: [a giver]; one of the four sons of david who were born to him by bathshua

3482.gl: [gift of god]; an intimate disciple of jesus christ, he is commonly thought to be the same person as bartholomew
3482.gi: Nathanael (cioè Nathanel), un israelita e cristiano

3483.gl: yea, verily, truly, assuredly, even so

3489.g: to be shipwrecked (stranded, "navigate"), literally or figuratively
3489.gi: fare naufragio (restare bloccato, "navigare"), letteralmente o figurativamente

3490.gl: a ship owner, ship master; one who hires out his vessel, or a portion of it, for purposes of transportation

3491.gl: a ship, vessel of considerable size

3493.gl: [snorting]; was the name of two persons in the family of abraham, an ancestor of christ

3494.g: a youth (up to about forty years)

3495.gl: a young man, youth; used of a young attendant or servant

3496.gl: [new city]; a maritime city of macedonia, on the gulf of syrymon, having a port and colonised by chalcidians
3496.gi: nuova città; Neapoli, un luogo in Macedonia

3497.gl: [pleasantness]; commander-in-chief of the army of syria

3498.g: dead (literally or figuratively; also as noun)
3498.gl: properly; one that has breathed his last, lifeless; deceased, departed, one whose soul is in hades; destitute of life, without life, inanimate; metaphorically; spiritually dead; destitute of a life that recognizes and is devoted to god, because given up to trespasses and sins; inactive as respects doing right; destitute of force or power, inactive, inoperative
3498.gi: morto (letteralmente o figurativamente; anche come sostantivo)

3499.gl: to make dead, to put to death, slay; worn out; of an impotent old man; to deprive of power, destroy the strength of

3500.gl: putting to death, killing; being put to death; the dead state, utter sluggishness; of bodily members and organs

3501.g: "new", i.e., (of persons) youthful, or (of things) fresh; figuratively, regenerate
3501.gi: "nuovo", cioè, (di persone) giovane, o (di cose) fresco; figurativamente, rigenerato

3504.g: newly planted, i.e., (figuratively) a young convert ("neophyte")
3504.gl: newly planted; a new convert, neophyte (one who has recently become a christian)
3504.gi: piantato di nuovo, cioè (figurato) un neofita

3505.gl: [brave]; a famous but cruel emperor of rome from 54 to 68 ad

3506.gl: to give a nod; to signify by a nod (of what one wishes to be done)

3507.gl: a cloud; used of the cloud which led the israelites in the wilderness

3508.g: nephthaleim (i.e., naphthali), a tribe in palestine
3508.gl: [wrestling]; naphthali, the sixth son of jacob, the second child borne to him by bilhah, rachel's slave
3508.gi: Neftalim (cioè, Nefthalì), una tribù in Palestina

3509.gl: a cloud, a large dense multitude, a throng; used to denote a great shapeless collection of vapour obscuring the heavens as opposed to a particular and definite masses of vapour with some form or shape; a cloud in the sky

3510.g: a kidney (plural), i.e., (figuratively) the inmost mind
3510.gl: a kidney; kidneys, loins; used of the inmost thoughts, feelings, purposes, of the soul

3511.g: a temple-servant, i.e., (by implication) a votary
3511.gl: one who sweeps and cleans a temple; one who has charge of a temple, to keep and adorn it, a sacristan; the worshipper of a deity; word appears from coins still extant, it was an honorary title [temple-keeper or temple-warden] of certain cities, especially in asia minor, or in which some special worship of some deity or even some deified human ruler had been established; used of ephesus

3512.g: appertaining to younger persons, i.e., juvenile
3512.gl: peculiar to an age, of youth, youthful, younger; younger (than now); young, youthful; younger (by birth); an attendant, servant, inferiority in rank
3512.gi: appartenente a persone più giovani, cioè giovanile

3513.g: a particle of attestation (accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); as sure as
3513.gl: by; used in the affirmations of oaths
3513.gi: una particella di attestazione (accompagnata dall'oggetto invocato o appellato in conferma); sicuro come

3515.g: to act as a babe, i.e., (figuratively) innocently
3515.gi: comportarsi come un bambino, cioè, (figurativamente) innocentemente

3516.g: not speaking, i.e., an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature christian
3516.gl: an infant, little child; a minor, not of age; metaphorically childish, untaught, unskilled
3516.gi: non parlando, cioè, un infante (minore); figurativamente, una persona sempliciotto, un cristiano immaturo

3517.gl: [lump]; a christian at rome saluted by paul

3518.gl: [jehovah is my lamp]; the grandfather of zerubbabel

3521.gi: astinenza (per mancanza di cibo, o volontaria e religiosa); specialmente, il digiuno del giorno dell'espiazione

3523.g: not eating, i.e., abstinent from food (religiously)
3523.gi: non mangiare, cioè astenuto dal cibo (religiosamente)

3524.gl: sober, temperate; abstaining from wine, either entirely or at least from its immoderate use; of things free from all wine, as vessels, offerings

3525.g: to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e., (figuratively) be discreet
3525.gl: to be sober, to be calm and collected in spirit; to be temperate, dispassionate, circumspect
3525.gi: astenersi dal vino (restare sobrio), cioè, (figurativamente) essere discreto

3527.gl: [conqueror]; one of the seven deacons in the church at jerusalem

3528.gl: to conquer; to carry off the victory, come off victorious; of christ, victorious over all his foes; of christians, that hold fast their faith even unto death against the power of their foes, and temptations and persecutions; when one is arraigned or goes to law, to win the case, maintain one's cause

3529.g: conquest (abstractly), i.e., (figuratively) the means of success
3529.gi: conquista (astrattamente), cioè (figurato) i mezzi di successo

3530.g: victorious among his people; nicodemus, an israelite
3530.gl: [conqueror]; a member of the sanhedrin who took the part of jesus
3530.gi: vittorioso tra il suo popolo; Nicodemo, un israelita

3531.g: a nicolate, i.e., adherent of nicolas
3531.gl: [destruction of people]; a sect mentioned in revelation 2:6,15, who were charged with holding the error of balaam, casting a stumbling block before the church of god by upholding the liberty of eating things sacrificed to idols as well as committing fornication
3531.gi: un nicolaïta, cioè seguace di Nicola

3532.g: victorious over the people; nicolas, a heretic
3532.gl: [victor of the people]; was a proselyte of antioch and one of the seven deacons of the church at jerusalem
3532.gi: vittorioso sul popolo; Nicola, un eretico

3533.g: victorious city; nicopolis, a place in macedonia
3533.gl: [city of victory]; a city in macedonia where paul temporarily dwelt (perhaps thracian nicopolis, founded by trojan on the river nestus)
3533.gi: città vittoriosa; Nicopoli, un luogo in Macedonia

3535.g: ninevi (i.e., nineveh), the capital of assyria
3535.gl: [offspring of ease, offspring abiding]; the capital of the ancient kingdom of assyria

3536.g: a ninevite, i.e., inhabitant of nineveh
3536.gl: a ninevite, an inhabitant of nineveh
3536.gi: un ninivita, cioè, abitante di Ninive

3537.gl: a vessel for washing the hands and the feet, a basin

3538.g: to cleanse (especially the hands or the feet or the face); ceremonially, to perform ablution
3538.gl: to wash; to wash one's self
3538.gi: purificare (specialmente le mani o i piedi o il volto); ritualmente, compiere abluzioni

3539.g: to exercise the mind (observe), i.e., (figuratively) to comprehend, heed
3539.gl: to perceive with the mind, to understand, to have understanding; to think upon, heed, ponder, consider
3539.gi: esercitare la mente (osservare), cioè (figurato) comprendere, badare

3540.g: a perception, i.e., purpose, or (by implication) the intellect, disposition, itself
3540.gl: a mental perception, thought; an evil purpose; that which thinks, the mind, thoughts or purposes
3540.gi: una percezione, cioè scopo, o (per implicazione) l'intelletto, disposizione, essa stessa

3541.gl: illegitimate, bastard; one born, not in lawful wedlock, but of a concubine or female slave

3542.g: pasture, i.e., (the act) feeding (figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage
3542.gl: pasturage, fodder, food; figuratively he shall not want the needful supplies for the true life; growth, increase; of evils spreading like a gangrene; of ulcers; of a conflagration
3542.gi: pascolo, cioè (l'atto) nutrire (figurato, diffusione di un'gangrena), o (il cibo) foraggiatura

3543.g: properly, to do by law (usage), i.e., to accustom (passively, be usual); by extension, to deem or regard
3543.gl: to hold by custom or usage, own as a custom or usage, to follow a custom or usage; it is the custom, it is the received usage; to deem, think, suppose

3692.gi: una buca (come per luce), cioè caverna; per analogia, una sorgente (d'acqua)

3693.g: from g3700) with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e., at the back (adverb and preposition of place or time)
3693.gl: from behind, on the back, behind, after
3693.gi: da g3700) con enclitica di origine; dal retro (come aspetto sicuro), cioè, dietro (avverbio e preposizione di luogo o tempo)

3694.g: to the back, i.e., aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun)
3694.gl: back, behind, after, afterwards; of place: things that are behind; of time: after
3694.gi: al retro, cioè, di sorpresa (come avverbio o preposizione di tempo o luogo; o come sostantivo)

3695.g: to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively))
3695.gl: to arm, furnish with arms; to provide; to furnish one's self with a thing (as with arms); metaphorically take on the same mind

3696.g: an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war)
3696.gl: any tool or implement for preparing a thing; arms used in warfare, weapons; an instrument
3696.gi: un attrezzo o utensile o strumento (letteralmente o figurato, specialmente offensivo per la guerra)

3697.g: of what kind that, i.e., how (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent g5108 of quality)
3697.gl: of what sort or quality, what manner of
3697.gi: di che genere che, cioè come (di) grande (eccellente) (specialmente, come correlativo indefinito all'antecedente definito g5108 di qualità)

3698.g: what(-ever) then, i.e., (of time) as soon as
3698.gi: che(-unque) allora, cioè (di tempo) non appena

3699.g: what(-ever) where, i.e., at whichever spot
3699.gi: che(-unque) dove, cioè, in qualsiasi punto

3700.g: to gaze (i.e., with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from g0991, which denotes simply voluntary observation; and from g1492, which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while g2300, and still more emphatically its intensive g2334, signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and g4648 a watching from a distance)
3700.gl: to look at, behold; to allow one's self to be seen, to appear
3700.gi: fissare lo sguardo (cioè con occhi spalancati, come di fronte a qualcosa di notevole; e così differendo da g0991, che denota semplicemente osservazione volontaria; e da g1492, che esprime solo visione meccanica, passiva o occasionale; mentre g2300, e ancora più enfaticamente la sua forma intensiva g2334, indica un'ispezione più seria e continua; e g4648 una sorveglianza da lontano)

3701.gl: the act of exhibiting one's self to view; a sight, a vision, an appearance presented to one whether asleep or awake

3703.g: properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e., (by implication) ripe fruit
3703.gl: the season which succeeds summer, from the rising of sirius to that of arcturus, i.e., from late summer, early autumn, our dog days; ripe fruits (of trees)
3703.gi: propriamente, crepuscolo della stagione (estiva) (giorni del cane), cioè (per implicazione) frutto maturo

3704.g: what(-ever) how, i.e., in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual)
3704.gi: qualunque come, cioè, nel modo che (come avverbio o congiunzione di coincidenza, intenzionale o effettiva)

3705.g: something gazed at, i.e., a spectacle (especially supernatural)
3705.gl: that which is seen, spectacle; a sight divinely granted in an ecstasy or in a sleep, a vision
3705.gi: qualcosa osservato, cioè, uno spettacolo (specialmente soprannaturale)

3706.g: the act of gazing, i.e., (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance
3706.gl: the act of seeing; the sense of sight, the eyes; appearance, visible form; a vision; an appearance divinely granted in an ecstasy or dream
3706.gi: l'atto di guardare, cioè, (esternamente) un aspetto o (internamente) un'apparizione ispirata

3707.g: gazed at, i.e., (by implication) capable of being seen
3707.gi: guardato, cioè (per implicazione) capace di essere visto

3708.g: by extension, to attend to; by hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear
3708.gl: to see with the eyes; to see with the mind, to perceive, know; to see, i.e., become acquainted with by experience, to experience; to see, to look to; to take heed, beware; to care for, pay heed to; i was seen, showed myself, appeared
3708.gi: per estensione, prestare attenzione; per ebraismo, esperire; passivamente, apparire

3709.g: properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e., (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment
3709.gl: anger, the natural disposition, temper, character; movement or agitation of the soul, impulse, desire, any violent emotion, but especially anger; anger, wrath, indignation; anger exhibited in punishment, hence used for punishment itself; of punishments inflicted by magistrates
3709.gi: propriamente, desiderio (come una tendenza o eccitazione della mente), cioè, (per analogia), passione violenta (ira, o (giustificabile) abominio); per implicazione, punizione

3710.g: to provoke or enrage, i.e., (passively) become exasperated
3710.gl: to provoke, to arouse to anger; to be provoked to anger, be angry, be wroth
3710.gi: provocare o infuriare, cioè, (passivamente) diventare esasperato

3712.g: a stretch of the arms, i.e., a fathom
3712.gl: fathom, the distance across the breast from the tip of one middle finger to the tip of the other when the arms are outstretched, 5 to 6 feet (2 m)
3712.gi: uno slancio delle braccia, cioè, un braccio

3713.g: to stretch oneself, i.e., reach out after (long for)
3713.gl: to stretch one's self out in order to touch or to grasp something, to reach after or desire something; to give one's self up to the love of money
3713.gi: distendere sé stesso, cioè, tendere verso (desiderare ardentemente)

3714.g: mountainous, i.e., (feminine by implication, of g5561) the highlands (of judaea)
3714.gl: mountainous, hilly; the mountain district, hill country
3714.gi: montuoso, cioè, (per implicazione femminile, di g5561) le alture (di Giudea)

3715.g: excitement of the mind, i.e., longing after
3715.gl: desire, longing, craving for; eager desire, lust, appetite; used both in a good and a bad sense, as well of natural and lawful and even of proper cravings (of appetite for food), also of corrupt and unlawful desires
3715.gi: eccitazione della mente, cioè desiderio di

3716.g: to be straight-footed, i.e., (figuratively) to go directly forward
3716.gl: to walk in a straight course; metaphorically to act uprightly
3716.gi: avere i piedi diritti, cioè (figurato) andare direttamente avanti

3717.g: right (as rising), i.e., (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct
3717.gl: straight, erect; upright; straight, not crooked
3717.gi: diritto (come che sorge), cioè (perpendicolarmente) eretto (figurato, onesto), o (orizzontalmente) livellato o diretto

3718.gl: to cut straight, to cut straight ways; to proceed on straight paths, hold a straight course, equivalent to doing right; to make straight and smooth, to handle aright, to teach the truth directly and correctly

3719.g: to use the dawn, i.e., (by implication) to repair betimes
3719.gl: to rise early in the morning
3719.gi: usare l'alba, cioè, (per implicazione) recarsi in anticipo
