3720.g: relating to the dawn, i.e., matutinal (as an epithet of venus, especially brilliant in the early day)
3720.gi: relativo all'alba, cioè mattutino (come epiteto di Venere, specialmente brillante nel primo giorno)

3721.g: in the dawn, i.e., up at day-break
3721.gl: early; rising at the first dawn or very early in the morning
3721.gi: nell'alba, cioè al sorgere del sole

3722.g: dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn
3722.gl: daybreak, dawn; at early dawn, at daybreak, early in the morning
3722.gi: alba (come sorgere del sole, levata di luce); per estensione, mattina

3723.g: in a straight manner, i.e., (figuratively) correctly (also morally)
3723.gi: in modo retto, cioè, (figurato) correttamente (anche moralmente)

3724.g: to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e., (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify
3724.gl: to define; to mark out the boundaries or limits (of any place or thing); to determine, appoint; that which has been determined, according to appointment, decree; to ordain, determine, appoint
3724.gi: segnare o delimitare ("orizzonte"), cioè (figurato) nominare, decretare, specificare

3725.g: a boundary-line, i.e., (by implication) a frontier (region)
3725.gl: boundaries; for a region, district, land, territory
3725.gi: una linea di confine, cioè (per implicazione) una frontiera (regione)

3726.g: to put on oath, i.e., make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin
3726.gl: to force to take an oath, to administer an oath to; to adjure (solemnly implore)
3726.gi: porre giuramento, cioè, far giurare; per analogia, ingiungere solennemente

3727.g: a limit, i.e., (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath)
3727.gl: that which has been pledged or promised with an oath
3727.gi: un limite, cioè, (sacro) vincolo (specialmente, un giuramento)

3728.gl: affirmation made on oath, the taking of an oath, an oath

3729.g: to start, spur or urge on, i.e., (reflexively) to dash or plunge
3729.gl: to set in rapid motion, stir up, incite, urge on; to start forward impetuously, to rush
3729.gi: partire, spronare o spingere, cioè, (riflessivamente) balzare o tuffarsi

3730.gl: a violent motion, impulse; a hostile movement, onset, assault

3731.gl: a rush, impulse; that which is impelled or hurried away by impulse

3733.g: a bird (as rising in the air), i.e., (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl)
3733.gl: a bird; a cock, a hen
3733.gi: un uccello (come che si alza nell'aria), cioè (specialmente) una gallina (o volatile domestico femminile)

3734.gl: a setting of boundaries, laying down limits; a definite limit, bounds
3734.gi: un posizionamento di limite, cioè (concretamente) linea di confine

3735.g: a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain)
3735.gi: una montagna (come che si eleva sopra la pianura)

3736.g: to "burrow" in the ground, i.e., dig

3737.gl: bereft (of a father, of parents); of those bereft of a teacher, guide, guardian; orphaned
3737.gi: privato dei genitori ("orfano"), cioè senza genitori

3738.g: to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion)
3738.gi: danzare (dal movimento a ranghi o regolare)

3739.g: the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that
3739.gi: il pronome relativo (a volte dimostrativo), chi, che, cosa, quello

3740.g: how (i.e., with g0302, so) many times as
3740.gl: as often as, as often soever as
3740.gi: quante (cioè con g0302, così) volte come

3741.g: properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from 1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from g2413, which denotes formal consecration; and from g0040, which relates to purity from defilement), i.e., hallowed (pious, sacred, sure)
3741.gl: undefiled by sin, free from wickedness, religiously observing every moral obligation, pure holy, pious
3741.gi: propriamente, diritto (per carattere intrinseco o divino; così distinto da 1342, che si riferisce piuttosto a statuti umani e relazioni; da g2413, che denota consacrazione formale; e da g0040, che si riferisce alla purezza da contaminazione), cioè sacro (pio, sacro, sicuro)

3742.gl: piety towards god, fidelity in observing the obligations of piety, holiness

3745.gl: as great as, as far as, how much, how many, whoever

3748.g: which some, i.e., any that; also (definite) which same
3748.gi: alcuni dei quali, cioè, qualsiasi; anche (definitivo) stesso

3749.g: earthen-ware, i.e., clayey; by implication, frail
3749.gl: earthen, clay; with the added suggestion of frailty
3749.gi: terraglia, cioè argillosa; per implicazione, fragile

3751.g: the loin (externally), i.e., the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power
3751.gl: the hip (loin); to gird, gird about, the loins; a loin, the (two) loins; the place where the hebrews thought the generative power (semen) resided
3751.gi: il lombo (esternamente), cioè, anche l'anca; internamente (per estensione) potenza procreativa

3752.g: whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as
3752.gl: when, whenever, as long as, as soon as
3752.gi: ogni volta che (implying ipotesi o più o meno incertezza); anche causalmente (congiuntivamente) dal momento che

3753.gl: when whenever, while, as long as

3754.gi: dimostrativo, quello (a volte ridondante); causativo, perché

3755.g: during which same time, i.e., whilst
3755.gi: durante lo stesso tempo, cioè, mentre

3756.g: the absolute negative (compare g3361) adverb; no or not
3756.gi: l'avverbio negativo assoluto (cfr. g3361); no o non

3758.gl: ah! ha! an interjection of wonder and amazement

3760.gl: by no means, in no wise

3761.g: not however, i.e., neither, nor, not even
3761.gl: but not, neither, nor, not even

3762.g: not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e., none, nobody, nothing
3762.gi: nemmeno uno (uomo, donna o cosa), cioè, nessuno, nessuno, niente

3763.g: not even at any time, i.e., never at all
3763.gi: nemmeno in qualsiasi momento, cioè, mai per niente

3765.gl: no longer, no more, no further

3766.g: is it not therefore that, i.e., (affirmatively) hence or so
3766.gi: non è quindi che, cioè (affermando) quindi o così

3767.gl: then, therefore, accordingly, consequently, these things being so

3770.g: celestial, i.e., belonging to or coming from the sky
3770.gl: heavenly; dwelling in heaven; coming from heaven
3770.gi: celeste, cioè, appartenente o proveniente dal cielo

3772.g: the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of god); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the gospel (christianity)
3772.gl: the vaulted expanse of the sky with all things visible in it; the universe, the world; the aerial heavens or sky, the region where the clouds and the tempests gather, and where thunder and lightning are produced; the sidereal or starry heavens; the region above the sidereal heavens, the seat of order of things eternal and consummately perfect where god dwells and other heavenly beings
3772.gi: il cielo; per estensione, cielo (dimora di Dio); per implicazione, felicità, potere, eternità; specialmente, il vangelo (cristianesimo)

3773.gl: [of the city; polite]; a certain christian in romans 16:9

3774.gl: [light of jehovah]; the husband of bathsheba, one of david's mighty men

3775.gl: the ear; metaphorically the faculty of perceiving with the mind, the faculty of understanding and knowing

3776.gl: what one has, i.e., property, possessions, estate

3777.g: not too, i.e., neither or nor; by analogy, not even
3777.gi: non troppo, cioè, né o né; per analogia, nemmeno

3778.g: the he (she or it), i.e., this or that (often with article repeated)
3778.gi: lui (lei o esso), cioè, questo o quello (spesso con articolo ripetuto)

3779.g: in this way (referring to what precedes or follows)
3779.gi: in questo modo (riferendosi a ciò che precede o segue)

3780.gl: not, by no means, not at all

3781.g: an ower, i.e., person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against god)
3781.gl: one who owes another, a debtor; one held by some obligation, bound by some duty; one who has not yet made amends to whom he has injured:; one who owes god penalty or whom god can demand punishment as something due, i.e., a sinner
3781.gi: un debitore, cioè persona indebitata; figurato, un inadempiente; moralmente, un trasgressore (contro Dio)

3782.g: indebtedness, i.e., (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e., (conjugal) duty
3782.gl: that which is owed; a debt; metaphorically dues: specifically of conjugal duty
3782.gi: debito, cioè, (concretamente) una somma dovuta; figurato, obbligo, cioè, (coniugale) dovere

3783.g: something owed, i.e., (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault
3783.gl: that which is owed; that which is justly or legally due, a debt; metaphorically offence, sin
3783.gi: qualcosa dovuto, cioè, (figurato) un dovuto; moralmente, un difetto

3784.g: to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty
3784.gl: to owe; to owe money, be in debt for; that which is due, the debt; metaphorically the goodwill due
3784.gi: dovere (economicamente); figurato, essere obbligato (dovrebbe, deve, dovrebbe); moralmente, mancare al dovere

3785.gl: would that, where one wishes that a thing had happened which has not happened or a thing be done which probably will not be done

3787.gl: service performed [only] under the master's eyes; for the master's eye usually stimulates to greater diligence; his absence, on the other hand, renders sluggish
3787.gi: lavoro-vista, cioè ciò che ha bisogno di sorveglianza (negligenza)

3788.g: the eye (literally or figuratively); by implication, vision; figuratively, envy (from the jealous side-glance)
3788.gl: the eye; metaphorically the eyes of the mind, the faculty of knowing
3788.gi: l'occhio (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, visione; figurato, invidia (dal sguardo laterale geloso)

3789.g: a snake, figuratively, (as a type of sly cunning) an artful malicious person, especially satan
3789.gl: snake, serpent; with the ancients, the serpent was an emblem of cunning and wisdom; satan, the devil
3789.gi: un serpente, figurato, (come tipo di astuzia subdola) una persona maliziosa e astuta, specialmente satana

3790.g: the eye-"brow" or forehead, i.e., (figuratively) the brink of a precipice
3790.gl: the eyebrow; any prominence or projection
3790.gi: la "sopracciglia" o fronte, cioè, (figurato) il bordo di un precipizio

3791.g: to mob, i.e., (by implication) to harass
3791.gl: to excite a mob against one; to disturb, roll away; to trouble, molest; be in confusion, in an uproar; to be vexed, molested, troubled: by demons
3791.gi: assaltare in massa, cioè (per implicazione) molestare

3792.g: to make a crowd, i.e., raise a public disturbance
3792.gl: to collect a crowd, gather the people together
3792.gi: fare una folla, cioè, sollevare un disturbo pubblico

3793.g: a throng (as borne along); by implication, the rabble; by extension, a class of people; figuratively, a riot
3793.gl: a crowd; a casual collection of people; a multitude of men who have flocked together in some place; a throng; a multitude; the common people, as opposed to the rulers and leading men; with contempt: the ignorant multitude, the populace; a multitude; the multitudes, seems to denote troops of people gathered together without order
3793.gi: una folla (come portata via); per implicazione, la plebaglia; per estensione, una classe di persone; figurato, una rivolta

3794.gl: a castle, stronghold, fortress, fastness; anything on which one relies; of the arguments and reasonings by which a disputant endeavors to fortify his opinion and defend it against his opponent

3795.g: a relish to other food (as if cooked sauce), i.e., (specially), fish (presumably salted and dried as a condiment)
3795.gi: un condimento per altri cibi (come se fosse salsa), cioè (specialmente), pesce (presunto salato e essiccato come condimento)

3796.g: (adverbially) late in the day; by extension, after the close of the day
3796.gl: after a long time, long after, late; late in the day, i.e., at evening; the sabbath having just passed, after the sabbath; at the early dawn of the first day of the week
3796.gi: (avverbiamente) tardo nel giorno; per estensione, dopo la chiusura del giorno

3797.gl: late, later; of the time of subsidence of the waters of the nile; the latter or vernal rain, which falls chiefly in the months of march and april just before the harvest

3798.g: late; feminine (as noun) afternoon (early eve) or nightfall (later eve)
3798.gl: late; evening; either from three to six o'clock pm; from six o'clock pm to the beginning of night
3798.gi: tardo; femminile (come sostantivo) pomeriggio (sera iniziale) o tramonto (sera tarda)

3799.g: properly, sight (the act), i.e., (by implication) the visage, an external show
3799.gl: seeing, sight; face, countenance; the outward appearance, look
3799.gi: propriamente, vista (l'atto), cioè (per implicazione) il viso, una manifestazione esterna

3800.g: rations for a soldier, i.e., (by extension) his stipend or pay
3800.gl: a soldier's pay, allowance; that part of the soldier's support given in place of pay [i.e., rations] and the money in which he is paid; metaphorically wages: hire or pay of sin
3800.gi: razioni per un soldato, cioè (per estensione) la sua paga o stipendio

3801.g: the one being and the one that was and the one coming, i.e., the eternal, as a divine epithet of christ
3801.gl: he who is, and was, and is coming
3801.gi: colui che è e colui che era e colui che viene, cioè l'eterno, come epiteto divino di Cristo

3802.gl: to ensnare, entrap; of birds; metaphorically of the attempt to elicit from one some remark which can be turned into an accusation against him

3803.g: a trap (as fastened by a noose or notch); figuratively, a trick or statagem (temptation)
3803.gl: snare, trap, noose; of snares in which birds are entangled and caught; implies unexpectedly, suddenly, because birds and beasts are caught unawares; a snare, i.e., whatever brings peril, loss, destruction; of a sudden and unexpected deadly peril; of the allurements and seductions of sin; the allurements to sin by which the devil holds one bound; the snares of love
3803.gi: una trappola (come fissata da un nodo o tacca); figurato, un trucco o stratagemma (tentazione)

3804.g: something undergone, i.e., hardship or pain; subjectively, an emotion or influence
3804.gl: that which one suffers or has suffered; externally, a suffering, misfortune, calamity, evil, affliction; of the sufferings of christ; also the afflictions which christians must undergo in behalf of the same cause which christ patiently endured; of an inward state, an affliction, passion; an enduring, undergoing, suffering
3804.gi: qualcosa di subìto, cioè difficoltà o dolore; soggettivamente, un'emozione o influenza

3805.gl: passible, endued with the capacity of suffering, capable of feeling; subject to the necessity of suffering, destined to suffer

3806.g: properly, suffering ("pathos"), i.e., (subjectively) a passion (especially concupiscence)
3806.gl: whatever befalls one, whether it be sad or joyous; specifically a calamity, mishap, evil, affliction; a feeling which the mind suffers; an affliction of the mind, emotion, passion; passionate deed; used by the greeks in either a good or bad sense; in the new testament in a bad sense, depraved passion, vile passions
3806.gi: propriamente, sofferenza (pathos), cioè (soggettivamente) una passione (specialmente concupiscenza)

3807.g: a boy-leader, i.e., a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication, (figuratively) a tutor ("paedagogue"))
3807.gl: a tutor i.e., a guardian and guide of boys
3807.gi: un condottiero di ragazzi, cioè, un servo il cui ufficio era portare i bambini a scuola; (per implicazione, (figurato) un tutore ("paedagogo"))

3809.g: tutorage, i.e., education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction
3809.gl: the whole training and education of children (which relates to the cultivation of mind and morals, and employs for this purpose now commands and admonitions, now reproof and punishment), the training and care of the body; whatever in adults also cultivates the soul (especially by correcting mistakes and curbing passions); instruction which aims at increasing virtue; chastisement, chastening, (of the evils with which god visits men for their amendment)
3809.gi: tutela, cioè, educazione o istruzione; per implicazione, correzione disciplinare

3810.g: a trainer, i.e., teacher or (by implication) discipliner
3810.gl: an instructor, preceptor, teacher; a chastiser
3810.gi: un allenatore, cioè, insegnante o (per implicazione) un disciplinatore

3811.g: to train up a child, i.e., educate, or (by implication), discipline (by punishment)
3811.gl: to train children; to be instructed or taught or learn; to cause one to learn; to chastise; to chastise or castigate with words, to correct; of those who are moulding the character of others by reproof and admonition; of god; to chasten by the affliction of evils and calamities; to chastise with blows, to scourge; of a father punishing his son; of a judge ordering one to be scourged
3811.gi: educare un bambino, cioè, istruire, o (per implicazione), disciplinare (con punizione)

3813.g: a childling (of either sex), i.e., (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature christian
3813.gl: a young child, a little boy, a little girl; infants; children, little ones; an infant; of a (male) child just recently born; of a more advanced child; of a mature child;; metaphorically children (like children) in intellect
3813.gi: un fanciullo (di qualsiasi sesso), cioè (propriamente) un neonato, o (per estensione) un ragazzo o ragazza a metà crescita; figurato, un cristiano immaturo

3814.g: a girl, i.e., (specially), a female slave or servant
3814.gl: a young girl, damsel; a maid-servant, a young female slave; a maid servant who has charge of the door
3814.gi: una ragazza, cioè (specialmente), una schiava o serva femminile

3815.gl: to play like a child; to play, sport, jest; to give way to hilarity, especially by joking singing, dancing

3816.g: a boy (as often beaten with impunity), or (by analogy), a girl, and (genitive case) a child; specially, a slave or servant (especially a minister to a king; and by eminence to god)
3816.gl: a child, boy or girl; infants, children; servant, slave; an attendant, servant, specifically a king's attendant, minister
3816.gi: un ragazzo (spesso battuto con impunità), o (per analogia), una ragazza, e (caso genitivo) un bambino; specialmente, uno schiavo o servitore (specialmente un ministro di un re; e per eminenza a Dio)

3817.g: to hit (as if by a single blow and less violently than g5180); specially, to sting (as a scorpion)
3817.gl: to strike, smite; to sting (to strike or wound with a sting)
3817.gi: colpire (come se con un solo colpo e meno violentamente di g5180); specialmente, pungere (come uno scorpione)

3818.gl: [dry, barren]; in the 4th century after christ, phrygia was divided into phrygia salutaris and phrygia pacatiana; laodicea was a city in the latter

3819.g: (adverbially) formerly, or (by relatively) sometime since; (elliptically as adjective) ancient
3819.gi: (avverbiamente) un tempo, o (relativamente) da qualche tempo; (ellitticamente come aggettivo) antico

3820.g: antique, i.e., not recent, worn out
3820.gl: old, ancient; no longer new, worn by use, the worse for wear, old

3821.gl: oldness: the old state of life controlled by 'the letter'

3822.g: to make (passively, become) worn out, or declare obsolete
3822.gl: to make ancient or old; to become old, to be worn out; of things worn out by time and use; to declare a thing to be old and so about to be abrogated
3822.gi: rendere (passivamente, diventare) logoro, o dichiarare obsoleto

3823.gl: wrestling (a contest between two in which each endeavors to throw the other, and which is decided when the victor is able to hold his opponent down with his hand upon his neck); the term is transferred to the christian's struggle with the power of evil

3824.g: (spiritual) rebirth (the state or the act), i.e., (figuratively) spiritual renovation; specially, messianic restoration
3824.gl: new birth, reproduction, renewal, recreation, regeneration; hence renovation, regeneration, the production of a new life consecrated to god, a radical change of mind for the better; the renovation of the earth after the deluge; the renewal of the world to take place after its destruction by fire, as the stoics taught; the signal and glorious change of all things (in heaven and earth) for the better, that restoration of the primal and perfect condition of things which existed before the fall of our first parents; other uses; of cicero's restoration to rank and fortune on his recall from exile; of the restoration of the jewish nation after exile; of the recovery of knowledge by recollection
3824.gi: (spirituale) rinascita (lo stato o l'atto), cioè (figurato) rinnovamento spirituale; specialmente, restaurazione messianica

3825.g: (adverbially) anew, i.e., (of place) back, (of time) once more, or (conjunctionally) furthermore or on the other hand
3825.gl: anew, again; renewal or repetition of the action; again, anew; again, i.e., further, moreover; in turn, on the other hand
3825.gi: (avverbiamente) di nuovo, cioè (di luogo) indietro, (di tempo) ancora una volta, o (congiuntivamente) inoltre o dall'altro lato

3826.g: in full multitude, i.e., concertedly or simultaneously
3826.gl: with the whole multitude; all together, one and all
3826.gi: in piena moltitudine, cioè, concordemente o simultaneamente

3828.g: every-tribal, i.e., heterogeneous (g5561 being implied); pamphylia, a region of asia minor
3828.gl: [of every tribe]; a province in asia minor, bounded on the east by cilicia, on the west by lycia and phrygia minor, on the north by galatia and cappadocia, and on the south by the mediterranean sea
3828.gi: tribale-ogni, cioè eterogeneo (g5561 implicato); Pamfilia, una regione dell'Asia minore

3829.g: all-receptive, i.e., a public lodging-place (caravanserai or khan)
3829.gl: an inn, a public house for the reception of strangers
3829.gi: tutto-ricettivo, cioè, un alloggio pubblico (caravanserraglio o khan)

3831.gl: a festal gathering of the whole people to celebrate public games or other solemnities; a public festal assembly
3831.gi: un raduno di massa, cioè (figurato) compagnia universale

3832.gl: with all (his) house, with (his) whole family

3833.gl: full armour, complete armour; includes shield, sword, lance, helmet, greaves, and breastplate

3834.g: adroitness, i.e., (in a bad sense) trickery or sophistry
3834.gl: craftiness, cunning; a specious or false wisdom; in a good sense, prudence, skill, in undertaking and carrying on affairs
3834.gi: abilità, cioè (in senso negativo) astuzia o sofistica

3835.gl: skilful, clever; in a good sense, fit to undertake and accomplish anything, dexterous, wise, sagacious, skilful; in a bad sense, crafty, cunning, knavish, treacherous, deceitful

3836.gl: from all sides, from every quarter

3838.g: full-ended, i.e., entire (neuter as noun, completion)
3838.gl: all complete, perfect; completely, perfectly, utterly

3839.gl: everywhere, wholly, in all respects, in every way

3840.gl: from all sides, from every quarter

3841.g: the all-ruling, i.e., god (as absolute and universal sovereign)
3841.gl: he who holds sway over all things; the ruler of all; almighty: god
3841.gi: l'onnireggente, cioè Dio (come sovrano assoluto e universale)

3842.g: every when, i.e., at all times

3843.g: entirely; specially, at all events, (with negative, following) in no event
3843.gl: altogether; in any and every way, by all means; doubtless, surely, certainly; in no wise, not at all
3843.gi: interamente; specialmente, in ogni caso, (con negativo, seguente) in nessun caso

3844.g: properly, near; i.e., (with genitive case) from beside (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) at (or in) the vicinity of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the proximity with (local (especially beyond or opposed to) or causal (on account of)
3844.gl: from, of at, by, besides, near
3844.gi: propriamente, vicino; cioè (con genitivo) da presso (letteralmente o figurato), (con dativo) presso (o in) prossimità di (oggettivamente o soggettivamente), (con accusativo) alla vicinanza con (locale (specialmente oltre o opposto a) o causale (a causa di))

3845.g: to go contrary to, i.e., violate a command
3845.gl: to go by the side of; to go past or pass over without touching a thing; to overstep, neglect, violate, transgress; so to go past as to turn aside from; to depart, leave, be turned from; one who abandons his trust
3845.gi: andare contro, cioè violare un comando

3846.g: to throw alongside, i.e., (reflexively) to reach a place, or (figuratively) to liken
3846.gl: to throw before, cast to (as fodder for horses); to put one thing by the side of another for the sake of comparison, to compare, liken; to put one's self, betake one's self into a place or to a person
3846.gi: gettare accanto, cioè (riflessivo) raggiungere un luogo, o (figurato) paragonare

3847.gl: a going over; metaphorically a disregarding, violating; of the mosaic law; the breach of a definite, promulgated, ratified law; to create transgressions, i.e., that sins might take on the character of transgressions, and thereby the consciousness of sin be intensified and the desire for redemption be aroused

3849.g: to force contrary to (nature), i.e., compel (by entreaty)
3849.gl: to employ force contrary to nature and right; to compel by employing force; to constrain one by entreaties
3849.gi: forzare contro (la natura), cioè costringere (con suppliche)

3850.g: a similitude ("parable"), i.e., (symbolic) fictitious narrative (of common life conveying a moral), apothegm or adage
3850.gl: a placing of one thing by the side of another, juxtaposition, as of ships in battle; metaphorically; a comparing, comparison of one thing with another, likeness, similitude; an example by which a doctrine or precept is illustrated; a narrative, fictitious but agreeable to the laws and usages of human life, by which either the duties of men or the things of god, particularly the nature and history of god's kingdom are figuratively portrayed; a parable: an earthly story with a heavenly meaning; a pithy and instructive saying, involving some likeness or comparison and having preceptive or admonitory force; an aphorism, a maxim; a proverb; an act by which one exposes himself or his possessions to danger, a venture, a risk
3850.gi: una similitudine ("parabola"), cioè narrazione fittizia (simbolica) (di vita comune che trasmette una morale), apoftegma o adagio

3852.gl: announcement, a proclaiming or giving a message to; a charge, a command

3853.g: to transmit a message, i.e., (by implication) to enjoin
3853.gl: to transmit a message along from one to another, to declare, announce; to command, order, charge
3853.gi: trasmettere un messaggio, cioè (per implicazione) ingiungere

3854.g: to become near, i.e., approach (have arrived); by implication, to appear publicly
3854.gl: to be present, to come near, approach; to come forth, make one's public appearance
3854.gi: avvicinarsi, cioè avvicinarsi (essere arrivato); per implicazione, apparire pubblicamente

3855.g: to lead near, i.e., (reflexively or intransitively) to go along or away
3855.gl: pass by; to lead past, lead by; to lead aside, mislead; to lead away; to lead to; to lead forth, bring forward; to pass by, go past; to depart, go away; metaphorically disappear
3855.gi: condurre vicino, cioè (riflessivo o intransitivo) andare lungo o via

3856.g: to show alongside (the public), i.e., expose to infamy
3856.gl: to set forth as a public example, make an example of; in a bad sense; to hold up to infamy; to expose to public disgrace
3856.gi: mostrare accanto (al pubblico), cioè esporre all'infamia

3857.g: a park, i.e., (specially), an eden (place of future happiness, "paradise")
3857.gl: among the persians a grand enclosure or preserve, hunting ground, park, shady and well watered, in which wild animals, were kept for the hunt; it was enclosed by walls and furnished with towers for the hunters; a garden, pleasure ground; grove, park; the part of hades which was thought by the later jews to be the abode of the souls of pious until the resurrection: but some understand this to be a heavenly paradise; the upper regions of the heavens
3857.gi: un parco, cioè (specialmente) un eden (luogo di felicità futura, "paradiso")

3858.g: to accept near, i.e., admit or (by implication) delight in
3858.gl: to receive, take up, take upon one's self; to admit i.e., not to reject, to accept, receive; of a son: to acknowledge as one's own
3858.gi: accettare vicino, cioè ammettere o (per implicazione) dilettarsi di

3860.g: to surrender, i.e yield up, entrust, transmit
3860.gl: to give into the hands (of another); to give over into (one's) power or use; to deliver to one something to keep, use, take care of, manage; to deliver up one to custody, to be judged, condemned, punished, scourged, tormented, put to death; to deliver up treacherously; by betrayal to cause one to be taken; to deliver one to be taught, moulded; to commit, to commend; to deliver verbally; commands, rites; to deliver by narrating, to report; to permit allow; when the fruit will allow that is when its ripeness permits; gives itself up, presents itself

3862.g: transmission, i.e., (concretely) a precept; specially, the jewish traditionary law
3862.gl: giving up, giving over; the act of giving up; the surrender of cities; a giving over which is done by word of mouth or in writing, i.e., tradition by instruction, narrative, precept, etc.; objectively, that which is delivered, the substance of a teaching; of the body of precepts, especially ritual, which in the opinion of the later jews were orally delivered by moses and orally transmitted in unbroken succession to subsequent generations, which precepts, both illustrating and expanding the written law, as they did were to be obeyed with equal reverence
3862.gi: trasmissione, cioè (concretamente) un precetto; specialmente, la legge tradizionale ebraica

3863.g: to stimulate alongside, i.e., excite to rivalry
3863.gl: to provoke to; to provoke to jealously or rivalry; to provoke to anger
3863.gi: stimolare accanto, cioè eccitare alla rivalità

3864.gl: besides the sea, by the sea

3865.gl: to examine things placed beside each other, to compare; to overlook, neglect

3866.gl: a deposit, a trust or thing consigned to one's faithful keeping; used of the correct knowledge and pure doctrine of the gospel, to be held firmly and faithfully, and to be conscientiously delivered unto others

3867.g: to mispraise, i.e., recommend or advise (a different course)
3867.gi: lodare male, cioè raccomandare o consigliare (un corso diverso)

3868.g: to beg off, i.e., deprecate, decline, shun
3868.gl: to ask along side, beg to have near one; to obtain by entreaty; to beg from, to ask for, supplicate; to avert by entreaty or seek to avert, to deprecate; to not entreat; to refuse, decline; to shun, avoid; to avert displeasure by entreaty; to beg pardon, crave indulgence, to excuse; of one excusing himself for not accepting a wedding invitation to a feast
3868.gi: implorare di essere esentato, cioè deprecare, declinare, evitare

3869.gl: to make to sit down besides; to set beside, place near; sit down beside

3870.g: to call near, i.e., invite, invoke (by imploration, hortation or consolation)
3870.gl: to call to one's side, call for, summon; to address, speak to, (call to, call upon), which may be done in the way of exhortation, entreaty, comfort, instruction, etc.; to admonish, exhort; to beg, entreat, beseech; to strive to appease by entreaty; to console, to encourage and strengthen by consolation, to comfort; to receive consolation, be comforted; to encourage, strengthen; exhorting and comforting and encouraging; to instruct, teach
3870.gi: chiamare vicino, cioè invitare, invocare (con implorazione, esortazione o consolazione)

3871.gl: to cover over, cover up, hide, conceal

3872.g: something put down alongside, i.e., a deposit (sacred trust)
3872.gl: a deposit, a trust or thing consigned to one's faithful keeping; used of the correct knowledge and pure doctrine of the gospel, to be held firmly and faithfully, and to be conscientiously delivered unto others
3872.gi: qualcosa messo giù accanto, cioè un deposito (sacra fiducia)

3873.g: to lie near, i.e., be at hand (figuratively, be prompt or easy)
3873.gl: to lie beside, to be near; to be present, at hand
3873.gi: giacere vicino, cioè essere a portata di mano (figurato, essere pronto o facile)

3874.gl: a calling near, summons, (especially for help); importation, supplication, entreaty; exhortation, admonition, encouragement; consolation, comfort, solace; that which affords comfort or refreshment; thus of the messianic salvation (so the rabbis call the messiah the consoler, the comforter); persuasive discourse, stirring address; instructive, admonitory, conciliatory, powerful hortatory discourse

3875.gl: summoned, called to one's side, especially called to one's aid; one who pleads another's cause before a judge, a pleader, counsel for defense, legal assistant, an advocate; one who pleads another's cause with one, an intercessor; of christ in his exaltation at god's right hand, pleading with god the father for the pardon of our sins; in the widest sense, a helper, succourer, aider, assistant; of the holy spirit destined to take the place of christ with the apostles (after his ascension to the father), to lead them to a deeper knowledge of the gospel truth, and give them divine strength needed to enable them to undergo trials and persecutions on behalf of the divine kingdom

3877.g: to follow near, i.e., (figuratively) attend (as a result), trace out, conform to
3877.gl: to follow after; so to follow one as to be always at his side; to follow close, accompany; metaphorically; to be always present, to attend one wherever he goes; to follow up a thing in mind so as to attain to the knowledge of it; to understand, (compare the english phrases "to follow a matter up," "to trace its course"); to examine thoroughly, investigate; to follow faithfully i.e., a standard or rule, to conform one's self to
3877.gi: seguire vicino, cioè (figurato) assistere (come risultato), tracciare, conformarsi a

3878.g: to mishear, i.e., (by implication) to disobey
3878.gl: to hear aside; causally or carelessly or amiss; to be unwilling to hear; on hearing to neglect, to pay no heed to; to refuse to hear, pay no regard to, disobey

3879.g: to bend beside, i.e., lean over (so as to peer within)
3879.gl: to stoop to a thing in order to look at it; to look at with head bowed forward; to look into with the body bent; to stoop and look into; metaphorically to look carefully into, inspect curiously; of one who would become acquainted with something
3879.gi: piegarsi accanto, cioè, inclinarsi (per guardare dentro)

3880.g: to receive near, i.e., associate with oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy, to assume an office; figuratively, to learn
3880.gl: to take to, to take with one's self, to join to one's self; an associate, a companion; metaphorically; to accept or acknowledge one to be such as he professes to be; not to reject, not to withhold obedience; to receive something transmitted; an office to be discharged; to receive with the mind; by oral transmission: of the authors from whom the tradition proceeds; by the narrating to others, by instruction of teachers (used of disciples)
3880.gi: ricevere vicino, cioè associare a sé (in qualsiasi atto o relazione familiare o intima); per analogia, assumere un ufficio; figurato, imparare

3881.g: (specially), to lay one's course near, i.e., sail past
3881.gl: to sail past, coast along; work past, weather
3881.gi: (specialmente), mettere il proprio corso vicino, cioè, navigare oltre

3882.gl: by the sea, maritime, the sea coast

3883.g: transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e., (figuratively) fickleness
3883.gi: trasmutazione (di fase o orbita), cioè (figurato) incoerenza

3884.gl: to reckon wrong, miscount; to cheat by false reckoning; to deceive by false reasoning; to deceive, delude, circumvent

3885.gl: paralytic; suffering from the relaxing of the nerves of one's side; disabled, weak of limb

3886.g: to loosen beside, i.e., relax (perfect passive participle, paralyzed or enfeebled)
3886.gl: to loose on one side or from the side; to loose or part things placed side by side; to loosen, dissolve; to weaken, enfeeble; suffering from the relaxing of the nerves, unstrung, weak of limb; tottering, weakened, feeble knees
3886.gi: allentare accanto, cioè, rilassarsi (participio perfetto passivo, paralizzato o indebolito)

3887.g: to stay near, i.e., remain (literally, tarry; or figuratively, be permanent, persevere)
3887.gl: to remain beside, continue always near; to survive, remain alive
3887.gi: restare vicino, cioè, rimanere (letteralmente, fermarsi; o figurativamente, essere permanente, perseverare)

3888.g: to relate near, i.e., (by implication) encourage, console
3888.gl: to speak to, address one, whether by way of admonition and incentive, or to calm and console; to encourage, console
3888.gi: relazionare vicino, cioè (per implicazione) incoraggiare, consolare

3889.gl: any address, whether made for the purpose of persuading, or of arousing and stimulating, or of calming and consoling; consolation, comfort

3891.g: to be opposed to law, i.e., to transgress
3891.gl: to act contrary to the law, to break the law
3891.gi: essere contrario alla legge, cioè trasgredire

3893.g: to embitter alongside, i.e., (figuratively) to exasperate
3893.gl: to provoke, exasperate; to rouse to indignation

3895.g: to fall aside, i.e., (figuratively) to apostatize
3895.gl: to fall beside a person or thing; to slip aside; to deviate from the right path, turn aside, wander; to error; to fall away (from the true faith): from worship of jehovah

3898.g: in a manner near by, i.e., (figuratively) similarly
3898.gl: similarly, in like manner, in the same way
3898.gi: in un modo vicino, cioè (figurato) similmente

3899.gl: to proceed at the side, go past, pass by

3900.g: a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e., (unintentional) error or (wilful) transgression
3900.gl: to fall beside or near something; a lapse or deviation from truth and uprightness; a sin, misdeed
3900.gi: una deviazione (scivolata o deviazione), cioè, errore (non intenzionale) o trasgressione (volontaria)

3901.g: to flow by, i.e., (figuratively) carelessly pass (miss)
3901.gl: to glide by: lest we be carried by, pass by; lest the salvation which these things heard show us how to obtain, slip away from us; a thing escapes me; slips my mind
3901.gi: scorrere accanto, cioè (figurato) passare senza curarsi (perdere)

3902.g: side-marked, i.e., labelled (with a badge (figure-head) of a ship)
3902.gl: marked falsely, spurious, counterfeit: as a coin; marked beside or in the margin; so noteworthy words, which the reader of a book marks on the margin; noted, marked, conspicuous, remarkable; of persons in a bad sense, notorious; marked with a sign: a ship marked with the image or figure of dioscuri (castor and pollux)
3902.gi: contrassegnato lateralmente, cioè etichettato (con un emblema (testa di figura) di una nave)

3903.g: to furnish aside, i.e., get ready
3903.gl: to make one's self ready, to prepare one's self; have prepared one's self, to be prepared or ready

3904.gl: a making ready, preparation, equipping; that which is prepared, equipment; in the new testament in a jewish sense, the day of preparation; the day on which the jews made necessary preparation to celebrate a sabbath or a feast

3905.g: to extend along, i.e., prolong (in point of time)
3905.gl: to extend beside, to stretch out lengthwise, to extend; to prolong

3906.g: to inspect alongside, i.e., note insidiously or scrupulously
3906.gl: to stand beside and watch, to watch assiduously, observe carefully; of auguries, to see what he is going to do; to observe, keep scrupulously; to neglect nothing requisite to the religious observance of; to watch one's self
3906.gi: ispezionare accanto, cioè notare insidiosamente o scrupolosamente

3908.g: to place alongside, i.e., present (food, truth); by implication, to deposit (as a trust or for protection)
3908.gl: to place beside or near or set before; food, i.e., food placed on a table; to set before (one) in teaching; to set forth (from one's self), to explain; to place down (from one's self or for one's self) with any one; to deposit; to entrust, commit to one's charge
3908.gi: mettere accanto, cioè, presentare (cibo, verità); per implicazione, depositare (come un affidamento o per protezione)

3909.g: to chance near, i.e., fall in with
3909.gl: to chance to be by, to happen to be present, to meet by chance

3910.g: at the very instant, i.e., momentary

3911.g: to bear along or aside, i.e., carry off (literally or figuratively); by implication, to avert
3911.gl: to bear to, bring to, put before; to lead aside from the right course or path, to carry away; to carry past, lead past; to cause to pass by, to remove
3911.gi: portare lungo o di lato, cioè portare via (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, allontanare

3912.gl: to be beside one's self, out of one's senses, void of understanding, insane

3914.g: to winter near, i.e., stay with over the rainy season
3914.gl: to winter, pass the winter, with one or at a place
3914.gi: svernare vicino, cioè restare durante la stagione delle piogge

3916.g: at the thing itself, i.e., instantly

3917.gl: a pard, panther, leopard; a very fierce asiatic and african animal, having a tawny skin marked with large black spots

3918.g: to be near, i.e., at hand; neuter present participle (singular) time being, or (plural) property
3918.gl: to be by, be at hand, to have arrived, to be present; to be ready, in store, at command
3918.gi: essere vicino, cioè a portata di mano; participio presente neutro (singolare) tempo presente, o (plurale) proprietà

3919.g: to lead in aside, i.e., introduce surreptitiously
3919.gl: to introduce or bring in secretly or craftily
3919.gi: condurre di lato, cioè introdurre furtivamente

3920.gl: secretly or surreptitiously brought in; one who has stolen in

3921.g: to settle in alongside, i.e., lodge stealthily
3921.gl: to enter secretly, slip in stealthily; to steal in

3922.g: to come in alongside, i.e., supervene additionally or steathily
3922.gl: to come in secretly or by stealth, or creep or steal in; to enter in addition, come in besides
3922.gi: entrare accanto, cioè sopraggiungere aggiuntivamente o furtivamente

3923.g: to bear in alongside, i.e., introduce simultaneously
3923.gl: to bring in besides; to contribute besides to something

3924.gl: except, with the exception of (a thing); besides

3925.g: a throwing in beside (juxtaposition), i.e., (specially), battle-array, encampment or barracks (tower antonia)
3925.gl: an encampment; the camp of israel in the desert; used for the city of jerusalem, inasmuch as that was to the israelites what formerly the encampment had been in the desert; of the sacred congregation or assembly of israel, as it had been gathered formerly in camps in the wilderness; the barracks of the roman soldiers, which at jerusalem were in the castle of antonia; an army in a line of battle
3925.gi: un getto accanto (giustapposizione), cioè (specialmente) schieramento di battaglia, accampamento o caserma (torre Antonia)

3926.gl: to cause trouble in a matter, to trouble, annoy

3927.g: an alien alongside, i.e., a resident foreigner
3927.gl: one who comes from a foreign country into a city or land to reside there by the side of the natives; a stranger; sojourning in a strange place, a foreigner; in the new testament metaphorically in reference to heaven as the native country, one who sojourns on earth
3927.gi: un estraneo accanto, cioè un residente straniero

3928.g: to come near or aside, i.e., to approach (arrive), go by (or away), (figuratively) perish or neglect, (causative) avert
3928.gl: to go past, pass by; of persons moving forward; to pass by; of time; an act continuing for a time; metaphorically; to pass away, perish; to pass by (pass over), that is, to neglect, omit, (transgress); to be led by, to be carried past, be averted; to come near, come forward, arrive
3928.gi: avvicinarsi o di lato, cioè avvicinarsi (arrivare), passare (o andarsene), (figurato) perire o trascurare, (causativo) prevenire

3929.gl: passing over, letting pass, neglecting, disregarding

3930.g: to hold near, i.e., present, afford, exhibit, furnish occasion
3930.gl: to reach forth, offer; to show, afford, supply; to be the authors of, or to cause one to have; to give, bring, cause one something either favorable or unfavorable, to occasion; to offer, show or present one's self; to exhibit or offer on one's own part; to render or afford from one's own resources or by one's own power
3930.gi: tenere vicino, cioè presentare, permettere, mostrare, fornire occasione

3931.gl: addressing, address; exhortation; comfort, solace, relief, alleviation, consolation

3933.g: a maiden; by implication, an unmarried daughter
3933.gl: a virgin; a marriageable maiden; a woman who has never had sexual intercourse with a man; one's marriageable daughter; a man who has abstained from all uncleanness and whoredom attendant on idolatry, and so has kept his chastity; one who has never had intercourse with women
3933.gi: una giovane; per implicazione, una figlia non sposata

3934.g: a parthian, i.e., inhabitant of parthia
3934.gl: [a pledge]; an inhabitant of parthia, a district of asia, bounded on the north by hyrcania, on the east by ariana, on the south by carmania deserta, on the west by media
3934.gi: un parto, cioè abitante della Partia

3935.gl: to let pass; to pass by, neglect; to disregard, omit; to relax, loose, let go; relaxed, unstrung, weakened, exhausted

3936.g: to stand beside, i.e., (transitively) to exhibit, proffer, (specially), recommend, (figuratively) substantiate; or (intransitively) to be at hand (or ready), aid
3936.gl: to place beside or near; to set at hand; to present; to proffer; to provide; to place a person or thing at one's disposal; to present a person for another to see and question; to present or show; to bring to, bring near; metaphorically i.e., to bring into one's fellowship or intimacy; to present (show) by argument, to prove; to stand beside, stand by or near, to be at hand, be present; to stand by; to stand beside one, a bystander; to appear; to be at hand, stand ready; to stand by to help, to succour; to be present; to have come; of time
3936.gi: stare accanto, cioè (transitivamente) esibire, offrire, (specialmente) raccomandare, (figurato) corroborare; o (intransitivamente) essere presente (o pronto), aiutare

3937.gl: [abiding]; one of the seven deacons of the church at jerusalem

3938.gl: a passing by or passage; in passing
3938.gi: una strada secondaria, cioè (attivamente) un percorso

3939.g: to dwell near, i.e., reside as a foreigner
3939.gl: to dwell beside (one) or in one's neighbourhood, to live near; in the new testament, to be or dwell in a place as a stranger, to sojourn
3939.gi: dimorare vicino, cioè risiedere come straniero

3940.gl: a dwelling near or with one; a sojourning, dwelling in a strange land; metaphorically the life of a man here on earth is likened to a sojourning

3941.g: having a home near, i.e., (as noun) a by-dweller (alien resident)
3941.gl: dwelling near, neighbouring; in the new testament, a stranger, a foreigner, one who lives in a place without the right of citizenship; metaphorically; without citizenship in god's kingdom; one who lives on earth as a stranger, a sojourner on the earth; of christians whose home is in heaven
3941.gi: avere una casa vicino, cioè (come sostantivo) un abitante (residente straniero)

3942.g: apparently a state alongside of supposition, i.e., (concretely) an adage; specially, an enigmatical or fictitious illustration
3942.gl: a saying out of the usual course or deviating from the usual manner of speaking; a current or trite saying, a proverb; any dark saying which shadows forth some didactic truth; especially a symbolic or figurative saying; speech or discourse in which a thing is illustrated by the use of similes and comparisons; an allegory; extended and elaborate metaphor
3942.gi: apparentemente uno stato accanto alla supposizione, cioè (concretamente) un adagio; specialmente, un'illustrazione enigmatica o fittizia

3943.g: staying near wine, i.e., tippling (a toper)
3943.gi: restare vicino al vino, cioè bevere (un ubriacone)

3944.g: to escape along, i.e., be gone

3945.gl: to be like; to be not unlike

3947.g: to sharpen alongside, i.e., (figuratively) to exasperate
3947.gl: to make sharp, sharpen; to stimulate, spur on, urge; to irritate, provoke, arouse to anger; to scorn, despise; provoke, make angry; to exasperate, to burn with anger

3949.gl: to rouse to wrath, to provoke, exasperate, anger

3951.g: to urge along, i.e., stimulate (to hostility)

3952.g: a being near, i.e., advent (often, return; specially, of christ to punish jerusalem, or finally the wicked); (by implication) physically, aspect
3952.gl: presence; the coming, arrival, advent; the future visible return from heaven of jesus, to raise the dead, hold the last judgment, and set up formally and gloriously the kingdom of god
3952.gi: essere vicino, cioè avvento (spesso, ritorno; specialmente, di Cristo per punire Gerusalemme, o infine gli empi); (per implicazione) fisicamente, aspetto

3953.gl: a side dish, a dish of dainties or choice food suited not so much to satisfy as to gratify the appetite; a side accompaniment of the more solid food; the dish itself in which the delicacies are served up

3954.g: all out-spokenness, i.e., frankness, bluntness, publicity; by implication, assurance
3954.gl: freedom in speaking, unreservedness in speech; openly, frankly, i.e., without concealment; without ambiguity or circumlocution; without the use of figures and comparisons; free and fearless confidence, cheerful courage, boldness, assurance; the deportment by which one becomes conspicuous or secures publicity
3954.gi: tutta loquacità, cioè franchezza, schiettezza, pubblicità; per implicazione, sicurezza

3955.g: to be frank in utterance, or confident in spirit and demeanor
3955.gl: to use freedom in speaking, be free spoken; to speak freely; to grow confident, have boldness, show assurance, assume a bold bearing
3955.gi: essere franco nel parlare, o fiducioso nello spirito e nel comportamento

3956.gl: individually; each, every, any, all, the whole, everyone, all things, everything; collectively; some of all types

3957.g: the passover (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it)
3957.gl: the paschal sacrifice (which was accustomed to be offered for the people's deliverance of old from egypt); the paschal lamb, i.e., the lamb the israelites were accustomed to slay and eat on the fourteenth day of the month of nisan (the first month of their year) in memory of the day on which their fathers, preparing to depart from egypt, were bidden by god to slay and eat a lamb, and to sprinkle their door posts with its blood, that the destroying angel, seeing the blood, might pass over their dwellings; christ crucified is likened to the slain paschal lamb; the paschal supper; the paschal feast, the feast of the passover, extending from the 14th to the 20th day of the month nisan
3957.gi: la Pasqua (il pasto, il giorno, la festa o i sacrifici speciali ad essa connessi)

3958.g: to experience a sensation or impression (usually painful)
3958.gl: to be affected or have been affected, to feel, have a sensible experience, to undergo; in a good sense, to be well off, in good case; in a bad sense, to suffer sadly, be in a bad plight; of a sick person
3958.gi: provare una sensazione o un'impressione (solitamente dolorosa)

3959.g: patara, a place in asia minor
3959.gl: [scattering, cursing]; a maritime city of lycia, celebrated for its oracle of apollo
3959.gi: Patara, un luogo in Asia Minore

3960.g: to knock (gently or with a weapon or fatally)
3960.gl: to strike gently: as a part or a member of the body; to stroke, smite: with the sword, to afflict, to visit with evils, etc. as with a deadly disease; to smite down, cut down, to kill, slay
3960.gi: bussare (dolcemente o con un'arma o mortalmente)

3961.gl: to tread; to trample, crush with the feet; to advance by setting foot upon, tread upon: to encounter successfully the greatest perils from the machinations and persecutions with which satan would fain thwart the preaching of the gospel; to tread under foot, trample on, i.e., to treat with insult and contempt: to desecrate the holy city by devastation and outrage

3962.g: a "father" (literally or figuratively, near or more remote)
3962.gl: generator or male ancestor; either the nearest ancestor: father of the corporeal nature, natural fathers, both parents; a more remote ancestor, the founder of a race or tribe, progenitor of a people, forefather: so abraham is called, jacob and david; fathers i.e., ancestors, forefathers, founders of a race; one advanced in years, a senior; metaphorically; the originator and transmitter of anything; the authors of a family or society of persons animated by the same spirit as himself; one who has infused his own spirit into others, who actuates and governs their minds; one who stands in a father's place and looks after another in a paternal way; a title of honor; teachers, as those to whom pupils trace back the knowledge and training they have received; the members of the sanhedrin, whose prerogative it was by virtue of the wisdom and experience in which they excelled, to take charge of the interests of others; god is called the father; of the stars, the heavenly luminaries, because he is their creator, upholder, ruler; of all rational and intelligent beings, whether angels or men, because he is their creator, preserver, guardian and protector; of spiritual beings and of all men; of christians, as those who through christ have been exalted to a specially close and intimate relationship with god, and who no longer dread him as a stern judge of sinners, but revere him as their reconciled and loving father; the father of jesus christ, as one whom god has united to himself in the closest bond of love and intimacy, made acquainted with his purposes, appointed to explain and carry out among men the plan of salvation, and made to share also in his own divine nature; by jesus christ himself; by the apostles
3962.gi: un "padre" (letteralmente o figurato, vicino o più lontano)

3963.g: patmus, an islet in the mediterranean
3963.gl: [my killing]; a rugged and bare island in the aegean sea

3965.g: paternal descent, i.e., (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation)
3965.gl: lineage running back to some progenitor, ancestry; a race or tribe; a group of families, all those who in a given people lay claim to a common origin; the israelites which distributed into twelve tribes, descended from the twelve sons of jacob, these were divided into families which were divided into houses; family, in a wider sense, nation, people
3965.gi: discendenza paterna, cioè (concretamente) un gruppo di famiglie o un'intera razza (nazione)

3966.gl: patriarch, founder of a tribe, progenitor; of the twelve sons of jacob, founders of the tribes of israel; of abraham, isaac and jacob

3967.gl: paternal, ancestral, handed down by or received from one's fathers

3968.g: a father-land, i.e., native town; (figuratively) heavenly home
3968.gl: one's native country; one's fatherland, one's own country, a fixed abode or home; one's own native place i.e., a city
3968.gi: una patria, cioè città natale; (figurato) casa celeste

3969.gi: vita del padre; Patrobas, un cristiano

3970.gl: handed down from one's father's or ancestors

3971.gl: descending from father to son or from ancestors to their posterity as it were by right of inheritance; received from the fathers

3972.g: (little; but remotely from a derivative of g3973, meaning the same); paulus, the name of a roman and of an apostle
3972.gl: [small, little]; paul was the most famous of the apostles and wrote a good part of the new testament, the 14 pauline epistles; paulus was a deputy or pro-consul of cyprus and is said to be a prudent man, in the management of affairs, as a governor
3972.gi: (piccolo; ma da un derivato di g3973, con lo stesso significato); Paolo, il nome di un romano e di un apostolo

3973.g: to stop (transitively or intransitively), i.e., restrain, quit, desist, come to an end
3973.gl: to make to cease or desist; to restrain a thing or person from something; to cease, to leave off; have got release from sin; no longer stirred by its incitements and seductions
3973.gi: fermarsi (transitivamente o intransitivamente), cioè trattenere, smettere, astenersi, giungere a una fine

3974.gl: [boiling, hot]; a maritime city on the west end of cyprus, with a harbor

3975.g: to thicken, i.e., (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous)
3975.gl: to make thick, to make fat, fatten; metaphorically to make stupid (to render the soul dull or callous)
3975.gi: ispessire, cioè (per implicazione) ingrassare (figurato, stupefare o indurire)

3976.gl: a fetter, shackle for the feet

3978.g: to foot a journey, i.e., travel by land
3978.gl: to travel on foot (not on horseback or in carriage), or (if opposed to going by sea) by land
3978.gi: fare un viaggio a piedi, cioè viaggiare via terra

3979.gl: on foot (as opposed to riding); by land (as opposed to going by sea)

3980.g: to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e., (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice
3980.gl: to obey (a ruler or a superior)
3980.gi: essere persuaso da un sovrano, cioè (caso genitivo) sottomettersi all'autorità; per analogia, conformarsi ai consigli

3982.g: to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy, to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward certainty)
3982.gl: persuade; to persuade, i.e., to induce one by words to believe; to make friends of, to win one's favor, gain one's good will, or to seek to win one, strive to please one; to tranquillise; to persuade unto i.e., move or induce one to persuasion to do something; be persuaded; to be persuaded, to suffer one's self to be persuaded; to be induced to believe: to have faith: in a thing; to believe; to be persuaded of a thing concerning a person; to listen to, obey, yield to, comply with; to trust, have confidence, be confident
3982.gi: convincere (con argomenti, veri o falsi); per analogia, pacificare o riconciliare (con altri mezzi equi); riflessivamente o passivamente, acconsentire (a prove o autorità), affidarsi (per certezza interiore)

3983.g: to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave
3983.gl: to hunger, be hungry; to suffer want; to be needy; metaphorically to crave ardently, to seek with eager desire
3983.gi: morire di fame (assolutamente o comparativamente); figurato, desiderare ardentemente

3984.gl: a trial, experience, attempt; to attempt a thing, to make trial of a thing or of a person; to have a trial of a thing; to experience, learn to know by experience

3985.g: to test (objectively), i.e., endeavor, scrutinize, entice, discipline
3985.gl: to try whether a thing can be done; to attempt, endeavor; to try, make trial of, test: for the purpose of ascertaining his quantity, or what he thinks, or how he will behave himself; in a good sense; in a bad sense, to test one maliciously, craftily to put to the proof his feelings or judgments; to try or test one's faith, virtue, character, by enticement to sin; to solicit to sin, to tempt; of the temptations of the devil; after the old testament usage; of god: to inflict evils upon one in order to prove his character and the steadfastness of his faith; men are said to tempt god by exhibitions of distrust, as though they wished to try whether he is not justly distrusted; by impious or wicked conduct to test god's justice and patience, and to challenge him, as it were to give proof of his perfections
3985.gi: mettere alla prova (oggettivamente), cioè tentare, esaminare, tentare, disciplinare

3986.g: a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication, adversity
3986.gl: an experiment, attempt, trial, proving; trial, proving: the trial made of you by my bodily condition, since condition served as to test the love of the galatians toward paul (galatians 4:14); the trial of man's fidelity, integrity, virtue, constancy; an enticement to sin, temptation, whether arising from the desires or from the outward circumstances; an internal temptation to sin; of the temptation by which the devil sought to divert jesus the messiah from his divine errand; of the condition of things, or a mental state, by which we are enticed to sin, or to a lapse from the faith and holiness; adversity, affliction, trouble: sent by god and serving to test or prove one's character, faith, holiness; temptation (i.e., trial) of god by men; rebellion against god, by which his power and justice are, as it were, put to the proof and challenged to show themselves
3986.gi: una messa alla prova (per esperimento (del bene), esperienza (del male), sollecitazione, disciplina o provocazione); per implicazione, avversità

3987.gl: to make a trial of, to attempt; taught by trial, experienced; to test, to make trial of one, put him to proof; his mind, sentiments, temper; in particular, to attempt to induce one to commit some (especially carnal) crime; tempted to sin

3989.g: deep or open sea, i.e., the main
3989.gl: the sea; the high sea, the deep (where ships sail)
3989.gi: mare profondo o aperto, cioè il mare aperto

3990.g: to chop off (the head), i.e., truncate
3990.gl: to cut off with an axe, to behead

3992.g: to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas ???? (as a stronger form of ????) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and g4724 denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield
3992.gl: to send; to bid a thing to be carried to one; to send (thrust or insert) a thing into another
3992.gi: inviare (dalla prospettiva soggettiva o punto di partenza, mentre ???? (come forma più forte di ????) si riferisce piuttosto al punto oggettivo o terminus ad quem, e g4724 indica propriamente, il movimento ordinario coinvolto), specialmente per una missione temporanea; anche trasmettere, conferire o esercitare

3996.g: to grieve (the feeling or the act)
3996.gl: to mourn; to mourn for, lament one

4005.g: fiftieth (g2250 being implied) from passover, i.e., the festival of "pentecost"
4005.gl: [the fiftieth day]; the second of the three great jewish feasts, celebrated at jerusalem yearly, the seventh week after the passover, in grateful recognition of the completed harvest
4005.gi: cinquantesimo (g2250 sottinteso) dalla Pasqua, cioè la festa della "pentecoste"

4007.g: an enclitic particle significant of abundance (thoroughness), i.e., emphasis; much, very or ever
4007.gl: however much, very much, altogether, indeed
4007.gi: particella enclitica significativa di abbondanza (completezza), cioè enfasi; molto, molto o sempre

4008.g: through (as adverb or preposition), i.e., across
4008.gi: attraverso (come avverbio o preposizione), cioè, oltre

4009.gl: extremity, bound, end; of a portion of space; boundary; frontier; the ends of the earth; the remotest lands; of a thing extending through a period of time (termination)

4010.g: fortified; pergamus, a place in asia minor
4010.gl: [height, elevation]; a city of mysia minor, in asia minor, the seat of the dynasties of attalus and eumenes, famous for its temple of aesculapius and the invention and manufacture of parchment
4010.gi: fortificato; Pergamo, un luogo in Asia Minore

4011.g: a tower; perga, a place in asia minor
4011.gl: [earthy]; a town in pamphylia, on the river cestius, at a distance of 7 miles (10 km) from its mouth, and famous in antiquity for the worship of artemis (diana)
4011.gi: una torre; perga, un luogo in asia minore

4012.g: properly, through (all over), i.e., around; figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit, matter, circumstance or general period)
4012.gl: about, concerning, on account of, because of, around, near
4012.gi: propriamente, attraverso (dappertutto), cioè intorno; figurativamente riguardo a; usato in varie applicazioni, di luogo, causa o tempo (con il caso genitivo che denota il soggetto o l'occasione o il punto superlativo; con il caso accusativo il luogo, il circuito, la materia, la circostanza o il periodo generale)

4013.g: to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to walk around
4013.gl: to lead around, to lead about with one's self; to go about, walk about
4013.gi: portare intorno (come compagno); riflessivamente, camminare intorno

4014.g: to remove all around, i.e., unveil, cast off (anchor); figuratively, to expiate
4014.gl: to take away that which surrounds or envelopes a thing; metaphorically to take away altogether or entirely; the guilt of sin, to expiate perfectly
4014.gi: rimuire tutto intorno, cioè, svelare, gettare via (ancora); figuratamente, espiare

4015.g: to flash all around, i.e., envelop in light
4015.gi: brillare dappertutto, cioè avvolgere di luce

4016.g: to throw all around, i.e., invest (with a palisade or with clothing)
4016.gl: to throw around, to put around; to surround a city with a bank (palisade); of garments, to clothe one; to put a thing on one; to clothe one with a thing; to put on or clothe one's self
4016.gi: gettare dappertutto, cioè circondare (con una palizzata o con vestiti)

4017.gl: to look around; to look around about one's self; to look round on one (i.e., to look for one's self at one near by)

4018.g: something thrown around one, i.e., a mantle, veil
4018.gl: a covering thrown around, a wrapper; a mantle; a veil
4018.gi: qualcosa gettata intorno a uno, cioè, un mantello, un velo

4019.g: to bind around one, i.e., enwrap
4019.gi: legare intorno a uno, cioè, avvolgere

4020.g: to work all around, i.e., bustle about (meddle)
4020.gl: to bustle about uselessly, to busy one's self about trifling, needless, useless matters; used apparently of a person officiously inquisitive about other's affairs

4021.g: working all around, i.e., officious (meddlesome, neuter plural magic)
4021.gl: busy about trifles and neglectful of important matters; especially busy about other folks' affairs, a busybody; of things: impertinent and superfluous; of magic arts
4021.gi: lavorare dappertutto, cioè officioso (intrusivo, neutro plurale magico)

4022.g: to come all around, i.e., stroll, vacillate, veer
4022.gl: to go about; of strollers; of wanderers; of navigators (making a circuit)
4022.gi: venire tutto intorno, cioè, passeggiare, vacillare, deviare

4023.g: to hold all around, i.e., include, clasp (figuratively)
4023.gl: to surround, encompass; to contain: of the subject-matter, contents, of a writing; to take possession of, to seize
4023.gi: tenere tutto intorno, cioè, includere, abbracciare (figurativamente)

4024.g: to gird all around, i.e., (middle voice or passive) to fasten on one's belt (literally or figuratively)
4024.gl: to fasten garments with a girdle or belt; to gird one's self; metaphorically with truth as a girdle; to equip one's self with knowledge of the truth
4024.gi: cingere dappertutto, cioè (voce media o passiva) allacciarsi la cintura (letteralmente o figurativamente)

4025.g: a putting all around, i.e., decorating oneself with
4025.gl: the act of putting around; the adornment consisting of the golden ornaments wont to be placed around the head or the body
4025.gi: un mettere tutto intorno, cioè, adornarsi con

4026.g: to stand all around, i.e., (near) to be a bystander, or (aloof) to keep away from
4026.gl: to place around one; to stand around; to turn one's self about for the purpose of avoiding something; to avoid, shun
4026.gi: stare dappertutto, cioè (da vicino) essere uno spettatore, o (da lontano) tenersi alla larga

4027.g: something cleaned off all around, i.e., refuse (figuratively)
4027.gl: off scouring, refuse; metaphorically; the most abject and despicable men; the price of expiation or redemption, because the greeks used to apply the term "?????????" to victims sacrificed to make expiation for the people, and even to criminals who were maintained at the public expense, that on the outbreak of a pestilence or other calamity they might be offered as sacrifices to make expiation for the state
4027.gi: qualcosa di pulito dappertutto, cioè rifiuti (figurato)

4028.g: to cover all around, i.e., entirely (the face, a surface)
4028.gl: to cover all around, to cover up, cover over
4028.gi: coprire tutto intorno, cioè, completamente (il volto, una superficie)

4029.g: to lie all around, i.e., inclose, encircle, hamper (literally or figuratively)
4029.gl: to lie around; to be compassed with, have round one
4029.gi: giacere tutto intorno, cioè, racchiudere, circondare, ostacolare (letteralmente o figurativamente)

4030.g: encirclement of the head, i.e., a helmet
4030.gl: a helmet; metaphorically; the protection of the soul which consists in (the hope of) salvation
4030.gi: circondamento della testa, cioè, un elmo

4031.g: strong all around, i.e., a master (manager)

4032.g: to conceal all around, i.e., entirely
4032.gl: to conceal on all sides or entirely, to hide, seclude

4033.g: to encircle all around, i.e., blockade completely
4033.gl: to encircle, compass about; of a city (besieged)

4034.g: to illuminate all around, i.e., invest with a halo
4034.gi: illuminare dappertutto, cioè circondare di un'aureola

4035.g: to leave all around, i.e., (passively) survive
4035.gl: to leave over; to remain over, to survive

4036.g: grieved all around, i.e., intensely sad
4036.gl: very sad, exceedingly sorrowful; overcome with sorrow so much as to cause one's death

4038.g: all around, i.e., (as an adjective) circumjacent

4039.g: to reside around, i.e., be a neighbor
4039.gl: to dwell round about, to be one's neighbour
4039.gi: risiedere intorno, cioè, essere un vicino

4040.g: housed around, i.e., neighboring (used elliptically as a noun)
4040.gi: alloggiato dappertutto, cioè vicino (usato ellitticamente come sostantivo)

4041.g: being beyond usual, i.e., special (one's own)
4041.gl: that which is one's own, belonging to one's possessions; a people selected by god from the other nations for his own possession
4041.gi: essere oltre il solito, cioè speciale (proprio)

4042.g: a being held around, i.e., (concretely) a passage (of scripture, as circumscribed)
4042.gl: an encompassing, compass, circuit; that which is contained; the contents of any writing
4042.gi: un essere tenuto intorno, cioè, (concretamente) un passo (della Scrittura, come delimitato)

4043.g: to tread all around, i.e., walk at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport oneself, follow (as a companion or votary)
4043.gl: to walk; to make one's way, progress; to make due use of opportunities; hebrew for, to live; to regulate one's life; to conduct one's self; to pass one's life
4043.gi: calpestare tutto intorno, cioè, camminare liberamente (specialmente come prova di abilità); figurativamente, vivere, comportarsi, seguire (come compagno o votario)

4044.gl: to pierce through; metaphorically to torture one's soul with sorrows

4045.g: to fall into something that is all around, i.e., light among or upon, be surrounded with
4045.gl: so to fall into as to be encompassed
4045.gi: cadere in qualcosa che è tutto intorno, cioè, cadere tra o su, essere circondato da

4046.g: to make around oneself, i.e., acquire (buy)
4046.gl: to make to remain over; to reserve, to leave or keep safe, lay by; to make to remain for one's self; to preserve for one's self; to get for one's self, purchase
4046.gi: fare intorno a sé, cioè, acquisire (comprare)

4047.g: acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension, preservation
4047.gl: a preserving, a preservation; possession, one's own property; an obtaining
4047.gi: acquisizione (l'atto o la cosa); per estensione, conservazione

4048.g: to tear all around, i.e., completely away
4048.gl: to break off on all sides, break off all around; to rend or tear off all around

4049.g: to drag all around, i.e., (figuratively) to distract (with care)
4049.gl: to draw around, to draw away, distract; metaphorically; to be driven about mentally, to be distracted; to be over-occupied, too busy, about a thing
4049.gi: trascinare tutto intorno, cioè, (figurativamente) distrarre (con preoccupazione)

4050.gl: abundance, superabundantly, superfluously; superiority, preference, pre-eminence; gain, profit; residue, remains: the wickedness remaining over in a christian from his state prior to conversion

4051.gl: abundance, in which one delights; of that which fills the heart; that which is left over, residue, remains

4052.g: to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or excel
4052.gl: to exceed a fixed number of measure, to be left over and above a certain number or measure; to be over, to remain; to exist or be at hand in abundance; to be great (abundant); a thing which comes in abundance, or overflows unto one, something falls to the lot of one in large measure; to redound unto, turn out abundantly for, a thing; to abound, overflow; to be abundantly furnished with, to have in abundance, abound in (a thing), to be in affluence; to be pre-eminent, to excel; to excel more than, exceed; to make to abound; to furnish one richly so that he has abundance; to make abundant or excellent
4052.gi: sovrabbondare (in quantità o qualità), essere in eccesso, essere superfluo; anche (transitivo) causare sovrabbondanza o eccellere

4053.g: superabundant (in quantity) or superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with g1537) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence
4053.gl: exceeding some number or measure or rank or need; over and above, more than is necessary, superadded; exceeding abundantly, supremely; something further, more, much more than all, more plainly; superior, extraordinary, surpassing, uncommon; pre-eminence, superiority, advantage, more eminent, more remarkable, more excellent
4053.gi: sovrabbondante (in quantità) o superiore (in qualità); per implicazione, eccessivo; avverbialmente (con g1537) violentemente; neutro (come sostantivo) preminenza

4054.gl: exceeding some number or measure or rank or need; over and above, more than is necessary, superadded; exceeding abundantly, supremely; something further, more, much more than all, more plainly; superior, extraordinary, surpassing, uncommon; pre-eminence, superiority, advantage, more eminent, more remarkable, more excellent

4055.g: more superabundant (in number, degree or character)
4055.gl: exceeding some number or measure or rank or need; over and above, more than is necessary, superadded; exceeding abundantly, supremely; something further, more, much more than all, more plainly; superior, extraordinary, surpassing, uncommon; pre-eminence, superiority, advantage, more eminent, more remarkable, more excellent
4055.gi: più sovrabbondante (in numero, grado o carattere)

4056.gl: more abundantly; more in a greater degree; more earnestly, more exceedingly; especially, above others

4059.g: to cut around, i.e., (specially) to circumcise
4059.gl: to cut around; to circumcise; cut off one's prepuce (used of that well known rite by which not only the male children of the israelites, on the eighth day after birth, but subsequently also "proselytes of righteousness" were consecrated to jehovah and introduced into the number of his people); to get one's self circumcised, present one's self to be circumcised, receive circumcision; since by the rite of circumcision a man was separated from the unclean world and dedicated to god, the word is transferred to denote the extinguishing of lusts and the removal of sins
4059.gi: circondare con il taglio, cioè (specialmente) circoncidere

4060.g: to place around; by implication, to present
4060.gl: to place around, set about; to put on a garment; to put or bind a thing around another; to present, to bestow, confer, a thing upon one

4061.g: circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people, literally or figuratively)
4061.gl: circumcised; the act or rite of circumcision, "they of the circumcision" is a term used of the jews; of christians gathered from among the jews; the state of circumcision; metaphorically; of christians separated from the unclean multitude and truly consecrated to god; the extinction of passions and the removal of spiritual impurity
4061.gi: circoncisione (il rito, la condizione o il popolo, letteralmente o figurato)

4062.g: to turn around, i.e., (mentally) to craze
4062.gl: to turn about, to turn; to transfer or change by turning; a person or thing into some state; turning one mad

4063.gl: to run around, run around about

4064.g: to convey around, i.e., transport hither and thither
4064.gl: to carry round, to bear about everywhere with one; to carry here and there; to be driven; in doubt and hesitation to be led away now to this opinion, now to that
4064.gi: trasportare intorno, cioè, trasportare qua e là

4065.gl: to consider or examine on all sides i.e., carefully, thoroughly; to set one's self in thought beyond (exalt one's self in thought above) a person or a thing; to contemn, to despise

4066.g: around the region, i.e., circumjacent (as noun, with g1093 implied vicinity)
4066.gl: lying round about, neighbouring; the region round about; the region of jordan
4066.gi: intorno alla regione, cioè, circostante (come sostantivo, con g1093 vicinanza implicita)

4067.g: something brushed all around, i.e., off-scrapings (figuratively, scum)
4067.gl: what is wiped off; dirt rubbed off; off scouring, scrapings
4067.gi: qualcosa spazzato tutto intorno, cioè, residui di raschiatura (figurato, schiuma)

4068.g: perhaps by reduplication of the base of g4008); to boast
4068.gl: to boast one's self; a self display, employing rhetorical embellishments in extolling one's self excessively
4068.gi: forse per raddoppiamento della base di g4008); vantarsi

4069.g: a persian woman; persis, a christian female
4069.gl: [a persian woman]; a christian woman at rome
4069.gi: una donna persiana; Perside, una donna cristiana

4070.g: the by-gone, i.e., (as noun) last year
4070.gl: last year; the year just past; for a year past, a year ago
4070.gi: il passato, cioè (come sostantivo) l'anno scorso

4071.gl: flying, winged; flying or winged animals, birds; the birds of the heaven, i.e., flying in the heaven (air)

4073.gl: a rock, cliff or ledge; a projecting rock, crag, rocky ground; a rock, a large stone; metaphorically a man like a rock, by reason of his firmness and strength of soul

4074.g: a (piece of) rock (larger than g3037); as a name, petrus, an apostle
4074.gl: [a rock, a stone]; one of the twelve disciples of jesus
4074.gi: un (pezzo di) roccia (più grande di g3037); come nome, Pietro, un apostolo

4075.gl: rocky, stony; of a ground full of rocks

4076.g: rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves)
