4076.gl: rue; a shrubby plant about 2 feet (60 cm) high, of medicinal value
4076.gi: ruta (dalle sue foglie spesse o carnose)

4077.g: a fount (literally or figuratively), i.e., source or supply (of water, blood, enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring)
4077.gl: fountain, spring; a well fed by a spring
4077.gi: una fonte (letteralmente o figurato), cioè sorgente o approvvigionamento (di acqua, sangue, godimento) (non necessariamente la sorgente primordiale)

4078.g: to fix ("peg"), i.e., (specially) to set up (a tent)
4078.gl: to make fast, to fix; to fasten together, to build by fastening together

4080.g: how much (as an indefinite), i.e., in size or (figuratively) dignity
4080.gl: how great, how large; in a material reference (denoting geometrical magnitude as distinguished from arithmetical); in an ethical sense: how distinguished
4080.gi: quanto (come indefinito), cioè in dimensione o (figurato) dignità

4081.gl: clay, which potters uses; mud (wet clay)

4082.g: a wallet or leather pouch for food
4082.gl: a wallet; a leathern sack, in which travellers and shepherds carried their provisions
4082.gi: un borsello o sacchetto di cuoio per il cibo

4083.g: the fore-arm, i.e., (as a measure) a cubit
4083.gl: a cubit; a measure of length equal to distance from the joint of the elbow to the tip of the middle finger (i.e., about 18 inches or 0.5 m)

4084.g: to squeeze, i.e., seize (gently by the hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting (capture))
4084.gl: to lay hold of; to take, capture; of fishes; to apprehend; of a man, in order to imprison him
4084.gi: stringere, cioè, afferrare (gentilmente con la mano (premere), o ufficialmente (arrestare), o nella caccia (catturare))

4086.gl: speech adapted to persuade, discourse in which probable arguments are adduced; in a bad sense, persuasiveness of speech, specious discourse leading others into error

4087.gl: to make bitter; to produce a bitter taste in the stomach; to embitter, exasperate; render angry, indignant; to be embittered, irritated; to visit with bitterness, to grieve (deal bitterly with)

4088.gl: bitter gall; extreme wickedness; a bitter root, and so producing a bitter fruit; metaphorically bitterness, bitter hatred

4091.g: close-pressed, i.e., firm; pilatus, a roman
4091.gl: [armed with a spear]; the sixth roman procurator of judah and samaria who ordered christ to be crucified
4091.gi: stretto, cioè, saldo; pilato, un romano

4092.g: to fire, i.e., burn (figuratively and passively, become inflamed with fever)
4092.gl: to blow, to burn; to cause to swell, to render timid; to swell, become swollen; of the parts of the body
4092.gi: accendere, cioè bruciare (figurato e passivamente, infiammarsi di febbre)

4093.gl: a small tablet; a writing tablet

4094.gl: a board, a tablet; a dish, plate, platter

4095.gl: to drink; figuratively, to receive into the soul what serves to refresh strengthen, nourish it unto life eternal

4097.g: from the base of g4008); to traffic (by travelling), i.e., dispose of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively)
4097.gl: to sell; of price, one into slavery; of the master to whom one is sold as a slave; metaphorically; sold under sin, entirely under the control of the love of sinning; of one bribed to give himself up wholly to another's will
4097.gi: dalla base di g4008); trafficare (viaggiando), cioè, disporre come merce o in schiavitù (letteralmente o figurato)

4098.gl: to descend from a higher place to a lower; to fall (either from or upon); to be thrust down; metaphorically to fall under judgment, came under condemnation; to descend from an erect to a prostrate position; to fall down; to be prostrated, fall prostrate; of those overcome by terror or astonishment or grief or under the attack of an evil spirit or of falling dead suddenly; the dismemberment of a corpse by decay; to prostrate one's self; used of suppliants and persons rendering homage or worship to one; to fall out, fall from i.e., shall perish or be lost; to fall down, fall into ruin: of buildings, walls etc.; to be cast down from a state of prosperity; to fall from a state of uprightness; to perish, i.e., come to an end, disappear, cease; of virtues; to lose authority, no longer have force; of sayings, precepts, etc.; to be removed from power by death; to fail of participating in, miss a share in

4099.g: pisidia, a region of asia minor
4099.gl: [pitchy]; a region in asia minor bounded by pamphylia, and the pamphylian sea, phrygia, and lycaonia

4100.g: to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), i.e., credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's spiritual well-being to christ)
4100.gl: to think to be true, to be persuaded of, to credit, place confidence in; of the thing believed; to credit, have confidence; in a moral or religious reference; used in the new testament of the conviction and trust to which a man is impelled by a certain inner and higher prerogative and law of soul; to trust in jesus or god as able to aid either in obtaining or in doing something: saving faith; to entrust a thing to one, i.e., his fidelity; to be entrusted with a thing
4100.gi: avere fede (in, su, o riguardo a, una persona o cosa), cioè, credito; per implicazione, affidare (specialmente il proprio benessere spirituale a Cristo)

4101.gl: pertaining to belief; having the power of persuading, skilful in producing belief; trusty, faithful, that can be relied on
4101.gi: degno di fiducia, cioè autentico (non adulterato)

4102.g: persuasion, i.e., credence; moral conviction (of religious truth, or the truthfulness of god or a religious teacher), especially reliance upon christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such profession; by extension, the system of religious (gospel) truth itself
4102.gl: conviction of the truth of anything, belief; in the new testament of a conviction or belief respecting man's relationship to god and divine things, generally with the included idea of trust and holy fervour born of faith and joined with it; relating to god; the conviction that god exists and is the creator and ruler of all things, the provider and bestower of eternal salvation through christ; relating to christ; a strong and welcome conviction or belief that jesus is the messiah, through whom we obtain eternal salvation in the kingdom of god; the religious beliefs of christians; belief with the predominate idea of trust (or confidence) whether in god or in christ, springing from faith in the same; fidelity, faithfulness; the character of one who can be relied on
4102.gi: persuasione, cioè, credenza; convinzione morale (della verità religiosa, o della veridicità di Dio o di un insegnante religioso), specialmente affidamento su Cristo per la salvezza; astrattamente, costanza in tale professione; per estensione, il sistema della verità religiosa (vangelo) stessa

4103.gl: trusty, faithful; of persons who show themselves faithful in the transaction of business, the execution of commands, or the discharge of official duties; one who kept his plighted faith, worthy of trust; that can be relied on; easily persuaded; believing, confiding, trusting; in the new testament one who trusts in god's promises; one who is convinced that jesus has been raised from the dead; one who has become convinced that jesus is the messiah and author of salvation
4103.gi: oggettivamente, degno di fiducia; soggettivamente, fiducioso

4104.gl: to make faithful, render trustworthy; to make firm, establish; to be firmly persuaded of; to be assured of

4105.g: to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or virtue)
4105.gl: to cause to stray, to lead astray, lead aside from the right way; to go astray, wander, roam about; metaphorically; to lead away from the truth, to lead into error, to deceive; to be led into error; to be led aside from the path of virtue, to go astray, sin; to sever or fall away from the truth; of heretics; to be led away into error and sin
4105.gi: (propriamente, far) vagare (dalla sicurezza, dalla verità, o dalla virtù)

4106.g: objectively, fraudulence; subjectively, a straying from orthodoxy or piety
4106.gl: a wandering, a straying about; one led astray from the right way, roams hither and thither; metaphorically; mental straying; error, wrong opinion relative to morals or religion; error which shows itself in action, a wrong mode of acting; error, that which leads into error, deceit or fraud
4106.gi: oggettivamente, frode; soggettivamente, una deviazione dall'ortodossia o pietà

4107.g: a rover ("planet"), i.e., (figuratively) an erratic teacher
4107.gi: un vagabondo ("pianeta"), cioè (figurato) un insegnante erratico

4108.g: roving (as a tramp), i.e., (by implication) an impostor or misleader
4108.gl: wandering, roving; misleading, leading into error; a vagabond, "tramp", imposter; corrupter, deceiver
4108.gi: vagabondaggio (come un vagabondo), cioè (per implicazione) un impostore o un fuorviatore

4109.g: a moulding-board, i.e., flat surface ("plate", or tablet, literally or figuratively)
4109.gl: a flat thing, broad tablet, plane, level surface (as of the sea)
4109.gi: una tavola di modellazione, cioè, superficie piana ("lastra", o tavoletta, letteralmente o figurato)

4110.gl: what has been moulded or formed, as from wax; the thing formed by a potter, earthen vessel

4111.g: to mould, i.e., shape or fabricate
4111.gl: to form, mould (something from clay, wax, etc.); used of a potter

4112.g: moulded, i.e., (by implication) artificial or (figuratively) fictitious (false)
4112.gl: moulded, formed, as from clay, wax, or stone; feigned
4112.gi: modellato, cioè, (per implicazione) artificiale o (figurato) fittizio (falso)

4113.g: a wide "plat" or "place", i.e., open square
4113.gi: una vasta "piastra" o "luogo", cioè, piazza aperta

4115.gl: to make broad, enlarge; be enlarged in heart, i.e., to welcome and embrace you in love

4117.gl: what is woven, plaited, or twisted together; a web, plait, braid; of a net; of a basket, in which the infant moses was laid; of braided hair

4118.g: the largest number or very large
4118.gi: il numero più grande o molto grande

4119.g: more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the major portion
4119.gl: greater in quantity; the more part, very many; greater in quality, superior, more excellent
4119.gi: più in quantità, numero o qualità; anche (al plurale) la porzione maggiore

4121.g: to do, make or be more, i.e., increase (transitively or intransitively); by extension, to superabound
4121.gl: to superabound; of things; to exist in abundance; to increase; be augmented; to make to increase: one in a thing
4121.gi: fare, rendere o essere di più, cioè, aumentare (transitivo o intransitivo); per estensione, abbondare

4122.g: to be covetous, i.e., (by implication) to over-reach
4122.gl: to have more, or a greater part or share; to be superior, excel, surpass, have an advantage over; to gain or take advantage of another, to overreach

4123.g: holding (desiring) more, i.e., eager for gain (avaricious, hence a defrauder)
4123.gl: one eager to have more, especially what belongs to others; greedy of gain, covetous
4123.gi: desiderare di più, cioè, desideroso di guadagno (avaro, quindi un frodatore)

4124.gl: greedy desire to have more, covetousness, avarice

4126.gl: to sail, navigate, travel by ship

4127.g: a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a calamity
4127.gl: a blow, stripe, a wound; a public calamity, heavy affliction, plague,
4127.gi: un colpo; per implicazione, una ferita; figurato, una calamità

4128.g: a fulness, i.e., a large number, throng, populace
4128.gl: a multitude; a great number, of men or things; the whole number, the whole multitude, the assemblage; the multitude of the people
4128.gi: una pienezza, cioè, un gran numero, folla, popolo

4129.gl: to increase, to multiply; to be increased, (be multiplied) multiply; to be increased, to multiply

4130.g: to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply)); specially, to fulfil (time)
4130.gl: to fill; to be fulfilled, to be filled
4130.gi: riempire (letteralmente o figurato (impregnare, influenzare, fornire)); specialmente, compiere (tempo)

4131.gl: bruiser, ready for a blow; a pugnacious, contentious, quarrelsome person

4132.gl: a flood, whether of sea or of a river
4132.gi: flusso di marea, cioè, (per analogia) una piena

4133.g: moreover (besides), i.e., albeit, save that, rather, yet
4133.gl: moreover, besides, but, nevertheless; besides, except, but
4133.gi: inoltre (oltre), cioè, sebbene, eccetto che, piuttosto, ancora

4134.g: replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete
4134.gl: full, i.e., filled up (as opposed to empty); of hollow vessels; of a surface, covered in every part; of the soul, thoroughly permeated with; full, i.e., complete; lacking nothing, perfect
4134.gi: ripieno, o coperto; per analogia, completo

4135.g: to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e., completely assure (or convince), entirely accomplish
4135.gl: to bear or bring full, to make full; to cause a thing to be shown to the full; to fulfil the ministry in every part; to carry through to the end, accomplish; things that have been accomplished; to fill one with any thought, conviction, or inclination; to make one certain, to persuade, convince one; to be persuaded, persuaded, fully convinced or assured; to render inclined or bent on
4135.gi: portare a compimento (in prova), cioè, assicurare completamente (o convincere), compiere interamente

4137.g: to make replete, i.e., (literally) to cram (a net), level up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse, influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task), verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc
4137.gl: to make full, to fill up, i.e., to fill to the full; to cause to abound, to furnish or supply liberally; i abound, i am liberally supplied; to render full, i.e., to complete; to fill to the top: so that nothing shall be wanting to full measure, fill to the brim; to consummate: a number; to make complete in every particular, to render perfect; to carry through to the end, to accomplish, carry out, (some undertaking); to carry into effect, bring to realisation, realize; of matters of duty: to perform, execute; of sayings, promises, prophecies, to bring to pass, ratify, accomplish; to fulfil, i.e., to cause god's will (as made known in the law) to be obeyed as it should be, and god's promises (given through the prophets) to receive fulfilment
4137.gi: rendere ripieno, cioè, (letteralmente) riempire (una rete), livellare (una cavità), o (figurato) fornire (o impregnare, diffondere, influenzare), soddisfare, eseguire (un ufficio), finire (un periodo o compito), verificare (o coincidere con una predizione), ecc.

4138.g: repletion or completion, i.e., (subjectively) what fills (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is filled (as container, performance, period)
4138.gl: that which is (has been) filled; a ship inasmuch as it is filled (i.e., manned) with sailors, rowers, and soldiers; in the new testament, the body of believers, as that which is filled with the presence, power, agency, riches of god and of christ; that which fills or with which a thing is filled; of those things which a ship is filled, freight and merchandise, sailors, oarsmen, soldiers; completeness or fullness of time; fulness, abundance; a fulfilling, keeping
4138.gi: riempimento o compimento, cioè, (soggettivamente) ciò che riempie (come contenuto, supplemento, abbondanza, moltitudine), o (oggettivamente) ciò che è riempito (come contenitore, esecuzione, periodo)

4139.g: (adverbially) close by; as noun, a neighbor, i.e., fellow (as man, countryman, christian or friend)
4139.gl: a neighbour; a friend; any other person, and where two are concerned, the other (thy fellow man, thy neighbour), according to the jews, any member of the hebrew race and commonwealth; according to christ, any other man irrespective of race or religion with whom we live or whom we chance to meet
4139.gi: (avverbialmente) vicino; come sostantivo, un vicino, cioè, compagno (come uomo, concittadino, cristiano o amico)

4140.gl: repletion, satiety, for the satisfying of the flesh, to satiate the desires of the flesh; indulgence of the flesh

4141.g: to pound, i.e., (figuratively) to inflict with (calamity)

4145.gl: wealthy, abounding in material resources; metaphorically abounding, abundantly supplied; abounding (rich) in christian virtues and eternal possessions

4147.g: to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively)
4147.gl: to be rich, to have abundance; of outward possessions; metaphorically to be richly supplied; is affluent in resources so that he can give blessings of salvation to all

4148.gl: to make rich, enrich; of spiritual riches; to be richly furnished

4149.g: wealth (as fulness), i.e., (literally) money, possessions, or (figuratively) abundance, richness, (specially), valuable bestowment
4149.gl: riches, wealth; abundance of external possessions; fulness, abundance, plenitude; a good i.e., that with which one is enriched
4149.gi: ricchezza (come pienezza), cioè, (letteralmente) denaro, possedimenti, o (figurato) abbondanza, ricchezza, (specialmente), dono prezioso

4150.gl: to wash: with reference to clothing; use figuratively of those who by faith so appropriate the results of christ's expiation as to be regarded by god as pure and sinless

4151.g: a current of air, i.e., breath (blast) or a breeze; by analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e., (human) the rational soul, (by implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or (superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) god, christ's spirit, the holy spirit
4151.gl: a movement of air (a gentle blast; of the wind, hence the wind itself; breath of nostrils or mouth; the spirit, i.e., the vital principal by which the body is animated; the rational spirit, the power by which the human being feels, thinks, decides; the soul; a spirit, i.e., a simple essence, devoid of all or at least all grosser matter, and possessed of the power of knowing, desiring, deciding, and acting; a life giving spirit; a human soul that has left the body; a spirit higher than man but lower than god, i.e., an angel; used of demons, or evil spirits, who were conceived as inhabiting the bodies of men; the spiritual nature of christ, higher than the highest angels and equal to god, the divine nature of christ; of god; god's power and agency distinguishable in thought from his essence in itself considered; manifest in the course of affairs; by its influence upon the souls productive in the theocratic body (the church) of all the higher spiritual gifts and blessings; the third person of the trinity, the god the holy spirit; the disposition or influence which fills and governs the soul of any one; the efficient source of any power, affection, emotion, desire, etc.
4151.gi: una corrente d'aria, cioè, respiro (soffio) o una brezza; per analogia o figurato, uno spirito, cioè, (umano) l'anima razionale, (per implicazione) principio vitale, disposizione mentale, ecc., o (soprannaturale) un angelo, demone, o (divino) dio, spirito di Cristo, lo Spirito Santo

4152.g: non-carnal, i.e., (humanly) ethereal (as opposed to gross), or (daemoniacally) a spirit (concretely), or (divinely) supernatural, regenerate, religious
4152.gl: relating to the human spirit, or rational soul, as part of the man which is akin to god and serves as his instrument or organ; that which possesses the nature of the rational soul; belonging to a spirit, or a being higher than man but inferior to god; belonging to the divine spirit; of god the holy spirit; one who is filled with and governed by the spirit of god; pertaining to the wind or breath; windy, exposed to the wind, blowing
4152.gi: non carnale, cioè, (umanamente) etereo (in opposizione a grossolano), o (demoniacamente) uno spirito (concretamente), o (divinamente) soprannaturale, rigenerato, religioso

4153.gl: spiritually: i.e., by the aid of the holy spirit

4154.gl: to breathe, to blow; of the wind

4155.g: to wheeze, i.e., (causative, by implication) to throttle or strangle (drown)
4155.gl: to choke, strangle; of thorns crowding out the seed in the field and hindering its growth; to wring one's neck, throttle
4155.gi: ansimare, cioè, (causativo, per implicazione) strangolare o soffocare (annegare)

4156.g: throttled, i.e., (neuter concretely) an animal choked to death (not bled)
4156.gl: suffocate, strangled; what is strangled, i.e., an animal deprived of life without the shedding of blood; of cooking: our "smothered" as a culinary term
4156.gi: strozzato, cioè (neutro concretamente) un animale strangolato a morte (non dissanguato)

4158.g: a dress (g2066 implied) reaching the ankles

4158.gi: un vestito (g2066 implicito) che arriva alle caviglie

4159.g: from which (as interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or cause
4159.gl: of place: from where, from what condition; of origin or source: from what author or giver; of cause: how is that?, how can that be?
4159.gi: da quale (come interrogativo) o che (come relativo) luogo, stato, fonte o causa

4160.g: to make or do (in a very wide application, more or less direct)
4160.gl: to make; with the names of things made, to produce, construct, form, fashion, etc.; to be the authors of, the cause; to make ready, to prepare; to produce, bear, shoot forth; to acquire, to provide a thing for one's self; to make a thing out of something; to (make i.e.,) render one anything; to (make i.e.,) constitute or appoint one anything, to appoint or ordain one that; to (make i.e.,) declare one anything; to put one forth, to lead him out; to make one do something; cause one to; to be the authors of a thing (to cause, bring about); to do; to act rightly, do well; to carry out, to execute; to do a thing unto one; to do to one; with designation of time: to pass, spend; to celebrate, keep; to make ready, and so at the same time to institute, the celebration of the passover; to perform: to a promise
4160.gi: fare o compiere (in un'applicazione molto ampia, più o meno diretta)

4161.g: a product, i.e., fabric (literally or figuratively)
4161.gl: that which has been made; a work; of the works of god as creator
4161.gi: un prodotto, cioè tessuto (letteralmente o figurato)

4162.gl: a making; a doing or performing; in his doing i.e., in the obedience he renders to the law

4163.gl: a maker, a producer, author; a doer, performer; one who obeys or fulfils the law; a poet

4164.gl: a various colors, variegated; of various sorts

4165.g: to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser)
4165.gl: to feed, to tend a flock, keep sheep; to rule, govern; of rulers; to furnish pasture for food; to nourish; to cherish one's body, to serve the body; to supply the requisites for the soul's need
4165.gi: prendersi cura come un pastore di (figurato, supervisore)

4166.gl: a herdsman, especially a shepherd; in the parable, he to whose care and control others have committed themselves, and whose precepts they follow; metaphorically; the presiding officer, manager, director, of any assembly: so of christ the head of the church; of the overseers of the christian assemblies; of kings and princes

4167.gl: a flock (especially) of sheep; of christ's flock i.e., the body of those who follow jesus as their guide and keeper

4168.gl: a flock (especially) of sheep; a group of christ's disciples; bodies of christian (churches) presided over by elders

4169.g: individualizing interrogative (of character) what sort of, or (of number) which one
4169.gi: interrogativo individualizzante (di carattere) che tipo di, o (di numero) quale

4170.g: to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e., to battle (literally or figuratively)
4170.gl: to war, carry on war; to fight
4170.gi: essere (coinvolto) in guerra, cioè combattere (letteralmente o figurato)

4171.g: warfare (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series)
4171.gl: a war; a fight, a battle; a dispute, strife, quarrel
4171.gi: guerra (letteralmente o figurato; un singolo scontro o una serie)

4172.g: a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size)
4172.gl: a city; one's native city, the city in which one lives; the heavenly jerusalem; the abode of the blessed in heaven; of the visible capital in the heavenly kingdom, to come down to earth after the renovation of the world by fire; the inhabitants of a city
4172.gi: una città (propriamente, con mura, di maggiore o minore dimensione)

4173.gl: a ruler of a city or citizens

4174.gl: the administration of civil affairs; a state or commonwealth; citizenship, the rights of a citizen

4175.gl: the administration of civil affairs or of a commonwealth; the constitution of a commonwealth, form of government and the laws by which it is administered; a state, commonwealth; the commonwealth of citizens

4176.gl: to be a citizen; to administer civil affairs, manage the state; to make or create a citizen; to be a citizen; to behave as a citizen; to avail one's self of or recognize the laws; to conduct one's self as pledged to some law of life

4177.gl: a citizen; the inhabitant of any city or country; the association of another in citizenship; a fellow citizen, fellow countryman

4179.g: manifold, i.e., (neuter as noun) very much more
4179.gi: multiforme, cioè (neutro come sostantivo) molto di più

4181.g: in many portions, i.e., variously as to time and agency (piecemeal)
4181.gl: by many portions, by many times and in many ways
4181.gi: in molte porzioni, cioè, variamente per quanto tempo e agenzia (a pezzi)

4182.gl: much variegated, marked with a great variety of colors; of cloth or a painting; much varied, manifold

4183.g: (singular) much (in any respect) or (plural) many; neuter (singular) as adverbial, largely; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun often, mostly, largely
4183.gi: (singolare) molto (in qualsiasi aspetto) o (plurale) molti; neutro (singolare) come avverbio, per lo più; neutro (plurale) come avverbio o sostantivo spesso, per lo più, in gran parte

4185.gl: precious; requiring very great outlay, very costly; excellent, of surpassing value

4187.g: in many ways, i.e., variously as to method or form
4187.gi: in molti modi, cioè variamente per metodo o forma

4189.g: depravity, i.e., (specially), malice; plural (concretely) plots, sins
4189.gl: depravity, iniquity, wickedness; malice; evil purposes and desires
4189.gi: corruzione, cioè (specialmente), malizia; plurale (concretamente) trame, peccati

4190.g: hurtful, i.e., evil (properly, in effect or influence, and thus differing from g2556, which refers rather to essential character, as well as from g4550, which indicates degeneracy from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous; also (passively) ill, i.e., diseased; but especially (morally) culpable, i.e., derelict, vicious, facinorous; neuter (singular) mischief, malice, or (plural) guilt; masculine (singular) the devil, or (plural) sinners
4190.gl: full of labors, annoyances, hardships; pressed and harassed by labors; bringing toils, annoyances, perils; of a time full of peril to christian faith and steadfastness; causing pain and trouble; bad, of a bad nature or condition; in a physical sense: diseased or blind; in an ethical sense: evil wicked, bad
4190.gi: nocivo, cioè male (propriamente, in effetto o influenza, e quindi diverso da g2556, che si riferisce piuttosto al carattere essenziale, nonché da g4550, che indica degenerazione dalla virtù originale); figurato, calamitoso; anche (passivamente) malato, cioè malato; ma specialmente (moralmente) colpevole, cioè negligente, vizioso, scellerato; neutro (singolare) danno, malizia, o (plurale) colpa; maschile (singolare) il diavolo, o (plurale) peccatori

4193.g: a pontican, i.e., native of pontus
4193.gl: belonging to pontus, born in pontus
4193.gi: un pontico, cioè, nativo del Ponto

4194.gl: [of the sea]; the sixth roman procurator of judah who crucified christ

4195.g: a sea; pontus, a region of asia minor
4195.gl: [the sea]; a region of eastern asia minor, bounded by the euxine sea, armenia, cappadocia, galatia, paphlagonia
4195.gi: un mare; Ponto, una regione dell'Asia Minore

4196.gl: [popular]; the chief magistrate of the island of melita

4197.g: travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e., career
4197.gl: a journey; a going, that is: purpose, pursuit, undertaking
4197.gi: viaggiare (per terra); figurato (plurale) procedimenti, cioè, carriera

4198.g: to traverse, i.e., travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.)
4198.gl: to lead over, carry over, transfer; to pursue the journey on which one has entered, to continue on one's journey; to depart from life; to follow one, that is: become his adherent; to lead or order one's life
4198.gi: attraversare, cioè, viaggiare (letteralmente o figuratamente; specialmente per rimuovere (figurato, morire), vivere, ecc.)

4201.gl: [swinish]; the successor of felix as procurator of judea

4202.g: harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry
4202.gl: illicit sexual intercourse; adultery, fornication, homosexuality, lesbianism, intercourse with animals etc.; sexual intercourse with close relatives; leviticus 18; sexual intercourse with a divorced man or woman; mark 10:11,12; metaphorically the worship of idols; of the defilement of idolatry, as incurred by eating the sacrifices offered to idols
4202.gi: prostituzione (inclusa l'adulterio e l'incesto); figuratamente, idolatria

4203.g: to act the harlot, i.e., (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry
4203.gl: to prostitute one's body to the lust of another; to give one's self to unlawful sexual intercourse; to commit fornication; metaphorically to be given to idolatry, to worship idols; to permit one's self to be drawn away by another into idolatry
4203.gi: comportarsi come prostituta, cioè, (letteralmente) cedere a lussuria illegale (di qualsiasi sesso), o (figurato) praticare l'idolatria

4204.gl: a woman who sells her body for sexual uses; a prostitute, a harlot, one who yields herself to defilement for the sake of gain; any woman indulging in unlawful sexual intercourse, whether for gain or for lust; metaphorically an idolatress; of "babylon" i.e., rome, the chief seat of idolatry

4205.g: a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e., (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine)
4205.gl: a man who prostitutes his body to another's lust for hire; a male prostitute; a man who indulges in unlawful sexual intercourse, a fornicator
4205.gi: un (maschio) prostituto (venale), cioè, (per analogia) un libertino

4206.gl: far, at a distance, a great way off

4207.g: from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e., distantly
4207.gi: da lontano, o (per implicazione) a distanza, cioè lontano

4208.gi: più avanti, cioè, una maggiore distanza

4209.g: the "purple" mussel, i.e., (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it
4209.gl: the purple fish, a species of shell fish or mussel; a fabric colored with purple dye, a garment made from purple cloth
4209.gi: la "porpora" mollusco, cioè, (per implicazione) il colore rosso-blu stesso, e infine un vestito tinto con esso

4210.gl: purple, dyed in purple, made of purple fabric

4211.g: a female trader in purple cloth
4211.gl: a female seller of purple or of fabric dyed in purple

4213.g: a drinking (the act), i.e., (concretely) a draught

4214.g: interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many)
4214.gl: how great; how much; how many
4214.gi: pronome interrogativo (di quantità) quanto (grande, lungo o (plurale) molti)

4215.g: a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e., running water
4215.gl: a stream, a river; a torrent; floods
4215.gi: un corso, ruscello o piena (come potabile), cioè acqua corrente

4216.g: river-borne, i.e., overwhelmed by a stream
4216.gl: carried away by a stream (i.e., overwhelmed, drowned in the waters)
4216.gi: trasportato dal fiume, cioè, travolto da un corso d'acqua

4217.g: interrogatively, whatever, i.e., of what possible sort
4217.gl: from what country, race or tribe; of what sort or quality (what manner of); of persons; of things
4217.gi: interrogativamente, qualunque, cioè di che tipo possibile

4218.g: indefinite adverb, at some time, ever
4218.gl: once i.e., formerly, aforetime, at some time
4218.gi: avverbio indefinito, a un certo momento, mai

4220.g: interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e., is it this or that
4220.gi: interrogativo come avverbio, quale (di due), cioè è questo o quello

4221.g: a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e., a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate
4221.gl: a cup, a drinking vessel; metaphorically one's lot or experience, whether joyous or adverse, divine appointments, whether favorable or unfavorable, are likened to a cup which god presents one to drink: so of prosperity and adversity
4221.gi: un bicchiere da bevande; per estensione, il suo contenuto, cioè un bicchiere pieno (sorso); figuratamente, una sorte o un destino

4222.gl: to give to drink, to furnish drink; to water, irrigate (plants, fields etc.); metaphorically to imbue, saturate one's mind

4223.g: little wells, i.e., mineral springs; potioli (i.e., puteoli), a place in italy
4223.gl: [sulphurous springs]; a city of campania, in italy, situated on the bay of naples
4223.gi: piccoli pozzi, cioè sorgenti minerali; Pozzuoli (cioè Puteoli), un luogo in Italia

4225.g: as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e., nearly
4225.gi: come avverbio di luogo, da qualche parte, cioè, quasi

4226.g: as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality
4226.gl: somewhere; nearly; with numerals: somewhere about, about
4226.gi: come avverbio di luogo; a (per implicazione, verso) quale località

4227.gl: [modest]; a christian friend of timothy at rome, and may have been one of the seventy disciples

4228.gl: a foot, both of men or beast; often in the orient, one put his foot on vanquished; of disciples listening to their teacher's instruction are said to be at his feet

4229.g: a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material)
4229.gl: that which has been done, a deed, an accomplished fact; what is done or being accomplished; specifically business, a commercial transaction; a matter, question, affair; specifically in a forensic sense, a matter at law, case, suit; that which is or exists, a thing
4229.gi: un'azione; per implicazione, un affare; per estensione, un oggetto (materiale)

4230.gl: prosecution of any affair; business, occupation

4231.g: to busy oneself with, i.e., to trade
4231.gl: to be occupied in anything; to carry on a business; to carry on the business of a banker or a trader

4232.g: the praetorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp)
4232.gl: "head-quarters" in a roman camp, the tent of the commander-in-chief; the palace in which the governor or procurator of a province resided, to which use the romans were accustomed to appropriate the palaces already existing, and formerly dwelt in by kings or princes; at jerusalem it was a magnificent palace which herod the great had built for himself, and which the roman procurators seemed to have occupied whenever they came from caesarea to jerusalem to transact public business; the camp of the praetorian soldiers established by tiberius
4232.gi: il pretorio o la sala del governatore (a volte includendo l'intero edificio e campo)

4233.g: a practiser, i.e., (specially), an official collector
4233.gl: one who does anything, a doer; one who does the work of inflicting punishment or taking vengeance; the avenger of murder; the exactor of a monetary fine; an officer of justice of the lower order whose business it is to inflict punishment
4233.gi: un praticante, cioè (specialmente) un esattore ufficiale

4234.g: practice, i.e., (concretely) an act; by extension, a function
4234.gl: a doing, a mode of acting, a deal, a transaction; the doings of the apostles; in a bad sense, wicked deed, crime, wicked doings (our practices i.e., trickery); a thing to be done, business
4234.gi: pratica, cioè (concretamente) un atto; per estensione, una funzione

4237.g: a garden plot, i.e., (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by hebraism, to indicate an arrangement)

4237.gi: un appezzamento di giardino, cioè, (per implicazione, di letti regolari) una fila (ripetuta al plurale per ebraismo, per indicare una disposizione)

4238.g: to "practise", i.e., perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from g4160, which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally)
4238.gl: to exercise, practise, to be busy with, carry on; to undertake, to do; to accomplish, perform; to commit, perpetrate; to manage public affairs, transact public business; to exact tribute, revenue, debts; to act
4238.gi: "praticare", cioè, eseguire ripetutamente o abitualmente (così differendo da g4160, che si riferisce propriamente a un singolo atto); per implicazione, eseguire, compiere, ecc.; specialmente, riscuotere (tasse), fare (personalmente)

4239.gl: mildness of disposition, gentleness of spirit, meekness

4240.gl: mildness of disposition, gentleness of spirit, meekness

4241.g: to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e., (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right)
4241.gl: to stand out, to be conspicuous, to be eminent; to be becoming, seemly, fit
4241.gi: ergersi (essere evidente), cioè, (per implicazione) essere adatto o appropriato (terza persona singolare presente indicativo, spesso usato impersonalmente, è giusto o corretto)

4242.g: seniority (eldership), i.e., (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors)
4242.gl: age, dignity, right of the first born; the business normally entrusted to elders, specifically the office of an ambassador, an embassy

4243.g: to be a senior, i.e., (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher)
4243.gl: to be older, prior by birth or in age; to be an ambassador, act as an ambassador
4243.gi: essere anziano, cioè, (per implicazione) agire come rappresentante (figurato, predicatore)

4244.g: the order of elders, i.e., (specially), israelite sanhedrin or christian "presbytery"
4244.gl: body of elders, presbytery, senate, council; of the jewish elders; of the elders of any body (assembly) of christians
4244.gi: l'ordine degli anziani, cioè (specialmente) il sinedrio israelita o il "presbitero" cristiano

4245.g: older; as noun, a senior; specially, an israelite sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or christian "presbyter"
4245.gl: elder, of age,; the elder of two people; advanced in life, an elder, a senior; forefathers; a term of rank or office; among the jews; members of the great council or sanhedrin (because in early times the rulers of the people, judges, etc., were selected from elderly men); of those who in separate cities managed public affairs and administered justice; among the christians, those who presided over the assemblies (or churches) the new testament uses the term bishop, elders, and presbyters interchangeably; the twenty four members of the heavenly sanhedrin or court seated on thrones around the throne of god
4245.gi: più anziano; come sostantivo, un anziano; specialmente, un membro del Sinedrio israelita (anche figurato, membro del consiglio celeste) o cristiano "presbitero"

4246.gl: an old man, an aged man; ambassador

4248.gi: inclinarsi (cadere) in avanti ("prono"), cioè, testa in avanti

4249.gl: to saw, to cut in two with a saw to be "sawn asunder" was a kind of punishment among the hebrews, which according to tradition was inflicted on the prophet isaiah

4251.g: feminine of priscus, ancient; priska, a christian woman
4251.gl: [ancient]; a christian woman, the wife of aquila
4251.gi: femminile di priscus, antico; Prisca, una donna cristiana

4252.g: priscilla (i.e., little prisca), a christian woman
4252.gl: [ancient]; a christian woman, the wife of aquila
4252.gi: Priscilla (cioè, piccola Prisca), una donna cristiana

4253.g: "fore", i.e., in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to
4253.gi: "davanti", cioè, davanti a, precedente (figurato, superiore) a

4254.g: to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous))
4254.gl: to lead forward, lead forth; one from a place in which he has lain hidden from view, as from a prison; in a forensic sense, to bring one forth to trial; to go before; preceding, prior in time, previous; to proceed, go forward; in a bad sense, to go further than is right or proper
4254.gi: condurre avanti (maestoso); intransitivo, precedere (nel luogo o nel tempo (participio, precedente))

4255.g: to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e., (by implication) to propose (intend)
4255.gl: to bring forward, bring forth from one's stores; to bring forth for one's self, to choose for one's self before another, to prefer; to purpose
4255.gi: scegliere per sé prima di un'altra cosa (preferire), cioè (per implicazione) proporre (intendere)

4256.g: to accuse already, i.e., previously charge
4256.gl: to bring a charge against previously (i.e., in what has previously been said)

4257.gl: to hear before; the hoped for salvation before its realisation

4258.gl: to sin before; of those who before receiving baptism had been guilty of the vices especially common among the gentiles

4260.g: to walk forward, i.e., advance (literally, or in years)
4260.gi: camminare avanti, cioè, avanzare (letteralmente, o negli anni)

4261.g: to throw forward, i.e., push to the front, germinate
4261.gl: to throw forward; of trees, to shoot forth, put out leaves; to germinate; to push forward, thrust forward, put forward
4261.gi: gettare avanti, cioè spingere in avanti, germogliare

4262.g: relating to sheep, i.e., (a gate) through which they were led into jerusalem
4262.gl: pertaining to sheep; the sheep gate
4262.gi: relativo alle pecore, cioè (una porta) attraverso cui erano condotte a Gerusalemme

4263.g: something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e., (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively)
4263.gl: any four footed, tame animal accustomed to graze, small cattle (opposed to large cattle, horses, etc.), most commonly a sheep or a goat; a sheep, and so always in the new testament
4263.gi: qualcosa che cammina in avanti (un quadrupede), cioè (specialmente), una pecora (letteralmente o figurato)

4264.g: to force forward, i.e., bring to the front, instigate
4264.gl: to cause to go forward, to lean forward, to bring forward, drag forward; metaphorically to incite, instigate, urge, forward, set on; to induce by persuasion
4264.gi: forzare in avanti, cioè portare davanti, istigare

4265.g: to look out beforehand, i.e., furnish in advance
4265.gi: guardare in anticipo, cioè fornire in anticipo

4266.g: to be already, i.e., have previousy transpired
4266.gl: to arise or come before, happen before; of sins committed previously
4266.gi: essere già, cioè essere già accaduto

4267.gl: to have knowledge before hand; to foreknow; of those whom god elected to salvation; to predestinate

4269.gl: born before, older; of ancestors; of a mother; of grandparents; of great-grand parents (if they are still alive)

4270.g: to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe
4270.gl: to write before (of time); of old set forth or designated before hand (in the scriptures of the old testament); to depict or portray openly; to write before the eyes of all who can read; to depict, portray, paint, before the eyes

4271.g: plain before all men, i.e., obvious
4271.gl: openly evident, known to all, manifest
4271.gi: manifesto davanti a tutti gli uomini, cioè, ovvio

4272.g: to give before the other party has given
4272.gl: to give before, give first; to betray
4272.gi: dare prima che l'altra parte abbia dato

4274.g: a runner ahead, i.e., scout (figuratively, precursor)
4274.gl: a forerunner; especially one who is sent before to take observations or act as a spy, a scout, a light armed soldier; one who comes in advance to a place where the rest are to follow
4274.gi: un corridore davanti, cioè esploratore (figurato, precursore)

4276.g: to hope in advance of other confirmation
4276.gi: sperare in anticipo (in attesa di altra conferma)

4277.gl: to say before; to say in what precedes, to say above; to say before i.e., heretofore, formerly; to say beforehand i.e., before the event: prophecies

4279.gl: to announce before; to promise before

4280.g: used as alternate of g4277; to say already, predict
4280.gl: to say before; to say in what precedes, to say above; to say before i.e., heretofore, formerly; to say beforehand i.e., before the event: prophecies
4280.gi: usato come alternativo di g4277; dire già, predire

4281.g: to go onward, precede (in place or time)
4281.gl: to go forward, go on; to go before; to go before, precede; to go before, in the advance of another
4281.gi: andare avanti, precedere (nel luogo o nel tempo)

4282.g: to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively)
4282.gl: to prepare before, to make ready beforehand

4283.g: to announce glad news in advance
4283.gl: to announce or promise glad tidings beforehand

4284.g: to hold oneself before others, i.e., (figuratively) to excel
4284.gl: to have before or in advance of another, to have pre-eminence over another, to excel, surpass; to surpass in excellencies which can be passed to one's credit
4284.gi: tenersi davanti agli altri, cioè (figurato) eccellere

4285.g: to lead the way for others, i.e., show deference
4285.gl: to go before and show the way, to go before and lead, to go before as a leader
4285.gi: guidare la via agli altri, cioè mostrare deferenza

4286.g: a setting forth, i.e., (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the temple) as exposed before god
4286.gl: a setting forth of a thing, placing of it in view, the shewbread; twelve loaves of wheaten bread, corresponding to the number of the tribes of israel, which loaves were offered to god every sabbath, and separated into two rows, lay for seven days upon a table placed in the sanctuary or front portion of the tabernacle, and afterwards of the temple; a purpose
4286.gi: una presentazione, cioè (figurato) proposta (intenzione); specialmente, il pane di presentazione (nel tempio) come esposto davanti a Dio

4287.g: fixed beforehand, i.e., (feminine with g2250 implied) a designated day
4287.gl: set beforehand, appointed or determined beforehand, prearranged
4287.gi: fissato in anticipo, cioè (femminile con g2250 implicito) un giorno designato

4288.gl: zeal, spirit, eagerness; inclination, readiness of mind

4289.g: forward in spirit, i.e., predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity
4289.gi: avanti nello spirito, cioè predisposto; neutro (come sostantivo) prontezza

4291.g: to stand before, i.e., (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise
4291.gl: to set or place before; to set over; to be over, to superintend, preside over; to be a protector or guardian; to give aid; to care for, give attention to; profess honest occupations
4291.gi: stare davanti, cioè (in rango) presiedere, o (per implicazione) praticare

4292.g: to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e., (by implication) to irritate
4292.gl: to call forth; to call forth to one's self; especially to challenge to a combat or contest with one; to provoke, to irritate
4292.gi: chiamare a sé (sfidare), cioè (per implicazione) irritare

4293.g: to anounce beforehand, i.e., predict, promise
4293.gl: to announce beforehand (that a thing will be); of prophecies; to preannounce in the sense of to promise
4293.gi: annunciare in anticipo, cioè predire, promettere

4295.g: to lie before the view, i.e., (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward)
4295.gl: to lie or be placed before (a person or a thing) or in front of; to set before; to be placed before the eyes, to lie in sight; to stand forth; to be appointed, destined; to be there, be present, be at hand
4295.gi: giacere davanti alla vista, cioè (figurato) essere presente (alla mente), stare avanti (come esempio o ricompensa)

4296.gl: to announce or proclaim be herald beforehand; to announce beforehand (of the herald himself)

4298.g: to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e., (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along)
4298.gl: to beat forward; to lengthen out by hammering (as a smith forges metals); metaphorically to promote, forward, further; to go forward, advance, proceed; of time: the night is far spent; metaphorically to increase, make progress
4298.gi: spingere avanti (come per percussione), cioè (figurato e intransitivo) avanzare (in quantità, crescere; nel tempo, essere ben avviato)

4299.gl: an opinion formed before the facts are known; a prejudgment, a prejudice

4300.gl: to sanction, ratify, or establish beforehand

4301.g: to take in advance, i.e., (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise
4301.gl: to take before; to anticipate, to forestall; to take one by forestalling (him i.e., before he can flee or conceal his crime); surprise, detect
4301.gi: prendere in anticipo, cioè (letteralmente) mangiare prima che altri abbiano l'opportunità; (figurato) anticipare, sorprendere

4302.g: to say beforehand, i.e., predict, forewarn
4302.gi: dire in anticipo, cioè predire, preavvisare

4303.g: to be a witness in advance i.e., predict
4303.gl: antetestor; to testify beforehand; to make known, predict
4303.gi: essere testimone in anticipo, cioè predire

4306.g: to consider in advance, i.e., look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself)
4306.gl: to perceive before, foresee; to provide, think of beforehand; to provide for one; to take thought for, care for a thing
4306.gi: considerare in anticipo, cioè provvedere in anticipo (attivamente, per il mantenimento degli altri; voce media per circospezione per sé)

4307.g: forethought, i.e., provident care or supply
4307.gl: forethought, providential care; to make provision for a thing
4307.gi: preveggenza, cioè cura o provvista provvidenziale

4308.g: to behold in advance, i.e., (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view
4308.gl: to see before (whether as respects place or time); to keep before one's eye's; metaphorically to be mindful of one always
4308.gi: osservare in anticipo, cioè (attivamente) notare (un altro) precedentemente, o (voce media) tenere in (propria) vista

4309.g: to limit in advance, i.e., (figuratively) predetermine
4309.gl: to predetermine, decide beforehand; in the new testament of god decreeing from eternity; to foreordain, appoint beforehand

4311.g: to send forward, i.e., escort or aid in travel
4311.gl: to send before; to send forward, bring on the way, accompany or escort; to set one forward, fit him out with the requisites for a journey
4311.gi: inviare avanti, cioè scortare o aiutare nel viaggio

4312.gl: to fall forwards, headlong, sloping, precipitously; precipitate, rash, reckless
4312.gi: cadere in avanti, cioè a capofitto (figurato, precipitoso)

4313.gl: to send before, to make to precede; to go before one; of a leader; of a messenger or a herald

4314.g: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e., toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e., pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e., near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e., whither or for which it is predicated)
4314.gl: to the advantage of; at, near, by; to, towards, with, with regard to

4315.gi: un pre-sabbath, cioè la vigilia del sabbath

4316.g: to address, i.e., salute by name
4316.gl: to speak to, to address, accost, salute; especially to address or accost by some name, call by name; to give a name in public, to style

4317.g: to lead towards, i.e., (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach
4317.gl: to lead, to bring; to open a way of access, for one to god; to render one acceptable to god; in a forensic sense, to summon (to trial or punishment); to draw near to, approach; the land which a sailor is approaching seeming to approach him
4317.gi: condurre presso, cioè (transitivo) condurre vicino (chiamare, presentare), o (intransitivo) avvicinarsi

4318.gl: the act of bringing to, a moving to; access, approach; to god, i.e., that relationship with god whereby we are acceptable to him and have assurance that he is favorably disposed towards him

4319.gl: to ask for in addition; to approach one with supplications; to ask alms

4320.g: to ascend farther, i.e., be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat)
4320.gl: to go up further; go up higher
4320.gi: salire più in alto, cioè essere promosso (prendere un posto più elevato (più onorevole))

4322.g: to fill up further, i.e., furnish fully
4322.gl: to fill up by adding to

4323.g: to lay up in addition, i.e., (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult
4323.gl: to lay upon in addition to; to lay upon one's self in addition; to undertake besides; to put one's self upon another by going to him,; to commit or betake one's self to another for the purpose of consulting him; to consult, to take one into counsel; to add from one's store; to communicate, impart
4323.gi: accumulare in aggiunta, cioè (forma media e figurato) comunicare o (per implicazione) consultare

4326.g: to require additionally, i.e., want further
4326.gl: to want besides, need in addition
4326.gi: richiedere ulteriormente, cioè volere di più

4327.g: to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience)
4327.gl: to receive to one's self, to admit, to give access to one's self; to admit one, receive one into intercourse and companionship; to receive one (coming from some place); to accept (not to reject) a thing offered; to expect: the fulfilment of promises
4327.gi: ammettere (a commercio, ospitalità, credenza, o (figurato) sopportazione); per implicazione, attendere (con fiducia o pazienza)

4328.g: to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await
4328.gl: to expect (whether in thought, in hope, or in fear); to look for, wait for
4328.gi: anticipare (nel pensiero, speranza o timore); per implicazione, attendere

4329.g: apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated
4329.gi: apprensione (di male); per implicazione, inflizione anticipata

4330.gl: to permit one to approach or arrive

4332.g: to sit near, i.e., attend as a servant
4332.gl: to sit near; to attend assiduously; to be in attendance upon, not to quit one's side
4332.gi: sedere vicino, cioè assistere come servo

4333.g: to work additionally, i.e., (by implication) acquire besides
4333.gl: to work besides; by working or trading to make or gain besides
4333.gi: lavorare ulteriormente, cioè (per implicazione) acquisire in aggiunta

4334.g: to approach, i.e., (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to
4334.gl: to come to, approach; draw near to; to assent to
4334.gi: avvicinarsi, cioè (letteralmente) venire vicino, visitare, o (figurato) adorare, assentire a

4335.gl: prayer addressed to god; a place set apart or suited for the offering of prayer; a synagogue; a place in the open air where the jews were wont to pray, outside the cities, where they had no synagogue; such places were situated upon the bank of a stream or the shore of a sea, where there was a supply of water for washing the hands before prayer

4336.g: to pray to god, i.e., supplicate, worship

4337.g: (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e., pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to
4337.gl: to bring to, bring near; to bring a ship to land, and simply to touch at, put in; to turn the mind to, attend to be attentive; to a person or a thing: of caring for, providing for; to attend to one's self, i.e., to give heed to one's self; give attention to, take heed; to apply one's self to, attach one's self to, hold or cleave to a person or a thing; to be given or addicted to; to devote thought and effort to
4337.gi: (figurato) tenere la mente (implicito 3563) verso, cioè prestare attenzione a, essere cauti riguardo a, applicarsi a, aderire a

4338.g: to peg to, i.e., spike fast
4338.gl: to fasten with nails to, nail to

4339.g: an arriver from a foreign region, i.e., (specially), an acceder (convert) to judaism ("proselyte")
4339.gl: a newcomer; a stranger, alien; a proselyte; one who has come over from a gentile religion to judaism
4339.gi: un arrivato da una regione straniera, cioè (specialmente), un accedente (convertito) al giudaismo ('prosélito')

4340.g: for the occasion only, i.e., temporary
4340.gl: for a season; enduring only for a while; temporary

4341.g: to call toward oneself, i.e., summon, invite
4341.gl: to call to; to call to one's self; to bid to come to one's self; metaphorically; god is said to call to himself the gentiles, aliens as they are from him, by inviting them, through the preaching of the gospel unto fellowship with himself in the messiah's kingdom; christ and the holy sprit are said to call to themselves those preachers of the gospel to whom they have decided to entrust a service having reference to the extension of the gospel
4341.gi: chiamare verso sé, cioè convocare, invitare

4342.g: to be earnest towards, i.e., (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor)
4342.gl: to adhere to one, be his adherent, to be devoted or constant to one; to be steadfastly attentive unto, to give unremitting care to a thing; to continue all the time in a place; to persevere and not to faint; to show one's self courageous for; to be in constant readiness for one, wait on constantly
4342.gi: essere zelanti verso, cioè (verso una cosa) perseverare, essere costantemente diligenti, o (in un luogo) assistere assiduamente a tutti gli esercizi, o (verso una persona) aderire strettamente a (come servitore)

4344.g: something for the head, i.e., a cushion
4344.gi: qualcosa per la testa, cioè un cuscino

4345.g: to give a common lot to, i.e., (figuratively) to associate with
4345.gl: to add or assign by lot, to allot
4345.gi: dare una sorte comune a, cioè (figurato) associarsi a

4346.gl: an inclination or proclivity of mind; a joining the party of one; partiality

4347.g: to glue to, i.e., (figuratively) to adhere
4347.gl: to glue upon, glue to; to join one's self to closely, cleave to, stick to

4348.g: a stub, i.e., (figuratively) occasion of apostasy
4348.gl: a stumbling block; an obstacle in the way which if one strikes his foot against he stumbles or falls; that over which a soul stumbles i.e., by which is caused to sin
4348.gi: un ceppo, cioè (figurato) occasione di apostasia

4349.g: a stumbling, i.e., (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin
4349.gl: an occasion of stumbling; to do something which causes others to stumble; i.e., leads them into error or sin
4349.gi: un inciampo, cioè (figurato e concreto) occasione di peccato

4350.g: to strike at, i.e., surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e., trip up (literally or figuratively)
4350.gl: to strike against; of those who strike against a stone or other obstacle in the path, to stumble; to strike one's foot against a stone; i.e., to meet with some harm;; to rush upon, beat against; to be made to stumble by a thing; i.e., metaphorically to be induced to sin
4350.gi: colpire contro, cioè avanzare contro (come l'acqua); specialmente, inciampare su, cioè far inciampare (letteralmente o figurato)

4351.g: to roll towards, i.e., block against

4352.g: to fawn or crouch to, i.e., (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore)
4352.gl: to kiss the hand to (towards) one, in token of reverence; among the middle easterners, especially the persians, to fall upon the knees and touch the ground with the forehead as an expression of profound reverence; in the new testament by kneeling or prostration to do homage (to one) or make obeisance, whether in order to express respect or to make supplication; used of homage shown to men and beings of superior rank; to the jewish high priests; to god; to christ; to heavenly beings; to demons
4352.gi: adulare o accucciarsi verso, cioè (letteralmente o figurato) prostrarsi in omaggio (rendere omaggio, adorare)

4354.g: to talk to, i.e., converse with

4355.g: to take to oneself, i.e., use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality)
4355.gl: to take to, take in addition, to take to one's self; to take as one's companion; to take by the hand in order to lead aside; to take or receive into one's home, with the collateral idea of kindness; to receive, i.e., grant one access to one's heart; to take into friendship and intercourse; to take to one's self, to take: i.e., food
4355.gi: prendere per sé, cioè usare (cibo), condurre (fuori strada), ammettere (all'amicizia o all'ospitalità)

4356.gl: a receiving: into the kingdom of god

4357.g: to stay further, i.e., remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in
4357.gl: to remain with, to continue with one; to hold fast to: the grace of god received in the gospel; to remain still, tarry, stay
4357.gi: restare più a lungo, cioè rimanere in un luogo, con una persona; figurato, attenersi a, perseverare in

4358.g: to moor to, i.e., (by implication) land at
4358.gl: to bring a ship to moorings; to take one's station near the shore; to moor, come to anchor
4358.gi: ormeggiare a, cioè, (per implicazione) approdare a

4360.gl: to be wroth or displeased with; to loathe; to spew out; to be disgusted with

4362.g: to fasten to, i.e., (specially), to impale (on a cross)
4362.gi: fissare a, cioè, (specialmente) inchiodare (su una croce)

4363.g: to fall towards, i.e., (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm)
4363.gl: to fall forwards, fall down, prostrate one's self before, in homage or supplication: at one's feet; to rush upon, beat against; of winds beating upon a house
4363.gi: cadere verso, cioè, (gentilmente) prostrarsi (in supplicazione o omaggio), o (violentemente) assaltare (in tempesta)

4364.g: to do forward for oneself, i.e., pretend (as if about to do a thing)
4364.gl: to take or claim a thing to one's self; to conform one's self to a thing, or rather to affect to one's self; to pretend
4364.gi: fare avanti per sé, cioè fingere (come se per fare una cosa)

4365.g: to journey towards, i.e., approach (not the same as g4313)
4365.gi: viaggiare verso, cioè, avvicinarsi (non lo stesso di g4313)

4366.g: to tear towards, i.e., burst upon (as a tempest or flood)
4366.gl: to break against, break by dashing against
4366.gi: strappare verso, cioè assalire (come una tempesta o un'inondazione)

4367.gl: to assign or ascribe to, join to; to enjoin, order, prescribe, command; to appoint, to define

4368.gl: a woman set over others; a female guardian, protectress, patroness, caring for the affairs of others and aiding them with her resources

4369.g: to place additionally, i.e., lay beside, annex, repeat
4369.gl: to put to; to add; i.e., to join to, gather with any company, the number of one's followers or companions; he was gathered to his fathers i.e., died
4369.gi: collocare in aggiunta, cioè porre accanto, annettere, ripetere

4370.g: to run towards, i.e., hasten to meet or join
4370.gi: correre verso, cioè, affrettarsi a incontrare o unirsi

4371.g: something eaten in addition to bread, i.e., a relish (specially, fish; compare g3795)
4371.gl: anything eaten with bread; spoken of fish boiled or broiled
4371.gi: qualcosa mangiato in aggiunta al pane, cioè un accompagnamento (specialmente pesce; cfr. g3795)

4372.gl: lately slaughtered, freshly killed; recently made, new
4372.gi: precedentemente (di recente) ucciso (fresco), cioè, (figurato) fatto di recente

4374.g: to bear towards, i.e., lead to, tender (especially to god), treat
4374.gl: to bring to, lead to; one to a person who can heal him or is ready to show him some kindness, one to a person who is to judge him; to bring a present or a thing, to reach or hand a thing to one; to put to; to be borne towards one, to attack, assail; to behave one's self towards one, deal with one
4374.gi: portare verso, cioè condurre a, offrire (specialmente a Dio), trattare

4376.g: presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice
4376.gl: the act of offering, a bringing to; that which is offered, a gift, a present (whether bloody or not), offering for sin, expiatory offering
4376.gi: presentazione; concretamente, un'oblazione (senza sangue) o un sacrificio

4377.g: to sound towards, i.e., address, exclaim, summon
4377.gl: to call to, to address by calling; to call to one's self, summon
4377.gi: suonare verso, cioè rivolgere a, esclamare, convocare

4378.gl: a pouring or sprinkling upon, affusion

4379.g: to impinge, i.e., lay a finger on (in order to relieve)
4379.gi: urtare, cioè, toccare con un dito (al fine di alleviare)

4380.g: to favor an individual, i.e., show partiality
4380.gl: to respect the person (i.e., the external condition of man); to have respect of persons, discriminate
4380.gi: favorire un individuo, cioè mostrare parzialità

4381.g: an accepter of a face (individual), i.e., (specially), one exhibiting partiality
4381.gl: an acceptor of persons; one who discriminates
4381.gi: un accettatore di un volto (individuo), cioè (specialmente) uno che mostra parzialità

4382.gl: respect of persons; partiality; the fault of one who when called on to give judgment has respect of the outward circumstances of man and not to their intrinsic merits, and so prefers, as the more worthy, one who is rich, high born, or powerful, to another who does not have these qualities

4383.g: the front (as being towards view), i.e., the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person
4383.gl: the face; the front of the human head; countenance, look; the face so far forth as it is the organ of sight, and by it various movements and changes) the index of the inward thoughts and feelings; the appearance one presents by his wealth or property, his rank or low condition; outward circumstances, external condition; used in expressions which denote to regard the person in one's judgment and treatment of men; the outward appearance of inanimate things
4383.gi: la parte anteriore (essendo verso la vista), cioè, il volto, aspetto, apparenza, superficie; per implicazione, presenza, persona

4384.gl: to place before; to appoint before, define beforehand

4385.g: to protend, i.e., tie prostrate (for scourging)
4385.gl: to stretch forth, stretch out; when they had stretched one out on the thongs i.e., to receive the blows of the thongs (by tying him up to a beam or a pillar)
4385.gi: protendere, cioè, legare prostrato (per la flagellazione)

4387.gl: before, prior; of time, previous, former

4388.g: to place before, i.e., (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine)
4388.gl: to place before, to set forth; to set forth to be looked at, expose to view; to expose to public view; of the bodies of the dead; to let lie in state; to set before one's self, propose to one's self; to purpose, determine
4388.gi: porre davanti, cioè (per sé) esporre; (a sé) proporre (determinare)

4389.g: to turn forward for oneself, i.e., encourage
4389.gi: voltare avanti per sé, cioè incoraggiare

4390.g: to run forward, i.e., outstrip, precede
4390.gi: correre in avanti, cioè superare, precedere

4391.g: to exist before, i.e., (adverbially) to be or do something previously
4391.gi: esistere prima, cioè (avverbiamente) essere o fare qualcosa precedentemente

4392.gl: a pretext (alleged reason, pretended cause); show; under color as though they would do something; in pretence, ostensibly

4394.gl: prophecy; a discourse emanating from divine inspiration and declaring the purposes of god, whether by reproving and admonishing the wicked, or comforting the afflicted, or revealing things hidden; especially by foretelling future events; used in the new testament of the utterance of old testament prophets; of the prediction of events relating to christ's kingdom and its speedy triumph, together with the consolations and admonitions pertaining to it, the spirit of prophecy, the divine mind, to which the prophetic faculty is due; of the endowment and speech of the christian teachers called prophets; the gifts and utterances of these prophets, especially of the predictions of the works of which, set apart to teach the gospel, will accomplish for the kingdom of christ

4395.g: to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office
4395.gl: to prophesy, to be a prophet, speak forth by divine inspirations, to predict; to prophesy; with the idea of foretelling future events pertaining especially to the kingdom of god; to utter forth, declare, a thing which can only be known by divine revelation; to break forth under sudden impulse in lofty discourse or praise of the divine counsels; under like prompting, to teach, refute, reprove, admonish, comfort others; to act as a prophet, discharge the prophetic office
4395.gi: predire eventi, divinare, parlare sotto ispirazione, esercitare l'ufficio profetico

4396.g: a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet
4396.gl: in greek writings, an interpreter of oracles or of other hidden things; one who, moved by the spirit of god and hence his organ or spokesman, solemnly declares to men what he has received by inspiration, especially concerning future events, and in particular such as relate to the cause and kingdom of god and to human salvation; the old testament prophets, having foretold the kingdom, deeds and death, of jesus the messiah; of john the baptist, the herald of jesus the messiah; of the illustrious prophet, the jews expected before the advent of the messiah; the messiah; of men filled with the spirit of god, who by god's authority and command in words of weight pleads the cause of god and urges salvation of men; of prophets that appeared in the apostolic age among christians; they are associated with the apostles; they discerned and did what is best for the christian cause, foretelling certain future events (see acts 11:27); in the religious assemblies of the christians, they were moved by the holy spirit to speak, having power to instruct, comfort, encourage, rebuke, convict, and stimulate, their hearers; a poet (because poets were believed to sing under divine inspiration); of epimenides (see titus 1:12)
4396.gi: un preditore ("profeta"); per analogia, un oratore ispirato; per estensione, un poeta

4398.g: a female foreteller or an inspired woman
4398.gl: a prophetess; a woman to whom future events or things hidden from others are at times revealed, either by inspiration or by dreams and visions; a female who declares or interprets oracles
4398.gi: una preditrice o una donna ispirata

4399.g: to get an earlier start of, i.e., anticipate
4399.gi: avere un inizio più precoce, cioè, anticipare

4400.g: to handle for oneself in advance, i.e., (figuratively) to purpose
4400.gl: to put into the hand, to deliver into the hands; to take into one's hands; to set before one's self, to prostrate, to determine; to choose, to appoint; for one's use; for one's salvation
4400.gi: maneggiare per sé in anticipo, cioè, (figurato) intendere

4402.g: before the dance; prochorus, a christian
4402.gl: [leader of the chorus]; one of the seven deacons chosen by the church at jerusalem
4402.gi: prima della danza; procoro, un cristiano

4403.gl: the stern or hinder part of the ship

4404.g: at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch
4404.gl: in the morning, early; the fourth watch of the night, from 3 o'clock in the morning until 6 o'clock approximately
4404.gi: all'alba; per implicazione, la guardia del giorno

4405.gl: early, pertaining to the morning, at day break

4406.g: dawning, i.e., (by analogy) autumnal (showering, the first of the rainy season)
4406.gl: early; of the early rain which fell from october on
4406.gi: sorgere, cioè, (per analogia) autunnale (piovoso, il primo della stagione delle piogge)

4407.g: pertaining to the dawn, i.e., matutinal

4408.g: the prow, i.e., forward part of a vessel
4408.gl: the prow or forward part of a ship
4408.gi: la prua, cioè, parte anteriore di una nave

4409.g: to be first (in rank or influence)
4409.gl: to be first, hold the first place
4409.gi: essere il primo (in rango o influenza)

4410.g: a sitting first (in the front row), i.e., preeminence in council
4410.gl: to sit in the first seat, the first or chief seat
4410.gi: un sedere per primo (nella prima fila), cioè, preminenza nel consiglio

4411.g: a reclining first (in the place of honor) at the dinner-bed, i.e., preeminence at meals
4411.gl: the first reclining place, the chief place at table; the relative rank of the several places at table varied among the persians, greeks, and romans; and what arrangements the jews had in the time of christ can not be accurately determined
4411.gi: un sdraiarsi per primo (nel posto d'onore) al letto dei pasti, cioè, preminenza nei pasti

4412.g: firstly (in time, place, order, or importance)
4412.gl: first in time or place; in any succession of things or persons; first in rank; influence, honor; chief; principal; first, at the first
4412.gi: per primo (nel tempo, nel luogo, nell'ordine, o nell'importanza)

4413.g: foremost (in time, place, order or importance)
4413.gl: first in time or place; in any succession of things or persons; first in rank; influence, honor; chief; principal; first, at the first
4413.gi: il più importante (nel tempo, nel luogo, nell'ordine o nell'importanza)

4414.g: one standing first in the ranks, i.e., a captain (champion)
4414.gl: one who stands in the front rank; a leader, chief, champion
4414.gi: uno che sta per primo nelle file, cioè, un capitano (campione)

4415.gl: the right or advantages of the first born son

4416.g: first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively)
4416.gl: the firstborn; of man or beast; of christ, the first born of all creation
4416.gi: primogenito (solitamente come sostantivo, letteralmente o figurato)

4417.g: to trip, i.e., (figuratively) to err, sin, fail (of salvation)
4417.gl: to cause one to stumble or fall; to stumble; to err, make a mistake, to sin; to fall into misery, become wretched
4417.gi: inciampare, cioè, (figurato) sbagliare, peccare, fallire (della salvezza)

4418.gl: the heel (of the foot); to lift up the heel against one; to injure one by trickery (figure borrowed either from kicking, or from a wrestler tripping up his antagonist)

4419.gl: a wing, a little wing; any pointed extremity; of fins of fishes; of part of a dress hanging down in the form of a wing; of the top of the temple at jerusalem

4421.gl: furnished with wings; winged, flying; of birds

4423.gl: to be afraid of with terror

4424.gl: [warlike]; a maritime city of phoenicia, which got its name, apparently, from ptolemy lathyrus, who captured it 103 bc, and rebuilt it more beautifully

4425.gi: una forca per la trebbiatura (come spargere come la saliva)

4428.g: and thus apparently allied to g4072 through the idea of expansion, and to 4429 through that of flattening; compare g3961); to fold, i.e., furl a scroll
4428.gi: e così apparentemente alleato a g4072 attraverso l'idea di espansione, e a 4429 attraverso quella di appiattimento; cfr. g3961); piegare, cioè, arrotolare un rotolo

4430.g: a ruin, i.e., (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion)
4430.gl: a fall, downfall; metaphorically a failure, defeat, calamity; an error, lapse into sin; that which has fallen; the fallen body of one dead or slain, a corpse, a carcase

4431.g: a crash, i.e., downfall (literally or figuratively)

4432.gl: beggary; in the new testament poverty; the condition of one destitute of riches and abundance

4433.g: to be a beggar, i.e., (by implication) to become indigent (figuratively)
4433.gl: to be a beggar, to beg, to be poor
4433.gi: essere un mendicante, cioè, (per implicazione) diventare indigente (figurato)

4434.g: akin to g4422 and the alternate of g4098); a beggar (as cringing), i.e., pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas g3993 properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed)
4434.gl: reduced to beggary, begging, asking alms; destitute of wealth, influence, position, honor; lowly, afflicted, destitute of the christian virtues and eternal riches; helpless, powerless to accomplish an end; poor, needy; lacking in anything; as respects their spirit; destitute of wealth of learning and intellectual culture which the schools afford (men of this class most readily give themselves up to christ's teaching and proved them selves fitted to lay hold of the heavenly treasure)
4434.gi: simile a g4422 e alternativo di g4098); un mendicante (come chi si umilia), cioè, povero (che denota strettamente mendicità assoluta o pubblica, sebbene usato anche in senso qualificato o relativo; mentre g3993 significa propriamente solo circostanze ristrette in privato), letteralmente (spesso come sostantivo) o figurato (in difficoltà)

4435.g: the clenched hand, i.e., (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing)
4435.gl: the fist, clenched hand; up to the elbow
4435.gi: pugno chiuso, cioè (solo nel caso dativo come avverbio) con il pugno (scrubbing duro)

4436.g: a python, i.e., (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying)
4436.gl: in greek mythology the name of the pythian serpent or dragon that dwelt in the region of pytho at the foot of parnassus in phocis, and was said to have guarded the oracle at delphi and been slain by apollo; a spirit of divination
4436.gi: pitone, cioè (per analogia, con il presunto indovino lì) ispirazione (divinazione)

4437.g: clasped (thick), i.e., (figuratively) frequent; neuter plural (as adverb) frequently
4437.gl: thick, dense, compact; in reference to time; frequently, often, recurring; vigorously, diligently; often, more frequently, the oftener
4437.gi: chiuso (denso), cioè, (figurato) frequente; neutro plurale (come avverbio) frequentemente

4438.g: to box (with the fist), i.e., contend (as a boxer) at the games (figuratively)
4438.gl: to be a boxer, to box
4438.gi: battere (pugni), cioè, contendere (come pugile) nei giochi (figurato)

4439.g: a gate, i.e., the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively)
4439.gl: a gate; of the larger sort; in the wall of either a city; a palace; a town; the temple; a prison; the gates of hell (likened to a vast prison); metaphorically the access or entrance into any state
4439.gi: una porta, cioè, la foglia o ala di un ingresso pieghevole (letteralmente o figurato)

4440.g: a gate-way, door-way of a building or city; by implication, a portal or vestibule
4440.gl: a large gate: of a palace; the front part of a house, into which one enters through the gate, porch
4440.gi: un portale, ingresso di un edificio o città; per implicazione, un portico o vestibolo
