4441.g: to question, i.e., ascertain by inquiry (as a matter of information merely; and thus differing from g2065, which properly means a request as a favor; and from g0154, which is strictly a demand for something due; as well as from g2212, which implies a search for something hidden; and from g1189, which involves the idea of urgent need); by implication, to learn (by casual intelligence)
4441.gl: to enquire, ask; to ascertain, by enquiry
4441.gi: interrogare, cioè accertare per indagine (come mera questione di informazione; e quindi diverso da g2065, che propriamente significa una richiesta come favore; e da g0154, che è una richiesta rigorosa di qualcosa dovuto; così come da g2212, che implica una ricerca di qualcosa di nascosto; e da g1189, che coinvolge l'idea di bisogno urgente); per implicazione, imparare (per informazione occasionale)

4443.gl: a fire, a pile of burning fuel

4444.gl: a tower; a fortified structure rising to a considerable height, to repel a hostile attack or to enable a watchman to see in every direction

4445.g: to be on fire, i.e., (specially), to have a fever
4445.gl: to be sick with a fever
4445.gi: essere in fiamme, cioè, (specialmente), avere febbre

4446.g: inflamed, i.e., (by implication) feverish (as noun, fever)
4446.gi: infiammato, cioè, (per implicazione) febbrile (come sostantivo, febbre)

4448.g: to kindle, i.e., (passively) to be ignited, glow (literally), be refined (by implication), or (figuratively) to be inflamed (with anger, grief, lust)
4448.gl: to burn with fire, to set on fire, kindle; to be on fire, to burn; to be incensed, indignant; make to glow; full of fire, fiery, ignited; of darts filled with inflammable substances and set on fire; melted by fire and purged of dross
4448.gi: accendere, cioè, (passivamente) essere infuocato, brillare (letteralmente), essere raffinato (per implicazione), o (figurato) essere infiammato (di collera, dolore, lussuria)

4449.gl: to become glowing, grow red, be red

4450.gl: having the color of fire, red
4450.gi: simile al fuoco, cioè, (specialmente), di colore fiamma

4451.g: ignition, i.e., (specially), smelting (figuratively, conflagration, calamity as a test)
4451.gl: a burning; the burning by which metals are roasted and reduced; by a figure drawn from a refiners fire; calamities or trials that test the character
4451.gi: accensione, cioè (specialmente), fusione (figurato, incendio, calamità come prova)

4452.g: an enclitic particle of indefiniteness; yet, even; used only in the comparative.
4452.gl: yet, even; used only in compound with words g3369, g3380, g3764, g3768, and g4455
4452.gi: particella enclitica di indefiniteness; ancora, anche; usata solo nel comparativo

4453.g: to barter (as a pedlar), i.e., to sell
4453.gi: barattare (come un mercante ambulante), cioè, vendere

4454.g: a "foal" or "filly", i.e., (specially), a young ass
4454.gl: a colt, the young of a horse; a young creature; of a young ass; an ass's colt
4454.gi: un "puledro" o "ginnetta", cioè (specialmente), un giovane asino

4455.g: at any time, i.e., (with negative particle) at no time
4455.gi: in qualsiasi momento, cioè (con particella negativa) mai

4456.g: to petrify, i.e., (figuratively) to indurate (render stupid or callous)
4456.gl: to cover with a thick skin, to harden by covering with a callus; metaphorically; to make the heart dull; to grow hard, callous, become dull, lose the power of understanding
4456.gi: petrificare, cioè, (figurato) indurire (rendere stupido o insensibile)

4457.gl: the covering with a callus; obtrusiveness of mental discernment, dulled perception; the mind of one has been blunted; of stubbornness, obduracy

4458.g: an enclitic particle of indefiniteness of manner; somehow or anyhow; used only in composition
4458.gl: by any means, at all, perhaps
4458.gi: particella enclitica di indefiniteness di modo; in qualche modo o comunque; usata solo in composizione

4459.g: an interrogative particle of manner; in what way? (sometimes the question is indirect, how?); also as exclamation, how much!
4459.gi: una particella interrogativa di modo; in che modo? (a volte la domanda è indiretta, come?); anche come esclamazione, quanto!

4461.g: my master, i.e rabbi, as an official title of honor
4461.gl: my great one, my honorable sir; rabbi, a title used by the jews to address their teachers (and also honor them when not addressing them)
4461.gi: mio maestro, cioè rabbino, come titolo onorifico ufficiale

4462.gl: master, chief, prince; rabboni is a title of honor mary used to address jesus

4463.g: to strike with a stick, i.e., bastinado
4463.gi: colpire con un bastone, cioè bastonare

4464.g: a stick or wand (as a cudgel, a cane or a baton of royalty)
4464.gl: a staff, a walking stick, a twig, rod, branch; a rod with which one is beaten; a staff; as used on a journey, or to lean upon, or by shepherds; when applied to kings; with a rod of iron, indicates the severest, most rigorous rule; a royal sceptre
4464.gi: un bastone o una verga (come un manganello, un bastone o un bastone di regalità)

4465.g: a rod- (the latin fasces) holder, i.e., a roman lictor (constable or executioner)
4465.gl: one who carries the rods i.e., the fasces; a lictor, a public official who bore the fasces or staff and other insignia of office before a magistrate
4465.gi: un portatore di verga (il latino fasces), cioè, un lictore romano (maresciallo o boia)

4466.gl: [associate ye, feed ye]; one of the ancestors of christ

4467.g: easy-going behavior, i.e., (by extension) a crime
4467.gl: a piece of knavery, rascality, villainy
4467.gi: comportamento accomodante, cioè, (per estensione) un crimine

4468.gl: ease in doing, faculty; levity or easiness in thinking or acting; love of a lazy effeminate life; unscrupulous, cunning, mischief

4469.g: o empty one, i.e., thou worthless (as a term of utter vilification)
4469.gl: empty, i.e., a senseless, empty headed man; a term of reproach used among the jews in the time of christ
4469.gi: o vuoto, cioè tu inutile (come termine di vilipendio totale)

4470.gl: a piece torn off; a bit of cloth; cloth

4471.g: rama (i.e., ramah), a place in palestine
4471.gl: [a hill]; a town of the tribe of benjamin, situated about 5 miles (8 km) north of jerusalem on the road to bethel
4471.gi: rama (cioè, ramah), un luogo in palestina

4472.g: to render besprinkled, i.e., asperse (ceremonially or figuratively)
4472.gl: to sprinkle; to cleanse by sprinkling, hence to purify, cleanse
4472.gi: rendere spruzzato, cioè aspergere (cerimonialmente o figurato)

4473.gl: a sprinkling (purification); blood of sprinkling; i.e., appointed for sprinkling (serving to purify)

4474.gl: to smite with a rod or staff; to smite in the face with the palm of the hand, to box the ear

4475.gl: a blow with a rod or staff or a scourge; a blow with the flat of the hand, a slap in the face, box the ear

4479.g: rebecca (i.e., ribkah), the wife of isaac
4479.gi: rebecca (cioè, ribkah), la moglie di isaac

4480.g: a rheda, i.e., four-wheeled carriage (wagon for riding)
4480.gl: a chariot, a type of vehicle having four wheels
4480.gi: una rheda, cioè, carro a quattro ruote (carro per andare a cavallo)

4481.gl: [the shrunken (as lifeless)]; the name of an idol worshipped secretly by the israelites in the wilderness

4482.g: for some tenses of which a prolonged form ???? <pronunciation strongs="hryoo'-o"/> is used to flow ("run"; as water)
4482.gi: per alcuni tempi del quale una forma prolungata ???? <pronunciation strongs="hryoo'-o"/> è usata per scorrere (correre; come acqua)

4483.g: to utter, i.e., speak or say

4484.gl: [breach]; an italian town situated on the bruttian coast, just at the southern entrance of the straits of messina

4485.g: something torn, i.e., a fragment (by implication and abstractly, a fall)
4485.gl: that which has been broken or rent asunder; a fracture, breach, cleft; rent clothes; fall, ruin
4485.gi: qualcosa di strappato, cioè un frammento (per implicazione e astrattamente, una caduta)

4486.g: to "break," "wreck" or "crack", i.e., (especially) to sunder (by separation of the parts; g2608 being its intensive (with the preposition in composition), and g2352 a shattering to minute fragments; but not a reduction to the constituent particles, like g3089) or disrupt, lacerate; by implication, to convulse (with spasms); figuratively, to give vent to joyful emotions
4486.gl: to rend, burst or break asunder, break up, break through; to tear in pieces; to break forth; into joy, of infants or dumb persons beginning to speak; to distort, convulse; of a demon causing convulsions in a man possessed; to dash down, hurl to the ground (a common occurrence in cases of demon possession and epilepsy)
4486.gi: "rompere", "distruggere" o "incrinare", cioè (specialmente) separare (per separazione delle parti; g2608 è la sua forma intensiva (con la preposizione in composizione), e g2352 una frantumazione in frammenti minuti; ma non una riduzione alle particelle costituenti, come g3089) o interrompere, lacerare; per implicazione, contrarsi (con spasmi); figurato, dare sfogo a emozioni gioiose

4487.g: an utterance (individually, collectively or specially),; by implication, a matter or topic (especially of narration, command or dispute); with a negative naught whatever
4487.gl: that which is or has been uttered by the living voice, thing spoken, word; any sound produced by the voice and having definite meaning; speech, discourse; what one has said; a series of words joined together into a sentence (a declaration of one's mind made in words); an utterance; a saying of any sort as a message, a narrative; concerning some occurrence; subject matter of speech, thing spoken of; so far forth as it is a matter of narration; so far as it is a matter of command; a matter of dispute, case at law
4487.gi: un enunciato (individualmente, collettivamente o specialmente); per implicazione, una questione o argomento (specialmente di narrazione, comando o disputa); con una negazione niente affatto

4488.gl: [head]; the son of zerubbabel in the genealogy of christ

4489.g: a speaker, i.e., (by implication) a forensic advocate
4489.gl: a speaker, an orator; of a forensic orator or advocate
4489.gi: un oratore, cioè (per implicazione) un avvocato forense

4491.gl: a root; that which like a root springs from a root, a sprout, shoot; metaphorically offspring, progeny

4492.gl: to cause to strike root, to strengthen with roots, to render firm, to fix, establish, cause a person or a thing to be thoroughly grounded

4493.g: a jerk (of the eye, i.e., (by analogy) an instant)
4493.gl: a throw, stroke, beat; a moment of time
4493.gi: un baleno (dell'occhio, cioè, (per analogia) un istante)

4494.g: to breeze up, i.e., (by analogy) to agitate (into waves)
4494.gl: to raise a breeze, put air in motion, whether for the sake of kindling a fire or cooling one's self; to blow up a fire; to fan, i.e., cool with a fan; to toss to and fro, to agitate; of the wind; of persons whose mind wavers in uncertainty between hope and fear, between doing and not doing a thing
4494.gi: alzarsi di vento, cioè (per analogia) agitare (in onde)

4495.gl: to cast, throw; throw down; to cast forward or before; to set down (with the suggestion of haste and want of care); to throw to the ground, prostrate

4496.g: to fling (properly, with a quick toss, thus differing from g0906, which denotes a deliberate hurl; and from ????? (see in g1614), which indicates an extended projection); by qualification, to deposit (as if a load); by extension, to disperse
4496.gl: to cast, throw; throw down; to cast forward or before; to set down (with the suggestion of haste and want of care); to throw to the ground, prostrate
4496.gi: lanciare (propriamente, con un rapido lancio, quindi diverso da g0906, che indica un lancio deliberato; e da ????? (vedi in g1614), che indica una proiezione estesa); per qualificazione, depositare (come se fosse un carico); per estensione, disperdere

4497.gl: [enlarger of the people]; the son of solomon by an ammonite princess naamah

4498.gl: [rose]; the name of a certain maid servant

4499.g: rhodus, an island of the mediterranean
4499.gl: [rosy]; a well known island of the cyclades opposite caria and lycia, with a rhodes as the capital city

4500.gi: con un fischio, cioè, con un fragore

4501.g: a sabre, i.e., a long and broad cutlass (any weapon of the kind, literally or figuratively)
4501.gl: a large sword; properly a long thracian javelin, also a kind of long sword wont to be worn on the right shoulder
4501.gi: sciabola, cioè, una lunga e larga spada (qualsiasi arma del genere, letteralmente o figurato)

4502.gl: [behold a son]; jacob's firstborn child by leah

4503.gl: [a female friend]; the ancestor of david and of christ

4505.gl: a swing, rush, force, trail, of a body in motion; a tract of way in a town shut in by buildings on both sides; a street, a lane

4506.g: compare g4511); to rush or draw (for oneself), i.e., rescue
4506.gl: to draw to one's self, to rescue, to deliver; the deliverer
4506.gi: cfr. g4511); precipitare o tirare (per sé), cioè, salvare

4507.gl: to make filthy, befoul; to defile, dishonor; to make filthy

4508.g: dirty, i.e., (relatively) cheap or shabby; morally, wicked
4508.gl: to be dirty, grow filthy; metaphorically to be defiled with iniquity
4508.gi: sporco, cioè (relativamente) economico o trascurabile; moralmente, malvagio

4510.g: to soil, i.e., (intransitively) to become dirty (morally)
4510.gl: to make filthy, defile, soil; to be filthy (morally)

4512.g: a fold (as drawing together), i.e., a wrinkle (especially on the face)
4512.gi: una piega (come insieme), cioè una ruga (soprattutto sul viso)

4513.gl: [of rome's strength]; the language spoken by the romans

4514.gl: a resident of the city of rome, a roman citizen

4515.g: romaistically, i.e., in the latin language
4515.gl: [of rome's strength]; the language spoken by the romans
4515.gi: in modo romano, cioè nella lingua latina

4516.g: strength; roma, the capital of italy
4516.gl: [strength]; the famous capital of the ancient world

4517.g: probably akin to g4506); to strengthen, i.e., (impersonal passive) have health (as a parting exclamation, good-bye)
4517.gl: to make strong, strengthen; to be strong, to thrive, prosper; in the usual formula in closing of a letter, farewell
4517.gi: probabilmente affine a g4506); rafforzare, cioè (passivo impersonale) avere salute (come saluto di congedo, arrivederci)

4518.g: thou hast left me; sabachthani (i.e., shebakthani), a cry of distress
4518.gi: mi hai abbandonato; sabachthani (cioè shebakthani), un grido di angoscia

4519.g: armies; sabaoth (i.e., tsebaoth), a military epithet of god
4519.gl: "lord of sabaoth"; lord of the armies of israel, as those who are under the leadership and protection of jehovah maintain his cause in war
4519.gi: eserciti; sabaoth (cioè tsebaoth), epiteto militare di Dio

4520.g: a "sabbatism", i.e., (figuratively) the repose of christianity (as a type of heaven)
4520.gl: a keeping sabbath; the blessed rest from toils and troubles looked for in the age to come by the true worshippers of god and true christians
4520.gi: un "sabbatismo", cioè (figurato) il riposo del cristianesimo (come tipo di paradiso)

4521.g: the sabbath (i.e., shabbath), or day of weekly repose from secular avocations (also the observance or institution itself); by extension, a se'nnight, i.e., the interval between two sabbaths; likewise the plural in all the above applications
4521.gl: the seventh day of each week which was a sacred festival on which the israelites were required to abstain from all work; the institution of the sabbath, the law for keeping holy every seventh day of the week; a single sabbath, sabbath day; seven days, a week
4521.gi: il sabato (cioè shabbath), o giorno di riposo settimanale dalle occupazioni mondane (anche l'osservanza o l'istituzione stessa); per estensione, una settimana, cioè l'intervallo tra due sabati; similmente il plurale in tutte le applicazioni sopra menzionate

4522.gl: a large fishing net, a drag net

4523.g: a sadducaean (i.e., tsadokian), or follower of a certain heretical israelite
4523.gl: [the righteous]; a religious party at the time of christ among the jews, who denied that the oral law was a revelation of god to the israelites, and who deemed the written law alone to be obligatory on the nation, as the divine authority
4523.gi: un sadduceo (cioè tsadokiano), o seguace di un certo eretico israelita

4524.gl: [just]; a descendant of zerubbabel in the genealogy of christ

4525.g: to wag (as a dog its tail fawningly), i.e., (generally) to shake (figuratively, disturb)
4525.gl: to wag the tail; of dogs; metaphorically; to flatter, fawn upon; to move (the mind of one); agreeably; to agitate, disturb, trouble
4525.gi: agitare (come un cane la coda in modo affettuoso), cioè (genericamente) scuotere (figurato, disturbare)

4526.g: "sack"-cloth, i.e., mohair (the material or garments made of it, worn as a sign of grief)
4526.gl: a sack; a receptacle for holding or carrying various things, as money, food, etc.; a course cloth, a dark course stuff made especially from the hair of animals; a garment of the like material, and clinging to the person like a sack, which was wont to be worn (or drawn over the tunic instead of the cloak or mantle) by mourners, penitents, suppliants and also by those who like the hebrew prophets, lead an austere life
4526.gi: "sack"-cloth, cioè tessuto di capra (il materiale o gli indumenti fatti di esso, indossati come segno di lutto)

4527.gl: [sprout]; the son of arphaxad, and father of eber

4528.gl: [i have asked of god]; the son of jeconiah in the genealogy of christ

4529.gl: [salt]; a principal city at the east end of the island of cyprus

4530.gl: [peace]; a well known town 8 miles (11 km) south of scythopolis

4531.g: to waver, i.e., agitate, rock, topple or (by implication) destroy; figuratively, to disturb, incite
4531.gl: a motion produced by winds, storms, waves, etc; to agitate or shake; to cause to totter; to shake thoroughly, of a measure filled by shaking its contents together; to shake down, overthrow; to cast down from one's (secure and happy) state; to move, agitate the mind, to disturb one
4531.gi: vacillare, cioè agitare, scuotere, rovesciare o (per implicazione) distruggere; figurato, disturbare, istigare

4532.g: salem (i.e., shalem), a place in palestine
4532.gl: [peace]; the place where melchizedek was king and thought to be the ancient name of jerusalem
4532.gi: Salem (cioè Shalem), un luogo in Palestina

4533.gl: [raiment, a garment]; the father of boaz in the genealogy of christ

4534.gl: [clothed]; a bold promontory on the east point of the island of crete

4535.gl: the tossing or swell of the sea

4537.g: to trumpet, i.e., sound a blast (literally or figuratively)
4537.gi: suonare la tromba, cioè emettere un suono (letteralmente o figurato)

4539.gl: [peaceful]; the wife of zebedee and the mother of the apostle james the elder and john

4540.g: samaria (i.e., shomeron), a city and region of palestine
4540.gl: [guardianship]; a territory in palestine, which had samaria as its capital
4540.gi: Samaria (cioè Shomeron), una città e regione della Palestina

4541.g: a samarite, i.e., inhabitant of samaria
4541.gl: a samaritan,; an inhabitant of the city of samaria; an inhabitant of the region of samaria
4541.gi: un samaritano, cioè abitante di Samaria

4542.g: a samaritess, i.e., woman of samaria
4542.gi: una samaritana, cioè donna di Samaria

4543.g: samo-thrace (samos of thrace), an island in the mediterranean
4543.gl: [a sign of rags]; an island on the aegean sea, about 38 miles (60 km) from the coast of thrace at the mouth of the river hebrus
4543.gi: samotracia (samos della tracia), un'isola nel mediterraneo

4544.g: samus, an island of the mediterranean
4544.gl: [a sandy bluff]; an island off that part of asia minor where ionia touches caria

4545.gl: [his name is of god]; the son of elkanah and hannah, the last of the judges, a distinguished prophet, and a founder of the prophetic order, he gave the jews there first kings, saul, david

4546.gl: [like the sun]; a famous judge of israel renowned for his physical strength

4547.gl: a sandal, a sole made of wood or leather, covering the bottom of the foot and bound on with thongs

4549.g: saul (i.e., shaul), the jewish name of paul
4549.gl: [desired]; the jewish name of the apostle paul; the son of kish and the first king of israel
4549.gi: Saul (cioè Shaul), il nome ebraico di Paolo

4550.gl: rotten, putrefied; corrupted by one and no longer fit for use, worn out; of poor quality, bad, unfit for use, worthless

4553.gl: a braided rope, a band; a basket, a basket made of ropes, a hamper

4554.g: sardis, a place in asia minor
4554.gl: [red ones]; a luxurious city in asia minor, the capital of lydia
4554.gi: sardi, un luogo in asia minore

4555.g: sardine (g3037 being implied), i.e., a gem, so called
4555.gl: a sardius, a precious stone of which there are two types, the former is called a carnelian (because flesh colored) and the latter a sard
4555.gi: sardina (g3037 implicito), cioè una gemma, così chiamata

4556.g: sardian (3037 being implied), i.e., (as noun) the gem so called
4556.gl: a sardius, a precious stone of which there are two types, the former is called a carnelian (because flesh colored) and the latter a sard
4556.gi: sardio (3037 implicito), cioè (come nome) la gemma così chiamata

4557.g: a "sardonyx", i.e., the gem so called
4557.gl: a sardonyx, a precious stone marked by the red colors of the carnelian (sard) and the white of the onyx
4557.gi: un "sardonice", cioè la gemma così chiamata

4558.g: sarepta (i.e., tsarephath), a place in palestine
4558.gl: [smelting]; the greek name for zarephath, a phoenician town between tyre and sidon, but nearer sidon
4558.gi: sarepta (cioè tsarefath), un luogo in palestina

4559.g: pertaining to flesh, i.e., (by extension) bodily, temporal, or (by implication) animal, unregenerate
4559.gl: fleshly, carnal; having the nature of flesh, i.e., under the control of the animal appetites; governed by mere human nature not by the spirit of god; having its seat in the animal nature or aroused by the animal nature; human: with the included idea of depravity; pertaining to the flesh; to the body: related to birth, linage, etc
4559.gi: relativo alla carne, cioè (per estensione) corporeo, temporale, o (per implicazione) animale, non rigenerato

4560.g: similar to flesh, i.e., (by analogy) soft
4560.gl: fleshly, consisting of flesh, composed of flesh; pertaining to the body (as earthly and perishable material); wholly given up to the flesh, rooted in the flesh as it were
4560.gi: simile alla carne, cioè (per analogia) morbido

4561.g: flesh (as stripped of the skin), i.e., (strictly) the meat of an animal (as food), or (by extension) the body (as opposed to the soul (or spirit), or as the symbol of what is external, or as the means of kindred), or (by implication) human nature (with its frailties (physically or morally) and passions), or (specially), a human being (as such)
4561.gl: flesh (the soft substance of the living body, which covers the bones and is permeated with blood) of both man and beasts; the body; the body of a man; used of natural or physical origin, generation or relationship; born of natural generation; the sensuous nature of man, "the animal nature"; without any suggestion of depravity; the animal nature with cravings which incite to sin; the physical nature of man as subject to suffering; a living creature (because possessed of a body of flesh) whether man or beast; the flesh, denotes mere human nature, the earthly nature of man apart from divine influence, and therefore prone to sin and opposed to god
4561.gi: carne (come privata della pelle), cioè (strettamente) la carne di un animale (come cibo), o (per estensione) il corpo (in opposizione all'anima (o spirito), o come simbolo di ciò che è esterno, o come mezzo di parentela), o (per implicazione) la natura umana (con le sue debolezze (fisiche o morali) e passioni), o (specialmente), un essere umano (come tale)

4562.gl: [intertwined]; the son of reu in the genealogy of christ

4564.g: sarra (i.e., sarah), the wife of abraham

4565.g: saron (i.e., sharon), a district of palestine
4565.gl: [plain, level]; a level region extending from caesarea of palestine as far as joppa, abounding in good pasture and famous for its fertility
4565.gi: sharon (cioè sharon), un distretto di palestina

4566.gl: adversary (one who opposes another in purpose or act), the name given to; the prince of evil spirits, the inveterate adversary of god and christ; he incites apostasy from god and to sin; circumventing men by his wiles; the worshippers of idols are said to be under his control; by his demons he is able to take possession of men and inflict them with diseases; by god's assistance he is overcome; on christ's return from heaven he will be bound with chains for a thousand years, but when the thousand years are finished he will walk the earth in yet greater power, but shortly after will be given over to eternal punishment; a satan-like man

4567.gl: adversary (one who opposes another in purpose or act), the name given to; the prince of evil spirits, the inveterate adversary of god and christ; he incites apostasy from god and to sin; circumventing men by his wiles; the worshippers of idols are said to be under his control; by his demons he is able to take possession of men and inflict them with diseases; by god's assistance he is overcome; on christ's return from heaven he will be bound with chains for a thousand years, but when the thousand years are finished he will walk the earth in yet greater power, but shortly after will be given over to eternal punishment; a satan-like man

4568.g: a certain measure for things dry
4568.gl: a kind of dry measure, 3 gallons (14 liters)
4568.gi: una certa misura per cose secche

4569.g: saulus (i.e., shaul), the jewish name of paul
4569.gl: [desired]; the jewish name of the apostle paul
4569.gi: saulo (cioè shaul), il nome ebraico di paolo

4570.gl: to extinguish, quench; of fire or things on fire; to be quenched, to go out; metaphorically to quench, to suppress, stifle; of divine influence

4573.gl: to fear, be afraid; to honor religiously, to worship

4574.g: something adored, i.e., an object of worship (god, altar, etc)
4574.gl: whatever is religiously honored, an object of worship; of temples, altars, statues, idolatrous images
4574.gi: qualcosa di adorato, cioè un oggetto di culto (Dio, altare, ecc.)

4575.g: venerable (august), i.e., (as noun) a title of the roman emperor, or (as adjective) imperial
4575.gl: reverend, venerable; the title of the roman emperors; augustan, i.e., taking its name from the emperor; a title of honor which used to be given certain legions, or cohorts, or battalions, "for valour"
4575.gi: venerabile (augusto), cioè (come sostantivo) un titolo dell'imperatore romano, o (come aggettivo) imperiale

4577.g: akin to g0138); a chain (as binding or drawing)
4577.gl: a line, a rope; a chain
4577.gi: affine a g0138); una catena (come legame o trazione)

4578.g: a commotion, i.e., (of the air) a gale, (of the ground) an earthquake
4578.gl: a shaking, a commotion; a tempest; an earthquake
4578.gi: una commozione, cioè (dell'aria) una bufera, (del terreno) un terremoto

4579.g: to rock (vibrate, properly, sideways or to and fro), i.e., (generally) to agitate (in any direction; cause to tremble); figuratively, to throw into a tremor (of fear or concern)
4579.gl: to shake, agitate, cause to tremble; of men, to be thrown into a tremor, to quake for fear; metaphorically to agitate the mind
4579.gi: dondolare (vibrare, propriamente, lateralmente o avanti e indietro), cioè (genericamente) agitare (in qualsiasi direzione; causare a tremare); figurato, gettare in un tremito (di paura o preoccupazione)

4581.gl: [white light]; a city of syria near the mouth of the orontes, about 16 miles (25 km) from antioch

4583.gl: to be moon-struck, to be a lunatic; to be epileptic; epilepsy being supposed to return and increase with the increase of the moon
4583.gi: essere colpito dalla luna, cioè pazzo

4584.gl: [harkeners, my report]; the father of mattathias in the genealogy of christ

4586.gl: august, venerable, reverend; to be venerated for character, honorable; of persons; of deeds

4587.gl: the characteristic of a thing or person which entitles to reverence and respect, dignity, majesty, sanctity; honor, purity

4588.gl: [earth-born, born a wonder]; surnamed paulus, a deputy or proconsul of cyprus and converted to christianity by paul

4589.gl: [compensation]; the third son of adam and the father of enos

4591.gl: to give a sign, to signify, indicate; to make known

4592.g: an indication, especially ceremonially or supernaturally
4592.gl: a sign, mark, token; that by which a person or a thing is distinguished from others and is known; a sign, prodigy, portent, i.e., an unusual occurrence, transcending the common course of nature; of signs portending remarkable events soon to happen; of miracles and wonders by which god authenticates the men sent by him, or by which men prove that the cause they are pleading is god's

4593.gl: to mark, to note, distinguish by marking; to mark or note for one's self

4594.g: on the (i.e., this) day (or night current or just passed); generally, now (i.e., at present, hitherto)
4594.gl: this (very) day); what has happened today
4594.gi: nel (cioè questo) giorno (o notte corrente o appena passato); generalmente, ora (cioè al presente, finora)

4595.gl: to make corrupt, to destroy; to become corrupt, corrupted, rotten

4596.g: seric, i.e., silken (neuter as noun, a silky fabric)
4596.gl: made of silk; silk, i.e., the fabric, silken garments
4596.gi: serico, cioè, setoso (neutro come sostantivo, un tessuto setoso)

4599.g: to strengthen, i.e., (figuratively) confirm (in spiritual knowledge and power)
4599.gl: to make strong, strengthen; of one's soul
4599.gi: rafforzare, cioè (figurato) confermare (nella conoscenza e potere spirituale)

4600.g: the jaw-bone, i.e., (by implication) the cheek or side of the face
4600.gi: la mandibola, cioè (per implicazione) la guancia o il lato del viso

4601.gl: to keep silence, hold one's peace; to be kept in silence, be concealed

4605.g: sidon (i.e., tsidon), a place in palestine
4605.gl: [hunting]; an ancient and wealthy city of phoenicia, on the east coast of the mediterranean sea, less than 20 miles (30 km) north of tyre
4605.gi: sidone (cioè, tsidon), un luogo in palestina

4606.g: a sidonian, i.e., inhabitant of sidon
4606.gl: an inhabitant of sidon, a sidonian
4606.gi: un sidonio, cioè abitante di Sidone

4607.g: a dagger-man or assassin; a freebooter (jewish fanatic outlawed by the romans)
4607.gl: an assassin; one who carries a dagger or short sword under his clothing, that he may kill secretly and treacherously any one he wishes to; a cutthroat
4607.gi: un uomo con pugnale o assassino; un fuorilegge (fanatico ebreo bandito dai romani)

4608.g: an intoxicant, i.e., intensely fermented liquor
4608.gl: strong drink, an intoxicating beverage, different from wine; it was a artificial product, made of a mixture of sweet ingredients, whether derived from grain and vegetables, or from the juice of fruits (dates), or a decoction of honey
4608.gi: un intossicante, cioè, liquore intensamente fermentato

4609.gl: [woody]; a roman citizen, the companion of the apostle paul on several of his missionary journeys

4610.gl: [woody]; a roman citizen, the companion of the apostle paul on several of his missionary journeys

4611.g: siloam (i.e., shiloach), a pool of jerusalem
4611.gl: [sent]; the pool of siloam, a fountain of water in jerusalem (also called shiloah in isaiah 8:6); the tower of siloam (may have been a tower near or over the pool of siloam)
4611.gi: Siloa (cioè Siloah), una piscina di Gerusalemme

4612.g: a semicinctium or half-girding, i.e., narrow covering (apron)
4612.gl: a narrow apron, or linen covering, which workmen and servants were accustomed to wear
4612.gi: un semicinto o mezzo-cintura, cioè, copertura stretta (grembiule)

4613.g: simon (i.e., shimon), the name of nine israelites
4613.gl: [a rock, stone]; peter was one of the apostles; simon called zelotes or the kanaites; simon, father of judas who betrayed jesus; simon magus, the samaritan wizard; simon the tanner, acts 10; simon the pharisee, luke 7:4044; simon of cyrene who carried the cross of christ; simon the cousin of jesus, the son of cleophas; simon the leper, so called to distinguish him from others of the same name
4613.gi: Simone (cioè Shimon), il nome di nove israeliti

4614.g: sina (i.e., sinai), a mountain in arabia
4614.gl: [thorny]; a mountain or rather a mountainous region in the peninsula of arabia petraea, made famous by the giving of the mosaic law
4614.gi: Sina (cioè Sinai), una montagna in Arabia

4615.gl: mustard, the name of a plant which in middle eastern countries grows from a very small seed and attains to the height of a tree, 10 feet (3 m) and more; hence a very small quantity of a thing is likened to a mustard seed, and also a thing which grows to a remarkable size

4616.g: byssos, i.e., bleached linen (the cloth or a garment of it)
4616.gl: linen cloth, especially that which was fine and costly, in which the bodies of the dead were wrapped; thing made of fine cloth; of a light and loose garment worn at night over a naked body
4616.gi: bisso, cioè, lino bianco (il tessuto o un indumento di esso)

4617.gl: to sift, shake in a sieve; figuratively by inward agitation to try one's faith to the verge of overthrow

4620.g: a grain-measure, i.e., (by implication) ration (allowance of food)
4620.gi: una misura di cereali, cioè (per implicazione) razione (dotazione di cibo)

4622.g: sion (i.e., tsijon), a hill of jerusalem; figuratively, the church (militant or triumphant)
4622.gl: [a parched place]; the hill on which the higher and more ancient part of jerusalem was built; the southwestern most and highest of the hills on which the city was built; often used of the entire city of jerusalem; since jerusalem because the temple stood there, was called the dwelling place of god
4622.gi: Sion (cioè Tzion), una collina di Gerusalemme; figurato, la chiesa (militante o trionfante)

4623.g: to be dumb (but not deaf also, like 2974 properly); figuratively, to be calm (as quiet water)
4623.gl: to be silent, hold one's peace; used of one's silence because dumb; metaphorically of a calm, quiet sea
4623.gi: essere muto (ma non anche sordo, come 2974 propriamente); figurato, essere calmo (come acqua tranquilla)

4624.g: to entrap, i.e., trip up (figuratively, stumble (transitively) or entice to sin, apostasy or displeasure)
4624.gl: to put a stumbling block or impediment in the way, upon which another may trip and fall, metaphorically to offend; to entice to sin; to cause a person to begin to distrust and desert one whom he ought to trust and obey; to cause to fall away; to be offended in one, i.e., to see in another what i disapprove of and what hinders me from acknowledging his authority; to cause one to judge unfavorably or unjustly of another; since one who stumbles or whose foot gets entangled feels annoyed; to cause one displeasure at a thing; to make indignant; to be displeased, indignant
4624.gi: intrappolare, cioè far inciampare (figurato, far sbilanciare (transitivamente) o indurre al peccato, all'apostasia o al dispiacere)

4625.g: a trap-stick (bent sapling), i.e., snare (figuratively, cause of displeasure or sin)
4625.gl: the movable stick or trigger of a trap, a trap stick; a trap, snare; any impediment placed in the way and causing one to stumble or fall, (a stumbling block, occasion of stumbling) i.e., a rock which is a cause of stumbling; figuratively applied to jesus christ, whose person and career were so contrary to the expectations of the jews concerning the messiah, that they rejected him and by their obstinacy made shipwreck of their salvation; any person or thing by which one is (entrapped) drawn into error or sin
4625.gi: un bastone-trappola (tremolo piegato), cioè una trappola (figurato, causa di dispiacere o peccato)

4627.g: a "skiff" (as if dug out), or yawl (carried aboard a large vessel for landing)
4627.gl: anything dug out, hollow vessel, trough, tray, tub; of a boat
4627.gi: una "sciffo" (come se scavata), o yawl (portata a bordo di una grande nave per sbarcare)

4628.g: through the idea of leanness); the leg (as lank)
4628.gl: the leg, from the hip to the toes inclusive
4628.gi: attraverso l'idea di magrezza); la gamba (come magra)

4630.gl: [mind reader]; a certain chief priest residing at ephesus

4631.gl: any apparatus, equipment, or furniture; of the utensils or tackling of a ship

4632.g: a vessel, implement, equipment or apparatus (literally or figuratively (specially, a wife as contributing to the usefulness of the husband))
4632.gl: a vessel; an implement; in the plural; household utensils, domestic gear; the tackle and armament of vessels, used specifically of sails and ropes; metaphorically; a man of quality, a chosen instrument; in a bad sense, an assistant in accomplishing an evil deed
4632.gi: un vaso, strumento, attrezzatura o apparecchio (letteralmente o figurato (specialmente, una moglie che contribuisce all'utilità del marito))

4633.g: a tent or cloth hut (literally or figuratively)
4633.gl: tent, tabernacle, (made of green boughs, or skins or other materials); of that well known movable temple of god after the pattern of which the temple at jerusalem was built
4633.gi: una tenda o capanna di stoffa (letteralmente o figurato)

4634.g: the festival of tabernacles (so called from the custom of erecting booths for temporary homes)
4634.gl: the construction of a tabernacle or tabernacles; the feast of tabernacles
4634.gi: la festa delle capanne (così chiamata dal costume di erigere capanne per abitazioni temporanee)

4635.gl: a tentmaker; one that makes small portable tents, of leather or cloth of goat's hair or linen, for the use of travellers

4636.g: a hut or temporary residence, i.e., (figuratively) the human body (as the abode of the spirit)
4636.gl: a tabernacle, a tent; metaphorically of the human body, in which the soul dwells as in a tent, and which is taken down at death
4636.gi: una capanna o residenza temporanea, cioè (figurato) il corpo umano (come dimora dello spirito)

4637.g: to tent or encamp, i.e., (figuratively) to occupy (as a mansion) or (specially), to reside (as god did in the tabernacle of old, a symbol of protection and communion)
4637.gl: to fix one's tabernacle, have one's tabernacle, abide (or live) in a tabernacle (or tent), tabernacle; to dwell
4637.gi: tendere o accamparsi, cioè, (figurato) occupare (come una magione) o (specialmente), risiedere (come Dio faceva nella tenda d'un tempo, simbolo di protezione e comunione)

4638.g: an encampment, i.e., (figuratively) the temple (as god's residence), the body (as a tenement for the soul)
4638.gl: a tent, a tabernacle; of the temple as god's habitation; of the tabernacle of the covenant; metaphorically of the human body as the dwelling of the soul
4638.gi: un accampamento, cioè (figurato) il tempio (come dimora di Dio), il corpo (come abitazione per l'anima)

4639.g: "shade" or a shadow (literally or figuratively (darkness of error or an adumbration))
4639.gl: shadow; shade caused by the interception of light; an image cast by an object and representing the form of that object; a sketch, outline, adumbration
4639.gi: "ombra" o un'ombra (letteralmente o figurato (oscurità di errore o una figura))

4640.g: to jump, i.e., sympathetically move (as the quickening of a fetus)
4640.gi: saltare, cioè, muoversi simpateticamente (come il movimento del feto)

4641.gi: durezza di cuore, cioè (specialmente), mancanza di percezione (spirituale)

4642.g: dry, i.e., hard or tough (figuratively, harsh, severe)
4642.gl: hard, harsh, rough, stiff; of men: metaphorically harsh, stern, hard; of things: violent, rough, offensive, intolerable
4642.gi: secco, cioè, duro o resistente (figurato, aspro, severo)

4645.gl: to make hard, harden; metaphorically; to render obstinate, stubborn; to be hardened; to become obstinate or stubborn

4646.gl: crooked, curved; metaphorically; perverse, wicked; unfair, surly, froward

4647.g: withered at the front, i.e., a point or prickle (figuratively, a bodily annoyance or disability)
4647.gl: a pointed piece of wood, a pale, a stake; a sharp stake, splinter
4647.gi: appassito davanti, cioè un punto o una spina (figurato, un disturbo o disabilità fisica)

4648.g: to take aim at (spy), i.e., (figuratively) regard
4648.gl: to look at, observe, contemplate; to mark; to fix one's eyes upon, direct one's attention to, any one; to look to, take heed to thyself

4649.g: perhaps akin to g4626 through the idea of concealment; compare g4629); a watch (sentry or scout), i.e., (by implication) a goal
4649.gl: an observer, a watchman; the distant mark looked at, the goal or end one has in view
4649.gi: forse affine a g4626 attraverso l'idea di occultamento; cfr. g4629); una guardia (sentinella o esploratore), cioè, (per implicazione) un obiettivo

4650.g: to dissipate, i.e., (figuratively) put to flight, waste, be liberal
4650.gl: to scatter; of those who, routed or terror stricken or driven by some other impulses, fly in every direction; to scatter abroad (what others may collect for themselves), or one dispensing blessings literally
4650.gi: dissipare, cioè (figurato) mettere in fuga, sprecare, essere generoso

4651.gl: a scorpion, the name of a little animal, somewhat resembling a lobster, which in warm regions lurk, especially in stone walls; it has a poisonous sting in its tail

4652.gl: full of darkness, covered with darkness

4653.gl: darkness; the darkness due to want of light; metaphorically used of ignorance of divine things, and its associated wickedness, and the resultant misery in hell

4654.gl: to cover with darkness, to darken; to be covered with darkness, be darkened; of heavenly bodies as deprived of light; metaphorically; of the eyes; of the understanding; of the mind

4655.gl: darkness; of night darkness; of darkened eyesight or blindness; metaphorically; of ignorance respecting divine things and human duties, and the accompanying ungodliness and immorality, together with their consequent misery in hell; persons in whom darkness becomes visible and holds sway

4656.g: to obscure or blind (literally or figuratively)
4656.gl: to darken, cover with darkness; metaphorically to darken or blind the mind

4657.g: what is thrown to the dogs, i.e., refuse (ordure)
4657.gl: any refuse, as the excrement of animals, offscourings, rubbish, dregs; of things worthless and detestable
4657.gi: ciò che viene gettato ai cani, cioè, rifiuti (sporcizia)

4658.g: a scythene or scythian, i.e., (by implication) a savage
4658.gl: [rude, rough]; a scythian, an inhabitant of scythia or modern day russia; by the more civilised nations of antiquity the scythians were regarded as the wildest of barbarians
4658.gi: uno scita o scitico, cioè, (per implicazione) un selvaggio

4659.g: angry-visaged, i.e., gloomy or affecting a mournful appearance
4659.gl: of a sad and gloomy countenance
4659.gi: dal viso arrabbiato, cioè, tetro o che assume un aspetto triste

4660.gl: to skin, flay; to rend, mangle; to vex, trouble, annoy; to give one's self trouble, trouble one's self

4661.g: something stripped (as a hide), i.e., booty
4661.gl: a (beast's) skin stripped off, a pelt; the weapons and valuables stripped off from an enemy, spoils
4661.gi: qualcosa di sfilacciato (come una pelle), cioè, bottino

4662.gi: mangiato dai vermi, cioè, malato di vermi

4663.gl: a worm, spec. that kind which preys upon dead bodies
4663.gi: una larva, un verme o un lombrico

4665.g: the emerald or green gem so called
4665.gl: a transparent precious stone noted especially for its light green color
4665.gi: lo smeraldo o gemma verde così chiamata

4666.gl: myrrh, a bitter gum and costly perfume which exudes from a certain tree or shrub in arabia and ethiopia, or is obtained by incisions made in the bark: as an antiseptic it was used for embalming

4667.g: smyrna, a place in asia minor
4667.gl: [myrrh]; an ionian city of asia minor, on the aegean sea, 40 miles (65 km) north of ephesus
4667.gi: Smirne, un luogo in Asia Minore

4668.gl: of or belonging to smyrna, an inhabitant of smyrna

4669.g: to tincture with myrrh, i.e., embitter (as a narcotic)
4669.gl: to be like myrrh; to mix and so flavor with myrrh; wine with myrrh: i.e., wine flavored with myrrh
4669.gi: tingere con mirra, cioè amareggiare (come narcotico)

4670.g: sodoma (i.e., sedom), a place in palestine
4670.gl: [burning]; a city destroyed by the lord raining fire and brimstone on it; metaphorically jerusalem revelation 11:8
4670.gi: Sodoma (cioè, Sedom), un luogo in Palestina

4672.g: solomon (i.e., shelomoh), the son of david
4672.gl: [peaceful]; the son of david and was the wisest and richest king that ever lived

4673.g: a funereal receptacle (urn, coffin), i.e., (by analogy) a bier
4673.gl: an urn or receptacle for keeping the bones of the dead; the funeral couch or bier on which the jews carried their dead forth to burial
4673.gi: un contenitore funerario (urna, bara), cioè (per analogia) una barella

4676.g: a sudarium (sweat-cloth), i.e., towel (for wiping the perspiration from the face, or binding the face of a corpse)
4676.gl: a handkerchief; a cloth for wiping perspiration from the face and for cleaning the nose and also used in swathing the head of a corpse
4676.gi: un sudario (panno per il sudore), cioè asciugamano (per asciugare il sudore dal viso, o per avvolgere il volto di un cadavere)

4677.gl: [a lily]; one of the women who ministered to christ

4678.g: wisdom (higher or lower, worldly or spiritual)
4678.gl: wisdom, broad and full of intelligence; used of the knowledge of very diverse matters; the wisdom which belongs to men; specifically the varied knowledge of things human and divine, acquired by acuteness and experience, and summed up in maxims and proverbs; the science and learning; the act of interpreting dreams and always giving the sagest advice; the intelligence evinced in discovering the meaning of some mysterious number or vision; skill in the management of affairs; devout and proper prudence in intercourse with men not disciples of christ, skill and discretion in imparting christian truth; the knowledge and practice of the requisites for godly and upright living; supreme intelligence, such as belongs to god; to christ; the wisdom of god as evinced in forming and executing counsels in the formation and government of the world and the scriptures
4678.gi: saggezza (più alta o più bassa, terrena o spirituale)

4679.g: to render wise; in a sinister acceptation, to form "sophisms", i.e., continue plausible error
4679.gl: to make wise, teach; to become wise, to have understanding; to invent, play the sophist; to devise cleverly or cunningly
4679.gi: rendere saggio; in un'accezione negativa, formare "sofismi", cioè continuare un errore plausibile

4680.gl: wise; skilled, expert: of artificers; wise, skilled in letters, cultivated, learned; of the greek philosophers and orators; of jewish theologians; of christian teachers; forming the best plans and using the best means for their execution

4681.gl: [scarceness]; the whole peninsula south of the pyrenees

4682.g: apparently strengthened from g4685 through the idea of spasmodic contraction); to mangle, i.e., convluse with epilepsy
4682.gi: apparentemente rafforzato da g4685 attraverso l'idea di contrazione spasmica); mutilare, cioè convulsionare con l'epilessia

4683.g: to wrap tightly in cloths (especially a new born baby)
4683.gl: to swathe (an infant after the middle eastern custom), to wrap in swaddling clothes (especially an infant just born)
4683.gi: avvolgere strettamente in panni (specialmente un neonato)

4684.gl: to live luxuriously, lead a voluptuous life, (give one's self to pleasure)

4686.g: a coil (spira, "spire"), i.e., (figuratively) a mass of men (a roman military cohort; also (by analogy) a squad of levitical janitors)
4686.gl: anything rolled into a circle or ball, anything wound, rolled up, folded together; a military cohort; the tenth part of legion; about 600 men i.e., legionaries; if auxiliaries either 500 or 1000; a maniple, or the thirtieth part of a legion; any band, company, or detachment, of soldiers
4686.gi: una spirale (spira, "girella"), cioè (figurato) una massa di uomini (una coorte militare romana; anche (per analogia) una squadra di inservienti levitici)

4687.g: to scatter, i.e., sow (literally or figuratively)
4687.gl: to sow, scatter, seed; metaphorically of proverbial sayings

4688.g: a speculator, i.e., military scout (spy or (by extension) life-guardsman)
4688.gl: a spy, scout; under the emperors an attendant and member of the body guard, employed as messengers, watchers, and executioners; the name is transferred to an attendant of herod antipas that acted as executioner
4688.gi: uno speculatore, cioè esploratore militare (spia o (per estensione) guardia del corpo)

4689.g: to pour out as a libation, i.e., (figuratively) to devote (one's life or blood, as a sacrifice) ("spend")
4689.gl: to pour out as a drink offering, make a libation; in the new testament to be offered as a libation; figuratively used of one whose blood is poured out in a violent death for the cause of god
4689.gi: versare come libazione, cioè (figurato) dedicare (la propria vita o il proprio sangue, come sacrificio) ("spendere")

4690.g: something sown, i.e., seed (including the male "sperm"); by implication, offspring; specially, a remnant (figuratively, as if kept over for planting)
4690.gl: from which a plant germinates; the seed i.e., the grain or kernel which contains within itself the germ of the future plants; of the grains or kernels sown; metaphorically a seed i.e., a residue, or a few survivors reserved as the germ of a new race (just as seed is kept from the harvest for the sowing); the semen virile; the product of this semen, seed, children, offspring, progeny; family, race, posterity; whatever possesses vital force or life giving power; of divine energy of the holy spirit operating within the soul by which we are regenerated
4690.gi: qualcosa seminato, cioè seme (incluso lo sperma maschile); per implicazione, prole; specialmente, un residuo (figurato, come se fosse conservato per la semina)

4691.g: a seed-picker (as the crow), i.e., (figuratively) a sponger, loafer (specially, a gossip or trifler in talk)
4691.gl: picking up seed; of birds, especially of the crow or daw that picks up grain in fields; metaphorically; lounging about the market place and picking up a substance by whatever may chance to fall from the loads of merchandise; hence, beggarly, abject, vile, (a parasite); getting a living by flattery and bufferoonery; an empty talker, babbler
4691.gi: un raccoglitore di semi (come il corvo), cioè (figurato) un parassita, un ozioso (specialmente, un pettegolo o chi si diletta in chiacchiere futili)

4692.g: to "speed" ("study"), i.e., urge on (diligently or earnestly); by implication, to await eagerly
4692.gl: to haste, make haste; to desire earnestly
4692.gi: accelerare ("studiare"), cioè spingere (con diligenza o zelo); per implicazione, attendere con impazienza

4693.g: a cavern; by implication, a hiding-place or resort
4693.gi: una caverna; per implicazione, un nascondiglio o un rifugio

4694.g: a ledge or reef of rock in the sea
4694.gl: a rock in the sea, ledge, reef; metaphorically of men who by their conduct damage others morally, wreck them as it were
4694.gi: una sporgenza o scoglio di roccia nel mare

4695.g: to stain or soil (literally or figuratively)

4696.g: a stain or blemish, i.e., (figuratively) defect, disgrace
4696.gl: a spot; a fault, moral blemish; of base and gluttonous men
4696.gi: una macchia o un difetto, cioè (figurato) difetto, disonore

4697.g: to have the bowels yearn, i.e., (figuratively) feel sympathy, to pity
4697.gl: to be moved as to one's bowels, hence to be moved with compassion, have compassion (for the bowels were thought to be the seat of love and pity)
4697.gi: avere le viscere commuoversi, cioè (figurato) provare simpatia, avere pietà

4698.g: an intestine (plural); figuratively, pity or sympathy
4698.gl: bowels, intestines, (the heart, lungs, liver, etc.); bowels; the bowels were regarded as the seat of the more violent passions, such as anger and love; but by the hebrews as the seat of the tenderer affections, especially kindness, benevolence, compassion; hence our heart (tender mercies, affections, etc.); a heart in which mercy resides
4698.gi: un intestino (plurale); figurato, pietà o simpatia

4700.gl: ashes: placed on sackcloth as a token of grief

4702.g: sown, i.e., (neuter plural) a planted field
4702.gl: fit for sowing, sown; sown fields, growing crops
4702.gi: seminato, cioè (neutro plurale) un campo coltivato

4703.g: a scattering (of seed), i.e., (concretely) seed (as sown)
4703.gi: una dispersione (di seme), cioè (concretamente) seme (come seminato)

4704.g: to use speed, i.e., to make effort, be prompt or earnest
4704.gl: to hasten, make haste; to exert one's self, endeavor, give diligence
4704.gi: usare velocità, cioè fare sforzo, essere sollecito o zelante

4705.gl: active, diligent, zealous, earnest; very diligent

4706.g: more earnestly than others), i.e., very promptly
4706.gi: più sinceramente degli altri), cioè molto prontamente

4707.gl: active, diligent, zealous, earnest; very diligent

4708.g: more speedily, i.e., sooner than otherwise
4708.gi: più rapidamente, cioè prima del previsto

4710.gl: haste, with haste; earnestness, diligence; earnestness in accomplishing, promoting, or striving after anything; to give all diligence, interest one's self most earnestly

4711.gl: a reed basket, (a plaited basket, a lunch basket, hamper)
4711.gi: un cesto o contenente per il pranzo

4712.g: a stade or certain measure of distance; by implication, a stadium or race-course
4712.gl: a space or distance of about 600 feet (185 m); a race course; place in which contests in running were held, the one who outstripped the rest and reached the goal first, receiving the prize
4712.gi: uno stadio o una certa misura di distanza; per implicazione, uno stadio o un percorso di corsa

4713.gl: among the greeks an earthen jar, into which wine was drawn off for keeping but also used for other purposes; of the little jar in which the manna was kept, laid up in the ark of the covenant
4713.gi: un vaso o un serbatoio di terracotta

4714.g: a standing (properly, the act), i.e., (by analogy) position (existence); by implication, a popular uprising; figuratively, controversy
4714.gl: a standing, station, state; an insurrection; strife, insurrection
4714.gi: una posizione (propriamente, l'atto), cioè (per analogia) posizione (esistenza); per implicazione, una rivolta popolare; figurato, controversia

4715.g: a stander (standard of value), i.e., (specially), a stater or certain coin
4715.gl: a stater, a coin; in the new testament a silver stater equal to four attic or two alexandrian drachmas, a jewish shekel
4715.gi: un punto di riferimento (standard di valore), cioè (specialmente) un statere o una certa moneta

4716.g: a stake or post (as set upright), i.e., (specially), a pole or cross (as an instrument of capital punishment); figuratively, exposure to death, i.e., self-denial; by implication, the atonement of christ
4716.gl: an upright stake, especially a pointed one; a cross; a well known instrument of most cruel and ignominious punishment, borrowed by the greeks and romans from the phoenicians; to it were affixed among the romans, down to the time of constantine the great, the guiltiest criminals, particularly the basest slaves, robbers, the authors and abetters of insurrections, and occasionally in the provinces, at the arbitrary pleasure of the governors, upright and peaceable men also, and even roman citizens themselves; the crucifixion which christ underwent
4716.gi: un palo o un paliotto (come messo in posizione verticale), cioè (specialmente), un palo o una croce (come strumento di pena capitale); figurato, esposizione alla morte, cioè negazione di sé; per implicazione, l'espiazione di Cristo

4717.g: to impale on the cross; figuratively, to extinguish (subdue) passion or selfishness
4717.gl: to stake, drive down stakes; to fortify with driven stakes, to palisade; to crucify; to crucify one; metaphorically to crucify the flesh, destroy its power utterly (the nature of the figure implying that the destruction is attended with intense pain)
4717.gi: impalare sulla croce; figurato, estinguere (sottomettere) la passione o l'egoismo

4718.g: a cluster of grapes (as if intertwined)

4719.g: a head of grain (as standing out from the stalk)
4719.gl: an ear of corn or of growing grain
4719.gi: una spiga di grano (che sporge dal gambo)

4720.gl: [a head of grain]; a man with a greek name, he is said to be one of the seventy disciples, and bishop of byzantium (gill)

4722.g: to roof over, i.e., (figuratively) to cover with silence (endure patiently)
4722.gl: deck, thatch, to cover; to protect or keep by covering, to preserve; to cover over with silence; to keep secret; to hide, conceal; of the errors and faults of others; by covering to keep off something which threatens, to bear up against, hold out against, and so endure, bear, forbear
4722.gi: coprire con un tetto, cioè (figurato) coprire con il silenzio (subire pazientemente)

4723.gl: hard, stiff; of men and animals; barren; of woman who does not conceive

4724.g: properly, to set fast ("stall"), i.e., (figuratively) to repress (reflexively, abstain from associating with)
4724.gl: to set, place, set in order, arrange; to fit out, to prepare, equip; to prepare one's self, to fit out for one's self; to fit out for one's own use; to prepare one's self, to fit out for one's self; to fit out for one's own use; arranging, providing for this, etc.; to bring together, contract, shorten; to diminish, check, cause to cease; to cease to exist; to remove one's self, withdraw one's self, to depart; to abstain from familiar intercourse with one
4724.gi: propriamente, fissare ("bloccare"), cioè (figurato) reprimere (riflessivamente, astenersi da associazioni con)

4725.gl: a fillet, a garland, put upon victims

4727.g: to make (intransitively, be) in straits, i.e., (by implication) to sigh, murmur, pray inaudibly
4727.gi: mettersi (intransitivamente, essere) in difficoltà, cioè (per implicazione) sospirare, mormorare, pregare inudibilmente

4728.gi: stretto (da ostacoli che si trovano vicini)

4729.g: to hem in closely, i.e., (figuratively) cramp
4729.gl: to be in a narrow place; to straiten, compress, cramp, reduce to straits; to be sorely straitened in spirit

4730.gl: narrowness of place, a narrow place; metaphorically dire calamity, extreme affliction

4731.g: stiff, i.e., solid, stable (literally or figuratively)
4731.gl: strong, firm, immovable, solid, hard, rigid; in a bad sense, cruel, stiff, stubborn, hard; in a good sense, firm, steadfast
4731.gi: rigido, cioè solido, stabile (letteralmente o figurato)

4732.g: to solidify, i.e., confirm (literally or figuratively)
4732.gl: to make solid, make firm, strengthen, make strong; of the body of anyone

4733.gl: that which has been made firm; the firmament, the arch of the sky, which in early times was thought to be solid; a fortified place; that which furnishes a foundation; on which a thing rests firmly, support; firmness, steadfastness; metaphorically in a military sense: solid front

4735.g: a chaplet (as a badge of royalty, a prize in the public games or a symbol of honor generally; but more conspicuous and elaborate than the simple fillet, g1238), literally or figuratively
4735.gl: a crown; a mark of royal or (generally) exalted rank; the wreath or garland which was given as a prize to victors in public games; metaphorically the eternal blessedness which will be given as a prize to the genuine servants of god and christ: the crown (wreath) which is the reward of the righteous; that which is an ornament and honor to one
4735.gi: una corona (come distintivo di regalità, premio nei giochi pubblici o simbolo d'onore in generale; ma più appariscente ed elaborata del semplice nastro, g1238), letteralmente o figurato

4736.gl: [crowned]; one of the seven deacons in jerusalem and the first christian martyr

4737.g: to adorn with an honorary wreath (literally or figuratively)
4737.gl: to encircle with a crown, to crown: the victor in a contest; to adorn, to honor
4737.gi: adornare con una corona onoraria (letteralmente o figurato)

4739.g: to be stationary, i.e., (figuratively) to persevere
4739.gl: to stand firm; to persevere, to persist; to keep one's standing

4741.g: to set fast, i.e., (literally) to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or (figuratively) to confirm
4741.gl: to make stable, place firmly, set fast, fix; to strengthen, make firm; to render constant, confirm, one's mind
4741.gi: fissare, cioè (letteralmente) voltare risolutamente in una certa direzione, o (figurato) confermare

4742.g: a mark incised or punched (for recognition of ownership), i.e., (figuratively) scar of service
4742.gl: a mark pricked in or branded upon the body
4742.gi: un'incisione o un foro (per riconoscimento di proprietà), cioè (figurato) segno di servizio

4743.g: a point of time, i.e., an instant
4743.gl: an instant (i.e., a moment) of time
4743.gi: un punto nel tempo, cioè un istante

4745.gl: a portico, a covered colonnade where people can stand or walk protected from the weather and the heat of the sun; the portico built by solomon in the eastern part of the temple

4746.g: a spread (as if tramped flat) of loose materials for a couch, i.e., (by implication) a bough of a tree so employed
4746.gi: un tappeto (come se calpestato e appiattito) di materiali sciolti per un lettino, cioè (per implicazione) un ramo di impiegato in questo modo

4747.g: something orderly in arrangement, i.e., (by implication) a serial (basal, fundamental, initial) constituent (literally), proposition (figuratively)
4747.gl: any first thing, from which the others belonging to some series or composite whole take their rise, an element, first principal; the letters of the alphabet as the elements of speech, not however the written characters, but the spoken sounds; the elements from which all things have come, the material causes of the universe; the heavenly bodies, either as parts of the heavens or (as others think) because in them the elements of man, life and destiny were supposed to reside; the elements, rudiments, primary and fundamental principles of any art, science, or discipline; i.e., of mathematics, euclid's geometry
4747.gi: qualcosa di ordinato nell'arrangiamento, cioè (per implicazione) un costituito seriale (basale, fondamentale, iniziale) (letteralmente), proposizione (figurato)

4748.g: to march in (military) rank (keep step), i.e., (figuratively) to conform to virtue and piety
4748.gl: to proceed in a row as the march of a soldier, go in order; metaphorically to go on prosperously, to turn out well; to walk; to direct one's life, to live
4748.gi: marciare in (militare) formazione (mantenere il passo), cioè (figurato) conformarsi alla virtù e alla pietà

4749.g: equipment, i.e., (specially), a "stole" or long-fitting gown (as a mark of dignity)
4749.gl: an equipment; an equipment in clothes, clothing; specifically a loose outer garment for men extending to the feet, worn by kings, priests, and persons of rank
4749.gi: equipaggiamento, cioè (specialmente), una "stola" o tunica lunga (come segno di dignità)

4750.g: the mouth (as if a gash in the face); by implication, language (and its relations); figuratively, an opening (in the earth); specially, the front or edge (of a weapon)
4750.gl: the mouth, as part of the body: of man, of animals, of fish, etc.; since thoughts of a man's soul find verbal utterance by his mouth, the "heart" or "soul" and the mouth are distinguished; the edge of a sword
4750.gi: la bocca (come se fosse una ferita sul volto); per implicazione, il linguaggio (e le sue relazioni); figurato, un'apertura (nella terra); specialmente, il bordo o il taglio (di un'arma)

4751.gl: the throat; an opening, orifice, especially of the stomach; the stomach

4752.g: military service, i.e., (figuratively) the apostolic career (as one of hardship and danger)
4752.gl: an expedition, campaign, military service, warfare; metaphorically paul likens his contest with the difficulties that oppose him in the discharge of his apostolic duties, as warfare
4752.gi: servizio militare, cioè (figurato) la carriera apostolica (come una di difficoltà e pericolo)

4753.g: an armament, i.e., (by implication) a body of troops (more or less extensive or systematic)
4753.gl: an army; a band of soldiers; bodyguard, guards men
4753.gi: un armamento, cioè (per implicazione) un corpo di truppe (più o meno esteso o sistematico)

4754.g: to serve in a military campaign; figuratively, to execute the apostolate (with its arduous duties and functions), to contend with carnal inclinations
4754.gl: to make a military expedition, to lead soldiers to war or to battle, (spoken of a commander); to do military duty, be on active service, be a soldier; to fight
4754.gi: servire in una campagna militare; figurato, esercitare l'apostolato (con i suoi doveri e funzioni faticose), contendere con le inclinazioni carnali

4755.g: a general, i.e., (by implication or analogy) a (military) governor (praetor), the chief (praefect) of the (levitical) temple-wardens
4755.gl: the commander of an army; in the new testament a civic commander, a governor; the name the highest magistrate in the municipia or colonies; they had the power of administering justice in the less important cases; of civil magistrates; captain of the temple, i.e., the commander of the levites who kept guard in and around the temple
4755.gi: un generale, cioè (per implicazione o analogia) un governatore (pretore), il capo (prefetto) dei (levitici) custodi del tempio

4756.g: from the base of g4766, as encamped); camp-likeness, i.e., an army, i.e., (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries
4756.gl: an army, band of soldiers; in the new testament, the hosts of heaven; troops of angels; the heavenly bodies, stars of heaven (so called on account of their number and their order)
4756.gi: dalla base di g4766, come accampato); aspetto di accampamento, cioè un esercito, cioè (figurato) gli angeli, le luci celesti

4757.g: a camper-out, i.e., a (common) warrior (literally or figuratively)
4757.gl: a (common) soldier; metaphorically a champion of the cause of christ
4757.gi: un campeggiatore, cioè un guerriero (comune) (letteralmente o figurato)

4758.g: to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e., enlist in the army
4758.gl: to gather (collect) an army, to enlist soldiers; of the commander
4758.gi: radunare (o selezionare) come guerriero, cioè arruolarsi nell'esercito

4759.g: a ruler of an army, i.e., (specially), a praetorian praefect
4759.gl: the commander of a camp and army, a military tribune; praetorian praefect (or prefect), commander of the praetorian cohorts, captain of the roman emperor's body guard
4759.gi: un comandante di un esercito, cioè (specialmente), un prefetto pretoriano

4760.g: a camping-ground, i.e., (by implication) a body of troops
4760.gl: a military camp; soldiers in camp, an army
4760.gi: un campo di accampamento, cioè (per implicazione) un corpo di truppe

4761.g: to wrench, i.e., (specially), to torture (by the rack), but only figuratively, to pervert
4761.gl: to twist, turn awry; to torture, put to the rack; metaphorically to pervert, of one who wrests or tortures language in a false sense
4761.gi: torcere, cioè (specialmente), torturare (con la ruota), ma solo figurato, corrompere

4762.g: to twist, i.e., turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively)
4762.gl: to turn, turn around; to turn one's self (i.e., to turn the back to one; of one who no longer cares for another); metaphorically to turn one's self from one's course of conduct, i.e., to change one's mind
4762.gi: torcere, cioè girare completamente intorno o invertire (letteralmente o figurato)

4763.gl: to be wanton, to live luxuriously

4764.gl: excessive strength which longs to break forth, over strength; luxury; eager desire

4765.gl: a little bird, especially of the sparrow sort, a sparrow

4766.g: to "strew," i.e., spread (as a carpet or couch)
4766.gl: to spread; furnish; to spread with couches or divans
4766.gi: "spargere", cioè stendere (come un tappeto o un divano)

4768.g: to render gloomy, i.e., (by implication) glower (be overcast with clouds, or sombreness of speech)
4768.gl: to be sad, sorrowful; metaphorically of the sky covered with clouds
4768.gi: rendere cupo, cioè (per implicazione) fare lo sguardo torvo (essere coperto di nuvole, o di asprezza nel parlare)

4769.gl: a pillar; a column; pillars of fire i.e., flames rising like pillars; a prop or support

4770.g: a "stoic" (as occupying a particular porch in athens), i.e., adherent of a certin philosophy
4770.gl: [of the portico]; pertaining to the stoic philosophy, the author of which, zeno of citium, taught at athens
4770.gi: uno "stoico" (come che occupa una particolare portico ad Atene), cioè un seguente di una certa filosofia

4772.gl: a kinship, relationship; kindred, relations collectively, family

4773.g: a relative (by blood); by extension, a fellow countryman
4773.gl: of the same kin, akin to, related by blood; in a wider sense, of the same race, a fellow countryman
4773.gi: un parente (per sangue); per estensione, un concittadino

4775.g: to seat oneself in company with
4775.gl: to sit together, to sit with one another

4776.g: to give (or take) a seat in company with
4776.gl: to cause to sit down together, place together; to sit down together
4776.gi: dare (o prendere) posto in compagnia di

4777.g: to suffer hardship in company with
4777.gl: to suffer hardship together with one

4778.g: to maltreat in company with, i.e., (passively) endure persecution together
4778.gl: to treat ill with another; to be ill treated in company with, share persecutions or come into a fellowship of ills
4778.gi: maltrattare in compagnia di, cioè (passivamente) sopportare persecuzione insieme

4779.gl: to call together, assemble; to call together to one's self

4780.gl: to cover on all sides, to conceal entirely, to cover up completely

4781.g: to bend together, i.e., (figuratively) to afflict
4781.gl: to bend together, to bend completely; metaphorically to subject one to error and hardness of heart, a figure taken from bowing the back by captives compelled to pass under the yoke

4782.gl: to go down with; of those who descend from a high place to a lower place as from jerusalem to caesarea

4783.g: a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e., (figuratively) accord with
4783.gl: a putting together or joint deposit (of votes); hence approval, assent, agreement
4783.gi: una deposizione (di sentimento) in compagnia di, cioè (figurato) accordarsi con

4784.g: to deposit (one's vote or opinion) in company with, i.e., (figuratively) to accord with
4784.gl: to deposit together with another; to deposit one's vote in the urn with another; to consent to, vote for, agree with
4784.gi: depositare (il proprio voto o opinione) in compagnia di, cioè (figurato) accordarsi con

4785.g: to count down in company with, i.e., enroll among
4785.gl: be depositing a ballot in the urn (i.e., by voting for) to assign one a place among, to vote one a place among; to vote against with others, i.e., to condemn with others

4786.g: to commingle, i.e., (figuratively) to combine or assimilate
4786.gl: to mix together, commingle; to unite; caused the several parts to combine into an organic structure, which is the body; to unite one thing to another

4787.g: to move together, i.e., (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition)
4787.gl: to move together with others; to throw into commotion, excite, stir up
4787.gi: muoversi insieme, cioè (specialmente), eccitare come massa (a sedizione)

4788.g: to shut together, i.e., include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to
4788.gl: to shut up together, enclose; of a shoal of fishes in a net; to shut up on all sides, shut up completely
4788.gi: chiudere insieme, cioè includere o (figurato) abbracciare in una soggezione comune a

4789.g: a co-heir, i.e., (by analogy) participant in common
4789.gl: a fellow heir, a joint heir; one who obtains something assigned to himself with others, a joint participant
4789.gi: un coerede, cioè (per analogia) partecipante comune

4790.g: to share in company with, i.e., co-participate in
4790.gl: to become a partaker together with others, or to have fellowship with a thing
4790.gi: condividere in compagnia di, cioè co-partecipare in

4791.gl: participant with others in anything, joint partner

4792.g: to convey together, i.e., collect or bear away in company with others
4792.gl: to carry or bring together, to collect; to house crops, gather into granaries; to carry with others, help in carrying out, the dead to be buried or burned; to bury
4792.gi: trasportare insieme, cioè raccogliere o portare via in compagnia di altri

4793.g: to judge of one thing in connection with another, i.e., combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance)
4793.gl: to joint together fitly, compound, combine; to interpret; to compare
4793.gi: giudicare una cosa in connessione con un'altra, cioè combinare (idee spirituali con espressioni appropriate) o confrontare (una persona con un'altra per contrasto o somiglianza)

4794.g: to stoop altogether, i.e., be completely overcome by
4794.gl: to bend completely forwards, to be bowed together
4794.gi: chinarsi completamente, cioè essere completamente sopraffatto da

4796.gl: to rejoice with, take part in another's joy; to rejoice together, to congratulate

4797.g: to commingle promiscuously, i.e., (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind)
4797.gl: to pour together, commingle; to disturb the mind of one, to stir up to tumult or outbreak; to confound or bewilder
4797.gi: mescolare promiscuamente, cioè (figurato) gettare (un'assemblea) nel disordine, confondere (la mente)

4798.g: to use jointly, i.e., (by implication) to hold intercourse in common
4798.gl: to use with anyone, use jointly; to associate with, to have dealings with
4798.gi: usare in comune, cioè (per implicazione) avere rapporti in comune

4800.g: to continue to live in common with, i.e., co-survive (literally or figuratively)
4800.gl: to live together with one; of physical life on earth; to live a new life in union with christ, i.e., dedicated to god
4800.gi: continuare a vivere in comune con, cioè coesistere (letteralmente o figurato)

4801.g: to yoke together, i.e., (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage)
4801.gl: to fasten to one yoke, yoke together; to join together unite; of the marriage tie

4802.g: to investigate jointly, i.e., discuss, controvert, cavil
4802.gl: to seek or examine together; in the new testament to discuss, dispute, question
4802.gi: investigare insieme, cioè discutere, contraddire, cavillare

4804.gl: a disputer, i.e., a learned disputant, sophist

4805.g: co-yoked, i.e., (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as a proper name; syzygus, a christian
4805.gl: yoked together; of those united by the bond of marriage, relationship, office, labor, study, business, or the like; of a yoke fellow, consort, comrade, colleague, partner
4805.gi: accoppiato insieme, cioè (figurato) come sostantivo, un collega; probabilmente piuttosto come nome proprio; syzygus, un cristiano

4806.gl: to make one alive together; of christians, with christ

4807.gl: sycamine tree, having the form and foliage of the mulberry, but fruit resembling the fig

4810.gl: a fig, the ripe fruit of a fig tree

4811.g: to be a fig-informer (reporter of the law forbidding the exportation of figs from greece), "sycophant", i.e., (genitive and by extension) to defraud (exact unlawfully, extort)
4811.gl: to accuse wrongfully, to calumniate, to attack by malicious devices; to exact money wrongfully; to extort from, defraud
4811.gi: essere un informatore di fichi (denunciatore della legge che vieta l'esportazione di fichi dalla Grecia), "sifofante", cioè (genitivo e per estensione) defraudare (esigere illegalmente, estorcere)

4812.g: to lead away as booty, i.e., (figuratively) seduce
4812.gl: to carry off booty; to carry one off as a captive (and slave); to lead away from the truth and subject to one's sway
4812.gi: condurre via come bottino, cioè (figurato) sedurre

4815.g: to clasp, i.e., seize (arrest, capture); specially, to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication, to aid
4815.gl: to seize, take: one as prisoner; to conceive, of a woman; metaphorically of lust whose impulses a man indulges; to seize for one's self; in a hostile sense, to make (one a permanent) prisoner; to take hold together with one, to assist, help, to succour
4815.gi: abbracciare, cioè afferrare (arrestare, catturare); specialmente, concepire (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, aiutare

4816.gl: to gather up; to collect in order to carry off

4817.g: to reckon together (with oneself), i.e., deliberate
4817.gl: to bring together accounts, reckon up, compute; to reckon with one's self, to reason
4817.gi: calcolare insieme (con sé stesso), cioè deliberare

4818.g: to afflict jointly, i.e., (passive) sorrow at (on account of) someone
4818.gl: to affect with grief together; give with one's self
4818.gi: affliggere insieme, cioè (passivo) provare tristezza per (a causa di) qualcuno

4819.g: to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e., concur (take place)
4819.gl: to walk with the feet near together; to come together, meet with one; of things which fall out at the same time, to happen, turn out, come to pass

4820.g: to combine, i.e., (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack
4820.gl: to throw together, to bring together; to converse; to bring together in one's mind, confer with one's self; to come together, meet; to encounter in a hostile sense; to fight with one; to bring together of one's property, to contribute, aid, help
4820.gi: combinare, cioè (parlando) conversare, consultare, disputare, (mentalmente) considerare, (per implicazione) aiutare, (personalmente) unirsi, attaccare

4821.gl: to reign together; metaphorically to possess supreme honor, liberty, blessedness, with one in the kingdom of god

4822.g: causative (by reduplication) of the base of g0939); to drive together, i.e., unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach
4822.gl: to cause to coalesce, to join together, put together; to unite or knit together: in affection; to put together in one's mind; to compare; to gather, conclude, consider; to cause a person to unite with one in a conclusion or come to the same opinion, to prove, demonstrate; to teach, instruct, one
4822.gi: causativo (per raddoppiamento) della base di g0939); radunare insieme, cioè unire (in associazione o affetto), (mentalmente) inferire, mostrare, insegnare

4823.g: to give (or take) advice jointly, i.e., recommend, deliberate or determine
4823.gl: to give counsel; to take counsel with others, take counsel together, to consult, deliberate
4823.gi: dare (o ricevere) consiglio insieme, cioè raccomandare, deliberare o determinare
