4824.g: advisement; specially, a deliberative body, i.e., the provincial assessors or lay-court
4824.gl: counsel, which is given, taken, entered upon; consult, deliberate; a council; an assembly of counsellors or persons in consultation (the governors and procurators of provinces had a board of assessors or advisers with whom they took council before rendering judgment)
4824.gi: consiglio; specialmente, un corpo deliberativo, cioè gli assessori provinciali o tribunale laico

4826.g: symeon (i.e., shimon), the name of five israelites
4826.gl: [harkening]; the second son of jacob by leah; one of abraham's descendants; the one who took the infant jesus in his arms in the temple; a teacher at the church of antioch; the original name of peter the apostle
4826.gi: Simeone (cioè Simone), il nome di cinque israeliti

4828.g: to testify jointly, i.e., corroborate by (concurrent) evidence
4828.gl: to bear witness with, bear joint witness
4828.gi: testimoniare insieme, cioè corroborare con (concorrente) testimonianza

4829.g: to share jointly, i.e., participate in
4829.gl: to divide at the same time, divide together; to assign a portion; to divide together with one (so that a part comes to me, a part to him)

4830.gl: partaking together with one, a joint partaker; of something

4831.gi: un co-imitatore, cioè un compagno votante

4832.gl: having the same form as another, similar, conformed to

4833.g: to render like, i.e., (figuratively) to assimilate
4833.gl: to be conformed to, receive the same form as

4834.g: to feel "sympathy" with, i.e., (by implication) to commiserate
4834.gl: to be affected with the same feeling as another, to sympathise with; to feel for, have compassion on

4835.g: having a fellow-feeling ("sympathetic"), i.e., (by implication) mutually commiserative
4835.gl: suffering or feeling the like with another, sympathetic
4835.gi: avere un sentimento di fratellanza ("simpatico"), cioè (per implicazione) reciprocamente compassionevole

4836.g: to be present together, i.e., to convene; by implication, to appear in aid
4836.gl: to come together; to come to one's help
4836.gi: essere presenti insieme, cioè riunirsi; per implicazione, apparire in aiuto

4837.gl: to call upon or invite or exhort at the same time or together; to strengthen (comfort) with others

4838.gl: to take along together with; in the new testament to take with one as a companion

4839.g: to remain in company, i.e., still live
4839.gl: to abide together with; to continue to live together
4839.gi: rimanere in compagnia, cioè ancora vivere

4840.g: to be at hand together, i.e., now present
4840.gi: essere presenti insieme, cioè, presenti ora

4841.g: to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specially, persecution; to "sympathize")
4841.gl: to suffer or feel pain together; to suffer evils (troubles, persecutions) in the like manner with another
4841.gi: provare dolore insieme o dello stesso tipo (specialmente, persecuzione; "simpatizzare")

4843.g: to take by enclosing altogether, i.e., earnestly throw the arms about one
4843.gl: to comprehend at once; to embrace completely
4843.gi: afferrare racchiudendo completamente, cioè, abbracciare con ardore qualcuno

4844.g: to partake a beverage in company

4845.g: to implenish completely, i.e., (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passive, be complete)
4845.gl: to fill completely; of the hold of a ship; to complete entirely, be fulfilled: of time
4845.gi: riempire completamente, cioè (di spazio) sommergere (una barca), o (di tempo) compiere (passivo, essere completo)

4846.g: to strangle completely, i.e., (literally) to drown, or (figuratively) to crowd
4846.gl: to choke utterly; metaphorically the seed of the divine word sown in the mind; to press round or throng one so as almost to suffocate him
4846.gi: strangolare completamente, cioè (letteralmente) annegare, o (figurato) affollare

4847.g: a native of the same town, i.e., (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow-christian)
4847.gl: possessing the same citizenship with others, a fellow citizen; of gentiles as received into communion of the saints; of the people consecrated to god
4847.gi: un nativo della stessa città, cioè (figurato) coreligionista (cristiano)

4848.g: to journey together; by implication, to assemble
4848.gl: to go or journey together; to come together, to assemble

4849.g: a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e., (by extension) a room of guests
4849.gl: a drinking party, entertainment; of the party itself, the guests; rows of guests
4849.gi: una festa di bevute ("simposio"), cioè (per estensione) una stanza di ospiti

4851.g: to bear together (contribute), i.e., (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage
4851.gl: to bear or bring together; to bear together or at the same time; to carry with others; to collect or contribute in order to help; to help, be profitable, be expedient
4851.gi: portare insieme (contribuire), cioè (letteralmente) raccogliere, o (figurato) contribuire; specialmente (participio neutro come sostantivo) vantaggio

4852.g: to say jointly, i.e., assent to

4853.g: a co-tribesman, i.e., native of the same country
4853.gl: one who is of the same people, a fellow countryman
4853.gi: un co-tribale, cioè nativo dello stesso paese

4854.g: grown along with (connate), i.e., (figuratively) closely united to
4854.gl: born together with, of joint origin; connate, congenital, innate, implanted by birth or nature; grown together, united with; kindred
4854.gi: cresciuto insieme (congenito), cioè (figurato) strettamente unito a

4855.gl: to cause to grow together; to grow together, grow with

4856.g: to be harmonious, i.e., (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact)
4856.gl: to agree together; to agree with one in making a bargain, to make an agreement, to bargain
4856.gi: essere armonioso, cioè (figurato) accordarsi (essere adatto, concordare) o stipulare (per patto)

4858.g: unison of sound ("symphony"), i.e., a concert of instruments (harmonious note)
4858.gi: unisono di suono ("sinfonia"), cioè, un concerto di strumenti (nota armoniosa)

4859.g: sounding together (alike), i.e., (figuratively) accordant (neuter as noun, agreement)
4859.gl: harmonious, accordant, agreeing; thing agreed upon, compact
4859.gi: risuonare insieme (allo stesso modo), cioè, (figurato) accordante (neutro come sostantivo, accordo)

4860.gl: to compute, count up; to vote with one

4861.gl: of one mind, of one accord
4861.gi: spirito comune, cioè, simile nel sentimento

4862.g: with or together (but much closer than g3326 or g3844), i.e., by association, companionship, process, resemblance, possession, instrumentality, addition, etc
4862.gi: con o insieme (ma molto più vicino di g3326 o g3844), cioè per associazione, compagnia, processo, somiglianza, possesso, strumentalità, aggiunta, ecc

4863.g: to lead together, i.e., collect or convene; specially, to entertain (hospitably)
4863.gl: to gather together, to gather; to draw together, collect; of fishes; of a net in which they are caught; to bring together, assemble, collect; to join together, join in one (those previously separated); to gather together by convoking; to be gathered i.e., come together, gather, meet; to lead with one's self; into one's home, i.e., to receive hospitably, to entertain
4863.gi: condurre insieme, cioè, raccogliere o convocare; specialmente, ospitare (conospitalità)

4864.g: an assemblage of persons; specially, a jewish "synagogue" (the meeting or the place); by analogy, a christian church
4864.gl: a bringing together, gathering (as of fruits), a contracting; in the new testament, an assembling together of men, an assembly of men; a synagogue; an assembly of jews formally gathered together to offer prayers and listen to the reading and expositions of the scriptures; assemblies of that sort were held every sabbath and feast day, afterwards also on the second and fifth days of every week; name transferred to an assembly of christians formally gathered together for religious purposes; the buildings where those solemn jewish assemblies are held
4864.gi: un'assemblea di persone; specialmente, una sinagoga ebraica (l'incontro o il luogo); per analogia, una chiesa cristiana

4865.g: to struggle in company with, i.e., (figuratively) to be a partner (assistant)
4865.gl: to strive together with one, to help one in striving
4865.gi: lottare in compagnia con, cioè (figurato) essere un partner (assistente)

4866.g: to wrestle in company with, i.e., (figuratively) to seek jointly
4866.gl: to strive at the same time with another

4867.gl: to gather together with others; to assemble; to be gathered together i.e., to come together

4868.g: to make up together, i.e., (figuratively) to compute (an account)
4868.gl: to take up together with another or others; to bring together with others; to cast up or settle accounts; to make a reckoning with

4870.gl: to follow together with others, to accompany

4871.gl: to gather together, assemble; to be assembled, meet with

4872.gl: to ascend at the same time, come up together with to a higher place; with one

4873.g: to recline in company with (at a meal)
4873.gl: to recline together, feast together; of guests
4873.gi: sdraiarsi in compagnia con (a un pasto)

4874.g: to mix up together, i.e., (figurative) associate with
4874.gl: to mix up together; to keep company with, be intimate with one

4875.g: to recruit oneself in company with
4875.gl: to take rest together with; to sleep together with, to lie with; of a husband and wife; metaphorically to rest or refresh one's spirits with one (i.e., to give and get refreshment by mutual intercourse)

4876.g: to meet with; figuratively, to occur
4876.gl: to meet with; of events: to happen or befall

4878.g: to take hold of opposite together, i.e., co-operate (assist)
4878.gl: to lay hold along with, to strive to obtain with others, help in obtaining; to take hold with another

4879.g: to take off together, i.e., transport with (seduce, passively, yield)
4879.gl: to lead away with or together; metaphorically to be carried away with; of a thing, i.e., by a thing, so as to experience with others the force of that which carries away; to yield or submit one's self to lowly things, conditions, employments: not to evade their power
4879.gi: portare via insieme, cioè trasportare con (sedurre, passivamente, cedere)

4880.g: to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to
4880.gl: to die together; to die with one
4880.gi: morire (letteralmente) insieme, o (figurato), in modo simile

4881.g: to destroy (middle voice or passively, be slain) in company with
4881.gl: to destroy together; to perish together (to be slain along with)
4881.gi: distruggere (voce media o passivamente, essere ucciso) insieme

4882.g: to despatch (on an errand) in company with
4882.gi: inviare (in una missione) in compagnia con

4883.g: to render close-jointed together, i.e., organize compactly
4883.gl: to join closely together; to frame together; parts of a building; the members of the body
4883.gi: rendere unito compatto, cioè, organizzare in modo compatto

4884.gl: to seize by force; to catch or lay hold of (one so that he is no longer his own master); to seize by force and carry away

4885.gl: to cause to grow together; to grow together

4886.g: a joint tie, i.e., ligament, (figuratively) uniting principle, control
4886.gl: that which binds together, a band, bond; of ligaments by which the members of the human body are united together; that which is bound together, a bundle
4886.gi: un legame comune, cioè, legamento, (figurato) principio unificante, controllo

4887.g: to bind with, i.e., (passively) be a fellow-prisoner (figuratively)
4887.gl: to tie together, to bind together; to bind or fasten on all sides; to bind just as (i.e., jointly with) another
4887.gi: legarsi con, cioè, (passivamente) essere un compagno di prigione (figurato)

4888.g: to exalt to dignity in company (i.e., similarly) with
4888.gl: to approve together, to join in approving; to glorify together
4888.gi: esaltare alla dignità insieme (cioè, similmente) con

4889.g: a co-slave, i.e., servitor or ministrant of the same master (human or divine)
4889.gl: a fellow servant, one who serves the same master with another; the associate of a servant (or slave); one who with others serves (ministers to) a king; a colleague of one who is christ's servant in publishing the gospel; one who with others acknowledges the same lord, jesus, and obeys his commands; one who with others is subject to the same divine authority in the messianic economy; of angels as the fellow servants of christians
4889.gi: un co-schiavo, cioè servitore o ministro dello stesso padrone (umano o divino)

4890.gl: a running together, concourse, especially hostile or riotous

4891.g: to rouse (from death) in company with, i.e., (figuratively) to revivify (spirtually) in resemblance to
4891.gl: to raise together, to cause to raise together; to raise up together from mortal death to a new and blessed life dedicated to god
4891.gi: risvegliare (dalla morte) in compagnia, cioè (figurato) rivivificare (spiritualmente) per somiglianza a

4892.g: a joint session, i.e., (specially), the jewish sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal
4892.gl: any assembly (especially of magistrates, judges, ambassadors), whether convened to deliberate or pass judgment; any session or assembly or people deliberating or adjudicating; the sanhedrin, the great council at jerusalem, consisting of the seventy one members (namely, scribes, elders, prominent members of the high priestly families and the high priest, the president of the assembly); a smaller tribunal or council which every jewish town had for the decision of less important cases
4892.gi: sessione congiunta, cioè (specialmente) il sinedrio ebraico; per analogia, un tribunale subordinato

4893.gl: the consciousness of anything; the soul as distinguishing between what is morally good and bad, prompting to do the former and shun the latter, commending one, condemning the other; the conscience

4894.g: to see completely; used (like its primary) only in two past tenses, respectively meaning to understand or become aware, and to be conscious or (clandestinely) informed of
4894.gl: to see (have seen) together with others; to see (have seen) in one's mind with one's self; to understand, perceive, comprehend,; to know with another; to know in one's mind or with one's self, to be conscience of
4894.gi: vedere completamente; usato (come il suo primario) solo in due tempi passati, rispettivamente significando comprendere o rendersi conto, e essere consapevole o (clandestinamente) informato di

5008.g: the fresh, i.e., young girl; talitha (o maiden)

5021.g: to arrange in an orderly manner, i.e., assign or dispose (to a certain position or lot)

5143.g: which uses ????? <pronunciation strongs="drem'-o"/> (the base of g1408) as alternate in certain tenses; to run or walk hastily (literally or figuratively)
5143.gl: to run; of persons in haste; of those who run in a race course; metaphorically; of doctrine rapidly propagated; by a metaphor taken from runners in a race, to exert one's self, strive hard; to spend one's strength in performing or attaining something; word occurs in greek writings denoting to incur extreme peril, which it requires the exertion of all one's effort to overcome
5143.gi: che usa ????? <pronunciation strongs="drem'-o"/> (la base di g1408) come alternativa in certi tempi; correre o camminare con fretta (letteralmente o figurato)

5146.g: properly, a crow-foot (three-pronged obstruction in war), i.e., (by analogy) a thorny plant (caltrop)
5146.gl: a thistle, a prickly wild plant, hurtful to other plants
5146.gi: propriamente, un piede di corvo (ostacolo a tre punte in guerra), cioè (per analogia) una pianta spinosa (calcatreppola)

5149.g: to creak (squeak), i.e., (by analogy) to grate the teeth (in frenzy)
5149.gl: to squeak, make a shrill cry; to gnash or grind one's teeth
5149.gi: cigolare (stridere), cioè (per analogia) digrignare i denti (in furore)

5150.gl: of three months; a space of three months

5152.gl: having three roofs or stories, the third story

5154.g: third; neuter (as noun) a third part, or (as adverb) a (or the) third time, thirdly
5154.gi: terzo; neutro (come sostantivo) una terza parte, o (come avverbio) una (o la) terza volta, terzo

5156.gl: a trembling or quaking with fear; with fear and trembling, used to describe the anxiety of one who distrusts his ability completely to meet all requirements, but religiously does his utmost to fulfil his duty

5157.gl: a turning; of the heavenly bodies

5158.g: a turn, i.e., (by implication) mode or style (especially with preposition or relative prefix as adverb, like); figuratively, deportment or character
5158.gl: a manner, way, fashion; as, even as, like as; manner of life, character, deportment
5158.gi: una svolta, cioè (per implicazione) modo o stile (specialmente con preposizione o prefisso relativo come avverbio, tipo); figurato, comportamento o carattere

5159.gl: to bear one's manner, endure one's character

5160.g: nourishment (literally or figuratively); by implication, rations (wages)
5160.gi: nutrimento (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, razioni (paghe)

5161.gl: [nutritious]; an ephesian christian, and friend of the apostle paul

5163.g: a track (as a wheel-rut), i.e., (figuratively) a course of conduct
5163.gl: a track of a wheel, a rut; a track, a path
5163.gi: una traccia (come un solco di ruota), cioè (figurato) un corso di condotta

5164.g: a wheel (as a runner), i.e., (figuratively) a circuit of physical effects
5164.gi: una ruota (come un rotolo), cioè (figurato) un circuito di effetti fisici

5166.gl: to gather in ripe fruits; to gather the harvest or vintage; of fruit gathered

5168.gi: un'apertura, cioè l'occhio di una spilla

5169.g: an aperture, i.e., a needle's eye
5169.gi: un'apertura, cioè l'occhio di una spilla

5171.gl: to live delicately, live luxuriously, be given to soft and luxurious life

5174.g: the troad (or plain of troy), i.e., troas, a place in asia minor
5174.gi: la Troade (o pianura di Troia), cioè Troas, un luogo in Asia Minore

5175.g: trogyllium, a place in asia minor
5175.gl: [a cache]; the name of a town and a promontory of ionia, not far from the island of samos, at the foot of matthew mycale between ephesus and the mouth of the river maeander
5175.gi: trogylion, un luogo in asia minore

5176.g: or perhaps rather of a base of g5167 and g5149 through the idea of a craunching sound; to gnaw or chew, i.e., (generally) to eat
5176.gl: to gnaw, crunch, chew raw vegetables or fruits (as nuts, almonds); of animals feeding; of men; to eat
5176.gi: o forse piuttosto di una base di g5167 e g5149 attraverso l'idea di un suono di frantumazione; rosicchiare o masticare, cioè (in generale) mangiare

5177.g: akin to the base of g5088 through the idea of effecting; properly, to affect; or (specially), to hit or light upon (as a mark to be reached), i.e., (transitively) to attain or secure an object or end, or (intransitively) to happen (as if meeting with); but in the latter application only impersonal (with g1487), i.e., perchance; or (present participle) as adjective, usual (as if commonly met with, with g3756, extraordinary), neuter (as adverb) perhaps; or (with another verb) as adverb, by accident (as it were)
5177.gl: to hit the mark; of one discharging a javelin or arrow; to reach, attain, obtain, get, become master of; to happen, chance, fall out; to specify, to take a case, as for example; to meet one; of he who meets one or presents himself unsought, any chance, ordinary, common person; to chance to be
5177.gi: affine alla base di g5088 attraverso l'idea di effetto; propriamente, affettare; o (specialmente), colpire o giungere (come un bersaglio da raggiungere), cioè (transitivamente) ottenere o assicurare un oggetto o fine, o (intransitivamente) accadere (come se si incontrasse); ma in quest'ultima applicazione solo impersonale (con g1487), cioè per caso; o (participio presente) come aggettivo, usuale (come se comunemente incontrato, con g3756, straordinario), neutro (come avverbio) forse; o (con un altro verbo) come avverbio, per caso (così direi)

5178.g: to stretch on an instrument of torture resembling a drum, and thus beat to death
5178.gl: to beat the drum or timbrel; to torture with the tympanum, an instrument of punishment
5178.gi: distendere su uno strumento di tortura simile a un tamburo, e così battere a morte

5179.g: a die (as struck), i.e., (by implication) a stamp or scar; by analogy, a shape, i.e., a statue, (figuratively) style or resemblance; specially, a sampler ("type"), i.e., a model (for imitation) or instance (for warning)
5179.gl: the mark of a stroke or blow, print; a figure formed by a blow or impression; of a figure or image; of the image of the gods; form; the teaching which embodies the sum and substance of religion and represents it to the mind, manner of writing, the contents and form of a letter; an example; in the technical sense, the pattern in conformity to which a thing must be made; in an ethical sense, a dissuasive example, a pattern of warning; of ruinous events which serve as admonitions or warnings to others; an example to be imitated; of men worthy of imitation; in a doctrinal sense; of a type i.e., a person or thing prefiguring a future (messianic) person or thing
5179.gi: un dado (come colpito), cioè (per implicazione) un timbro o una cicatrice; per analogia, una forma, cioè una statua, (figurato) stile o somiglianza; specialmente, un campione ("tipo"), cioè un modello (per imitazione) o un esempio (per avvertimento)

5180.g: to "thump", i.e., cudgel or pummel (properly, with a stick or bastinado), but in any case by repeated blows; thus differing from g3817 and g3960, which denote a (usually single) blow with the hand or any instrument, or g4141 with the fist (or a hammer), or g4474 with the palm; as well as from g5177, an accidental collision); by implication, to punish; figuratively, to offend (the conscience)
5180.gl: to strike, beat, smite; with a staff, a whip, the fist, the hand; of mourners, to smite their breast; to smite one on whom he inflicts punitive evil; to smite; metaphorically to wound, disquiet one's conscience
5180.gi: "battere", cioè percuotere o pestare (propriamente, con un bastone o con la bastonatura), ma in ogni caso con colpi ripetuti; differendo così da g3817 e g3960, che indicano un (di solito singolo) colpo con la mano o qualsiasi strumento, o g4141 con il pugno (o un martello), o g4474 con la mano; così come da g5177, una collisione accidentale); per implicazione, punire; figurato, offendere (la coscienza)

5181.gl: [sovereign]; an ephesian in whose school paul taught the gospel

5182.gl: disturb, trouble; to be troubled in mind, disquieted

5183.g: a tyrian, i.e., inhabitant of tyrus
5183.gi: un tirio, cioè abitante di tiro

5184.gl: [a rock]; a phoenician city on the mediterranean, very ancient, large, splendid, flourishing in commerce, and powerful by land and sea

5185.g: opaque (as if smoky), i.e., (by analogy) blind (physically or mentally)
5185.gi: opaco (come se fumoso), cioè (per analogia) cieco (fisicamente o mentalmente)

5186.g: to make blind, i.e., (figuratively) to obscure
5186.gl: to blind, make blind; in the new testament metaphorically to blunt the mental discernment, darken the mind

5187.g: to envelop with smoke, i.e., (figuratively) to inflate with self-conceit
5187.gl: to raise a smoke, to wrap in a mist; metaphorically; to make proud, puff up with pride, render insolent; to be puffed up with haughtiness or pride; to blind with pride or conceit, to render foolish or stupid; beclouded, besotted
5187.gi: avvolgere di fumo, cioè (figurato) gonfiarsi di superbia

5188.g: to make a smoke, i.e., slowly consume without flame
5188.gl: to cause or emit smoke, raise a smoke; to smoke
5188.gi: fare fumo, cioè consumare lentamente senza fiamma

5190.g: fortuitous, i.e., fortunate; tychicus, a christian
5190.gl: [fateful]; an asiatic christian, friend and companion of the apostle paul
5190.gi: fortuito, cioè fortunato; tychicus, un cristiano

5191.gl: hyacinth, of the color of hyacinth; of a red color bordering on black

5192.g: the "hyacinth" or "jacinth", i.e., some gem of a deep blue color, probably the zirkon
5192.gl: hyacinth, the name of a flower, also of a precious stone of the same color, a dark blue verging on black
5192.gi: il "giacinto" o "iacinto", cioè qualche gemma di colore blu profondo, probabilmente lo zirkon

5193.gl: of glass or transparent like glass, glassy

5194.gl: any stone transparent like glass; glass

5195.gl: to be insolent, to behave insolently, wantonly, outrageously; to act insolently and shamefully towards one, to treat shamefully; of one who injures another by speaking evil of him

5196.gl: insolence; impudence, pride, haughtiness; a wrong springing from insolence, an injury, affront, insult; mental injury and wantonness of its infliction being prominent; injury inflicted by the violence of a tempest

5197.gl: an insolent man; one who, uplifted with pride, either heaps insulting language upon others or does them some shameful act of wrong

5198.g: to have sound health, i.e., be well (in body); figuratively, to be uncorrupt (true in doctrine)
5198.gl: to be sound, to be well, to be in good health; metaphorically; of christians whose opinions are free from any mixture of error; of one who keeps the graces and is strong
5198.gi: avere buona salute, cioè stare bene (nel corpo); figurato, essere incorrotto (vero nella dottrina)

5199.g: healthy, i.e., well (in body); figuratively, true (in doctrine)
5199.gl: sound; of a man who is sound in body; to make one whole i.e., restore him to health; metaphorically teaching which does not deviate from the truth
5199.gi: sano, cioè bene (nel corpo); figurato, vero (nella dottrina)

5200.g: wet (as if with rain), i.e., (by implication) sappy (fresh)
5200.gl: damp, moist, wet; full of sap, green
5200.gi: umido (come se con la pioggia), cioè (per implicazione) succoso (fresco)

5201.g: a water-jar, i.e., receptacle for family supply
5201.gl: a vessel for holding water; a water jar, a water pot
5201.gi: un vaso d'acqua, cioè contenitore per le provviste familiari

5202.g: to be a water-drinker, i.e., to abstain from vinous beverages
5202.gl: to drink water, be a drinker of water
5202.gi: essere un bevitore d'acqua, cioè astenersi da bevande vinose

5204.g: water (as if rainy) literally or figuratively
5204.gl: water; of water in rivers, in fountains, in pools; of the water of the deluge; of water in any of the earth's repositories; of water as the primary element, out of and through which the world that was before the deluge, arose and was compacted; of the waves of the sea; figuratively used of many peoples
5204.gi: acqua (come se piovosa) letteralmente o figurato

5206.g: the placing as a son, i.e., adoption (figuratively, christian sonship in respect to god)
5206.gl: adoption, adoption as sons; that relationship which god was pleased to establish between himself and the israelites in preference to all other nations; the nature and condition of the true disciples in christ, who by receiving the spirit of god into their souls become sons of god; the blessed state looked for in the future life after the visible return of christ from heaven
5206.gi: il porre come figlio, cioè adozione (figurato, figliolanza cristiana riguardo a Dio)

5207.g: a "son" (sometimes of animals), used very widely of immediate, remote or figuratively, kinship
5207.gl: a son; rarely used for the young of animals; generally used of the offspring of men; in a restricted sense, the male offspring (one born by a father and of a mother); in a wider sense, a descendant, one of the posterity of any one,; the children of israel; sons of abraham; used to describe one who depends on another or is his follower; a pupil; son of man; term describing man, carrying the connotation of weakness and mortality; son of man, symbolically denotes the fifth kingdom in daniel 7:13 and by this term its humanity is indicated in contrast with the barbarity and ferocity of the four preceding kingdoms (the babylonian, the median and the persian, the macedonian, and the roman) typified by the four beasts; used by christ himself, doubtless in order that he might intimate his messiahship and also that he might designate himself as the head of the human race, the man, the one who both furnished the pattern of the perfect man and acted on behalf of all mankind; son of god; used to describe adam (see luke 3:38); used to describe those who are born again (see luke 20:36) and of angels and of jesus christ; of those whom god esteems as sons, whom he loves, protects and benefits above others; in the old testament used of the jews; in the new testament of christians; those whose character god, as a loving father, shapes by chastisements (hebrews 12:58); those who revere god as their father, the pious worshipers of god, those who in character and life resemble god, those who are governed by the spirit of god, repose the same calm and joyful trust in god which children do in their parents (see romans 8:14, galatians 3:26), and hereafter in the blessedness and glory of the life eternal will openly wear this dignity of the sons of god
5207.gi: un "figlio" (a volte di animali), usato molto ampiamente di parentela immediata, remota o figurata

5208.gl: a forest, a wood; felled wood, fuel

5209.g: you (as the objective of a verb or preposition)
5209.gi: voi (come oggetto di un verbo o preposizione)

5211.gl: [belonging to marriage]; a heretic, one of the opponents of the apostle paul

5212.gl: you, yours; to be possessed by you; to be allocated by you; proceeding from you

5214.g: to hymn, i.e., sing a religious ode; by implication, to celebrate (god) in song
5214.gl: to sing the praise of, sing hymns to; to sing a hymn, to sing; singing of paschal (passover) hymns; these were psalms 113118 (which are called the "full hallel" (??? ???) and psalm 136 (which is called the "great hallel")
5214.gi: cantare un inno, cioè cantare un'ode religiosa; per implicazione, celebrare (Dio) con il canto

5215.g: probably akin to g0103; compare h5667); a "hymn" or religious ode (one of the psalms)
5215.gl: a song in tithe praise of gods, heroes, conquerors; a sacred song, hymn
5215.gi: probabilmente affine a g0103; cfr. h5667); un "inno" o ode religiosa (uno dei salmi)

5217.g: to lead (oneself) under, i.e., withdraw or retire (as if sinking out of sight), literally or figuratively
5217.gl: to lead under, bring under; to withdraw one's self, to go away, depart
5217.gi: condursi sotto, cioè ritirarsi o andarsene (come se affondando fuori dalla vista), letteralmente o figuratamente

5218.g: attentive hearkening, i.e., (by implication) compliance or submission
5218.gl: obedience, compliance, submission; obedience rendered to anyone's counsels, an obedience shown in observing the requirements of christianity
5218.gi: ascolto attento, cioè (per implicazione) conformità o sottomissione

5219.g: to hear under (as a subordinate), i.e., to listen attentively; by implication, to heed or conform to a command or authority
5219.gl: to listen, to harken; of one who on the knock at the door comes to listen who it is, (the duty of a porter); to harken to a command; to obey, be obedient to, submit to
5219.gi: sentire sotto (come subordinato), cioè ascoltare attentamente; per implicazione, obbedire o conformarsi a un comando o autorità

5220.g: in subjection under a man, i.e., a married woman
5220.gl: under i.e., subject to a man: married
5220.gi: in soggezione sotto un uomo, cioè una donna sposata

5221.g: to go opposite (meet) under (quietly), i.e., to encounter, fall in with
5221.gl: to go to meet, to meet; in military reference; of a hostile meeting
5221.gi: andare incontro (incontrare) sotto (silenziosamente), cioè incontrare, imbattersi in

5222.g: an encounter or concurrence (with g1519 for infinitive, in order to fall in with)
5222.gi: un incontro o concordanza (con g1519 per infinitivo, per imbattersi in)

5223.g: existency or proprietorship, i.e., (concretely) property, wealth
5223.gi: esistenza o proprietà, cioè (concretamente) proprietà, ricchezza

5224.g: things extant or in hand, i.e., property or possessions
5224.gi: cose esistenti o in mano, cioè proprietà o beni

5225.g: to begin under (quietly), i.e., come into existence (be present or at hand); expletively, to exist (as copula or subordinate to an adjective, participle, adverb or preposition, or as an auxiliary to a principal (verb)
5225.gl: to begin below, to make a beginning; to begin; to come forth, hence to be there, be ready, be at hand; to be
5225.gi: iniziare sotto (silenziosamente), cioè venire all'esistenza (essere presente o a portata); espletivamente, esistere (come copula o subordinato a un aggettivo, participio, avverbio o preposizione, o come ausiliare a un verbo principale)

5226.gl: to resist no longer, but to give way, yield (of combatants); metaphorically to yield to authority and admonition, to submit

5227.g: under (covertly) contrary to, i.e., opposed or (as noun) an opponent
5227.gl: opposite to; set over against: meeting one another; opposed to, contrary to, an adversary
5227.gi: sotto (copertamente) contrario a, cioè opposto o (come sostantivo) un avversario

5228.g: "over", i.e., (with the genitive case) of place, above, beyond, across, or causal, for the sake of, instead, regarding; with the accusative case superior to, more than
5228.gl: in behalf of, for the sake of; over, beyond, more than; more, beyond, over
5228.gi: "sopra", cioè (con il caso genitivo) di luogo, al di sopra, oltre, attraverso, o causale, per il bene di, invece, riguardo a; con il caso accusativo superiore a, più di

5229.g: to raise oneself over, i.e., (figuratively) to become haughty
5229.gl: to lift or raise up over some thing; to lift one's self up, be exalted, be haughty; to carry one's self haughtily to, behave insolently towards one

5230.g: beyond the "acme", i.e., figuratively (of a daughter) past the bloom (prime) of youth
5230.gl: beyond the bloom or prime of life; overripe, plump and ripe, (and so in a greater danger of defilement); of a virgin
5230.gi: oltre l'"acme", cioè figurato (di una figlia) oltre la fioritura (maturità) della giovinezza

5231.g: above upward, i.e., greatly higher (in place or rank)
5231.gl: above; above a thing; of a place; of rank or power
5231.gi: al di sopra, verso l'alto, cioè molto più in alto (in luogo o rango)

5232.gl: to increase beyond measure; to grow exceedingly

5233.gl: to step over, beyond; metaphorically; to transgress; to overstep the proper limits; trespass, do wrong, sin; of one who defrauds another in business; overreaches

5235.g: to throw beyod the usual mark, i.e., (figuratively) to surpass (only active participle supereminent)
5235.gl: to surpass in throwing, to throw over or beyond any thing; to transcend, surpass, exceed, excel; excelling, exceeding
5235.gi: lanciare oltre il segno abituale, cioè (figurato) superare (solo participio attivo supereminente)

5236.g: a throwing beyond others, i.e., (figuratively) supereminence; adverbially (with g1519 or g2596) pre- eminently
5236.gl: a throwing beyond; metaphorically; superiority, excellence, pre-eminence; beyond measure, exceedingly, preeminently; beyond all measure
5236.gi: un lanciare oltre gli altri, cioè (figurato) superiorità; avverbialmente (con g1519 o g2596) preminente

5237.gl: to overlook, take no notice of, not attend to

5238.g: above those parts, i.e., still farther
5238.gl: beyond: the regions lying beyond the country of one's residence
5238.gi: sopra quelle parti, cioè ancora più lontano

5239.gl: to extend beyond the prescribed bounds, stretch out beyond measure, stretch out overmuch

5240.g: to pour out over, i.e., (passively) to overflow
5240.gl: to pour out beyond measure; to overflow, run over

5242.g: to hold oneself above, i.e., (figuratively) to excel; participle (as adjective, or neuter as noun) superior, superiority
5242.gl: to have or hold over one; to stand out, rise above, overtop; to be above, be superior in rank, authority, power; the prominent men, rulers; to excel, to be superior, better than, to surpass
5242.gi: tenersi al di sopra, cioè (figurato) eccellere; participio (come aggettivo, o neutro come sostantivo) superiore, superiorità

5243.gl: pride, haughtiness, arrogance; the character of one who, with a swollen estimate of his own powers or merits, looks down on others and even treats them with insolence and contempt

5244.gl: showing one's self above others, overtopping, conspicuous above others, pre-eminent; with an overweening estimate of one's means or merits, despising others or even treating them with contempt, haughty
5244.gi: apparire sopra gli altri (evidente), cioè (figurato) superbo

5245.g: to vanquish beyond, i.e., gain a decisive victory
5245.gl: to be more than a conqueror, to gain a surpassing victory
5245.gi: sconfiggere oltre, cioè ottenere una vittoria decisiva

5247.g: prominence, i.e., (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character)
5247.gi: prominenza, cioè (figurato) superiorità (in rango o carattere)

5248.gl: to abound beyond measure, abound exceedingly; to overflow, to enjoy abundantly

5250.gl: to be exceedingly abundant; to overflow; to possess in excess

5251.g: to elevate above others, i.e., raise to the highest position
5251.gl: metaphorically to exalt to the highest rank and power, raise to supreme majesty; to extol most highly; to be lifted up with pride, exalted beyond measure; to carry one's self loftily
5251.gi: elevare sopra gli altri, cioè elevare alla posizione più alta

5252.g: to esteem oneself overmuch, i.e., be vain or arrogant
5252.gl: to think more highly of one's self than is proper
5252.gi: stimarsi eccessivamente, cioè essere vano o arrogante

5253.g: a higher part of the house, i.e., apartment in the third story
5253.gl: the highest part of the house, the upper rooms or story where the women resided; a room in the upper part of a house, sometimes built upon the flat roof of the house, whither middle easterners were wont to retire in order to sup, meditate, pray
5253.gi: una parte più alta della casa, cioè appartamento al terzo piano

5254.g: to hold oneself under, i.e., endure with patience
5254.gl: to hold under, to put under, place underneath; metaphorically to sustain, undergo; suffer punishment
5254.gi: tenersi sotto, cioè sopportare con pazienza

5256.g: to be a subordinate, i.e., (by implication) subserve
5256.gl: to act as a rower, to row; to minister, render services

5257.g: an under-oarsman, i.e., (generally) subordinate (assistant, sexton, constable)
5257.gl: servant; an underrower, subordinate rower; any one who serves with hands: a servant; in the new testament of the officers and attendants of magistrates; of the officer who executes penalties; of the attendants of a king, servants, retinue, the soldiers of a king, of the attendant of a synagogue; of any one ministering or rendering service; any one who aids another in any work; an assistant; of the preacher of the gospel
5257.gi: un rematore sottostante, cioè (genericamente) subordinato (assistente, sacrestano, maresciallo)

5259.g: under, i.e., (with the genitive case) of place (beneath), or with verbs (the agency or means, through); (with the accusative case) of place (whither (underneath) or where (below) or time (when (at))
5259.gi: sotto, cioè (con il caso genitivo) di luogo (sotto), o con verbi (l'agenzia o il mezzo, attraverso); (con il caso accusativo) di luogo (verso dove (sotto) o dove (sotto) o tempo (quando (a))

5260.g: to throw in stealthily, i.e., introduce by collusion
5260.gl: to throw or put under; to suggest to the mind; to instruct privately, instigate, to bribe or induce (someone) unlawfully or secretly to perform some misdeed or commit a crime; to induce (a person especially a witness) to give false testimony
5260.gi: lanciare furtivamente, cioè introdurre per collusione

5261.g: an underwriting, i.e., copy for imitation (figuratively)
5261.gl: a writing copy, including all the letters of the alphabet, given to beginners as an aid in learning to draw them; an example set before one
5261.gi: una sottoscrizione, cioè copia da imitare (figurato)

5262.g: an exhibit for imitation or warning (figuratively, specimen, adumbration)
5262.gl: a sign suggestive of anything, delineation of a thing, representation, figure, copy; an example: for imitation; of the thing to be imitated; for a warning, of a thing to be shunned
5262.gi: un'esposizione per imitazione o avvertimento (figurato, campione, abbozzo)

5263.g: to exhibit under the eyes, i.e., (figuratively) to exemplify (instruct, admonish)
5263.gl: to show by placing under (i.e., before) the eyes; to show by words and arguments, i.e., to teach; to show by make known future things
5263.gi: mostrare davanti agli occhi, cioè (figurato) esemplificare (istruire, ammonire)

5264.g: to admit under one's roof, i.e., entertain hospitably
5264.gi: ammettere sotto il proprio tetto, cioè ospitare con ospitalità

5265.g: to bind under one's feet, i.e., put on shoes or sandals
5265.gl: to underbind; to bind under one's self, bind on
5265.gi: legare sotto i propri piedi, cioè mettersi scarpe o sandali

5266.g: something bound under the feet, i.e., a shoe or sandal
5266.gl: what is bound under, a sandal, a sole fastened to the foot with thongs
5266.gi: qualcosa legato sotto i piedi, cioè una scarpa o un sandalo

5267.gl: under judgment, one who lost his suit; debtor to one, owing satisfaction to; of liable to punishment from god

5268.g: an animal under the yoke (draught-beast), i.e., (specially), a donkey
5268.gl: under the yoke; a beast of burden, an ass; the ass was the common animal used by the middle easterners on journey and for carrying burdens
5268.gi: un animale sotto il giogo (animale da tiro), cioè (specialmente) un asino

5269.g: to gird under, i.e., frap (a vessel with cables across the keel, sides and deck)
5269.gl: to undergird; to bind a ship together laterally: i.e., with girths or cables, to enable it to survive the force of waves and tempest
5269.gi: cingere sotto, cioè frap (una nave con cavi attraverso la chiglia, i fianchi e il ponte)

5271.g: to decide (speak or act) under a false part, i.e., (figuratively) dissemble (pretend)
5271.gl: to take up another's statements in reference to what one has decided for one's self; to reply, answer; to make answer (speak) on the stage; to impersonate anyone, play a part; to simulate, feign, pretend
5271.gi: decidere (parlare o agire) sotto una falsa parte, cioè (figurato) fingere (simulare)

5272.g: acting under a feigned part, i.e., (figuratively) deceit ("hypocrisy")
5272.gl: an answering; an answer; the acting of a stage player; dissimulation, hypocrisy
5272.gi: agire sotto una parte finta, cioè (figurato) inganno ("ipocrisia")

5273.g: an actor under an assumed character (stage-player), i.e., (figuratively) a dissembler ("hypocrite"
5273.gl: one who answers, an interpreter; an actor, stage player; a dissembler, pretender, hypocrite
5273.gi: un attore sotto un personaggio assunto (attore di teatro), cioè (figurato) un ipocrita

5274.g: to take from below, i.e., carry upward; figuratively, to take up, i.e., continue a discourse or topic; mentally, to assume (presume)
5274.gl: to take up in order to raise, to bear on high; to take up and carry away; to receive hospitably, welcome; to take up; follow in speech, in order either to reply to or controvert or supplement what another has said; to take up in the mind; to assume, suppose
5274.gi: prendere da sotto, cioè portare in alto; figurato, riprendere, cioè continuare un discorso o un argomento; mentalmente, assumere (presumere)

5275.g: to leave under (behind), i.e., (passively) to remain (survive)
5275.gl: to leave behind; to be left behind, left remaining; of a survivor

5276.g: vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e., lower wine-vat
5276.gl: a vessel placed under a press (and in the orient usually sunk in the earth) to receive the expressed juice of the grapes, a pit
5276.gi: vaso o recipiente sotto la pressa, cioè tino inferiore per il vino

5277.gi: lasciare indietro, cioè lasciare in eredità

5278.g: to stay under (behind), i.e., remain; figuratively, to undergo, i.e., bear (trials), have fortitude, persevere
5278.gl: to remain; to tarry behind; to remain i.e., abide, not recede or flee; to preserve: under misfortunes and trials to hold fast to one's faith in christ; to endure, bear bravely and calmly: ill treatments
5278.gi: rimanere sotto (dietro), cioè rimanere; figurativamente, subire, cioè sopportare (prove), avere fortitudine, perseverare

5279.g: to remind quietly, i.e., suggest to the (middle voice, one's own) memory
5279.gl: to cause one to remember, bring to remembrance, recall to mind: to another; to put one in remembrance, admonish, of something; to be reminded, to remember
5279.gi: ricordare silenziosamente, cioè suggerire alla (voce media, propria) memoria

5281.gl: steadfastness, constancy, endurance; in the new testament the characteristic of a man who is not swerved from his deliberate purpose and his loyalty to faith and piety by even the greatest trials and sufferings; patiently, and steadfastly; a patient, steadfast waiting for; a patient enduring, sustaining, perseverance

5282.g: to think under (privately), i.e., to surmise or conjecture
5282.gi: pensare sotto (privatamente), cioè supporre o congetturare

5284.g: to sail under the lee of
5284.gl: to sail under, that is, to sail close by; to the leeward of

5285.gl: to blow underneath; to blow softly

5286.g: something under the feet, i.e., a foot-rest (figuratively)
5286.gl: a footstool; to make one a footstool of one's feet, i.e., to subject, to reduce under one's power; metaphorically taken from the practice of conquerors who placed their feet on the necks of their conquered enemies
5286.gi: qualcosa sotto i piedi, cioè un poggiapiedi (figurato)

5287.g: a setting under (support), i.e., (figuratively) concretely, essence, or abstractly, assurance (objectively or subjectively)
5287.gl: a setting or placing under; thing put under, substructure, foundation; that which has foundation, is firm; that which has actual existence; a substance, real being; the substantial quality, nature, of a person or thing; the steadfastness of mind, firmness, courage, resolution; confidence, firm trust, assurance
5287.gi: un posizionamento sotto (supporto), cioè (figurato) concretamente, essenza, o astrattamente, sicurezza (oggettivamente o soggettivamente)

5288.g: to withhold under (out of sight), i.e., (reflexively) to cower or shrink, (figuratively) to conceal (reserve)
5288.gl: to draw back, let down, lower; to withdraw: of a timid person; to withdraw one's self, i.e., to be timid, to cover, shrink; of those who from timidity hesitate to avow what they believe; to be unwilling to utter from fear; to shrink from declaring, to conceal, dissemble
5288.gi: trattenere sotto (fuori vista), cioè (riflessivamente) rannicchirsi o ritirarsi, (figurato) nascondere (riservare)

5289.gl: the timidity of one stealthily retreating

5290.g: to turn under (behind), i.e., to return (literally or figuratively)
5290.gl: to turn back; to turn about; to return
5290.gi: girare sotto (dietro), cioè, ritornare (letteralmente o figurato)

5291.g: to strew underneath (the feet as a carpet)
5291.gi: spargere sotto (ai piedi come un tappeto)

5292.gl: the act of subjecting; obedience, subjection

5293.gl: to arrange under, to subordinate; to subject, put in subjection; to subject one's self, obey; to submit to one's control; to yield to one's admonition or advice; to obey, be subject

5294.g: to place underneath, i.e., (figuratively) to hazard, (reflexively) to suggest
5294.gl: to place under; metaphorically to supply, suggest (supply from one's own resources)

5295.g: to run under, i.e., (specially), to sail past
5295.gl: to run under; of navigators; to run past a place on the shore, and therefore in a higher position; running under the lee of

5296.g: typification under (after), i.e., (concretely) a sketch (figuratively) for imitation
5296.gl: an outline, sketch, brief and summary exposition; an example, pattern; for an example of those who should hereafter believe; to show by the example of my conversation that the same grace which i had obtained would not be wanting also to those who should hereafter believe
5296.gi: tipificazione sotto (dopo), cioè (concretamente) uno schizzo (figurato) per imitazione

5297.g: to bear from underneath, i.e., (figuratively) to undergo hardship
5297.gl: to bear by being under, bear up (a thing placed on one's shoulders); to bear patiently, to endure
5297.gi: sostenere da sotto, cioè, (figurato) sopportare difficoltà

5298.g: to vacate down, i.e., retire quietly
5298.gi: svuotare verso il basso, cioè ritirarsi silenziosamente

5299.g: to hit under the eye (buffet or disable an antagonist as a pugilist), i.e., (figuratively) to tease or annoy (into compliance), subdue (one's passions)
5299.gl: to beat black and blue, to smite so as to cause bruises and livid spots; like a boxer one buffets his body, handle it roughly, discipline by hardships; metaphorically; to give one intolerable annoyance; beat one out, wear one out; by entreaties; that part of the face that is under the eyes
5299.gi: colpire sotto l'occhio (battere o disabilitare un avversario come un pugile), cioè, (figurato) infastidire o molestare (per obbedienza), sottomettere (le proprie passioni)

5301.gl: hyssop; a plant used by the hebrews in their ritual sprinklings

5302.g: to be later, i.e., (by implication) to be inferior; generally, to fall short (be deficient)
5302.gl: behind; to come late or too tardily; to be left behind in the race and so fail to reach the goal, to fall short of the end; metaphorically fail to become a partaker, fall back from; to be inferior in power, influence and rank; of the person: to be inferior to; to fail, be wanting; to be in want of, lack; to suffer want, to be devoid of, to lack (be inferior) in excellence, worth
5302.gi: essere più tardi, cioè, (per implicazione) essere inferiore; generalmente, mancare (essere carente)

5303.gl: deficiency, that which is lacking; in reference to property and resources, poverty, want, destitution

5305.gl: latter, later, coming after, the second; afterward, after this, later, lastly

5306.gl: latter, later, coming after, the second; afterward, after this, later, lastly

5308.gl: high, lofty; exalted on high; with an uplifted arm, i.e., with signal power; metaphorically eminent, exalted; in influence and honor; to set the mind on, to seek, high things (as honors and riches), to be aspiring

5309.g: to be lofty in mind, i.e., arrogant
5309.gi: essere superbo di mente, cioè, arrogante

5310.g: highest, i.e., (masculine singular) the supreme (god), or (neuter plural) the heavens
5310.gl: highest, most high; of place: the highest regions; of rank: the most high god
5310.gi: il più alto, cioè (maschile singolare) il supremo (Dio), o (neutro plurale) i cieli

5311.g: elevation, i.e., (abstractly) altitude, (specially), the sky, or (figuratively) dignity
5311.gl: height; of measurement; of place, heaven; metaphorically rank, high station
5311.gi: elevazione, cioè (astrattamente) altitudine, (specialmente) il cielo, o (figurato) dignità

5312.gl: to lift up on high, to exalt; metaphorically; to raise to the very summit of opulence and prosperity; to exalt, to raise to dignity, honor and happiness

5313.g: an elevated place or thing, i.e., (abstractly) altitude, or (by implication) a barrier (figuratively)
5313.gl: thing elevated, height; of space; elevated structure i.e., barrier, rampart, bulwark
5313.gi: un luogo o cosa elevato, cioè (astrattamente) altitudine, o (per implicazione) una barriera (figurato)

5315.gl: to eat; to eat (consume) a thing; to take food, eat a meal; metaphorically to devour, consume

5316.g: to lighten (shine), i.e., show (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative)
5316.gl: to bring forth into the light, cause to shine, shed light; shine; to shine, be bright or resplendent; to become evident, to be brought forth into the light, come to view, appear; of growing vegetation, to come to light; to appear, be seen; exposed to view; to meet the eyes, strike the sight, become clear or manifest; to be seen, appear; to appear to the mind, seem to one's judgment or opinion
5316.gi: illuminare (splendere), cioè, mostrare (transitivo o intransitivo, letterale o figurato)

5318.g: shining, i.e., apparent (literally or figuratively); neuter (as adverb) publicly, externally
5318.gl: apparent, manifest, evident, known; manifest i.e., to be plainly recognized or known
5318.gi: splendente, cioè, apparire (letteralmente o figurato); neutro (come avverbio) pubblicamente, esternamente

5319.gl: to make manifest or visible or known what has been hidden or unknown, to manifest, whether by words, or deeds, or in any other way; make actual and visible, realized; to make known by teaching; to become manifest, be made known; of a person; expose to view, make manifest, to show one's self, appear; to become known, to be plainly recognized, thoroughly understood; who and what one is

5320.gi: chiaramente, cioè in modo chiaro o pubblico

5321.g: exhibition, i.e., (figuratively) expression, (by extension) a bestowment
5321.gi: esposizione, cioè (figurato) espressione, (per estensione) una donazione

5323.gl: [the face of god]; the father of anna, the prophetess of the tribe of asher

5324.g: to make apparent, i.e., (passively) to appear (neuter participle as noun, a spectacle)
5324.gl: to cause to appear, make visible, expose to view, show; the appearance, sight
5324.gi: rendere apparire, cioè, (passivamente) apparire (participio neutro come nome, uno spettacolo)

5327.g: a gap or chasm, i.e., ravine (winter-torrent)
5327.gl: a valley shut off by cliffs and precipices; a ravine
5327.gi: una fessura o abisso, cioè, forra (torrente invernale)

5328.gl: [his nakedness]; was a common title of the native kings of egypt

5329.gl: [a breach]; the son of judah and tamar, his daughter-in-law

5330.g: a separatist, i.e., exclusively religious; a pharisean, i.e., jewish sectary
5330.gl: a jewish sect (which seems to have started after the jewish exile) that focused on outward forms of piety, enemies of jesus christ
5330.gi: un separatista, cioè, esclusivamente religioso; un fariseo, cioè, sectario ebreo

5331.g: medication ("pharmacy"), i.e., (by extension) magic (literally or figuratively)
5331.gl: the use or the administering of drugs; poisoning; sorcery, magical arts, often found in connection with idolatry and fostered by it; metaphorically the deceptions and seductions of idolatry
5331.gi: medicazione ("farmacia"), cioè, (per estension) magia (letteralmente o figurato)

5332.g: a druggist ("pharmacist") or poisoner, i.e., (by extension) a magician
5332.gl: one who prepares or uses magical remedies; sorcerer
5332.gi: un farmacista ("farmacista") o avvelenatore, cioè, (per estension) un mago

5333.gl: pertaining to magical arts (i.e., black magic), sorcerer, magician, necromancer

5334.gl: in the attic orators, the exposure of (informing against) those who have embezzled the property of the state, or violated the laws respecting the importation or exporting of merchandise, or defrauded their wards; the disclosure of secret crime

5335.gl: to affirm, allege, portend or profess

5337.gl: easy, slight, ordinary, mean, worthless, of no account; ethically, bad, base, wicked

5338.gl: light; of the moon; of a candle or lamp; the bright sunshine, the beam of light

5339.g: to be chary of, i.e., (subjectively) to abstain or (objectively) to treat leniently
5339.gi: essere cauto di, cioè, (soggettivamente) astenersi o (oggettivamente) trattare con indulgenza

5341.gl: a travelling cloke, used for protection against stormy weather

5342.g: to "bear" or carry (in a very wide application, literally and figuratively, as follows)
5342.gl: to carry; to carry some burden; to bear with one's self; to move by bearing; move or, to be conveyed or borne, with the suggestion of force or speed; of persons borne in a ship over the sea; of a gust of wind, to rush; of the mind, to be moved inwardly, prompted; to bear up i.e., uphold (keep from falling); of christ, the preserver of the universe; to bear, i.e., endure, to endure the rigour of a thing, to bear patiently one's conduct, or spare one (abstain from punishing or destroying); to bring, bring to, bring forward; to move to, apply; to bring in by announcing, to announce; to bear i.e., bring forth, produce; to bring forward in a speech; to lead, conduct
5342.gi: "sostenere" o portare (in un'applicazione molto ampia, letterale e figurata, come segue)

5343.g: to run away (literally or figuratively); by implication, to shun; by analogy, to vanish
5343.gl: to flee away, seek safety by flight; metaphorically to flee (to shun or avoid by flight) something abhorrent, especially vices; to be saved by flight, to escape safely out of danger; poetically, to flee away, vanish
5343.gi: fuggire (letteralmente o figurato); per implicazione, evitare; per analogia, svanire

5344.gl: [happy]; a roman procurator of judea appointed by the emperor claudius in ad 53

5346.g: to show or make known one's thoughts, i.e., speak or say
5346.gl: to make known one's thoughts, to declare; to say
5346.gi: mostrare o far conoscere i propri pensieri, cioè, parlare o dire

5347.gl: [festival]; the successor of felix as procurator of judea

5348.g: to be beforehand, i.e., anticipate or precede; by extension, to have arrived at
5348.gl: to come before, precede, anticipate; to come to, arrive at; to reach, attain to
5348.gi: essere prima, cioè, anticipare o precedere; per estension, essere arrivato a

5350.g: to utter a clear sound, i.e., (generally) to proclaim
5350.gl: to give out a sound, noise or cry; of any sort of sound or voice, whether of man or of animal or inanimate object as thunder, musical instruments, etc.
5350.gi: pronunciare un suono chiaro, cioè (genericamente) proclamare

5351.g: properly, to shrivel or wither, i.e., to spoil (by any process) or (generally) to ruin (especially figuratively, by moral influences, to deprave)
5351.gl: to corrupt, to destroy; in the opinion of the jews, the temple was corrupted or "destroyed" when anyone defiled or in the slightest degree damaged anything in it, or if its guardians neglected their duties; to lead away a christian church from that state of knowledge and holiness in which it ought to abide; to be destroyed, to perish; in an ethical sense, to corrupt, deprave
5351.gi: propriamente, avvizzire o seccarsi, cioè guastare (qualsiasi processo) o (genericamente) rovinare (specialmente figurato, per influssi morali, corrompere)

5352.g: akin to the base of g5351) and g3703 (meaning late autumn); autumnal (as stripped of leaves)
5352.gl: autumn trees; trees such as they are at the close of autumn, dry, leafless and without fruit; metaphorically of unfruitful, worthless men
5352.gi: affine alla base di g5351) e g3703 (significato tardo autunno); autunnale (come spogliato di foglie)

5353.g: utterance, i.e., a musical note (vocal or instrumental)
5353.gl: musical sound, whether vocal or instrumental
5353.gi: enunciazione, cioè una nota musicale (vocale o strumentale)

5355.gl: envy; for envy, i.e., prompted by envy

5356.g: decay, i.e., ruin (spontaneous or inflicted, literally or figuratively)
5356.gl: corruption, destruction, perishing; that which is subject to corruption, what is perishable; in the christian sense, eternal misery in hell; in the new testament, in an ethical sense, corruption i.e., moral decay
5356.gi: decadimento, cioè rovina (spontanea o inflitta, letteralmente o figurato)

5357.gl: a broad shallow bowl, deep saucer

5358.g: fond to good, i.e., a promoter of virtue
5358.gi: incline al bene, cioè promotore di virtù

5359.g: philadelphia, a place in asia minor
5359.gl: [brotherly love]; a city of lydia in asia minor, situated near the eastern base of of mount tmolus
5359.gi: filadelfia, un luogo in asia minore

5360.gl: love of brothers or sisters, brotherly love; in the new testament the love which christians cherish for each other as brethren

5361.gl: loving brother or sister; in a broader sense, loving one like a brother, loving one's fellow countrymen; of an israelite; of a christian loving christians

5362.g: fond of man, i.e., affectionate as a wife
5362.gi: affezionato all'uomo, cioè, affettuoso come una moglie

5367.gl: loving one's self; too intent on one's interest, selfish

5368.g: to be a friend to (fond of (an individual or an object)), i.e., have affection for (denoting personal attachment, as a matter of sentiment or feeling; while g0025 is wider, embracing especially the judgment and the deliberate assent of the will as a matter of principle, duty and propriety: the two thus stand related very much as g2309 and g1014, or as g2372 and g3563 respectively; the former being chiefly of the heart and the latter of the head); specially, to kiss (as a mark of tenderness)
5368.gl: to love; to approve of; to like; sanction; to treat affectionately or kindly, to welcome, befriend; to show signs of love; to kiss; to be fond of doing; be wont, use to do
5368.gi: essere amico di (amante (di un individuo o di un oggetto)), cioè avere affetto per (denotando attaccamento personale, come questione di sentimento o sentire; mentre g0025 è più ampio, abbracciando specialmente il giudizio e il consenso deliberato della volontà come questione di principio, dovere e proprietà: i due stanno quindi correlati molto come g2309 e g1014, o come g2372 e g3563 rispettivamente; il primo è principalmente del cuore e il secondo della testa); specialmente, baciare (come segno di tenerezza)

5370.gl: a kiss; the kiss with which, as a sign of fraternal affection, christians were accustomed to welcome or dismiss their companions in the faith

5371.gl: [one who kisses]; a resident of colosse, converted to christianity by paul, and the recipient of the letter bearing his name

5372.g: amiable; philetus, an opposer of christianity
5372.gl: [beloved]; a heretic and a disciple of hymenaeus,
5372.gi: amabile; fileto, un oppositore del cristianesimo

5374.g: a philippesian (philippian), i.e., native of philippi
5374.gl: a resident of the town of philippi
5374.gi: un filippese (filippiano), cioè nativo di Filippi

5375.gl: [lover of horses]; a city of macedonia located on or near the northern coast of the aegean sea, between the rivers strymon and nestus, and the cities neapolis and amphipolis

5376.g: fond of horses; philippus, the name of four israelites
5376.gl: [lover of horses]; an apostle of christ; an evangelist and one of the seven deacons of the jerusalem church; philip the tetrarch of trachonitis (see luke 3:1); caesarea philippi
5376.gi: amante dei cavalli; Filippo, il nome di quattro israeliti

5378.g: fond of words, i.e., talkative (argumentative, learned, "philological"); philologus, a christian
5378.gl: [lover of the word]; a christian paul greets in his epistle to romans
5378.gi: amante delle parole, cioè loquace (polemico, erudito, "filologico"); Filologo, un cristiano

5379.gl: love of strife, eagerness to contend; contention; in a good sense, emulation

5380.gl: fond of strife, contentious; in a good sense, emulous

5383.g: to be fond of being first, i.e., ambitious of distinction
5383.gl: to aspire to pre-eminence, to desire to be first
5383.gi: essere affezionato ad essere primo, cioè ambizioso di distinzione

5384.g: actively, fond, i.e., friendly (still as a noun, an associate, neighbor, etc.)
5384.gl: friend, to be friendly to one, wish him well; a friend; an associate; he who associates familiarly with one, a companion; one of the bridegroom's friends who on his behalf asked the hand of the bride and rendered him various services in closing the marriage and celebrating the nuptials
5384.gi: attivamente, amante, cioè amichevole (ancora come sostantivo, un associato, un vicino, ecc.)

5385.gl: love of wisdom; used either of zeal for or skill in any art or science, any branch of knowledge

5386.g: fond of wise things, i.e., a "philosopher"
5386.gl: a philosopher, one given to the pursuit of wisdom or learning; in a narrower sense, one who investigates and discusses the cause of things and the highest good
5386.gi: affezionato alle cose sagge, cioè un filosofo

5387.g: fond of natural relatives, i.e., fraternal towards fellow christian
5387.gl: the mutual love of parents and children and wives and husbands; loving affection, prone to love, loving tenderly; chiefly of the reciprocal tenderness of parents and children
5387.gi: amante dei parenti naturali, cioè fraterno verso il cristiano fratello

5388.g: fond of one's children, i.e., maternal
5388.gi: affezionato ai propri figli, cioè materno

5389.g: to be fond of honor, i.e., emulous (eager or earnest to do something)
5389.gl: to be fond of honor; to be actuated by love of honor; from a love of honor to strive to bring something to pass; to be ambitious; to strive earnestly, make it one's aim
5389.gi: essere affezionato all'onore, cioè emulo (ansioso o desideroso di fare qualcosa)

5390.g: with friendliness of mind, i.e., kindly
5390.gi: con amicizia di mente, cioè gentile

5392.gl: to close the mouth with a muzzle, to muzzle; metaphorically; to stop the mouth, make speechless, reduce to silence; to become speechless; to be kept in check

5393.gl: [burning]; a resident at rome greeted by paul of the book of romans

5394.g: to cause a blaze, i.e., ignite (figuratively, to inflame with passion)
5394.gl: to ignite, set on fire; to burn up; figuratively to operate destructively, have a most pernicious power; of that in which the destructive influences are kindled
5394.gi: causare una fiamma, cioè accendere (figurato, infiammare di passione)

5396.g: to be a babbler or trifler, i.e., (by implication) to berate idly or mischievously
5396.gl: to utter nonsense, talk idly, prate; to bring forward idle accusations, make empty charges; to accuse one falsely with malicious words
5396.gi: essere un ciarlone o un frivolo, cioè (per implicazione) berare oziosamente o maliziosamente

5397.gl: of persons uttering or doing silly things, garrulous, babbling; of things, foolish, trifling, vain

5398.gl: inspiring fear, terrible, formidable; affected with fear, timid

5399.g: to frighten, i.e., (passively) to be alarmed; by analogy, to be in awe of, i.e., revere
5399.gl: to put to flight by terrifying (to scare away); to put to flight, to flee; to fear, be afraid; to be struck with fear, to be seized with alarm; of those startled by strange sights or occurrences; of those struck with amazement; to fear, be afraid of one; to fear (i.e., hesitate) to do something (for fear of harm); to reverence, venerate, to treat with deference or reverential obedience
5399.gi: spaventare, cioè (passivamente) essere allarmato; per analogia, essere in awe di, cioè riverire

5400.g: a frightening thing, i.e., terrific portent
5400.gl: that which strikes terror, a terror, (cause of) fright
5400.gi: una cosa spaventosa, cioè terrificante presagio

5401.gl: fear, dread, terror; that which strikes terror; reverence for one's husband

5402.g: probably akin to the base of g5457); phoebe, a christian woman
5402.gl: [radiant]; a servant of the church at cenchrea, near corinth
5402.gi: probabilmente affine alla base di g5457); febe, una donna cristiana

5403.g: palm-country; phoenice (or phoenicia), a region of palestine
5403.gl: [land of palm trees]; a territory of the province of syria, situated on the coast of the mediterranean between the river eleutherus and the promontory of carmel, some 30 miles (50 km) long and 3 (5 km) broad
5403.gi: terra delle palme; Fenice (o Fenicia), una regione della Palestina

5405.gl: [palm tree]; the name of a haven in crete on the south coast

5406.g: a murderer (always of criminal (or at least intentional) homicide; which g0443 does not necessarily imply; while g4607 is a special term for a public bandit)
5406.gi: un assassino (sempre di omicidio criminale (o almeno intenzionale); che g0443 non implica necessariamente; mentre g4607 è un termine speciale per un bandito pubblico)

5407.gl: to kill, slay, murder; to commit murder

5409.g: to have a burden, i.e., (by analogy) to wear as clothing or a constant accompaniment
5409.gl: to bear constantly, wear; of clothing, garments, armour
5409.gi: avere un peso, cioè (per analogia) indossare come abbigliamento o accompagnamento costante

5410.g: a forum or market-place; only in comparative with g0675; a station on the appian road
5410.gl: appius forum, a town in italy, 43 roman miles (70 km) from rome on the appian way
5410.gi: un foro o mercato; solo in confronto con g0675; una stazione sulla via Appia

5411.g: a load (as borne), i.e., (figuratively) a tax (properly, an individual assessment on persons or property; whereas g5056 is usually a general toll on goods or travel)
5411.gl: tribute, especially the annual tax levied upon houses, lands, and persons
5411.gi: un carico (portato), cioè (figurato) un tributo (propriamente, una tassazione individuale su persone o proprietà; mentre g5056 è di solito un pedaggio generale su merci o viaggi)

5412.g: to load up (properly, as a vessel or animal), i.e., (figuratively) to overburden with ceremony (or spiritual anxiety)
5412.gl: to place a burden upon, to load; metaphorically to load one with a burden (of rites and unwarranted precepts)
5412.gi: caricare (propriamente, come un vascello o un animale), cioè (figurato) sovraccaricare di cerimonie (o ansia spirituale)

5413.g: an invoice (as part of freight), i.e., (figuratively) a task or service
5413.gl: a burden, load; of the freight or lading of a ship; metaphorically; of burdensome rites; of the obligations christ lays upon his followers, and styles a "burden" by way of the contrast to the precepts of the pharisees, the observance of which was most oppressive; faults of the conscience which oppress the soul
5413.gi: una fattura (come parte del carico), cioè (figurato) un compito o servizio

5414.g: something carried, i.e., the cargo of a ship
5414.gl: a load, burden; of a ship
5414.gi: qualcosa di trasportato, cioè il carico di una nave

5416.g: a whip, i.e., roman lash as a public punishment
5416.gi: una frusta, cioè frusta romana come punizione pubblica

5417.g: to whip, i.e., lash as a public punishment
5417.gi: frustare, cioè flagellare come punizione pubblica

5418.g: a fence, or inclosing barrier (literally or figuratively)
5418.gl: a hedge, a fence; that which separates, prevents two from coming together
5418.gi: una recinzione, o barriera di confine (letteralmente o figurativamente)

5419.g: to indicate (by word or act), i.e., (specially), to expound
5419.gl: to indicate plainly, make known, declare, whether by gesture or by writing or speaking, or in some other ways; to explain
5419.gi: indicare (per parola o atto), cioè (specialmente), spiegare

5420.g: to fence or inclose, i.e., (specially), to block up (figuratively, to silence)
5420.gl: to fence in, block up, stop up, close up; to put to silence
5420.gi: recintare o chiudere, cioè (specialmente), ostruire (figurato, zittire)

5421.g: a hole in the ground (dug for obtaining or holding water or other purposes), i.e., a cistern or well; figuratively, an abyss (as a prison)
5421.gl: a well; the pit of the abyss (because the nether world is thought to increase in size the further it extends from the surface of the earth and so resemble a cistern, the orifice of which is narrow)
5421.gi: una buca nel terreno (scavata per ottenere o contenere acqua o altri scopi), cioè una cisterna o un pozzo; figurativamente, un abisso (come prigione)

5422.g: to be a mind-misleader, i.e., delude
5422.gi: essere un ingannatore di mente, cioè ingannare

5423.gi: un ingannatore di mente, cioè seduttore

5424.g: the midrif (as a partition of the body), i.e., (figuratively and by implication, of sympathy) the feelings (or sensitive nature; by extension (also in the plural) the mind or cognitive faculties)
5424.gl: the midriff or diaphragm, the parts of the heart; the mind; the faculty of perceiving and judging
5424.gi: la parte centrale (come partizione del corpo), cioè (figurato e per implicazione, di simpatia) i sentimenti (o natura sensibile; per estensione (anche al plurale) la mente o le facoltà cognitive)

5425.gl: to bristle, stiffen stand up; to shudder, to be struck with extreme fear, to be horrified

5426.g: to exercise the mind, i.e., entertain or have a sentiment or opinion; by implication, to be (mentally) disposed (more or less earnestly in a certain direction); intensively, to interest oneself in (with concern or obedience)
5426.gl: to have understanding, be wise; to feel, to think; to have an opinion of one's self, think of one's self, to be modest, not let one's opinion (though just) of himself exceed the bounds of modesty; to think or judge what one's opinion is; to be of the same mind i.e., agreed together, cherish the same views, be harmonious; to direct one's mind to a thing, to seek, to strive for; to seek one's interest or advantage; to be of one's party, side with him (in public affairs)
5426.gi: esercitare la mente, cioè avere o nutrire un sentimento o un'opinione; per implicazione, essere (mentalmente) disposto (più o meno sinceramente in una certa direzione); intensivamente, interessarsi a (con preoccupazione o obbedienza)

5427.gl: what one has in the mind, the thoughts and purposes

5428.g: mental action or activity, i.e., intellectual or moral insight
5428.gl: understanding; knowledge and holy love of the will of god
5428.gi: azione o attività mentale, cioè intuizione intellettuale o morale

5429.g: thoughtful, i.e., sagacious or discreet (implying a cautious character; while g4680 denotes practical skill or acumen; and g4908 indicates rather intelligence or mental acquirement); in a bad sense conceited (also in the comparative)
5429.gl: intelligent, wise; prudent, i.e., mindful of one's interests
5429.gi: riflessivo, cioè saggio o discreto (implicando un carattero cauto; mentre g4680 indica abilità pratica o acume; e g4908 indica piuttosto intelligenza o acquisizione mentale); in senso negativo vanitoso (anche al comparativo)

5431.g: to exercise thought, i.e., be anxious
5431.gl: to think, to be careful; to be thoughtful or anxious
5431.gi: esercitare il pensiero, cioè essere ansioso

5432.g: to be a watcher in advance, i.e., to mount guard as a sentinel (post spies at gates); figuratively, to hem in, protect
5432.gl: to guard, protect by a military guard, either to prevent hostile invasion, or to keep the inhabitants of a besieged city from flight; metaphorically; under the control of the mosaic law, that he might not escape from its power; to protect by guarding, to keep; by watching and guarding to preserve one for the attainment of something
5432.gi: essere un osservatore in anticipo, cioè fare la guardia come sentinella (postare spie alle porte); figurato, circondare, proteggere

5433.g: to snort (as a spirited horse), i.e., (figuratively) to make a tumult
5433.gl: to neigh, stamp the ground, prance, snort; to be high-spirited; of horses; of men; to take on lofty airs; behave arrogantly; to be tumultuous, to rage
5433.gi: soffiare dal naso (come un cavallo vivace), cioè (figurato) fare un tumulto

5434.g: something desiccated, i.e., a dry twig
5434.gl: a dry stick, a twig; all dry sticks, bush wood, fire wood, or similar material used as fuel; of straw, stubble
5434.gi: qualcosa di disidratato, cioè un ramo secco

5435.g: phrygia, a region of asia minor
5435.gl: [dry, barren]; a region in asia minor bounded by bithynia, galatia, lycaonia, pisidia, lydia, mysia and it contained the cities of laodicea, hierapolis, and colosse

5436.gl: [a little fugitive]; a christian who was with paul and deserted him

5438.g: a guarding or (concretely, guard), the act, the person; figuratively, the place, the condition, or (specially), the time (as a division of day or night), literally or figuratively
5438.gl: guard, watch; a watching, keeping watch; to keep watch; persons keeping watch, a guard, sentinels; of the place where captives are kept, a prison; of the time (of night) during which guard was kept, a watch i.e., a period of time during which part of the guard was on duty, and at the end of which others relieved them
5438.gi: una guardia o (concretamente, guardia), l'atto, la persona; figurativamente, il luogo, la condizione, o (specialmente), il tempo (come divisione del giorno o della notte), letteralmente o figurativamente

5440.g: a guard-case, i.e., "phylactery" for wearing slips of scripture texts
5440.gl: a case containing scripture verses worn on the body; a fortified place provided with a garrison, a station for a guard or garrison; a preservative or safeguard , an amulet
5440.gi: una custodia di protezione, cioè "filatterio" per portare strisce di testi delle Scritture

5442.g: to watch, i.e., be on guard (literally of figuratively); by implication, to preserve, obey, avoid
5442.gl: to guard; to watch, keep watch; to guard or watch, have an eye upon: lest he escape; to guard a person (or thing) that he may remain safe; lest he suffer violence, be despoiled, etc. to protect; to protect one from a person or thing; to keep from being snatched away, preserve safe and unimpaired; to guard from being lost or perishing; to guard one's self from a thing; to guard i.e., care for, take care not to violate; to observe; to observe for one's self something to escape; to avoid, shun flee from; to guard for one's self (i.e., for one's safety's sake) so as not to violate, i.e., to keep, observe (the precepts of the mosaic law)
5442.gi: vegliare, cioè stare in guardia (letteralmente o figurativamente); per implicazione, preservare, obbedire, evitare

5443.g: an offshoot, i.e., race or clan
5443.gl: a tribe; in the new testament all the persons descending from one of the twelve sons of the patriarch, jacob; a race, nation, people
5443.gi: un germoglio, cioè razza o clan

5445.g: perhaps akin to g5453 through the idea of swelling in bulk), mean to knead; a mass of dough
5445.gl: any substance mixed with water and kneaded; a mass, a lump; of dough; of clay
5445.gi: forse affine a g5453 attraverso l'idea di gonfiarsi in massa), significa impastare; una massa di pasta

5446.gl: produced by nature, inborn; agreeable to nature; governed by (the instincts of) nature

5447.gl: in a natural manner, by nature, under the guidance of nature: by the aid of the bodily senses

5448.gl: to make natural, to cause a thing to pass into nature; to inflate, blow up, to cause to swell up; to puff up, make proud; to be puffed up, to bear one's self loftily, be proud

5449.g: growth (by germination or expansion), i.e., (by implication) natural production (lineal descent); by extension, a genus or sort; figuratively, native disposition, constitution or usage
5449.gl: nature; as opposed to what is monstrous, abnormal, perverse; birth, physical origin; a mode of feeling and acting which by long habit has become nature; the sum of innate properties and powers by which one person differs from others, distinctive native peculiarities, natural characteristics: the natural strength, ferocity, and intractability of beasts
5449.gi: "crescita" (per germinazione o espansione), cioè (per implicazione) produzione naturale (discendenza lineare); per estensione, un genere o tipo; figurato, disposizione nativa, costituzione o uso

5450.gl: a puffing up of soul, loftiness, pride
