5451.g: trans-planting, i.e., (concretely) a shrub or vegetable
5451.gl: a planting; the thing planted, a plant
5451.gi: trapianto, cioè (concretamente) un arbusto o una pianta

5452.g: to set out in the earth, i.e., implant; figuratively, to instil doctrine
5452.gi: piantare nella terra, cioè impiantare; figurativamente, infondere dottrina

5453.g: probably originally, to "puff" or blow, i.e., to swell up; but only used in the implied sense, to germinate or grow (sprout, produce), literally or figuratively
5453.gl: to beget, bring forth, produce; to be born, to spring up, to grow; to shoot forth, spring up
5453.gi: probabilmente originariamente, "soffiare" o gonfiarsi, cioè gonfiarsi; ma usato solo nel senso implicito, germogliare o crescere (germogliare, produrre), letteralmente o figurativamente

5454.gl: a lurking hole, a burrow; a lair

5455.g: to emit a sound (animal, human or instrumental); by implication, to address in words or by name, also in imitation
5455.gl: to sound, emit a sound, to speak; of a cock: to crow; of men: to cry, cry out, cry aloud, speak with a loud voice; to call, to call one's self, either by one's own voice or though another; to send for, summon; to call out of (i.e., bid one to quit a place and come to one; to invite; to address, accost, call by a name
5455.gi: emettere un suono (animale, umano o strumentale); per implicazione, rivolgere parole o chiamare per nome, anche per imitazione

5456.g: a tone (articulate, bestial or artificial); by implication, an address (for any purpose), saying or language
5456.gl: a sound, a tone; of inanimate things, as musical instruments; a voice; of the sound of uttered words; speech; of a language, tongue
5456.gi: un tono (articolato, bestiale o artificiale); per implicazione, un indirizzo (per qualsiasi scopo), un detto o una lingua

5457.g: luminousness (in the widest application, natural or artificial, abstract or concrete, literal or figurative)
5457.gl: light; the light; emitted by a lamp; a heavenly light such as surrounds angels when they appear on earth; anything emitting light; a star; fire because it is light and sheds light; a lamp or torch; light, i.e., brightness; of a lamp; metaphorically; god is light because light has the extremely delicate, subtle, pure, brilliant quality; of truth and its knowledge, together with the spiritual purity associated with it; that which is exposed to the view of all, openly, publicly; reason, mind; the power of understanding especially moral and spiritual truth
5457.gi: luminosità (nella più ampia applicazione, naturale o artificiale, astratta o concreta, letterale o figurativa)

5458.g: an illuminator, i.e., (concretely) a luminary, or (abstractly) brilliancy
5458.gl: that which gives light, an illuminator; of the stars, sun and moon; light, brightness
5458.gi: un illuminatore, cioè (concretamente) un lume, o (astrattamente) splendore

5459.gl: light bringing, giving light; the planet venus, the morning star, day star; metaphorically christ
5459.gi: portatore di luce ("fosforo"), cioè (specialmente), la stella del mattino (figurativamente)

5460.gl: light; composed of light; of a bright character; full of light; well lit
5460.gi: lucido, cioè trasparente o ben illuminato (figurato)

5461.g: to shed rays, i.e., to shine or (transitively) to brighten up (literally or figuratively)
5461.gl: to give light, to shine; to enlighten, light up, illumine; to bring to light, render evident; to cause something to exist and thus come to light and become clear to all; to enlighten, spiritually, imbue with saving knowledge; to instruct, to inform, teach; to give understanding to
5461.gi: emettere raggi, cioè brillare o (transitivamente) illuminare (letteralmente o figurativamente)

5462.gl: the act of enlightening, illumination; brightness, bright light

5463.g: to be "cheer"ful, i.e., calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well
5463.gl: to rejoice, be glad; to rejoice exceedingly; to be well, thrive; in salutations, hail!; at the beginning of letters: to give one greeting, salute
5463.gi: essere "alle"gre, cioè serenamente felice o benestante; impersonalmente, specialmente come saluto (all'incontro o alla separazione), stare bene

5465.gl: to loosen, slacken, relax; to let down from a higher place to a lower

5466.g: a chaldaean (i.e., kasdi), or native or the region of the lower euphrates
5466.gi: un caldeo (cioè, kasdi), o nativo della regione del basso Eufrate

5467.g: difficult, i.e., dangerous, or (by implication) furious
5467.gl: hard to do, to take, to approach; hard to bear, troublesome, dangerous; harsh, fierce, savage
5467.gi: difficile, cioè pericoloso, o (per implicazione) furioso

5468.g: to be a bit-leader, i.e., to curb (figuratively)
5468.gl: to lead by a bridle, to guide; to bridle, hold in check, restrain
5468.gi: essere un conduttore di morso, cioè frenare (figurato)

5469.g: a curb or head-stall (as curbing the spirit)
5469.gi: un freno o un boccaglio (come freno allo spirito)

5471.gl: a worker in copper or iron, a smith
5471.gi: un lavoratore di rame o un brasatore

5472.gl: chalcedony is a precious stone of misty grey color, clouded with blue, yellow, or purple

5474.g: burnished copper, an alloy of copper (or gold) and silver having a brilliant lustre
5474.gl: some metal like gold if not more precious
5474.gi: rame lucidato, una lega di rame (o oro) e argento con splendido lustro

5475.g: copper (the substance, or some implement or coin made of it)
5475.gl: brass; what is made of brass, money, coins of brass (also of silver and gold)
5475.gi: rame (la sostanza, o qualche strumento o moneta fatta di esso)

5476.gl: on the ground, on the earth; to the ground

5477.g: chanaan (i.e., kenaan), the early name of palestine
5477.gl: [lowland]; the land of canaan; in a narrower sense: the part of palestine lying west of the jordan; in a wider sense: all of palestine
5477.gi: Canaan (cioè, Kenaan), il nome antico della Palestina

5478.g: a chanaanaean (i.e., kenaanite), or native of gentile palestine
5478.gl: canaanite, the name of the ancient inhabitants of palestine before its conquest by the israelites; in christ's time: a phoenician
5478.gi: un cananeo (cioè, kenaanita), o nativo della Palestina gentile

5479.gl: joy, gladness; the joy received from you; the cause or occasion of joy; of persons who are one's joy

5480.g: a scratch or etching, i.e., stamp (as a badge of servitude), or scupltured figure (statue)
5480.gl: a stamp, an imprinted mark; of the mark stamped on the forehead or the right hand as the badge of the followers of the antichrist; the mark branded upon horses; thing carved, sculpture, graven work; of idolatrous images
5480.gi: un graffio o incisione, cioè un timbro (come segno di servitù), o figura scolpita (statua)

5481.g: a graver (the tool or the person), i.e., (by implication) engraving (("character"), the figure stamped, i.e., an exact copy or (figuratively) representation)
5481.gl: the instrument used for engraving or carving; the mark stamped upon that instrument or wrought out on it; a mark or figure burned in (leviticus 13:28) or stamped on, an impression; the exact expression (the image) of any person or thing, marked likeness, precise reproduction in every respect, i.e., facsimile
5481.gi: un incisore (lo strumento o la persona), cioè (per implicazione) incisione (("carattere"), la figura impressa, cioè una copia esatta o (figurato) rappresentazione)

5482.g: a stake, i.e., (by implication) a palisade or rampart (military mound for circumvallation in a siege)
5482.gl: a pale or stake, a palisade; a palisade or rampart; pales between which earth, stones, trees, and timbers are heaped and packed together
5482.gi: un palo, cioè (per implicazione) una palizzata o un terrapieno (mucchio militare per la circumvallazione durante un assedio)

5483.g: to grant as a favor, i.e., gratuitously, in kindness, pardon or rescue
5483.gl: to do something pleasant or agreeable (to one), to do a favor to, gratify; to show one's self gracious, kind, benevolent; to grant forgiveness, to pardon; to give graciously, give freely, bestow; to forgive; graciously to restore one to another; to preserve for one a person in peril
5483.gi: concedere come favore, cioè gratuitamente, in gentilezza, perdono o salvataggio

5484.g: through favor of, i.e., on account of
5484.gl: in favor of, for the pleasure of; for, for the sake of; on this account, for this cause
5484.gi: per favore di, cioè a causa di

5485.g: graciousness (as gratifying), of manner or act (abstract or concrete; literal, figurative or spiritual; especially the divine influence upon the heart, and its reflection in the life; including gratitude)
5485.gl: grace; that which affords joy, pleasure, delight, sweetness, charm, loveliness: grace of speech; good will, loving-kindness, favor; of the merciful kindness by which god, exerting his holy influence upon souls, turns them to christ, keeps, strengthens, increases them in christian faith, knowledge, affection, and kindles them to the exercise of the christian virtues; what is due to grace; the spiritual condition of one governed by the power of divine grace; the token or proof of grace, benefit; a gift of grace; benefit, bounty; thanks, (for benefits, services, favors), recompense, reward
5485.gi: grazia (come gratificante), di modo o atto (astratto o concreto; letterale, figurativo o spirituale; specialmente l'influenza divina sul cuore, e la sua riflessione nella vita; includendo gratitudine)

5486.g: a (divine) gratuity, i.e., deliverance (from danger or passion); (specially), a (spiritual) endowment, i.e., (subjectively) religious qualification, or (objectively) miraculous faculty
5486.gl: a favor with which one receives without any merit of his own; the gift of divine grace; the gift of faith, knowledge, holiness, virtue; the economy of divine grace, by which the pardon of sin and eternal salvation is appointed to sinners in consideration of the merits of christ laid hold of by faith; grace or gifts denoting extraordinary powers, distinguishing certain christians and enabling them to serve the church of christ, the reception of which is due to the power of divine grace operating on their souls by the holy spirit
5486.gi: una (divina) gratificazione, cioè liberazione (dal pericolo o dalla passione); (specialmente), una (spirituale) dotazione, cioè (soggettivamente) qualificazione religiosa, o (oggettivamente) facoltà miracolosa

5487.g: to grace, i.e., indue with special honor
5487.gl: to make graceful; charming, lovely, agreeable; to peruse with grace, compass with favor; to honor with blessings
5487.gi: onorare, cioè investire di speciale onore

5488.g: charrhan (i.e., charan), a place in mesopotamia
5488.gl: [a mountaineer]; a city in mesopotamia, of great antiquity and made famous by the defeat of crassus
5488.gi: Carran (cioè, Charan), un luogo in Mesopotamia

5489.g: a sheet ("chart") of writing-material (as to be scribbled over)
5489.gi: un foglio ("carta") di materiale da scrivere (su cui si può scrivere a casaccio)

5490.gl: a gaping opening, a chasm, a gulf

5491.g: a lip (as a pouring place); figuratively, a margin (of water)
5491.gl: a lip, of the speaking mouth; metaphorically the sea shore
5491.gi: un labbro (come luogo di versamento); figurativamente, un margine (di acqua)

5492.g: to storm, i.e., (passively) to labor under a gale
5492.gl: to afflict with a tempest, to toss about upon the waves
5492.gi: assaltare, cioè (passivamente) faticare sotto un forte vento

5493.gi: un ruscello di tempesta, cioè torrente invernale

5494.g: akin to the base of 5490 through the idea of a channel), meaning a storm (as pouring rain); by implication, the rainy season, i.e., winter
5494.gl: winter; stormy or rainy weather, a tempest; winter, the winter season
5494.gi: affine alla base di 5490 attraverso l'idea di un canale), significando una tempesta (come pioggia torrenziale); per implicazione, la stagione delle piogge, cioè l'inverno

5495.g: the hand (literally or figuratively (power); especially (by hebraism) a means or instrument)
5495.gl: by the help or agency of any one, by means of any one; figuratively applied to god symbolising his might, activity, power; in creating the universe; in upholding and preserving (god is present protecting and aiding one); in punishing; in determining and controlling the destinies of men
5495.gi: la mano (letteralmente o figurato (potere); specialmente (per ebraismo) un mezzo o strumento)

5496.g: to be a hand-leader, i.e., to guide (a blind person)
5496.gi: essere un conduttore di mano, cioè guidare (una persona cieca)

5497.g: a hand-leader, i.e., personal conductor (of a blind person)
5497.gi: un conduttore manuale, cioè, conduttore personale (di una persona non vedente)

5498.g: something hand-written ("chirograph"), i.e., a manuscript (specially, a legal document or bond (figuratively))
5498.gl: a handwriting, what one has written by his own hand; a note of hand or writing in which one acknowledges that money has either been deposited with him or lent to him by another, to be returned at the appointed time
5498.gi: qualcosa di scritto a mano ("cirografo"), cioè un manoscritto (specialmente, un documento legale o obbligazione (figurato))

5499.gl: made by the hands i.e., the skill of men; of temples; of circumcision; of idols

5500.g: to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e., (generally) to select or appoint
5500.gl: to vote by stretching out the hand; to create or appoint by vote: one to have charge of some office or duty; to elect, create, appoint
5500.gi: essere un protettore di mano o un elettore (alzando la mano), cioè (genericamente) selezionare o nominare

5501.g: from an obsolete equivalent ????? (of uncertain derivation); more evil or aggravated (physically, mentally or morally)
5501.gi: da un equivalente obsoleto ????? (di derivazione incerta); più male o aggravato (fisicamente, mentalmente o moralmente)

5502.gl: cherubim, two golden figures of living creatures with two wings

5503.g: a widow (as lacking a husband), literally or figuratively
5503.gl: a widow; metaphorically a city stripped of its inhabitants and riches is represented under the figure of a widow
5503.gi: una vedova (come priva di marito), letteralmente o figurato

5504.g: "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto
5504.gi: "ieri"; per estensione, nel tempo passato o finora

5505.gl: a thousand, the number one thousand

5506.g: the commander of a thousand soldiers ("chiliarch"; i.e., colonel
5506.gl: a chiliarch, the commander of a thousand soldiers; the commander of a roman cohort (a military tribunal); any military commander
5506.gi: il comandante di mille soldati ('chiliarca'; cioè, colonnello)

5508.g: chios, an island in the mediterranean
5508.gl: [snowy]; is an island in the aegean, between samos and lesbos, not far from the shore of lydia

5509.gl: a tunic, an undergarment, usually worn next to the skin, a garment, a vestment

5511.gl: a chalamys, an outer garment usually worn over the tunic; a kind of short cloak worn by soldiers, military officers, magistrates, kings, emperors

5512.g: to throw out the lip, i.e., jeer at

5513.gl: tepid, lukewarm; metaphorically of the condition of the soul wretchedly fluctuating between a torpor and a fervour of love

5514.gl: [a green herb]; a christian woman of corinth

5515.gi: verde, cioè, verdastro, di colore bruno-rossastro

5516.gl: six hundred and sixty six, the meaning of which is the basis of much vain speculation

5517.g: dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e., (by implication) terrene
5517.gi: polveroso o sporco (simile a terra), cioè (per implicazione) terreno

5518.g: a choenix or certain dry measure
5518.gl: a choenix, a dry measure, containing four cotylae or two setarii (less than our quart, one litre) (or as much as would support a man of moderate appetite for a day)
5518.gi: un choenix o una certa misura secca

5520.g: to be bilious, i.e., (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric")
5520.gl: to be atrabilious; to be mad; to be angry, enraged

5521.g: "gall" or bile, i.e., (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.)
5521.gl: bile, gall; in the old testament used of other bitter things; wormwood; possibly myrrh
5521.gi: "fiele" o bile, cioè (per analogia) veleno o un antidolorifico (assenzio, papavero, ecc.)

5522.g: a heap (as poured out), i.e., rubbish; loose dirt
5522.gl: earth dug out, an earth heap; dust
5522.gi: un mucchio (come versato), cioè immondizia; terra scioltà

5523.gl: [a furnace of smoke]; a town in galilee

5524.g: to be a dance-leader, i.e., (generally) to furnish
5524.gl: to be a chorus leader, lead a chorus; to furnish the chorus at one's own expense; to procure and supply all things necessary to fit out a chorus; to supply, furnish abundantly
5524.gi: essere un maestro di danza, cioè (genericamente) fornire

5525.gl: a band (of dancers and singers), circular dance, a dance, dancing

5526.g: to fodder, i.e., (generally) to gorge (supply food in abundance)
5526.gl: to feed with herbs, grass, hay, to fill, satisfy with food, to fatten; of animals; to fill or satisfy men; to fulfil or satisfy the desire of any one
5526.gi: dare foraggi, cioè (in generale) saziare (fornire cibo in abbondanza)

5527.gl: feed, fodder for animals; food, (vegetable) sustenance, whether for men or flocks

5528.g: a "court" or "garden", i.e., (by implication, of pasture) herbage or vegetation
5528.gl: the place where grass grows and animals graze; grass, herbage, hay, provender; of green grass; of growing crops
5528.gi: un 'cortile' o 'giardino', cioè (per implicazione, di pascolo) erba o vegetazione

5529.gl: [the seer]; the house steward of herod antipas

5530.g: to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e., (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner
5530.gl: to receive a loan; borrow; to take for one's use, to use; to make use of a thing
5530.gi: fornire ciò che è necessario; (dare un oracolo, 'pascolare' (toccare leggermente), illuminare, ecc.), cioè (per implicazione) impiegare o (per estensione) agire verso qualcuno in un dato modo

5532.g: employment, i.e., an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution
5532.gi: impiego, cioè, un affare; anche (per implicazione) occasione, richiesta, requisito o indigenza

5535.g: to make (i.e., have) necessity, i.e., be in want of
5535.gl: to have need of, to be in want of
5535.gi: creare (cioè avere) necessità, cioè essere in mancanza di

5536.g: something useful or needed, i.e., wealth, price
5536.gl: a thing, a matter, affair, event, business; specifically money, riches
5536.gi: qualcosa di utile o necessario, cioè, ricchezza, prezzo

5537.g: to utter an oracle (compare the original sense of g5530), i.e., divinely intimate; by implication, (compare the secular sense of g5532) to constitute a firm for business, i.e., (generally) bear as a title
5537.gl: to transact business, especially to manage public affairs; to advise or consult with one about public affairs; to make answer to those who ask for advice, present enquiries or requests, etc.; of judges, magistrates, rulers, kings; to give a response to those consulting an oracle, to give a divine command or admonition, to teach from heaven; to be divinely commanded, admonished, instructed; to be the mouthpiece of divine revelations, to promulgate the commands of god; to assume or take to one's self a name from one's public business; to receive a name or title, be called
5537.gi: pronunciare un oracolo (cfr. il senso originale di g5530), cioè divinamente intimo; per implicazione, (cfr. il senso secolare di g5532) costituire una società per affari, cioè (genericamente) portare come titolo

5540.g: employment, i.e., (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body)
5540.gl: use; of the sexual use of a woman
5540.gi: impiego, cioè (specialmente), rapporto sessuale (come occupazione del corpo)

5541.g: to show oneself useful, i.e., act benevolently
5541.gl: to show one's self mild, to be kind, use kindness

5542.gl: fair speaking, the smooth and plausible address which simulates goodness

5543.g: employed, i.e., (by implication) useful (in manner or morals)
5543.gl: fit, fit for use, useful; virtuous, good; manageable; mild, pleasant (as opposed to harsh, hard sharp, bitter); of things: more pleasant, of people, kind, benevolent
5543.gi: impiegato, cioè (per implicazione) utile (nel comportamento o nei costumi)

5544.g: usefulness, i.e., morally, excellence (in character or demeanor)
5544.gi: utilità, cioè moralmente, eccellenza (nel carattere o nel comportamento)

5545.g: an unguent or smearing, i.e., (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the holy spirit
5545.gl: anything smeared on, unguent, ointment, usually prepared by the hebrews from oil and aromatic herbs
5545.gi: un unguento o unto, cioè (figurato) il dono speciale ('crisma') dello Spirito Santo

5546.g: a christian, i.e., follower of christ
5546.gi: un cristiano, cioè, seguace di Cristo

5547.g: anointed, i.e., the messiah, an epithet of jesus
5547.gl: [anointed]; christ was the messiah, the son of god; anointed
5547.gi: unto, cioè il messia, un epiteto di Gesù

5548.g: to smear or rub with oil, i.e., (by implication) to consecrate to an office or religious service
5548.gl: to anoint; consecrating jesus to the messianic office, and furnishing him with the necessary powers for its administration; enduing christians with the gifts of the holy spirit
5548.gi: ungere o strofinare con olio, cioè (per implicazione) consacrare a un ufficio o servizio religioso

5550.g: a space of time (in general, and thus properly distinguished from g2540, which designates a fixed or special occasion; and from g0165, which denotes a particular period) or interval; by extension, an individual opportunity; by implication, delay
5550.gi: uno spazio di tempo (in generale, e quindi opportunamente distinto da g2540, che designa un'occasione fissa o speciale; e da g0165, che denota un periodo particolare) o intervallo; per estensione, un'opportunità individuale; per implicazione, ritardo

5551.g: to be a time-wearer, i.e., to procrastinate (linger)
5551.gl: to wear away time, spend time

5552.gl: golden; made of gold; overlaid or covered with gold

5553.g: a golden article, i.e., gold plating, ornament, or coin
5553.gl: gold, both that which lies imbedded in the earth and is dug out of it; that which has been smelted and wrought; of a gold coin; of golden ornaments; of precious things made of gold
5553.gi: un oggetto d'oro, cioè, placcatura d'oro, ornamento o moneta

5554.g: gold-ringed, i.e., wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry
5554.gl: gold ringed, adorned with gold rings
5554.gi: con anello d'oro, cioè, che porta un anello d'oro o simili gioielli

5555.gl: chrysolite is a precious stone of golden color
5555.gi: pietra d'oro, cioè una gemma gialla ("cristolita")

5556.gl: chrysoprasus (chrysoprase), a greenish-yellow (or deep green) gemstone

5557.g: gold; by extension, a golden article, as an ornament or coin
5557.gl: precious things made of gold, golden ornaments; an image made of gold; stamped gold, gold coin
5557.gi: oro; per estensione, un oggetto d'oro, come ornamento o moneta

5558.g: to gild, i.e., bespangle with golden ornaments
5558.gl: to adorn with gold, to gild; of a woman ornamented with gold so profusely that she seems to be gilded
5558.gi: dorare, cioè abbellire con ornamenti d'oro

5559.g: the body (properly, its surface or skin)
5559.gl: the surface of the body, the skin
5559.gi: il corpo (propriamente, la sua superficie o pelle)

5560.gl: lame; deprived of a foot, maimed

5561.g: room, i.e., a space of territory (more or less extensive; often including its inhabitants)
5561.gl: the space lying between two places or limits; a region or country i.e., a tract of land; the (rural) region surrounding a city or village, the country; the region with towns and villages which surround a metropolis; land which is ploughed or cultivated, ground
5561.gi: spazio, cioè, un territorio (più o meno esteso; spesso inclusi i suoi abitanti)

5562.g: to be in (give) space, i.e., (intransitively) to pass, enter, or (transitively) to hold, admit (literally or figuratively)
5562.gl: to leave space (which may be filled or occupied by another), to make room, give place, yield; to retire; metaphorically to betake one's self, turn one's self; to go forward, advance, proceed, succeed; to have space or room for receiving or holding something
5562.gi: essere in (dare) spazio, cioè, (intransitivo) passare, entrare, o (transitivo) contenere, ammettere (letteralmente o figurato)

5563.g: to place room between, i.e., part; reflexively, to go away
5563.gl: to separate, divide, part, put asunder, to separate one's self from, to depart; of divorce; to depart, go away
5563.gi: mettere spazio tra, cioè separarsi; riflessivamente, andarsene

5564.g: a spot or plot of ground
5564.gl: a space, a place, a region, a district; a piece of ground, a field, land
5564.gi: una macchia o un appezzamento di terra

5565.g: at a space, i.e., separately or apart from (often as preposition)
5565.gi: a una distanza, cioè separatamente o a parte (spesso come preposizione)

5566.gl: the northwest wind; for the quarter of the heavens from which the wind blows

5567.g: to twitch or twang, i.e., to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes)
5567.gl: to pluck off, pull out; to cause to vibrate by touching, to twang; to touch or strike the chord, to twang the strings of a musical instrument so that they gently vibrate; to play on a stringed instrument, to play, the harp, etc.; to sing to the music of the harp; in the new testament to sing a hymn, to celebrate the praises of god in song
5567.gi: tirare o pizzicare, cioè suonare uno strumento a corda (celebrare il culto divino con musica e odi accompagnate)

5568.g: a set piece of music, i.e., a sacred ode (accompanied with the voice, harp or other instrument; a "psalm"); collectively, the book of the psalms
5568.gl: a striking, twanging; of a striking the chords of a musical instrument; of a pious song, a psalm
5568.gi: un brano musicale, cioè, un'ode sacra (accompagnata dalla voce, arpa o altro strumento; un "salmo"); collettivamente, il libro dei Salmi

5569.g: a spurious brother, i.e., pretended associate
5569.gl: a false brother; one who ostentatiously professes to be a christian, but is destitute of christian knowledge and piety
5569.gi: un fratello spurio, cioè, associato presunto

5570.g: a spurious apostle, i.e., pretended pracher
5570.gl: a false apostle, one who falsely claims to be an ambassador of christ
5570.gi: un apostolo spurio, cioè, predicatore presunto

5572.g: a spurious teacher, i.e., propagator of erroneous christian doctrine
5572.gi: un maestro spurio, cioè, propagatore di dottrina cristiana erronea

5573.g: mendacious, i.e., promulgating erroneous christian doctrine
5573.gi: mendace, cioè promulgare dottrina cristiana errata

5574.g: to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood
5574.gl: to lie, to speak deliberate falsehoods; to deceive one by a lie, to lie to
5574.gi: pronunciare una falsità o tentare di ingannare con menzogne

5575.g: a spurious witness, i.e., bearer of untrue testimony
5575.gi: un testimone spurio, cioè, portatore di testimonianza falsa

5576.g: to be an untrue testifier, i.e., offer falsehood in evidence
5576.gl: to utter falsehoods in giving testimony, to testify falsely, to bear false witness
5576.gi: essere un falso testimone, cioè offrire falsità come prova

5578.g: a spurious prophet, i.e., pretended foreteller or religious impostor
5578.gl: one who, acting the part of a divinely inspired prophet, utters falsehoods under the name of divine prophecies; a false prophet
5578.gi: un falso profeta, cioè un presunto veggente o impostore religioso

5579.gl: a lie; conscious and intentional falsehood; in a broad sense, whatever is not what it seems to be; of perverse, impious, deceitful precepts

5580.gl: a false christ (or messiah); one who falsely lays claim to the name and office of the messiah

5582.gl: a falsehood, a lie; the perfidy by which a man by sinning breaks faith with god

5583.gl: a liar; one who breaks faith; a false and faithless man

5584.g: to manipulate, i.e., verify by contact; figuratively, to search for
5584.gl: to handle, touch and feel; metaphorically mentally to seek after tokens of a person or a thing
5584.gi: manipolare, cioè verificare per contatto; figuratamente, cercare

5585.g: to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e., (generally) to compute
5585.gl: to count with pebbles, to compute, calculate, reckon; to give one's vote by casting a pebble into the urn; to decide by voting
5585.gi: usare ciottoli per il conteggio, cioè (genericamente) calcolare

5586.g: a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e., (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote
5586.gl: a small worn smooth stone, a pebble; in the ancient courts of justice the accused were condemned by black pebbles and the acquitted by white; a vote (on account of the use of pebbles in voting)
5586.gi: ciottolo (come levigato dal maneggio), cioè (per implicazione, usato come gettone o scheda) un verdetto (di assoluzione) o biglietto (di ammissione); un voto

5587.gl: a whispering, i.e., secret slandering; of the magical murmuring of a charmer of snakes

5590.g: breath, i.e., (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from g4151, which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from g2222, which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the hebrew h5315, h7307 and h2416)
5590.gl: breath; the breath of life; the vital force which animates the body and shows itself in breathing; of animals; of men; life; that in which there is life; a living being, a living soul; the soul; the seat of the feelings, desires, affections, aversions (our heart, soul etc.); the (human) soul in so far as it is constituted that by the right use of the aids offered it by god it can attain its highest end and secure eternal blessedness, the soul regarded as a moral being designed for everlasting life; the soul as an essence which differs from the body and is not dissolved by death (distinguished from other parts of the body)
5590.gi: respiro, cioè (per implicazione) spirito, astrattamente o concretamente (solo il principio sensibile animale; così distinto da un lato da g4151, che è l'anima razionale e immortale; e dall'altro da g2222, che è pura vitalità, anche delle piante: questi termini corrispondono esattamente rispettivamente all'ebraico h5315, h7307 e h2416)

5591.g: sensitive, i.e., animate (in distinction on the one hand from g4152, which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from g5446, which is the lower or bestial nature)
5591.gl: of or belonging to breath; having the nature and characteristics of the breath; the principal of animal life, which men have in common with the brutes; governed by breath; the sensuous nature with its subjection to appetite and passion
5591.gi: sensibile, cioè animato (in distinzione da un lato da g4152, che è la natura superiore o rinnovata; e dall'altro da g5446, che è la natura inferiore o bestiale)

5593.gl: cold, cool; of cool water; metaphorically; cold i.e., sluggish, inert; in mind: of one destitute of warm christian faith and the desire for holiness

5594.g: to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from g4154, which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of g0109, which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e., (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively)
5594.gl: to breathe, blow, cool by blowing; to be made or grow cool or cold; metaphorically of waning love
5594.gi: respirare (volontariamente ma delicatamente, differendo da un lato da g4154, che denota propriamente una respirazione forzata; e dall'altro dalla base di g0109, che si riferisce propriamente a una brezza inanimata), cioè (per implicazione, di riduzione della temperatura per evaporazione) raffreddare (figuratamente)

5595.g: to supply with bits, i.e., (generally) to nourish
5595.gl: to feed by putting a bit or crumb (of food) into the mouth; of infants, young animals etc.; to feed, nourish; to give a thing to feed someone, feed out to

5596.g: a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e., a mouthful
5596.gi: briciola o boccone (come se fosse sfregato via), cioè una bocciata

5597.g: to triturate, i.e., (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand)
5597.gl: to rub, to rub to pieces
5597.gi: triturare, cioè (per analogia) strofinare via (i chicchi dai gusci con le dita o la mano)

5598.g: the last letter of the greek alphabet, i.e., (figuratively) the finality
5598.gl: the last letter in the greek alphabet; the last
5598.gi: l'ultima lettera dell'alfabeto greco, cioè (figurativamente) la finalità

5599.g: as a sign of the vocative case, o; as a note of exclamation, oh
5599.gi: come segno del caso vocativo, o; come nota di esclamazione, oh

5600.g: (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with g1487 and its comparative, as well as with other particles) be
5600.gi: (può, potrebbe, può, potrebbe, vorrebbe, dovrebbe, deve, ecc.; anche con g1487 e il suo comparativo, così come con altre particelle) essere

5602.g: in this same spot, i.e., here or hither
5602.gi: in questo stesso luogo, cioè qui o verso qui

5603.g: a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while g5215 denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and g5568 still more specially, a hebrew cantillation)
5603.gi: un canto o "ode" (il termine generale per qualsiasi parola cantata; mentre g5215 denota specialmente una composizione metrica religiosa, e g5568 ancora più specialmente, una cantillazione ebraica)

5604.g: a pang or throe, especially of childbirth
5604.gl: the pain of childbirth, travail pain, birth pangs; intolerable anguish, in reference to the dire calamities precede the advent of the messiah
5604.gi: un crampo o un colpo, specialmente del parto

5605.g: to experience the pains of parturition (literally or figuratively)
5605.gl: to feel the pains of child birth, to travail
5605.gi: subire i dolori del parto (letteralmente o figuratamente)

5606.g: the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne)
5606.gi: la spalla (come quella su cui si portano i pesi)

5608.g: to purchase (synonymous with the earlier g4092)

5610.gl: a certain definite time or season fixed by natural law and returning with the revolving year; of the seasons of the year, spring, summer, autumn, winter; the daytime (bounded by the rising and setting of the sun), a day; a twelfth part of the day-time, an hour, (the twelve hours of the day are reckoned from the rising to the setting of the sun); any definite time, point of time, moment

5611.g: belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e., (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively))
5611.gl: blooming, beautiful (used of the human body)
5611.gi: appartenente al momento o stagione giusta (tempestivo), cioè (per implicazione) fiorente (bello (figurato))

5612.gl: to roar, to howl (of a lion, wolf, dog, and other beasts); of men, to raise a loud and inarticulate cry: either of grief, or of joy; to sing with a loud voice

5613.g: which how, i.e., in that manner (very variously used, as follows)
5613.gi: come, cioè in quel modo (usato in vari modi, come segue)

5614.g: oh save!; hosanna (i.e., hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration
5614.gi: oh, salva!; osanna (cioè, hosia-na), un'esclamazione di adorazione

5615.g: as thus, i.e., in the same way

5616.gl: as it were, (had been), as though, as, like as, like; about, nearly; before numerals; before a measure of time

5617.gl: [salvation]; the well known hebrew prophet, son of beeri and contemporary with isaiah

5619.g: just as if, i.e., as it were
5619.gi: come se, cioè per così dire

5620.g: so too, i.e., thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow)
5620.gl: so that, insomuch that; so then, therefore, wherefore
5620.gi: così anche, cioè quindi (in varie relazioni di consecuzione, come segue)

5621.g: an earlet, i.e., one of the ears, or perhaps the lobe of the ear
5621.gi: un orecchino, cioè una delle orecchie, o forse il lobo dell'orecchio

5623.g: to be useful, i.e., to benefit
5623.gl: to assist, to be useful or advantageous, to profit
